name: BezoutCounterexample.det_M
statement: theorem det_M : M.det = -Δ
proof:
:= by
  simp [M, Δ, Matrix.det_fin_two]
  ring

name: BezoutCounterexample.one_add_x_add_one_sub_x
statement: theorem one_add_x_add_one_sub_x : (1 + x) + (1 - x) = (MvPolynomial.C (2 : ℚ) : A₀)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_ofNat]; ring

name: BezoutCounterexample.span_entries_M
statement: theorem span_entries_M : (Ideal.span {1 + x, y, 1 - x} : Ideal A₀) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.eq_top_iff_one]
  have h2 : MvPolynomial.C (1 / 2 : ℚ) * (1 + x) + MvPolynomial.C (1 / 2 : ℚ) * (1 - x) =
      (1 : A₀) := by
    rw [← mul_add, one_add_x_add_one_sub_x, ← map_mul]
    norm_num
  have hmem : MvPolynomial.C (1 / 2 : ℚ) * (1 + x) + MvPolynomial.C (1 / 2 : ℚ) * (1 - x) ∈
      (Ideal.span {1 + x, y, 1 - x} : Ideal A₀) :=
    Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.subset_span (by simp)))
      (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.subset_span (by simp)))
  rwa [h2] at hmem

name: BezoutCounterexample.M_sq
statement: theorem M_sq : M * M - (2 : A₀) • M = Δ • (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) A₀)
proof:
:= by
  refine Matrix.ext fun i j => ?_
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [M, Δ] <;> ring

name: BezoutCounterexample.M_map
statement:
theorem M_map (A : Type*) [CommRing A] (ι : A₀ →+* A) (z : A →+* ℝ) :
    (M.map ι).map z = Mreal (z (ι x)) (z (ι y))
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [M, Mreal]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Mreal_mulVec
statement:
lemma Mreal_mulVec (a b : ℝ) (w : Fin 2 → ℝ) :
    (Mreal a b).mulVec w = ![(1 + a) * w 0 + b * w 1, b * w 0 + (1 - a) * w 1]
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  fin_cases i <;> simp [Mreal, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_two]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Mreal_det
statement: theorem Mreal_det (a b : ℝ) : (Mreal a b).det = 1 - a ^ 2 - b ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [Mreal, Matrix.det_fin_two]; ring

name: BezoutCounterexample.Mreal_trace
statement: theorem Mreal_trace (a b : ℝ) : (Mreal a b).trace = 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [Mreal, Matrix.trace_fin_two]; ring

name: BezoutCounterexample.half_Mreal_idempotent
statement:
theorem half_Mreal_idempotent {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 = 1) :
    IsIdempotentElem ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • Mreal a b)
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsIdempotentElem
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [Mreal, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two] <;> nlinarith [hab]

name: BezoutCounterexample.rank_pos_of_ne_zero
statement: lemma rank_pos_of_ne_zero {A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ} (h : A ≠ 0) : 0 < A.rank
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]
  intro h0
  apply h
  rw [Matrix.rank, Submodule.finrank_eq_zero, LinearMap.range_eq_bot] at h0
  ext i j
  have := congrArg (fun f => f (Pi.single j 1) i) h0
  simpa [Matrix.mulVec_single] using this

name: BezoutCounterexample.half_Mreal_rank
statement:
theorem half_Mreal_rank {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 = 1) :
    ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • Mreal a b).rank = 1
proof:
:= by
  set P := (1 / 2 : ℝ) • Mreal a b with hPdef
  have hP : P * P = P := half_Mreal_idempotent hab
  have h1 : P * (1 - P) = 0 := by rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_one, hP, sub_self]
  have hsum := Matrix.rank_add_rank_le_card_of_mul_eq_zero h1
  have htr : P.trace = 1 := by
    rw [hPdef, Matrix.trace_smul, Mreal_trace, smul_eq_mul]; norm_num
  have hP0 : P ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; rw [h, Matrix.trace_zero] at htr; exact zero_ne_one htr
  have hQ0 : (1 - P) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have := congrArg Matrix.trace h
    rw [Matrix.trace_sub, htr, Matrix.trace_one, Matrix.trace_zero] at this
    norm_num at this
  have r1 := rank_pos_of_ne_zero hP0
  have r2 := rank_pos_of_ne_zero hQ0
  simp only [Fintype.card_fin] at hsum
  omega

name: BezoutCounterexample.mem_lineBundle_iff
statement:
lemma mem_lineBundle_iff {X Y : K → ℝ} {z : K} {w : Fin 2 → ℝ} :
    w ∈ lineBundle X Y z ↔ w ∈ Set.range (Mreal (X z) (Y z)).mulVec
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨u, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨(1 / 2 : ℝ) • u, by simp [Matrix.mulVec_smul]⟩
  · rintro ⟨u, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨(2 : ℝ) • u, ?_⟩
    simp only [Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, Matrix.mulVec_smul, Matrix.smul_mulVec, smul_smul]
    norm_num

name: BezoutCounterexample.finrank_lineBundle
statement:
theorem finrank_lineBundle {X Y : K → ℝ} (hXY : ∀ z, X z ^ 2 + Y z ^ 2 = 1) (z : K) :
    Module.finrank ℝ (lineBundle X Y z) = 1
proof:
:=
  half_Mreal_rank (hXY z)

name: BezoutCounterexample.lineBundle_comp
statement:
theorem lineBundle_comp {K' : Type*} (X Y : K → ℝ) (q : K' → K) (z : K') :
    lineBundle (X ∘ q) (Y ∘ q) z = lineBundle X Y (q z)
proof: := rfl

name: BezoutCounterexample.lineBundle_locally_trivial
statement:
theorem lineBundle_locally_trivial {X Y : K → ℝ} (hX : Continuous X) (hY : Continuous Y)
    (z₀ : K) : ∃ U ∈ 𝓝 z₀, ∃ v : K → Fin 2 → ℝ, Continuous v ∧
      ∀ z ∈ U, v z ≠ 0 ∧ v z ∈ lineBundle X Y z
proof:
:= by
  have hcol : ∀ (j : Fin 2) (z : K), (fun i => Mreal (X z) (Y z) i j) ∈ lineBundle X Y z :=
    fun j z => mem_lineBundle_iff.2 ⟨Pi.single j 1, by
      ext i; simp [Matrix.mulVec_single]⟩
  by_cases h : 1 + X z₀ ≠ 0
  · refine ⟨{z | 1 + X z ≠ 0}, (isOpen_ne_fun (continuous_const.add hX)
      continuous_const).mem_nhds h, fun z i => Mreal (X z) (Y z) i 0, ?_, fun z hz => ⟨?_, hcol 0 z⟩⟩
    · refine continuous_pi fun i => ?_
      fin_cases i <;> simp [Mreal] <;> fun_prop
    · intro h0
      have := congrFun h0 0
      simp [Mreal] at this
      exact hz this
  · have h1 : 1 - X z₀ ≠ 0 := by
      have hx : 1 + X z₀ = 0 := not_ne_iff.1 h
      intro h'; linarith
    refine ⟨{z | 1 - X z ≠ 0}, (isOpen_ne_fun (continuous_const.sub hX)
      continuous_const).mem_nhds h1, fun z i => Mreal (X z) (Y z) i 1, ?_,
      fun z hz => ⟨?_, hcol 1 z⟩⟩
    · refine continuous_pi fun i => ?_
      fin_cases i <;> simp [Mreal] <;> fun_prop
    · intro h0
      have := congrFun h0 1
      simp [Mreal] at this
      exact hz this

name: BezoutCounterexample.cross_eq_zero_of_mem_range
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hp
  obtain ⟨w', rfl⟩ := hq
  simp only [Mreal_mulVec, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one]
  linear_combination (-(w 0 * w' 1 - w 1 * w' 0)) * hab

name: BezoutCounterexample.exists_smul_of_cross_eq_zero
statement:
lemma exists_smul_of_cross_eq_zero {p q : Fin 2 → ℝ} (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (h : p 0 * q 1 - p 1 * q 0 = 0) : ∃ t : ℝ, q = t • p
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h0 : p 0 = 0
  · have h1 : p 1 ≠ 0 := by
      intro h1
      apply hp
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [h0, h1]
    refine ⟨q 1 / p 1, ?_⟩
    ext i
    fin_cases i
    · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, h0, mul_zero]
      have : p 1 * q 0 = 0 := by rw [h0] at h; linarith
      rcases mul_eq_zero.1 this with h' | h'
      · exact absurd h' h1
      · exact h'
    · simp only [Fin.mk_one, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      field_simp
  · refine ⟨q 0 / p 0, ?_⟩
    ext i
    fin_cases i
    · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      field_simp
    · simp only [Fin.mk_one, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      field_simp
      linarith

name: BezoutCounterexample.eq_or_eq_neg_of_mem_range
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : p ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at hp1
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := exists_smul_of_cross_eq_zero hp0 (cross_eq_zero_of_mem_range hab hp hq)
  rw [norm_smul, hp1, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs] at hq1
  rcases abs_eq (zero_le_one' ℝ) |>.1 hq1 with rfl | rfl
  · left; simp
  · right; simp

name: BezoutCounterexample.smul_mem_range
statement:
lemma smul_mem_range {A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ} {p : Fin 2 → ℝ} (hp : p ∈ range A.mulVec)
    (c : ℝ) : c • p ∈ range A.mulVec
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hp
  exact ⟨c • w, Matrix.mulVec_smul A c w⟩

name: BezoutCounterexample.orientation_descent
statement:
theorem orientation_descent {K' K : Type*} [TopologicalSpace K'] [TopologicalSpace K]
    [CompactSpace K'] [T2Space K] {q : K' → K} (hq : IsMonotoneSurjection q)
    (X Y : K → ℝ) (_hX : Continuous X) (_hY : Continuous Y) (hXY : ∀ z, X z ^ 2 + Y z ^ 2 = 1)
    (h : IsOrientable (X ∘ q) (Y ∘ q)) : IsOrientable X Y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hvc, hv⟩ := h
  
  set u : K' → Fin 2 → ℝ := fun z => ‖v z‖⁻¹ • v z with hu_def
  have hnorm : ∀ z, ‖v z‖ ≠ 0 := fun z => norm_ne_zero_iff.2 (hv z).1
  have huc : Continuous u :=
    ((hvc.norm).inv₀ hnorm).smul hvc
  have hu1 : ∀ z, ‖u z‖ = 1 := fun z => by
    simp only [hu_def, norm_smul, norm_inv, norm_norm]
    exact inv_mul_cancel₀ (hnorm z)
  have hurange : ∀ z, u z ∈ range (Mreal (X (q z)) (Y (q z))).mulVec := fun z =>
    smul_mem_range (mem_lineBundle_iff.1 (hv z).2) _
  
  
  have hconst : ∀ z₁ z₂, q z₁ = q z₂ → u z₁ = u z₂ := by
    intro z₁ z₂ h12
    have hF : IsPreconnected (q ⁻¹' {q z₁}) := (hq.isConnected_fiber (q z₁)).isPreconnected
    have hT : IsDiscrete ({u z₁, -u z₁} : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) :=
      (Set.toFinite _).isDiscrete
    refine hF.constant_of_mapsTo hT huc.continuousOn ?_ (mem_preimage.2 rfl)
      (mem_preimage.2 h12.symm)
    intro z hz
    have hz' : q z = q z₁ := hz
    have h1 := hurange z
    have h2 := hurange z₁
    rw [hz'] at h1
    rcases eq_or_eq_neg_of_mem_range (hXY (q z₁)) h2 h1 (hu1 z₁) (hu1 z) with h | h
    · rw [h]; exact Or.inl rfl
    · rw [h]; exact Or.inr rfl
  
  have hqs := hq.surjective
  let σ : K → K' := Function.surjInv hqs
  have hσ : ∀ z, q (σ z) = z := Function.surjInv_eq hqs
  have hquot : IsQuotientMap q :=
    IsClosedMap.isQuotientMap (hq.continuous.isClosedMap) hq.continuous hqs
  refine ⟨fun z => u (σ z), ?_, fun z => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · rw [hquot.continuous_iff]
    convert huc using 1
    funext z
    exact hconst _ _ (hσ (q z))
  · intro h0
    have h0' : u (σ z) = 0 := h0
    have := hu1 (σ z)
    rw [h0', norm_zero] at this
    exact zero_ne_one this
  · have := hurange (σ z)
    rw [hσ z] at this
    exact mem_lineBundle_iff.2 this

name: BezoutCounterexample.not_isOrientable_comp
statement:
theorem not_isOrientable_comp {K' K : Type*} [TopologicalSpace K'] [TopologicalSpace K]
    [CompactSpace K'] [T2Space K] {q : K' → K} (hq : IsMonotoneSurjection q)
    (X Y : K → ℝ) (hX : Continuous X) (hY : Continuous Y) (hXY : ∀ z, X z ^ 2 + Y z ^ 2 = 1)
    (h : ¬ IsOrientable X Y) : ¬ IsOrientable (X ∘ q) (Y ∘ q)
proof:
:=
  fun h' => h (orientation_descent hq X Y hX hY hXY h')

name: BezoutCounterexample.IsMonotoneSurjection.isConnected_preimage_of_isClosed
statement:
theorem IsMonotoneSurjection.isConnected_preimage_of_isClosed {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
    [TopologicalSpace Y] [CompactSpace X] [T2Space Y] {q : X → Y} (hq : IsMonotoneSurjection q)
    {C : Set Y} (hC : IsClosed C) (hCc : IsConnected C) : IsConnected (q ⁻¹' C)
proof:
:= by
  have hCl : IsClosed (q ⁻¹' C) := hC.preimage hq.continuous
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hCc.nonempty
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hq.surjective c
    exact ⟨z, hc⟩
  rw [isPreconnected_iff_subset_of_fully_disjoint_closed hCl]
  intro F G hF hG hsub hdisj
  
  have hfib : ∀ c ∈ C, q ⁻¹' {c} ⊆ F ∨ q ⁻¹' {c} ⊆ G := by
    intro c hc
    have hsub' : q ⁻¹' {c} ⊆ F ∪ G := fun z hz =>
      hsub (show q z ∈ C by rw [show q z = c from hz]; exact hc)
    exact (isPreconnected_iff_subset_of_fully_disjoint_closed
      (isClosed_singleton.preimage hq.continuous)).1 (hq.isConnected_fiber c).isPreconnected
      F G hF hG hsub' hdisj
  
  set F' := q '' (F ∩ q ⁻¹' C)
  set G' := q '' (G ∩ q ⁻¹' C)
  have hF' : IsClosed F' :=
    ((hF.inter hCl).isCompact.image hq.continuous).isClosed
  have hG' : IsClosed G' :=
    ((hG.inter hCl).isCompact.image hq.continuous).isClosed
  have hcov : C ⊆ F' ∪ G' := by
    intro c hc
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hq.surjective c
    rcases hsub (show z ∈ q ⁻¹' C from hc) with h | h
    · exact Or.inl ⟨z, ⟨h, hc⟩, rfl⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨z, ⟨h, hc⟩, rfl⟩
  have hdisj' : Disjoint F' G' := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    rintro c ⟨z, ⟨hzF, hzC⟩, rfl⟩ ⟨w, ⟨hwG, -⟩, hw⟩
    rcases hfib (q z) hzC with h | h
    · exact Set.disjoint_left.1 hdisj (h (show q w = q z from hw)) hwG
    · exact Set.disjoint_left.1 hdisj hzF (h rfl)
  rcases (isPreconnected_iff_subset_of_fully_disjoint_closed hC).1 hCc.isPreconnected
      F' G' hF' hG' hcov hdisj' with h | h
  · left
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨w, ⟨hwF, -⟩, hw⟩ := h hz
    rcases hfib (q z) hz with h' | h'
    · exact h' rfl
    · exact absurd (h' (show q w = q z from hw)) (Set.disjoint_left.1 hdisj hwF)
  · right
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨w, ⟨hwG, -⟩, hw⟩ := h hz
    rcases hfib (q z) hz with h' | h'
    · exact absurd hwG (Set.disjoint_left.1 hdisj (h' (show q w = q z from hw)))
    · exact h' rfl

name: BezoutCounterexample.IsMonotoneSurjection.isConnected_preimage
statement:
theorem IsMonotoneSurjection.isConnected_preimage {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
    [TopologicalSpace Y] [CompactSpace X] [T2Space Y] {q : X → Y} (hq : IsMonotoneSurjection q)
    {C : Set Y} (hC : IsCompact C) (hCc : IsConnected C) : IsConnected (q ⁻¹' C)
proof:
:=
  hq.isConnected_preimage_of_isClosed hC.isClosed hCc

name: BezoutCounterexample.IsMonotoneSurjection.comp
statement:
theorem IsMonotoneSurjection.comp {X Y Z : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    [TopologicalSpace Z] [CompactSpace X] [T2Space Y] [T2Space Z] {q₁ : X → Y} {q₂ : Y → Z}
    (h₂ : IsMonotoneSurjection q₂) (h₁ : IsMonotoneSurjection q₁) :
    IsMonotoneSurjection (q₂ ∘ q₁) where
  continuous
proof:
:= h₂.continuous.comp h₁.continuous
  surjective := h₂.surjective.comp h₁.surjective
  isConnected_fiber z := by
    rw [preimage_comp]
    exact h₁.isConnected_preimage_of_isClosed (isClosed_singleton.preimage h₂.continuous)
      (h₂.isConnected_fiber z)

name: BezoutCounterexample.IsMonotoneSurjOn.trans
statement:
theorem IsMonotoneSurjOn.trans {X Y Z : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    [TopologicalSpace Z] [T2Space Y] [T2Space Z] {f : X → Y} {g : Y → Z}
    {K'' : Set X} {K' : Set Y} {K : Set Z} (hK'' : IsCompact K'')
    (hg : IsMonotoneSurjOn g K' K) (hf : IsMonotoneSurjOn f K'' K') :
    IsMonotoneSurjOn (g ∘ f) K'' K
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨mg, sg⟩ := hg
  obtain ⟨mf, sf⟩ := hf
  refine ⟨mg.comp mf, ?_⟩
  have := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.1 hK''
  have heq : (mg.comp mf).restrict (g ∘ f) K'' K = (mg.restrict g K' K) ∘ (mf.restrict f K'' K') := by
    funext z; rfl
  rw [heq]
  exact sg.comp sf

name: BezoutCounterexample.Δ_eval
statement: lemma Δ_eval (z : RealPt A₀) : z Δ = z x ^ 2 + z y ^ 2 - 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [Δ, map_sub, map_add, map_pow, map_one]

name: BezoutCounterexample.K₀_circle
statement: lemma K₀_circle {z : RealPt A₀} (hz : z ∈ K₀) : z x ^ 2 + z y ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have : z Δ = 0 := hz
  rw [Δ_eval] at this
  linarith

name: BezoutCounterexample.evalPt_x
statement: @[simp] lemma evalPt_x (p : Fin 2 → ℝ) : evalPt p x = p 0
proof: := by simp [evalPt, x]

name: BezoutCounterexample.evalPt_y
statement: @[simp] lemma evalPt_y (p : Fin 2 → ℝ) : evalPt p y = p 1
proof: := by simp [evalPt, y]

name: BezoutCounterexample.continuous_evalPt
statement: lemma continuous_evalPt : Continuous evalPt
proof:
:= by
  rw [RealPt.continuous_iff]
  intro q
  have : (fun p => evalPt p q) =
      fun p : Fin 2 → ℝ => MvPolynomial.eval p (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap ℚ ℝ) q) := by
    funext p
    simp [evalPt, MvPolynomial.aeval_def, MvPolynomial.eval_map]
  rw [this]
  exact MvPolynomial.continuous_eval _

name: BezoutCounterexample.realPt_A₀_ext
statement: lemma realPt_A₀_ext {z w : RealPt A₀} (hx : z x = w x) (hy : z y = w y) : z = w
proof:
:= by
  have : RealPt.toHom z = RealPt.toHom w := by
    apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
    · intro r
      have h1 := eq_ratCast ((RealPt.toHom z).comp MvPolynomial.C) r
      have h2 := eq_ratCast ((RealPt.toHom w).comp MvPolynomial.C) r
      simp only [RingHom.comp_apply] at h1 h2
      rw [h1, h2]
    · intro i
      fin_cases i
      · exact hx
      · exact hy
  exact this

name: BezoutCounterexample.evalPt_eval
statement: lemma evalPt_eval (z : RealPt A₀) : evalPt ![z x, z y] = z
proof:
:=
  realPt_A₀_ext (by simp) (by simp)

name: BezoutCounterexample.K₀HomeomorphCircle_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma K₀HomeomorphCircle_apply (z : K₀) :
    (K₀HomeomorphCircle z : Fin 2 → ℝ) = ![z.1 x, z.1 y]
proof: := rfl

name: BezoutCounterexample.isCompact_K₀
statement: theorem isCompact_K₀ : IsCompact K₀
proof:
:= by
  have hS : IsCompact unitCircle := by
    apply Metric.isCompact_of_isClosed_isBounded
    · exact isClosed_eq (by fun_prop) continuous_const
    · refine (Metric.isBounded_iff_subset_closedBall 0).2 ⟨1, fun p hp => ?_⟩
      simp only [unitCircle, mem_ofPred_eq] at hp
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg zero_le_one]
      intro i
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_le]
      fin_cases i <;> simp <;> constructor <;> nlinarith [sq_nonneg (p 0), sq_nonneg (p 1)]
  have := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.1 hS
  rw [isCompact_iff_compactSpace]
  exact K₀HomeomorphCircle.symm.compactSpace

name: BezoutCounterexample.Mreal_cos_sin
statement:
lemma Mreal_cos_sin (θ : ℝ) :
    Mreal (Real.cos θ) (Real.sin θ) =
      (2 : ℝ) • Matrix.vecMulVec ![Real.cos (θ / 2), Real.sin (θ / 2)]
        ![Real.cos (θ / 2), Real.sin (θ / 2)]
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Real.cos θ = 2 * Real.cos (θ / 2) ^ 2 - 1 := by
    rw [← Real.cos_two_mul]; ring_nf
  have hs : Real.sin θ = 2 * Real.sin (θ / 2) * Real.cos (θ / 2) := by
    rw [← Real.sin_two_mul]; ring_nf
  have h1 := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq (θ / 2)
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [Mreal, hc, hs] <;> nlinarith [h1]

name: BezoutCounterexample.mulVec_two_vecMulVec

name: BezoutCounterexample.L₀_not_isOrientable
statement: theorem L₀_not_isOrientable : ¬ IsOrientable X₀ Y₀
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨v, hvc, hv⟩
  let γ : ℝ → K₀ := fun θ => ⟨circlePt θ, circlePt_mem θ⟩
  have hγ : Continuous γ := continuous_circlePt.subtype_mk _
  let w : ℝ → Fin 2 → ℝ := fun θ => ![Real.cos (θ / 2), Real.sin (θ / 2)]
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun θ => v (γ θ) ⬝ᵥ w θ
  have hfc : Continuous f := by
    simp only [f, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    fun_prop
  
  have hvw : ∀ θ, v (γ θ) = f θ • w θ := by
    intro θ
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := mem_lineBundle_iff.1 (hv (γ θ)).2
    have hM : Mreal (X₀ (γ θ)) (Y₀ (γ θ)) = Mreal (Real.cos θ) (Real.sin θ) := by
      simp [γ, X₀, Y₀]
    rw [hM, Mreal_cos_sin, mulVec_two_vecMulVec] at hu
    have h1 := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq (θ / 2)
    have hfθ : f θ = 2 * (Real.cos (θ / 2) * u 0 + Real.sin (θ / 2) * u 1) := by
      show v (γ θ) ⬝ᵥ w θ = _
      rw [← hu]
      simp only [w, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_two, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
        Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one]
      linear_combination (2 * (Real.cos (θ / 2) * u 0 + Real.sin (θ / 2) * u 1)) * h1
    rw [hfθ, ← hu]
  have hf0 : ∀ θ, f θ ≠ 0 := by
    intro θ h
    apply (hv (γ θ)).1
    rw [hvw θ, h, zero_smul]
  
  have hγ2 : γ (2 * Real.pi) = γ 0 := Subtype.ext circlePt_two_pi
  have hw2 : w (2 * Real.pi) = -w 0 := by
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [w]
  have hf2 : f (2 * Real.pi) = -f 0 := by
    simp only [f, hγ2, hw2, dotProduct_neg]
  have h2pi : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (hf0 0) with hneg | hpos
  · obtain ⟨θ, -, hθ⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc h2pi hfc.continuousOn
      (show (0 : ℝ) ∈ Icc (f 0) (f (2 * Real.pi)) by rw [hf2]; constructor <;> linarith)
    exact hf0 θ hθ
  · obtain ⟨θ, -, hθ⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc' h2pi hfc.continuousOn
      (show (0 : ℝ) ∈ Icc (f (2 * Real.pi)) (f 0) by rw [hf2]; constructor <;> linarith)
    exact hf0 θ hθ

name: BezoutCounterexample.not_isOrientable_pullback
statement:
theorem not_isOrientable_pullback {A B : Type*} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (f : A →+* B)
    (a b : A) {K : Set (RealPt A)} {K' : Set (RealPt B)} (hK' : IsCompact K')
    (hmono : IsMonotoneSurjOn (RealPt.comap f) K' K) (hcirc : ∀ z ∈ K, z a ^ 2 + z b ^ 2 = 1)
    (h : ¬ IsOrientable (fun z : K => z.1 a) (fun z : K => z.1 b)) :
    ¬ IsOrientable (fun z : K' => z.1 (f a)) (fun z : K' => z.1 (f b))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hmaps, hq⟩ := hmono
  have := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.1 hK'
  exact not_isOrientable_comp hq (fun z : K => z.1 a) (fun z : K => z.1 b)
    ((RealPt.continuous_eval a).comp continuous_subtype_val)
    ((RealPt.continuous_eval b).comp continuous_subtype_val) (fun z => hcirc z.1 z.2) h

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.Chart.IsCentred.spanFinrank_le
statement:
lemma Principalization.Chart.IsCentred.spanFinrank_le {c : Chart S n} (hc : c.IsCentred) :
    (maximalIdeal S).spanFinrank ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [hc]
  refine (Submodule.spanFinrank_span_le_ncard_of_finite (Set.finite_range c.x)).trans ?_
  rw [← Set.image_univ]
  refine (Set.ncard_image_le Set.finite_univ).trans ?_

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.Chart.IsCentred.ringKrullDim_eq
statement:
theorem Principalization.Chart.IsCentred.ringKrullDim_eq {c : Chart S n} (hc : c.IsCentred) :
    ringKrullDim S = n
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine (ringKrullDim_le_spanFinrank_maximalIdeal S).trans ?_
    exact_mod_cast hc.spanFinrank_le
  · have hprime : ∀ k : ℕ, (Ideal.span (c.x '' {j | (j : ℕ) < k})).IsPrime :=
      fun k => Chart.IsCentred.span_x_isPrime c hc k
    let P : Fin (n + 1) → PrimeSpectrum S := fun i => ⟨_, hprime i⟩
    have hP : StrictMono P := by
      rw [Fin.strictMono_iff_lt_succ]
      intro i
      rw [← PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal_lt_asIdeal]
      refine lt_of_le_of_ne (Ideal.span_mono (Set.image_mono fun j hj => ?_)) fun h => ?_
      · simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_succ] at hj ⊢
        omega
      · have hmem : c.x i ∈ (P i.succ).asIdeal :=
          Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, by simp, rfl⟩
        rw [← h] at hmem
        refine hc.x_not_mem_RF (indW_nonneg _) i (t := 1) (e := indW (i : ℕ))
          (by simp [indW]) ?_
        rw [c.RF_indW]
        exact hmem
    exact Order.LTSeries.length_le_krullDim (LTSeries.mk n P hP)

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.Chart.IsCentred.isRegularSystemOfParameters

name: BezoutCounterexample.chart_size_eq_ringKrullDim
statement:
theorem chart_size_eq_ringKrullDim {𝔭 : Ideal A} [𝔭.IsPrime] {n : ℕ}
    (c : Chart (Localization.AtPrime 𝔭) n) : ringKrullDim A = n
proof:
:= by
  have hmax : ∀ (𝔪' : Ideal A) [𝔪'.IsMaximal], 𝔪'.height = n := by
    intro 𝔪' _
    obtain ⟨n', c', hc'⟩ := exists_centred_chart 𝔪'
    have h1 := hc'.ringKrullDim_eq
    rw [IsLocalization.AtPrime.ringKrullDim_eq_height 𝔪' (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪')] at h1
    obtain rfl : n' = n := chart_card_eq_of_domain 𝔪' 𝔭 c' c
    exact_mod_cast h1
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [ringKrullDim_le_iff_isMaximal_height_le]
    intro 𝔪' h𝔪'
    have := (hmax 𝔪').le
    exact_mod_cast this
  · obtain ⟨𝔪', h𝔪'⟩ := Ideal.exists_maximal A
    have := Ideal.height_le_ringKrullDim_of_ne_top h𝔪'.ne_top
    rw [hmax 𝔪'] at this
    exact_mod_cast this

name: BezoutCounterexample.exists_ringKrullDim_eq_natCast
statement:
theorem exists_ringKrullDim_eq_natCast (A : Type) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [Algebra ℚ A]
    [Algebra.Smooth ℚ A] : ∃ n : ℕ, ringKrullDim A = n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨𝔪', h𝔪'⟩ := Ideal.exists_maximal A
  obtain ⟨n, c, -⟩ := exists_centred_chart 𝔪'

name: BezoutCounterexample.IsRegularSystemOfParameters.exists_chart
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨n₀, c₀, hc₀⟩ := exists_centred_chart 𝔪
  have hn : n₀ = n := by
    have h := hc₀.ringKrullDim_eq
    rw [hx.2] at h
    exact_mod_cast h.symm
  subst hn
  have hxm : ∀ j, x j ∈ maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪) := fun j => by
    rw [← hx.1]; exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨j, rfl⟩
  
  choose a ha using fun j => Ideal.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun.1 (hc₀ ▸ hxm j)
  choose b hb using fun i => Ideal.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun.1 (hx.1 ▸ hc₀.x_mem i)
  
  have hmin : ∀ w : Fin n₀ → Localization.AtPrime 𝔪, ∑ l, w l * x l = 0 →
      ∀ l, w l ∈ maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪) := by
    intro w hw l₀
    by_contra hl₀
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := (IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal).1 hl₀
    have hx0 : x l₀ ∈ Ideal.span (x '' {l | l ≠ l₀}) := by
      have h := hw
      rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ l₀), ← hu] at h
      have hx0' : x l₀ = -(↑u⁻¹ * ∑ l ∈ Finset.univ.erase l₀, w l * x l) := by
        calc x l₀ = ↑u⁻¹ * (↑u * x l₀) := by rw [← mul_assoc, Units.inv_mul, one_mul]
          _ = _ := by rw [eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h]; ring
      rw [hx0']
      refine neg_mem (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.sum_mem _ fun l hl =>
        Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.subset_span ⟨l, Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hl, rfl⟩)))
    have heq : maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪) = Ideal.span (x '' {l | l ≠ l₀}) := by
      refine le_antisymm ?_ (Ideal.span_le.2 (by rintro _ ⟨l, -, rfl⟩; exact hxm l))
      rw [← hx.1, Ideal.span_le]
      rintro _ ⟨l, rfl⟩
      by_cases hl : l = l₀
      · subst hl; exact hx0
      · exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨l, hl, rfl⟩
    have h1 : (maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪)).spanFinrank < n₀ := by
      rw [heq]
      refine lt_of_le_of_lt (Submodule.spanFinrank_span_le_ncard_of_finite (Set.toFinite _)) ?_
      refine lt_of_le_of_lt (Set.ncard_image_le (Set.toFinite _)) ?_
      have hss : {l : Fin n₀ | l ≠ l₀} ⊂ Set.univ :=
        Set.ssubset_univ_iff.2 fun h => (h ▸ Set.mem_univ l₀ : l₀ ∈ {l : Fin n₀ | l ≠ l₀}) rfl
      calc {l : Fin n₀ | l ≠ l₀}.ncard < (Set.univ : Set (Fin n₀)).ncard :=
            Set.ncard_lt_ncard hss Set.finite_univ
        _ = n₀ := by simp
    have h2 := ringKrullDim_le_spanFinrank_maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪)
    rw [hx.2] at h2
    have h3 : n₀ ≤ (maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪)).spanFinrank := by exact_mod_cast h2
    omega
  
  have hd : ∀ k j, c₀.d k (x j) - a j k ∈ maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪) := by
    intro k j
    have h : c₀.d k (x j) = a j k + ∑ i, c₀.x i * c₀.d k (a j i) := by
      rw [← ha j, map_sum]
      have : ∀ i, c₀.d k (a j i * c₀.x i) =
          (if k = i then a j i else 0) + c₀.x i * c₀.d k (a j i) := by
        intro i
        rw [Derivation.leibniz, c₀.d_x, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
        split_ifs <;> ring
      simp only [this, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, ite_true]
    rw [h, add_sub_cancel_left]
    exact Ideal.sum_mem _ fun i _ => Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (hc₀.x_mem i)
  
  have hab : ∀ j l, (∑ i, a j i * b i l) - (if j = l then 1 else 0) ∈
      maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪) := by
    intro j
    apply hmin
    have h1 : x j = ∑ l, (∑ i, a j i * b i l) * x l := by
      calc x j = ∑ i, a j i * c₀.x i := (ha j).symm
        _ = ∑ i, a j i * ∑ l, b i l * x l := by simp only [hb]
        _ = ∑ l, (∑ i, a j i * b i l) * x l := by
          simp only [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul, mul_assoc]
          exact Finset.sum_comm
    simp only [sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul, Finset.sum_ite_eq,
      Finset.mem_univ, ite_true]
    rw [← h1, sub_self]
  
  set Ab : Matrix (Fin n₀) (Fin n₀) (ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪)) :=
    Matrix.of fun j i => residue _ (a j i) with hAb
  set Bb : Matrix (Fin n₀) (Fin n₀) (ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪)) :=
    Matrix.of fun i l => residue _ (b i l) with hBb
  have hAB : Ab * Bb = 1 := by
    ext j l
    rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply]
    simp only [hAb, hBb, Matrix.of_apply, ← map_mul, ← map_sum]
    have := (residue_eq_zero_iff _).2 (hab j l)
    rw [map_sub, sub_eq_zero] at this
    rw [this]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  have hdetA : Ab.det ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have := congrArg Matrix.det hAB
    rw [Matrix.det_mul, h0, zero_mul, Matrix.det_one] at this
    exact zero_ne_one this
  have hjac : (c₀.jac x).map (residue _) = Ab.transpose := by
    ext k j
    simp only [Matrix.map_apply, Chart.jac, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, hAb]
    have := (residue_eq_zero_iff _).2 (hd k j)
    rwa [map_sub, sub_eq_zero] at this
  have hunit : IsUnit (c₀.jac x).det := by
    rw [← IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal, ← residue_eq_zero_iff, RingHom.map_det,
      RingHom.mapMatrix_apply, hjac, Matrix.det_transpose]
    exact hdetA
  exact ⟨c₀.change x hunit, rfl, hx.1.symm⟩

name: BezoutCounterexample.weightLT_iff
statement: lemma weightLT_iff {e e' : ℕ → ℚ} : e ≺ e' ↔ toLex e' < toLex e
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne h1 (fun h => h2 (toLex.injective h).symm)
  · intro h
    exact ⟨h.le, fun h' => h.ne (congrArg toLex h'.symm)⟩

name: BezoutCounterexample.MarkedCenter.F_eq_RF
statement:
theorem MarkedCenter.F_eq_RF (J : MarkedCenter 𝔪) (c : Chart (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪) J.n)

proof:
:= by
  rw [MarkedCenter.F, Chart.RF, hc]
  congr 1
  ext f
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨α, h0, ht, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm α, fun i hi => by simpa using h0 i hi, ?_, by simp⟩
    simpa [lam, mul_comm] using ht
  · rintro ⟨α, h0, ht, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨α, h0, by simpa [lam, mul_comm] using ht, rfl⟩

name: BezoutCounterexample.toLex_ext0_le_iff
statement:
lemma toLex_ext0_le_iff {n : ℕ} {e e' : Fin n → ℚ} :
    toLex (ext0 e) ≤ toLex (ext0 e') ↔ toLex e ≤ toLex e'
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, ext0_le⟩
  by_contra h'
  rw [not_le] at h'
  have h2 : ext0 e' = ext0 e := toLex.injective (le_antisymm (ext0_le h'.le) h)
  exact h'.ne (congrArg toLex (ext0_injective h2))

name: BezoutCounterexample.isInv_of_invAt
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e₁, he₁⟩ := exists_isInv (Iloc_ne_bot hI 𝔪) (Iloc_le hI𝔪) J.c J.centred
  have h1 : ext0 e₁ = v := InvAt.unique ⟨m, e₁, he₁, rfl⟩ hv
  rwa [← ext0_injective (h1.trans hJv.symm)]

name: BezoutCounterexample.isInvariant_iff_invAt
statement:
theorem isInvariant_iff_invAt (hI : I ≠ ⊥) (hI𝔪 : I ≤ 𝔪) {v : ℕ → ℚ} :
    IsInvariant I 𝔪 v ↔ InvAt I 𝔪 v
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨J₀, hJ₀, rfl⟩, hmin⟩
    obtain ⟨J₀', -, he, hRF⟩ := J₀.exists_mc
    refine ⟨J₀.n, J₀.e, ⟨⟨J₀', ?_, he⟩, fun J' hJ' => ?_⟩, rfl⟩
    · show Iloc I 𝔪 ≤ J₀'.RF 1
      rw [hRF]
      exact hJ₀
    · have h := hmin (MarkedCenter.ofMC J') (by
        show Iloc I 𝔪 ≤ (MarkedCenter.ofMC J').F 1
        rw [MarkedCenter.ofMC_F]
        exact hJ')
      rw [MarkedCenter.ofMC_weights] at h
      exact (toLex_ext0_le_iff (e := J₀.e) (e' := J'.e)).1 h
  · rintro ⟨n, e, he, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨⟨J, hJ, rfl⟩, hmin⟩ := he
    refine ⟨⟨MarkedCenter.ofMC J, ?_, rfl⟩, fun J' hJ' => ?_⟩
    · show Iloc I 𝔪 ≤ (MarkedCenter.ofMC J).F 1
      rw [MarkedCenter.ofMC_F]
      exact hJ
    · obtain ⟨J'', -, he'', hRF⟩ := J'.exists_mc
      obtain ⟨e₁, he₁⟩ := exists_isInv (Iloc_ne_bot hI 𝔪) (Iloc_le hI𝔪) J''.c J''.centred
      have hv : ext0 e₁ = ext0 J.e :=
        InvAt.unique ⟨J'.n, e₁, he₁, rfl⟩ ⟨n, J.e, ⟨⟨J, hJ, rfl⟩, hmin⟩, rfl⟩
      have hadm : J''.Adm (Iloc I 𝔪) := by
        show Iloc I 𝔪 ≤ J''.RF 1
        rw [hRF]
        exact hJ'
      have h1 := he₁.2 J'' hadm
      rw [he''] at h1
      rw [← hv]
      exact ext0_le h1

name: BezoutCounterexample.invAt_inv
statement: theorem invAt_inv (hI : I ≠ ⊥) (hI𝔪 : I ≤ 𝔪) : InvAt I 𝔪 (inv I 𝔪)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := exists_invAt hI 𝔪 hI𝔪
  have h : ∃ v, IsInvariant I 𝔪 v := ⟨v, (isInvariant_iff_invAt hI hI𝔪).2 hv⟩
  rw [inv, dite_eq_left h]
  exact (isInvariant_iff_invAt hI hI𝔪).1 h.choose_spec

name: BezoutCounterexample.inv_eq_of_invAt
statement:
theorem inv_eq_of_invAt (hI : I ≠ ⊥) (hI𝔪 : I ≤ 𝔪) {v : ℕ → ℚ} (hv : InvAt I 𝔪 v) :
    inv I 𝔪 = v
proof:
:=
  (invAt_inv hI hI𝔪).unique hv

name: BezoutCounterexample.maxCenter_eq_cRF
statement: theorem maxCenter_eq_cRF (hI : I ≠ ⊥) (hI𝔪 : I ≤ 𝔪) (t : ℚ) : maxCenter I 𝔪 t = cRF I 𝔪 t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, e, he, hev⟩ := invAt_inv hI hI𝔪
  obtain ⟨J₀, hJ₀, rfl⟩ := he.1
  apply le_antisymm
  · have hadm : (MarkedCenter.ofMC J₀).IsAdmissible I := by
      show Iloc I 𝔪 ≤ (MarkedCenter.ofMC J₀).F 1
      rw [MarkedCenter.ofMC_F]
      exact hJ₀
    have h1 : maxCenter I 𝔪 t ≤ (MarkedCenter.ofMC J₀).F t :=
      iInf_le_of_le (MarkedCenter.ofMC J₀) (iInf_le_of_le hadm
        (iInf_le_of_le ((MarkedCenter.ofMC_weights J₀).trans hev) le_rfl))
    rwa [MarkedCenter.ofMC_F, ← cRF_eq hI hI𝔪 hJ₀ he] at h1
  · refine le_iInf fun J => le_iInf fun hJ => le_iInf fun hw => ?_
    obtain ⟨J', -, he', hRF⟩ := J.exists_mc
    have hJ' : J'.Adm (Iloc I 𝔪) := by
      show Iloc I 𝔪 ≤ J'.RF 1
      rw [hRF]
      exact hJ
    have hJ'i : IsInv (Iloc I 𝔪) J.n J'.e :=
      isInv_of_invAt hI hI𝔪 (invAt_inv hI hI𝔪) J' (by rw [he']; exact hw)
    rw [cRF_eq hI hI𝔪 hJ' hJ'i, hRF]

name: BezoutCounterexample.exists_isInvariant
statement: theorem exists_isInvariant : ∃ v, IsInvariant I 𝔪 v
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨inv I 𝔪, (isInvariant_iff_invAt hI hI𝔪).2 (invAt_inv hI hI𝔪)⟩

name: BezoutCounterexample.isInvariant_inv
statement: theorem isInvariant_inv : IsInvariant I 𝔪 (inv I 𝔪)
proof:
:= by
  have h := exists_isInvariant hI hI𝔪
  rw [inv, dite_eq_left h]
  exact h.choose_spec

name: BezoutCounterexample.MarkedCenter.F_eq_maxCenter
statement:
theorem MarkedCenter.F_eq_maxCenter (J : MarkedCenter 𝔪) (hJ : J.IsAdmissible I)
    (hw : J.weights = inv I 𝔪) (t : ℚ) : J.F t = maxCenter I 𝔪 t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨J', -, he', hRF⟩ := J.exists_mc
  have hJ' : J'.Adm (Iloc I 𝔪) := by
    show Iloc I 𝔪 ≤ J'.RF 1
    rw [hRF]
    exact hJ
  have hJ'i : IsInv (Iloc I 𝔪) J.n J'.e :=
    isInv_of_invAt hI hI𝔪 (invAt_inv hI hI𝔪) J' (by rw [he']; exact hw)
  rw [maxCenter_eq_cRF hI hI𝔪, cRF_eq hI hI𝔪 hJ' hJ'i, hRF]

name: BezoutCounterexample.inv_le_one
statement: theorem inv_le_one (i : ℕ) : inv I 𝔪 i ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, e, he, hev⟩ := invAt_inv hI hI𝔪
  rw [← hev]
  by_cases hi : i < n
  · simp only [ext0, dite_eq_left hi]
    exact he.le_one (Iloc_le hI𝔪) _
  · simp only [ext0, dite_eq_right hi]
    norm_num

name: BezoutCounterexample.ord_spec
statement:
lemma ord_spec :
    Iloc I 𝔪 ≤ maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪) ^ ord I 𝔪 ∧
    (∀ b : ℕ, Iloc I 𝔪 ≤ maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪) ^ b → b ≤ ord I 𝔪) ∧
    1 ≤ ord I 𝔪
proof:
:= by
  have hne : ({b : ℕ | Iloc I 𝔪 ≤ maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪) ^ b}).Nonempty :=
    ⟨0, by simp⟩
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hf0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot (Iloc_ne_bot hI 𝔪)
  have hint := Ideal.iInf_pow_eq_bot_of_isLocalRing (maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪))
    (maximalIdeal.isMaximal _).ne_top
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ : ∃ N : ℕ, f ∉ maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪) ^ N := by
    by_contra h
    replace h := not_exists_not.1 h
    apply hf0
    rw [← Ideal.mem_bot, ← hint, Ideal.mem_iInf]
    exact h
  have hbdd : BddAbove {b : ℕ | Iloc I 𝔪 ≤ maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪) ^ b} := by
    refine ⟨N, fun b hb => ?_⟩
    have hb' : Iloc I 𝔪 ≤ maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪) ^ b := hb
    by_contra hbN
    exact hN (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (not_le.1 hbN).le (hb' hf))
  have hord : ord I 𝔪 =
      sSup {b : ℕ | Iloc I 𝔪 ≤ maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪) ^ b} := rfl
  rw [hord]
  refine ⟨Nat.sSup_mem hne hbdd, fun b hb => le_csSup hbdd hb, le_csSup hbdd ?_⟩
  show Iloc I 𝔪 ≤ _ ^ 1
  rw [pow_one]
  exact Iloc_le hI𝔪

name: BezoutCounterexample.inv_zero_eq_one_div_ord
statement: theorem inv_zero_eq_one_div_ord : inv I 𝔪 0 = 1 / ord I 𝔪
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hle, hmaxb, h1⟩ := ord_spec hI hI𝔪
  have hnle : ¬ Iloc I 𝔪 ≤ maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪) ^ (ord I 𝔪 + 1) := fun h => by
    have := hmaxb _ h
    omega
  have h0 : inv I 𝔪 0 ≠ 0 := InvAt.zero_ne hI (invAt_inv hI hI𝔪)
  obtain ⟨n, e, he, hev⟩ := invAt_inv hI hI𝔪
  have hn : 0 < n := by
    by_contra hn
    apply h0
    rw [← hev]
    simp only [ext0, dite_eq_right hn]
  have hinv0 : inv I 𝔪 0 = e ⟨0, hn⟩ := by
    rw [← hev]
    simp only [ext0, dite_eq_left hn]
  obtain ⟨J, hJ, rfl⟩ := he.1
  rw [hinv0]
  refine le_antisymm (he.zero_le_of_le_pow J.c J.centred (by omega) hle hn) ?_
  by_contra hlt
  replace hlt := not_le.1 hlt
  apply hnle
  refine hJ.trans ?_
  show J.c.RF J.e 1 ≤ _
  rw [Chart.RF, Ideal.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨α, -, hα, rfl⟩
  have hb : (0 : ℚ) < ord I 𝔪 := by exact_mod_cast h1
  have he0 : 0 ≤ J.e ⟨0, hn⟩ := J.nonneg _
  have hsum : lam J.e α ≤ J.e ⟨0, hn⟩ * (α.degree : ℚ) := by
    rw [lam, Finsupp.degree_eq_sum, Nat.cast_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_
    have hi : J.e i ≤ J.e ⟨0, hn⟩ := J.anti (Fin.le_def.2 (Nat.zero_le _))
    rw [mul_comm]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hi (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  have hdeg : ord I 𝔪 + 1 ≤ α.degree := by
    by_contra hd
    replace hd := not_le.1 hd
    have hd' : (α.degree : ℚ) ≤ ord I 𝔪 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 hd
    have h2 : J.e ⟨0, hn⟩ * ord I 𝔪 < 1 := by
      calc J.e ⟨0, hn⟩ * ord I 𝔪 < (1 / ord I 𝔪) * ord I 𝔪 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hlt hb
        _ = 1 := one_div_mul_cancel hb.ne'
    linarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd' he0]
  have hmem : ∏ i, J.c.x i ^ α i ∈ maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪) ^ α.degree := by
    rw [Finsupp.degree_eq_sum, ← Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum]
    exact Ideal.prod_mem_prod fun i _ => Ideal.pow_mem_pow (J.centred.x_mem i) _
  exact Ideal.pow_le_pow_right hdeg hmem

name: BezoutCounterexample.exists_inv_zero_eq
statement: theorem exists_inv_zero_eq : ∃ a : ℕ, 0 < a ∧ inv I 𝔪 0 = 1 / a
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := (ord_spec hI hI𝔪).2.2
  exact ⟨ord I 𝔪, by omega, inv_zero_eq_one_div_ord hI hI𝔪⟩

name: BezoutCounterexample.inv_zero_le_of_le_pow
statement:
theorem inv_zero_le_of_le_pow {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (hIb : I.map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪)) ≤ maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪) ^ b) :
    inv I 𝔪 0 ≤ 1 / b
proof:
:= by
  rw [inv_zero_eq_one_div_ord hI hI𝔪]
  have hbord : b ≤ ord I 𝔪 := (ord_spec hI hI𝔪).2.1 b hIb
  exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by exact_mod_cast hb) (by exact_mod_cast hbord)

name: BezoutCounterexample.theorem_3_3_1
statement:
theorem theorem_3_3_1 :
    (∃ J : MarkedCenter 𝔪, J.IsAdmissible I ∧ J.weights = inv I 𝔪) ∧
    (∀ J : MarkedCenter 𝔪, J.IsAdmissible I → toLex (inv I 𝔪) ≤ toLex J.weights) ∧
    (∀ J : MarkedCenter 𝔪, J.IsAdmissible I → J.weights = inv I 𝔪 →
      ∀ t, J.F t = maxCenter I 𝔪 t) ∧
    (∀ i, inv I 𝔪 i ≤ 1) ∧ inv I 𝔪 0 = 1 / ord I 𝔪 ∧
    (∃ a : ℕ, 0 < a ∧ inv I 𝔪 0 = 1 / a) ∧
    (∀ b : ℕ, 0 < b → I.map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪)) ≤
      maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪) ^ b → inv I 𝔪 0 ≤ 1 / b)
proof:
:=
  ⟨(isInvariant_inv hI hI𝔪).1, (isInvariant_inv hI hI𝔪).2,
    fun J hJ hw t => J.F_eq_maxCenter hI hI𝔪 hJ hw t, inv_le_one hI hI𝔪,
    inv_zero_eq_one_div_ord hI hI𝔪, exists_inv_zero_eq hI hI𝔪,
    fun _ hb hIb => inv_zero_le_of_le_pow hI hI𝔪 hb hIb⟩

name: BezoutCounterexample.invAt_map_of_localization_polynomial
statement:
lemma invAt_map_of_localization_polynomial {B : Type} [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [Algebra ℚ B]
    [Algebra.Smooth ℚ B] [Algebra A B] {I : Ideal A} (hI : I ≠ ⊥)
    (𝔫 : Ideal B) [𝔫.IsMaximal] (𝔪 : Ideal A) [𝔪.IsMaximal]
    (h𝔪 : 𝔫.comap (algebraMap A B) = 𝔪) (hI𝔪 : I ≤ 𝔪) {r : ℕ}
    (Q : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin r) (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪))) [Q.IsPrime]
    (φ : Localization.AtPrime 𝔫 ≃ₐ[A] Localization.AtPrime Q) :
    Function.Injective (algebraMap A B) ∧ InvAt (I.map (algebraMap A B)) 𝔫 (inv I 𝔪)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  obtain ⟨θ, hθ⟩ : ∃ θ : MvPolynomial (Fin r) (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪) →+*
      Localization.AtPrime 𝔫, ∀ p, θ p = φ.symm (algebraMap _ (Localization.AtPrime Q) p) :=
    ⟨φ.symm.toRingEquiv.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap _ _), fun _ => rfl⟩
  have hAL : ∀ a : A, algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime Q) a =
      algebraMap _ (Localization.AtPrime Q)
        (MvPolynomial.C (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪) a)) := fun a => by
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A (MvPolynomial (Fin r) (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪))
      (Localization.AtPrime Q), MvPolynomial.algebraMap_apply]
  have hAT : ∀ a : A, algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime 𝔫) a =
      algebraMap B (Localization.AtPrime 𝔫) (algebraMap A B a) := fun a =>
    IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A B _ a
  have hinjS : Function.Injective (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪)) :=
    IsLocalization.injective _ (Ideal.primeCompl_le_nonZeroDivisors 𝔪)
  have hinjL : Function.Injective (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r) (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪))
      (Localization.AtPrime Q)) :=
    IsLocalization.injective (M := Q.primeCompl) (Localization.AtPrime Q)
      (Ideal.primeCompl_le_nonZeroDivisors Q)
  have hθinj : Function.Injective θ := by
    intro p q h
    rw [hθ, hθ] at h
    exact hinjL (φ.symm.injective h)
  have hcomp : ∀ a : A, θ (MvPolynomial.C (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪) a)) =
      algebraMap B (Localization.AtPrime 𝔫) (algebraMap A B a) := by
    intro a
    rw [hθ, ← hAL, AlgEquiv.commutes, hAT]
  have hinjA : Function.Injective (algebraMap A B) := by
    intro a a' h
    have h2 : θ (MvPolynomial.C (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪) a)) =
        θ (MvPolynomial.C (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪) a')) := by
      rw [hcomp, hcomp, h]
    exact hinjS (MvPolynomial.C_injective _ _ (hθinj h2))
  
  have hmaxL : ∀ z, z ∈ maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime 𝔫) →
      φ z ∈ maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime Q) := by
    intro z hz
    rw [IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff] at hz ⊢
    rwa [MulEquiv.isUnit_map]
  have hmaxT : ∀ z, z ∈ maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime Q) →
      φ.symm z ∈ maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime 𝔫) := by
    intro z hz
    rw [IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff] at hz ⊢
    rwa [MulEquiv.isUnit_map]
  
  have hQC : ∀ a ∈ maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪), MvPolynomial.C a ∈ Q := by
    intro a ha
    obtain ⟨⟨s, t⟩, hst⟩ := IsLocalization.mk'_surjective 𝔪.primeCompl a
    change IsLocalization.mk' (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪) s t = a at hst
    subst hst
    have hs : s ∈ 𝔪 :=
      (IsLocalization.AtPrime.mk'_mem_maximal_iff (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪) 𝔪 s t).1 ha
    have hsn : algebraMap A B s ∈ 𝔫 := by
      have : s ∈ 𝔫.comap (algebraMap A B) := by rw [h𝔪]; exact hs
      exact this
    have h1 : algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime 𝔫) s ∈
        maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime 𝔫) := by
      rw [hAT]
      exact (IsLocalization.AtPrime.to_map_mem_maximal_iff _ 𝔫 _).2 hsn
    have h2 := hmaxL _ h1
    rw [AlgEquiv.commutes, hAL] at h2
    have h3 : MvPolynomial.C (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪) s) ∈ Q :=
      (IsLocalization.AtPrime.to_map_mem_maximal_iff _ Q _).1 h2
    rw [IsLocalization.mk'_eq_mul_mk'_one, map_mul]
    exact Q.mul_mem_right _ h3
  have hloc : ∀ a ∈ maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪),
      θ (MvPolynomial.C a) ∈ maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime 𝔫) := by
    intro a ha
    rw [hθ]
    exact hmaxT _ ((IsLocalization.AtPrime.to_map_mem_maximal_iff _ Q _).2 (hQC a ha))
  have hsurj : ∀ z : Localization.AtPrime 𝔫, ∃ a b, IsUnit (θ b) ∧ z * θ b = θ a := by
    intro z
    obtain ⟨⟨a, b⟩, hab⟩ := IsLocalization.surj Q.primeCompl (φ z)
    refine ⟨a, b, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hθ]
      exact (IsLocalization.map_units (Localization.AtPrime Q) b).map φ.symm
    · rw [hθ, hθ]
      apply φ.injective
      rw [map_mul, AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply, AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
      exact hab
  
  obtain ⟨n, e, he, hev⟩ := invAt_inv hI hI𝔪
  obtain ⟨J, -, -⟩ := he.1
  have := residueField_isIntegral 𝔫
  have hIS := IsInv.transfer_mvLoc θ hθinj hsurj hloc J.centred (Iloc_ne_bot hI 𝔪)
    (Iloc_le hI𝔪) he
  have hmapeq : (I.map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪))).map (θ.comp MvPolynomial.C) =
      (I.map (algebraMap A B)).map (algebraMap B (Localization.AtPrime 𝔫)) := by
    rw [Ideal.map_map, Ideal.map_map]
    congr 1
    ext a
    exact hcomp a
  refine ⟨hinjA, n + r, pad (n + r) e, ?_, ?_⟩
  · show IsInv ((I.map (algebraMap A B)).map (algebraMap B (Localization.AtPrime 𝔫))) _ _
    rw [← hmapeq]
    exact hIS
  · rw [ext0_pad (Nat.le_add_right n r)]
    exact hev

name: BezoutCounterexample.inv_map_eq_of_localization_polynomial
statement:
theorem inv_map_eq_of_localization_polynomial {B : Type} [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [Algebra ℚ B]
    [Algebra.Smooth ℚ B] [Algebra A B] [IsScalarTower ℚ A B] {I : Ideal A} (hI : I ≠ ⊥)
    (𝔫 : Ideal B) [𝔫.IsMaximal] (hI𝔫 : I.map (algebraMap A B) ≤ 𝔫)
    (hloc : IsLocalizationOfPolynomial A 𝔫) :
    (𝔫.comap (algebraMap A B)).IsMaximal ∧
      inv (I.map (algebraMap A B)) 𝔫 = inv I (𝔫.comap (algebraMap A B))
proof:
:= by
  have h𝔪 : (𝔫.comap (algebraMap A B)).IsMaximal := comap_isMaximal_of_finiteType 𝔫
  refine ⟨h𝔪, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨r, Q, hQ, ⟨φ⟩⟩ := hloc
  have hI𝔪 : I ≤ 𝔫.comap (algebraMap A B) := Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.1 hI𝔫
  obtain ⟨hinjA, hinv⟩ :=
    invAt_map_of_localization_polynomial hI 𝔫 (𝔫.comap (algebraMap A B)) rfl hI𝔪 Q φ
  have hIB : I.map (algebraMap A B) ≠ ⊥ := by
    obtain ⟨f, hf, hf0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hI
    intro h
    have hmem : algebraMap A B f ∈ I.map (algebraMap A B) := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hf
    rw [h, Ideal.mem_bot, ← map_zero (algebraMap A B)] at hmem
    exact hf0 (hinjA hmem)
  exact inv_eq_of_invAt hIB hI𝔫 hinv

name: BezoutCounterexample.numNonzero_ext0
statement:
lemma numNonzero_ext0 {n k : ℕ} {e : Fin n → ℚ} (h : ∀ i, e i ≠ 0 ↔ (i : ℕ) < k) :
    numNonzero (ext0 e) = min n k
proof:
:= by
  have hset : {i : ℕ | ext0 e i ≠ 0} = ↑(Finset.range (min n k)) := by
    ext i
    rw [Finset.coe_range, Set.mem_Iio, lt_min_iff]
    by_cases hi : i < n
    · change (if h : i < n then e ⟨i, h⟩ else 0) ≠ 0 ↔ _
      rw [dite_eq_left hi, h ⟨i, hi⟩]
      exact ⟨fun h' => ⟨hi, h'⟩, fun h' => h'.2⟩
    · change (if h : i < n then e ⟨i, h⟩ else 0) ≠ 0 ↔ _
      rw [dite_eq_right hi]
      simp [hi]
  rw [numNonzero, hset, Set.ncard_coe_finset, Finset.card_range]

name: BezoutCounterexample.maxinv_spec
statement:
theorem maxinv_spec :
    (∃ (𝔪 : Ideal A) (_ : 𝔪.IsMaximal), I ≤ 𝔪 ∧ inv I 𝔪 = maxinv I) ∧
      ∀ (𝔪 : Ideal A) [𝔪.IsMaximal], I ≤ 𝔪 → inv I 𝔪 ⪯ maxinv I
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v₀, ⟨𝔪₀, h𝔪₀, hI𝔪₀, hv₀⟩, hmax⟩ := exists_maxInv hI hItop
  have h : ∃ v, (∃ (𝔪 : Ideal A) (_ : 𝔪.IsMaximal), I ≤ 𝔪 ∧ inv I 𝔪 = v) ∧
      ∀ (𝔪 : Ideal A) (_ : 𝔪.IsMaximal), I ≤ 𝔪 → inv I 𝔪 ⪯ v :=
    ⟨v₀, ⟨𝔪₀, h𝔪₀, hI𝔪₀, inv_eq_of_invAt hI hI𝔪₀ hv₀⟩,
      fun 𝔪 _ hI𝔪 => hmax 𝔪 hI𝔪 _ (invAt_inv hI hI𝔪)⟩
  rw [maxinv, dite_eq_left h]
  exact h.choose_spec

name: BezoutCounterexample.maxinv_le
statement:
lemma maxinv_le :
    ∀ (𝔪 : Ideal A) [𝔪.IsMaximal], I ≤ 𝔪 → ∀ v, InvAt I 𝔪 v → toLex (maxinv I) ≤ toLex v
proof:
:= by
  intro 𝔪 _ hI𝔪 v hv
  rw [← inv_eq_of_invAt hI hI𝔪 hv]
  exact (maxinv_spec hI hItop).2 𝔪 hI𝔪

name: BezoutCounterexample.maxLocusIdeal_eq
statement: lemma maxLocusIdeal_eq : maxLocusIdeal I = locusIdeal I (maxinv I)
proof:
:= by
  unfold maxLocusIdeal locusIdeal maxLocus
  congr 1
  ext 𝔪
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h𝔪, hI𝔪, heq⟩
    exact ⟨h𝔪, hI𝔪, heq ▸ invAt_inv hI hI𝔪⟩
  · rintro ⟨h𝔪, hI𝔪, hv⟩
    exact ⟨h𝔪, hI𝔪, inv_eq_of_invAt hI hI𝔪 hv⟩

name: BezoutCounterexample.exists_weights_maxinv
statement: lemma exists_weights_maxinv : ∃ d : ℕ, 0 < d ∧ ∀ i, ∃ w : ℕ, (w : ℚ) = d * maxinv I i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨𝔪, h𝔪, hI𝔪, heq⟩, -⟩ := maxinv_spec hI hItop
  obtain ⟨n, e, he, hev⟩ := invAt_inv hI hI𝔪
  rw [← heq, ← hev]
  refine exists_weights (N := n) (fun i => ?_) (fun i hi => ?_)
  · simp only [ext0]
    split_ifs
    · exact he.nonneg _
    · exact le_rfl
  · simp only [ext0, dite_eq_right (not_lt.2 hi)]

name: BezoutCounterexample.theorem_3_3_3
statement:
theorem theorem_3_3_3 :
    (components I).Finite ∧
    (∀ 𝔭 ∈ components I, 𝔭.IsPrime ∧ I ≤ 𝔭) ∧
    (∀ 𝔭 ∈ components I, ∀ 𝔭' ∈ components I, 𝔭 ≠ 𝔭' → 𝔭 ⊔ 𝔭' = ⊤) ∧
    (∀ (𝔪 : Ideal A) [𝔪.IsMaximal], I ≤ 𝔪 →
      (inv I 𝔪 = maxinv I ↔ ∃ 𝔭 ∈ components I, 𝔭 ≤ 𝔪)) ∧
    (∀ 𝔭 ∈ components I, ∀ (𝔪 : Ideal A) [𝔪.IsMaximal], 𝔭 ≤ 𝔪 →
      ∃ J : MarkedCenter 𝔪, J.weights = maxinv I ∧ J.IsAdmissible I ∧
        𝔭.map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪)) =
          Ideal.span (J.x '' {i | (i : ℕ) < numNonzero (maxinv I)}))
proof:
:= by
  have hmax := maxinv_le hI hItop
  have hcomp : components I = (locusIdeal I (maxinv I)).minimalPrimes := by
    rw [components, maxLocusIdeal_eq hI]
  refine ⟨Ideal.finite_minimalPrimes_of_isNoetherianRing A _, fun 𝔭 h𝔭 => ⟨h𝔭.1.1, ?_⟩,
    fun 𝔭 h𝔭 𝔭' h𝔭' hne => ?_, fun 𝔪 _ hI𝔪 => ⟨fun heq => ?_, ?_⟩, fun 𝔭 h𝔭 𝔪 _ h𝔭𝔪 => ?_⟩
  · 
    refine le_trans ?_ h𝔭.1.2
    exact le_sInf (by rintro 𝔪 ⟨-, hI𝔪, -⟩; exact hI𝔪)
  · 
    rw [hcomp] at h𝔭 h𝔭'
    exact minimalPrimes_sup_eq_top hI hmax h𝔭 h𝔭' hne
  · 
    have h𝔪L : maxLocusIdeal I ≤ 𝔪 := sInf_le ⟨inferInstance, hI𝔪, heq⟩
    obtain ⟨𝔭, h𝔭, h𝔭𝔪⟩ := Ideal.exists_minimalPrimes_le h𝔪L
    exact ⟨𝔭, h𝔭, h𝔭𝔪⟩
  · 
    rintro ⟨𝔭, h𝔭, h𝔭𝔪⟩
    rw [hcomp] at h𝔭
    exact inv_eq_of_invAt hI hI𝔪 (mem_maxLocus_of_minimal hI hmax h𝔭 𝔪 h𝔭𝔪).2
  · 
    rw [hcomp] at h𝔭
    obtain ⟨hI𝔪, hv⟩ := mem_maxLocus_of_minimal hI hmax h𝔭 𝔪 h𝔭𝔪
    obtain ⟨D⟩ := LocData.nonempty hI 𝔪 hI𝔪 hv
    have hp : 𝔭 = D.p := D.eq_p_of_minimal h𝔭 h𝔭𝔪
    let J' : MC (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪) D.n :=
      ⟨Loc.transport (D.ctrl 𝔪 D.hg) D.ck, D.ek, D.cent, D.inv.nonneg, D.inv.anti⟩
    have hadm : (MarkedCenter.ofMC J').IsAdmissible I := by
      show Iloc I 𝔪 ≤ (MarkedCenter.ofMC J').F 1
      rw [MarkedCenter.ofMC_F]
      obtain ⟨⟨J₀, hJ₀, hJ₀e⟩, -⟩ := D.inv
      exact hJ₀.trans (D.rf 𝔪 D.hg J₀ hJ₀ hJ₀e 1).le
    have hnum : numNonzero (maxinv I) = min D.n D.k := by
      have h := numNonzero_ext0 D.supp
      rw [D.hv] at h
      exact h
    have hk : ∀ i : Fin D.n, (i : ℕ) < numNonzero (maxinv I) ↔ (i : ℕ) < D.k := by
      intro i
      rw [hnum, lt_min_iff]
      exact ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨i.2, h⟩⟩
    have hset : {i : Fin D.n | (i : ℕ) < numNonzero (maxinv I)} =
        {i : Fin D.n | (i : ℕ) < D.k} :=
      Set.ext hk
    have hmap : 𝔭.map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪)) =
        Ideal.span ((Loc.transport (D.ctrl 𝔪 D.hg) D.ck).x ''
          {i : Fin D.n | (i : ℕ) < numNonzero (maxinv I)}) := by
      rw [hset, hp, D.map_p]
      rfl
    exact ⟨MarkedCenter.ofMC J', D.hv, hadm, hmap⟩

name: BezoutCounterexample.mem_globalCenter
statement:
lemma mem_globalCenter {I 𝔭 : Ideal A} {t : ℚ} {f : A} :
    f ∈ globalCenter I 𝔭 t ↔ ∀ (𝔪 : Ideal A) [𝔪.IsMaximal], 𝔭 ≤ 𝔪 →
      algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪) f ∈ maxCenter I 𝔪 t
proof:
:= by
  simp only [globalCenter, Submodule.mem_iInf, Ideal.mem_comap]

name: BezoutCounterexample.theorem_3_3_4
statement:
theorem theorem_3_3_4 {I : Ideal A} (hI : I ≠ ⊥) (hItop : I ≠ ⊤) {𝔭 : Ideal A}
    (h𝔭 : 𝔭 ∈ components I) (t : ℚ) :
    (∀ (𝔪 : Ideal A) [𝔪.IsMaximal], 𝔭 ≤ 𝔪 →
      (globalCenter I 𝔭 t).map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪)) = maxCenter I 𝔪 t) ∧
    (∀ (𝔪 : Ideal A) [𝔪.IsMaximal], ¬ 𝔭 ≤ 𝔪 →
      (globalCenter I 𝔭 t).map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪)) = ⊤)
proof:
:= by
  have hmax := maxinv_le hI hItop
  rw [components, maxLocusIdeal_eq hI] at h𝔭
  have hIL : I ≤ locusIdeal I (maxinv I) := le_sInf (by rintro 𝔪 ⟨-, hI𝔪, -⟩; exact hI𝔪)
  have hI𝔭 : I ≤ 𝔭 := hIL.trans h𝔭.1.2
  have hG : globalCenter I 𝔭 t = compF I 𝔭 t := by
    ext f
    rw [mem_globalCenter, mem_compF]
    constructor
    · intro h 𝔪 _ h𝔭𝔪
      have := h 𝔪 h𝔭𝔪
      rwa [maxCenter_eq_cRF hI (hI𝔭.trans h𝔭𝔪)] at this
    · intro h 𝔪 _ h𝔭𝔪
      rw [maxCenter_eq_cRF hI (hI𝔭.trans h𝔭𝔪)]
      exact h 𝔪 h𝔭𝔪
  refine ⟨fun 𝔪 _ h𝔭𝔪 => ?_, fun 𝔪 _ h𝔭𝔪 => ?_⟩
  · rw [hG, compF_map hI hmax h𝔭 𝔪 h𝔭𝔪 t, maxCenter_eq_cRF hI (hI𝔭.trans h𝔭𝔪)]
  · obtain ⟨d, hd, hw⟩ := exists_weights_maxinv hI hItop
    rw [hG]
    exact compF_map_of_not_le hI hmax h𝔭 hd hw 𝔪 h𝔭𝔪 t

name: BezoutCounterexample.inv_mem_Γ
statement:
theorem inv_mem_Γ {I : Ideal A} (hI : I ≠ ⊥) {𝔪 : Ideal A} [𝔪.IsMaximal] (hI𝔪 : I ≤ 𝔪) :
    inv I 𝔪 ∈ Γ
proof:
:= by
  have hv := invAt_inv hI hI𝔪
  refine ⟨InvAt.goodV hI hI𝔪 hv, fun i hi => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨n, e, he, hev⟩ := hv
  rw [← hev] at hi ⊢
  simp only [ext0] at hi ⊢
  by_cases h1 : i + 1 < n
  · rw [dite_eq_left h1]
    rw [dite_eq_left (show i < n by omega)] at hi
    have h2 : e ⟨i + 1, h1⟩ ≤ e ⟨i, by omega⟩ := he.anti (Fin.le_def.2 (Nat.le_succ i))
    exact le_antisymm (h2.trans hi.le) (he.nonneg _)
  · rw [dite_eq_right h1]

name: BezoutCounterexample.eq_zero_of_mem_Γ
statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_mem_Γ {N : ℕ} {e : ℕ → ℚ} (he : e ∈ Γ) (hN : {i | e i ≠ 0}.encard ≤ N)
    {i : ℕ} (hi : N ≤ i) : e i = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  have hprop : ∀ j k, e j = 0 → e (j + k) = 0 := by
    intro j k h0
    induction k with
    | zero => simpa using h0
    | succ k ih =>
      rw [← Nat.add_assoc]
      exact he.2 _ ih
  have hall : ∀ j ≤ i, e j ≠ 0 := by
    intro j hj h0
    apply hne
    have := hprop j (i - j) h0
    rwa [Nat.add_sub_of_le hj] at this
  have hsub : {j : ℕ | j < i + 1} ⊆ {j | e j ≠ 0} := fun j hj => hall j (Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 hj)
  have h1 := (Set.encard_le_encard hsub).trans hN
  rw [Set.Nat.encard_range] at h1
  have h2 : i + 1 ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast h1
  omega

name: BezoutCounterexample.Γ_wellFoundedOn
statement:
theorem Γ_wellFoundedOn (N : ℕ) :
    {e ∈ Γ | {i | e i ≠ 0}.encard ≤ N}.WellFoundedOn (· ≺ ·)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.wellFoundedOn_iff]
  refine Subrelation.wf (r := InvImage (· < ·) (encW N)) ?_ (InvImage.wf _ wellFounded_lt)
  intro a b ⟨hab, ha, hb⟩
  exact encW_lt hb.1.1 ha.1.1 (fun i hi => eq_zero_of_mem_Γ hb.1 hb.2 hi)
    (fun i hi => eq_zero_of_mem_Γ ha.1 ha.2 hi) (weightLT_iff.1 hab)

name: BezoutCounterexample.next_weight_form
statement:
theorem next_weight_form {r : ℕ} (e : Fin r → ℚ) (β : Fin r → ℕ) {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (h0 : 0 < 1 - ∑ i, (β i : ℚ) * e i) (h1 : 1 - ∑ i, (β i : ℚ) * e i ≤ 1) :
    ∃ a : ℕ, 0 < a ∧ (1 - ∑ i, (β i : ℚ) * e i) / q = ((∏ i, (e i).den).factorial : ℚ) / a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ : ∃ D, D = ∏ i, (e i).den := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hD]
  have hDpos : 0 < D := hD ▸ Finset.prod_pos fun i _ => (e i).den_pos
  
  have hint : ∃ z : ℤ, (D : ℚ) * ∑ i, (β i : ℚ) * e i = z := by
    have : ∀ i, ∃ z : ℤ, (D : ℚ) * ((β i : ℚ) * e i) = z := by
      intro i
      obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := dvd_den_mul_int (D := D)
        (hD ▸ Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem (fun i => (e i).den) (Finset.mem_univ i))
      exact ⟨β i * z, by push_cast; rw [← hz]; ring⟩
    choose z hz using this
    refine ⟨∑ i, z i, ?_⟩
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    push_cast
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => hz i
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hint
  have hDq : (0 : ℚ) < D := by exact_mod_cast hDpos
  have hzlt : z < D := by
    have : (z : ℚ) < D := by rw [← hz]; nlinarith
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hz0 : 0 ≤ z := by
    have : (0 : ℚ) ≤ z := by rw [← hz]; nlinarith
    exact_mod_cast this
  
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m : ℕ, (m : ℤ) = D - z := ⟨(D - z).toNat, Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)⟩
  have hm1 : 1 ≤ m := by omega
  have hmle : m ≤ D := by omega
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Nat.dvd_factorial (by omega : 0 < m) hmle
  have hk0 : 0 < k := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with h | h
    · rw [h, mul_zero] at hk
      exact absurd hk (Nat.factorial_pos D).ne'
    · exact h
  refine ⟨D * q * k, Nat.mul_pos (Nat.mul_pos hDpos hq) hk0, ?_⟩
  have hmq : (m : ℚ) = D - z := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have hD' : (D : ℚ) ≠ 0 := hDq.ne'
  have hq' : (q : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hq.ne'
  have hk' : (k : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hk0.ne'
  have h1' : 1 - ∑ i, (β i : ℚ) * e i = (m : ℚ) / D := by
    rw [hmq, ← hz, eq_div_iff hD']
    ring
  rw [h1', hk]
  push_cast
  rw [div_div, div_eq_div_iff (mul_ne_zero hD' hq') (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero hD' hq') hk')]
  ring

name: BezoutCounterexample.left_le_pairing
statement: theorem left_le_pairing (i j : ℕ) : i ≤ pairing (i, j)
proof: := Nat.left_le_pair i j

name: BezoutCounterexample.exists_coprime_factors
statement:
theorem exists_coprime_factors (a b : A) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    ∃ t : A × A × A, a = t.1 * t.2.1 ∧ b = t.1 * t.2.2 ∧ IsRelPrime t.2.1 t.2.2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a', b', c, hcop, ha, hb⟩ := UniqueFactorizationMonoid.exists_reduced_factors' a b hb
  exact ⟨(c, a', b'), ha.symm, hb.symm, hcop⟩

name: BezoutCounterexample.coprimeFactors_spec
statement:
theorem coprimeFactors_spec (a b : A) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    a = (coprimeFactors a b hb).1 * (coprimeFactors a b hb).2.1 ∧
      b = (coprimeFactors a b hb).1 * (coprimeFactors a b hb).2.2 ∧
      IsRelPrime (coprimeFactors a b hb).2.1 (coprimeFactors a b hb).2.2
proof:
:=
  (exists_coprime_factors a b hb).choose_spec

name: BezoutCounterexample.span_coprimeFactors_ne_bot
statement:
theorem span_coprimeFactors_ne_bot {a b : A} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    (Ideal.span {(coprimeFactors a b hb).2.1, (coprimeFactors a b hb).2.2} : Ideal A) ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply ha
  have h' : (coprimeFactors a b hb).2.1 ∈
      (Ideal.span {(coprimeFactors a b hb).2.1, (coprimeFactors a b hb).2.2} : Ideal A) :=
    Ideal.subset_span (by simp)
  rw [h, Ideal.mem_bot] at h'
  rw [(coprimeFactors_spec a b hb).1, h', mul_zero]

name: BezoutCounterexample.map_span_pair_eq_mul
statement:
theorem map_span_pair_eq_mul {A A' F : Type*} [CommRing A] [CommRing A'] [FunLike F A A']
    [RingHomClass F A A'] (f : F) {a b c a' b' : A} (ha : a = c * a') (hb : b = c * b') :
    (Ideal.span {a, b} : Ideal A).map f =
      Ideal.span {f c} * (Ideal.span {a', b'} : Ideal A).map f
proof:
:= by
  have h : (Ideal.span {a, b} : Ideal A) = Ideal.span {c} * Ideal.span {a', b'} := by
    rw [Ideal.span_mul_span, Set.singleton_mul, Set.image_pair, ← ha, ← hb]
  rw [h, Ideal.map_mul, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Construction.chooseSurj_surjective
statement:
theorem chooseSurj_surjective (A : SmoothFactorialDomain) :
    Function.Surjective (chooseSurj A)
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec (exists_surjective_nat (A × A))

name: BezoutCounterexample.Construction.principalizationStep_principal
statement:
theorem principalizationStep_principal (S : Stage) (a b : S.A) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    ((Ideal.span {(coprimeFactors a b hb).2.1, (coprimeFactors a b hb).2.2} : Ideal S.A).map
      (principalizationStep S a b ha hb).f).IsPrincipal
proof:
:=
  (principalizationResult _ _ (span_coprimeFactors_ne_bot ha hb) S.K S.isCompact_K).principal

name: BezoutCounterexample.Construction.principalizationStep_map_span
statement:
theorem principalizationStep_map_span (S : Stage) (a b : S.A) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    (Ideal.span {a, b} : Ideal S.A).map (principalizationStep S a b ha hb).f =
      Ideal.span {(principalizationStep S a b ha hb).f (coprimeFactors a b hb).1} *
        (Ideal.span {(coprimeFactors a b hb).2.1, (coprimeFactors a b hb).2.2} : Ideal S.A).map
          (principalizationStep S a b ha hb).f
proof:
:=
  map_span_pair_eq_mul _ (coprimeFactors_spec a b hb).1 (coprimeFactors_spec a b hb).2.1

name: BezoutCounterexample.Construction.step_of_eq_zero
statement:
theorem step_of_eq_zero (S : Stage) (a b : S.A) (h : a = 0 ∨ b = 0) :
    step S a b = trivialStep S a b h
proof:
:= by
  rw [step, dite_eq_left h]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Construction.step_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem step_of_ne_zero (S : Stage) (a b : S.A) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    step S a b = principalizationStep S a b ha hb
proof:
:= by
  rw [step, dite_eq_right (not_or.2 ⟨ha, hb⟩)]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Construction.nextStage_e_of_le
statement:
lemma nextStage_e_of_le (n : ℕ) (S : Stage) {i : ℕ} (h : i ≤ n) (j : ℕ) :
    (nextStage n S).e i j = Prod.map (step S (S.pair n).1 (S.pair n).2).f
      (step S (S.pair n).1 (S.pair n).2).f (S.e i j)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [nextStage, h, ite_true]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Construction.nextStage_e_succ
statement:
lemma nextStage_e_succ (n : ℕ) (S : Stage) (j : ℕ) :
    (nextStage n S).e (n + 1) j = chooseSurj (step S (S.pair n).1 (S.pair n).2).A' j
proof:
:= by
  simp [nextStage]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Construction.stage_zero
statement: theorem stage_zero : stage 0 = initialStage
proof: := rfl

name: BezoutCounterexample.Construction.stage_succ
statement: theorem stage_succ (n : ℕ) : stage (n + 1) = nextStage n (stage n)

name: BezoutCounterexample.Construction.A_zero
statement: theorem A_zero : A 0 = A₀SFD

name: BezoutCounterexample.Construction.K_zero
statement: theorem K_zero : K 0 = K₀

name: BezoutCounterexample.Construction.stepAt_of_eq_zero
statement:
theorem stepAt_of_eq_zero (n : ℕ) (h : (pairAt n).1 = 0 ∨ (pairAt n).2 = 0) :
    stepAt n = trivialStep (stage n) (pairAt n).1 (pairAt n).2 h
proof:
:=
  step_of_eq_zero _ _ _ h

name: BezoutCounterexample.Construction.stepAt_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem stepAt_of_ne_zero (n : ℕ) (ha : (pairAt n).1 ≠ 0) (hb : (pairAt n).2 ≠ 0) :
    stepAt n = principalizationStep (stage n) (pairAt n).1 (pairAt n).2 ha hb
proof:
:=
  step_of_ne_zero _ _ _ ha hb

name: BezoutCounterexample.Construction.A_succ_of_eq_zero
statement:
theorem A_succ_of_eq_zero (n : ℕ) (h : (pairAt n).1 = 0 ∨ (pairAt n).2 = 0) :
    A (n + 1) = A n
proof:
:= by
  show (stepAt n).A' = (stage n).A
  rw [stepAt_of_eq_zero n h]
  rfl

name: BezoutCounterexample.Construction.K_succ_of_eq_zero
statement:
theorem K_succ_of_eq_zero (n : ℕ) (h : (pairAt n).1 = 0 ∨ (pairAt n).2 = 0) :
    HEq (K (n + 1)) (K n)
proof:
:= by
  show HEq (stepAt n).K' (stage n).K
  rw [stepAt_of_eq_zero n h]
  exact HEq.rfl

name: BezoutCounterexample.Construction.isCompact_K
statement: theorem isCompact_K (n : ℕ) : IsCompact (K n)
proof: := (stage n).isCompact_K

name: BezoutCounterexample.Construction.incl_injective
statement: theorem incl_injective (n : ℕ) : Function.Injective (incl n)

name: BezoutCounterexample.Construction.isMonotoneSurjOn_incl
statement:
theorem isMonotoneSurjOn_incl (n : ℕ) :
    IsMonotoneSurjOn (RealPt.comap (incl n : A n →+* A (n + 1))) (K (n + 1)) (K n)
proof:

name: BezoutCounterexample.Construction.span_pairAt_map_isPrincipal
statement:
theorem span_pairAt_map_isPrincipal (n : ℕ) :
    ((Ideal.span {(pairAt n).1, (pairAt n).2} : Ideal (A n)).map (incl n)).IsPrincipal
proof:
:=
  (stepAt n).principal

name: BezoutCounterexample.Construction.inclLEFun_self
statement: lemma inclLEFun_self (i : ℕ) (a : A i) : inclLEFun (le_refl i) a = a
proof:
:=
  Nat.leRecOn_self _

name: BezoutCounterexample.Construction.inclLEFun_succ
statement:
lemma inclLEFun_succ {i j : ℕ} (h : i ≤ j) (a : A i) :
    inclLEFun (h.trans (Nat.le_succ j)) a = incl j (inclLEFun h a)
proof:
:=
  Nat.leRecOn_succ h _

name: BezoutCounterexample.Construction.inclLEFun_trans
statement:
lemma inclLEFun_trans {i j k : ℕ} (hij : i ≤ j) (hjk : j ≤ k) (a : A i) :
    inclLEFun (hij.trans hjk) a = inclLEFun hjk (inclLEFun hij a)
proof:
:=
  Nat.leRecOn_trans hij hjk _

name: BezoutCounterexample.Construction.inclLE_apply
statement: lemma inclLE_apply {i j : ℕ} (h : i ≤ j) (a : A i) : inclLE h a = inclLEFun h a
proof: := rfl

name: BezoutCounterexample.Construction.inclLE_self
statement: lemma inclLE_self (i : ℕ) (a : A i) : inclLE (le_refl i) a = a
proof: := inclLEFun_self i a

name: BezoutCounterexample.Construction.inclLE_succ
statement:
lemma inclLE_succ {i j : ℕ} (h : i ≤ j) (a : A i) :
    inclLE (h.trans (Nat.le_succ j)) a = incl j (inclLE h a)
proof: := inclLEFun_succ h a

name: BezoutCounterexample.Construction.inclLE_trans
statement:
lemma inclLE_trans {i j k : ℕ} (hij : i ≤ j) (hjk : j ≤ k) (a : A i) :
    inclLE (hij.trans hjk) a = inclLE hjk (inclLE hij a)
proof: := inclLEFun_trans hij hjk a

name: BezoutCounterexample.Construction.inclLE_succ_self
statement: lemma inclLE_succ_self (n : ℕ) (a : A n) : inclLE (Nat.le_succ n) a = incl n a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← inclLE_self n a, ← inclLE_succ (le_refl n), inclLE_self]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Construction.inclLE_injective
statement: lemma inclLE_injective {i j : ℕ} (h : i ≤ j) : Function.Injective (inclLE h)
proof:
:=
  Nat.leRecOn_injective h _ (fun k => incl_injective k)

name: BezoutCounterexample.Construction.ι_zero
statement: lemma ι_zero (a : A₀) : ι 0 a = a
proof: := inclLE_self 0 a

name: BezoutCounterexample.Construction.ι_succ
statement: lemma ι_succ (n : ℕ) (a : A₀) : ι (n + 1) a = incl n (ι n a)
proof:
:=
  inclLE_succ (Nat.zero_le n) a

name: BezoutCounterexample.Construction.η_surjective
statement: theorem η_surjective (i : ℕ) : Function.Surjective (η i)
proof:
:= by
  cases i with
  | zero => exact chooseSurj_surjective A₀SFD
  | succ n =>
    have : η (n + 1) = chooseSurj (A (n + 1)) := funext fun j => nextStage_e_succ n (stage n) j
    rw [this]
    exact chooseSurj_surjective _

name: BezoutCounterexample.Construction.e_eq
statement:
theorem e_eq {i : ℕ} (j : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (h : i ≤ n) :
    (stage n).e i j = Prod.map (inclLE h) (inclLE h) (η i j)
proof:
:= by
  induction n, h using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => ext <;> simp [η, inclLE_self]
  | succ k hik ih =>
    have h1 : (stage (k + 1)).e i j = Prod.map (incl k) (incl k) ((stage k).e i j) :=
      nextStage_e_of_le k (stage k) hik j
    rw [h1, ih]
    ext <;> simp only [Prod.map_fst, Prod.map_snd] <;> exact (inclLE_succ hik _).symm

name: BezoutCounterexample.Construction.pairAt_eq
statement:
theorem pairAt_eq (i j : ℕ) :
    pairAt (pairing (i, j)) =
      Prod.map (inclLE (left_le_pairing i j)) (inclLE (left_le_pairing i j)) (η i j)
proof:
:= by
  have h := e_eq j (left_le_pairing i j)
  rw [pairAt, Stage.pair, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  exact h

name: BezoutCounterexample.Construction.isMonotoneSurjOn_ι
statement: theorem isMonotoneSurjOn_ι (n : ℕ) : IsMonotoneSurjOn (RealPt.comap (ι n)) (K n) K₀
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    have : RealPt.comap (ι 0) = fun z => z := by
      funext z
      ext a
      exact congrArg z (ι_zero a)
    rw [this]
    exact IsMonotoneSurjOn.id K₀
  | succ n ih =>
    have : RealPt.comap (ι (n + 1)) =
        RealPt.comap (ι n) ∘ RealPt.comap (incl n : A n →+* A (n + 1)) := by
      funext z
      ext a
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, RealPt.comap_apply, ι_succ]
      rfl
    rw [this]
    exact IsMonotoneSurjOn.trans (isCompact_K (n + 1)) ih (isMonotoneSurjOn_incl n)

name: BezoutCounterexample.Construction.mapsTo_K₀
statement: theorem mapsTo_K₀ (n : ℕ) : MapsTo (RealPt.comap (ι n)) (K n) K₀
proof:
:=
  (isMonotoneSurjOn_ι n).1

name: BezoutCounterexample.Construction.Δ_eq_zero
statement: theorem Δ_eq_zero (n : ℕ) {z : RealPt (A n)} (hz : z ∈ K n) : z (ι n Δ) = 0
proof:

  mapsTo_K₀ n hz

name: BezoutCounterexample.Construction.circle
statement:
theorem circle (n : ℕ) {z : RealPt (A n)} (hz : z ∈ K n) :
    z (ι n x) ^ 2 + z (ι n y) ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:=
  K₀_circle (mapsTo_K₀ n hz)

name: BezoutCounterexample.Construction.K_nonempty
statement: theorem K_nonempty (n : ℕ) : (K n).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact ⟨circlePt 0, circlePt_mem 0⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨hmaps, hq⟩ := isMonotoneSurjOn_incl n
    obtain ⟨w, -⟩ := hq.surjective ⟨z, hz⟩
    exact ⟨w.1, w.2⟩

name: BezoutCounterexample.Construction.nonorientable
statement:
theorem nonorientable (n : ℕ) :
    ¬ IsOrientable (fun z : K n => z.1 (ι n x)) (fun z : K n => z.1 (ι n y))
proof:
:=
  not_isOrientable_pullback (ι n) x y (isCompact_K n) (isMonotoneSurjOn_ι n)
    (fun _ hz => K₀_circle hz) L₀_not_isOrientable

name: BezoutCounterexample.R.of_inclLE
statement: lemma of_inclLE {i j : ℕ} (h : i ≤ j) (a : A i) : of j (inclLE h a) = of i a
proof:
:=
  Ring.DirectLimit.of_f (G := fun n => (A n : Type)) (f := fun _ _ h => ⇑(inclLE h)) h a

name: BezoutCounterexample.R.of_incl
statement: lemma of_incl (n : ℕ) (a : A n) : of (n + 1) (incl n a) = of n a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← inclLE_succ_self, of_inclLE]

name: BezoutCounterexample.R.of_injective
statement: lemma of_injective (n : ℕ) : Function.Injective (of n)
proof:
:=
  Ring.DirectLimit.of_injective (G := fun n => (A n : Type)) (fun _ _ h => inclLE h)
    (fun _ _ h => inclLE_injective h) n

name: BezoutCounterexample.R.exists_of
statement: lemma exists_of (r : R) : ∃ n a, of n a = r
proof: := Ring.DirectLimit.exists_of r

name: BezoutCounterexample.R.exists_of_fin
statement:
lemma exists_of_fin (k : ℕ) (v : Fin k → R) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (w : Fin k → A n), ∀ t, of n (w t) = v t
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, Fin.elim0, fun t => Fin.elim0 t⟩
  | succ k ih =>
    obtain ⟨n, w, hw⟩ := ih (fun t => v t.castSucc)
    obtain ⟨m, a, ha⟩ := exists_of (v (Fin.last k))
    refine ⟨max n m, Fin.lastCases (inclLE (le_max_right n m) a)
      (fun t => inclLE (le_max_left n m) (w t)), fun t => ?_⟩
    induction t using Fin.lastCases with
    | last => simp only [Fin.lastCases_last, of_inclLE, ha]
    | cast t => simp only [Fin.lastCases_castSucc, of_inclLE, hw]

name: BezoutCounterexample.R.of_ι
statement: lemma of_ι (n : ℕ) (a : A₀) : of n (Construction.ι n a) = ι a

name: BezoutCounterexample.R.ι_injective

name: BezoutCounterexample.disjoint_of_comap
statement:
lemma disjoint_of_comap {S : Submonoid A} {L : Type*} [CommRing L] [Algebra A L]
    [IsLocalization S L] (Q : Ideal L) [hQ : Q.IsPrime] :
    Disjoint (S : Set A) (Q.comap (algebraMap A L) : Set A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro s hs hsQ
  exact hQ.ne_top (Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem _ hsQ (map_units L ⟨s, hs⟩))

name: BezoutCounterexample.UniqueFactorizationMonoid.of_isLocalization
statement:
theorem UniqueFactorizationMonoid.of_isLocalization [UniqueFactorizationMonoid A]
    (S : Submonoid A) (hS : (0 : A) ∉ S) (L : Type*) [CommRing L] [Algebra A L]
    [IsLocalization S L] : UniqueFactorizationMonoid L
proof:
:= by
  have hSle : S ≤ nonZeroDivisors A := fun s hs =>
    mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero (fun h => hS (h ▸ hs))
  have : IsDomain L := isDomain_of_le_nonZeroDivisors L hSle
  rw [UniqueFactorizationMonoid.iff_exists_prime_mem_of_isPrime]
  intro Q hQ0 hQ
  set P := Q.comap (algebraMap A L)
  have hP : P.IsPrime := Ideal.comap_isPrime _ Q
  have hdisj := disjoint_of_comap (S := S) Q
  have hP0 : P ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro h
    apply hQ0
    rw [eq_bot_iff]
    intro q hq
    obtain ⟨⟨a, s⟩, rfl⟩ := mk'_surjective S q
    have ha : algebraMap A L a ∈ Q := by
      rw [← mk'_spec L a s]; exact Q.mul_mem_right _ hq
    have : a ∈ P := ha
    rw [h, Ideal.mem_bot] at this
    simp [this]
  obtain ⟨π, hπP, hπ⟩ :=
    (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.iff_exists_prime_mem_of_isPrime.1 inferInstance) P hP0 hP
  refine ⟨algebraMap A L π, hπP, ?_⟩
  have hspan : (Ideal.span {π}).IsPrime := (Ideal.span_singleton_prime hπ.ne_zero).2 hπ
  have hdisj' : Disjoint (S : Set A) (Ideal.span {π} : Set A) :=
    hdisj.mono_right (by
      intro z hz
      exact (Ideal.span_le.2 (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hπP)) hz)
  have hmap := isPrime_of_isPrime_disjoint S L _ hspan hdisj'
  rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton] at hmap
  have hne : algebraMap A L π ≠ 0 := fun h =>
    hπ.ne_zero ((IsLocalization.injective L hSle) (by rw [h, map_zero]))
  exact (Ideal.span_singleton_prime hne).1 hmap

name: BezoutCounterexample.UniqueFactorizationMonoid.of_isLocalization_away
proof:
:= by
  have hSle : Submonoid.powers p ≤ nonZeroDivisors A := by
    rintro _ ⟨n, rfl⟩
    exact mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero n hp.ne_zero)
  have : IsDomain L := isDomain_of_le_nonZeroDivisors L hSle
  have hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap A L) := IsLocalization.injective L hSle
  rw [UniqueFactorizationMonoid.iff_exists_prime_mem_of_isPrime]
  intro P hP0 hP
  by_cases hpP : p ∈ P
  · exact ⟨p, hpP, hp⟩
  
  have hdisj : Disjoint (Submonoid.powers p : Set A) (P : Set A) := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    rintro _ ⟨n, rfl⟩ h
    exact hpP (hP.mem_of_pow_mem n h)
  set Q := P.map (algebraMap A L)
  have hQ : Q.IsPrime := isPrime_of_isPrime_disjoint _ L P hP hdisj
  have hQP : Q.comap (algebraMap A L) = P := under_map_of_isPrime_disjoint _ L hP hdisj
  have hQ0 : Q ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro h
    apply hP0
    rw [eq_bot_iff]
    intro a ha
    have : algebraMap A L a ∈ Q := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ ha
    rw [h, Ideal.mem_bot] at this
    rw [Ideal.mem_bot]
    exact hinj (by rw [this, map_zero])
  obtain ⟨q, hqQ, hq⟩ :=
    (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.iff_exists_prime_mem_of_isPrime.1 inferInstance) Q hQ0 hQ
  obtain ⟨⟨a, s⟩, hqa⟩ := mk'_surjective (Submonoid.powers p) q
  simp only at hqa
  
  have has : algebraMap A L a = q * algebraMap A L s := by rw [← hqa, mk'_spec]
  have haP : a ∈ P := by
    rw [← hQP]
    show algebraMap A L a ∈ Q
    rw [has]; exact Q.mul_mem_right _ hqQ
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [map_zero, eq_comm, mul_eq_zero] at has
    rcases has with h | h
    · exact hq.ne_zero h
    · exact (map_units L s).ne_zero h
  
  obtain ⟨a', ha', hpa'⟩ :=
    (FiniteMultiplicity.of_not_isUnit hp.not_isUnit ha0).exists_eq_pow_mul_and_not_dvd
  set m := multiplicity p a
  have ha'P : a' ∈ P := by
    rw [ha'] at haP
    rcases hP.mem_or_mem haP with h | h
    · exact absurd (hP.mem_of_pow_mem m h) hpP
    · exact h
  refine ⟨a', ha'P, ?_⟩
  
  have hassoc : Associated q (algebraMap A L a') := by
    have h1 : Associated q (algebraMap A L a) := by
      rw [has]; exact associated_mul_unit_right q _ (map_units L s)
    have h2 : Associated (algebraMap A L a') (algebraMap A L a) := by
      rw [ha', map_mul]
      exact associated_unit_mul_right _ _ ((IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit p).pow m |>
        fun h => by simpa [map_pow] using h)
    exact h1.trans h2.symm
  have ha'L : Prime (algebraMap A L a') := hassoc.prime hq
  refine ⟨fun h => hpa' (h ▸ dvd_zero p), fun hu => ha'L.not_isUnit (hu.map _), ?_⟩
  intro b c hbc
  have hbcL : algebraMap A L a' ∣ algebraMap A L b * algebraMap A L c := by
    rw [← map_mul]; exact map_dvd _ hbc
  
  have key : ∀ d : A, algebraMap A L a' ∣ algebraMap A L d → a' ∣ d := by
    intro d ⟨e, he⟩
    obtain ⟨⟨f, ⟨_, n, rfl⟩⟩, rfl⟩ := mk'_surjective (Submonoid.powers p) e
    simp only at he
    have h1 : algebraMap A L (d * p ^ n) = algebraMap A L (a' * f) := by
      rw [map_mul, he, map_mul, mul_assoc, mk'_spec]
    obtain ⟨⟨_, k, rfl⟩, hk⟩ := (IsLocalization.eq_iff_exists (Submonoid.powers p) L).1 h1
    simp only at hk
    
    have h2 : p ^ (k + n) ∣ a' * (p ^ k * f) := ⟨d, by rw [pow_add]; linear_combination hk.symm⟩
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hp.pow_dvd_of_dvd_mul_left (k + n) hpa' h2
    refine ⟨g, ?_⟩
    have h3 : p ^ (k + n) * d = p ^ (k + n) * (a' * g) := by
      rw [pow_add] at hg ⊢
      linear_combination hk + a' * hg
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero _ hp.ne_zero) h3
  rcases ha'L.dvd_or_dvd hbcL with h | h
  · exact Or.inl (key b h)
  · exact Or.inr (key c h)
