name: BezoutCounterexample.prime_laurentPolynomial_C
statement:
theorem prime_laurentPolynomial_C {p : A} (hp : Prime p) :
    Prime (LaurentPolynomial.C p : A[T;T⁻¹])
proof:
:= by
  have hpX : Prime (Polynomial.C p) := Polynomial.prime_C_iff.2 hp
  have hsle : Submonoid.powers (Polynomial.X : Polynomial A) ≤ nonZeroDivisors (Polynomial A) :=
    powers_le_nonZeroDivisors_of_noZeroDivisors Polynomial.X_ne_zero
  have hdisj : Disjoint (Submonoid.powers (Polynomial.X : Polynomial A) : Set (Polynomial A))
      (Ideal.span {Polynomial.C p} : Set (Polynomial A)) := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    rintro _ ⟨n, rfl⟩ h
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at h
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := h
    have := congrArg (fun f => Polynomial.coeff f n) hq
    simp only [Polynomial.coeff_X_pow_self, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul] at this
    exact hp.not_isUnit (IsUnit.of_mul_eq_one _ this.symm)
  have hprime := isPrime_of_isPrime_disjoint (Submonoid.powers (Polynomial.X : Polynomial A))
    A[T;T⁻¹] _ ((Ideal.span_singleton_prime hpX.ne_zero).2 hpX) hdisj
  rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton] at hprime
  have hC : algebraMap (Polynomial A) A[T;T⁻¹] (Polynomial.C p) = LaurentPolynomial.C p := by
    simp [LaurentPolynomial.algebraMap_eq_toLaurent]
  rw [hC] at hprime
  have hne : (LaurentPolynomial.C p : A[T;T⁻¹]) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have h0 : (LaurentPolynomial.C p * T 0 : A[T;T⁻¹]) = 0 := by rw [T_zero, mul_one, h]
    rw [← single_eq_C_mul_T] at h0
    exact hp.ne_zero (AddMonoidAlgebra.single_eq_zero.1 h0)
  exact (Ideal.span_singleton_prime hne).1 hprime

name: BezoutCounterexample.principalization_extension_ideal
statement:
theorem principalization_extension_ideal (A : SmoothFactorialDomain) (I : Ideal A) (hI : I ≠ ⊥)
    (K : Set (RealPt A)) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ (A' : SmoothFactorialDomain) (f : A →ₐ[ℚ] A') (K' : Set (RealPt A')),
      Function.Injective f ∧ (I.map f).IsPrincipal ∧ IsCompact K' ∧
        IsMonotoneSurjOn (RealPt.comap (f : A →+* A')) K' K
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_ringKrullDim_eq_natCast A
  exact principalization_star N A I 0 hI (star_initial hN I) K hK

name: BezoutCounterexample.principalization_extension
statement:
theorem principalization_extension (A : SmoothFactorialDomain) (a b : A)
    (hab : a ≠ 0 ∨ b ≠ 0) (K : Set (RealPt A)) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ (A' : SmoothFactorialDomain) (f : A →ₐ[ℚ] A') (K' : Set (RealPt A')),
      Function.Injective f ∧ (Ideal.span {f a, f b} : Ideal A').IsPrincipal ∧
      IsCompact K' ∧ IsMonotoneSurjOn (RealPt.comap (f : A →+* A')) K' K
proof:
:= by
  have hI : (Ideal.span {a, b} : Ideal A) ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro h
    have ha : a = 0 := by
      have hm : a ∈ (Ideal.span {a, b} : Ideal A) := Ideal.subset_span (by simp)
      simpa [h] using hm
    have hb : b = 0 := by
      have hm : b ∈ (Ideal.span {a, b} : Ideal A) := Ideal.subset_span (by simp)
      simpa [h] using hm
    exact hab.elim (fun h => h ha) (fun h => h hb)
  obtain ⟨A', f, K', hf, hpr, hK', hmono⟩ :=
    principalization_extension_ideal A (Ideal.span {a, b}) hI K hK
  refine ⟨A', f, K', hf, ?_, hK', hmono⟩
  simpa only [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_pair] using hpr

name: BezoutCounterexample.Jou.rel_eq
statement: lemma rel_eq (c : Fin r → B) : rel c = ∑ i, C (c i) * X i - 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rel, mul_comm]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Jou.mk_rel
statement: lemma mk_rel (c : Fin r → B) : mk c (rel c) = 0
proof:
:=
  Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.2 (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)

name: BezoutCounterexample.Jou.mk_C
statement: lemma mk_C (c : Fin r → B) (a : B) : mk c (C a) = algebraMap B (J c) a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq, AlgHom.commutes]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Jou.algebraMap_eq_mk_comp_C
statement:
lemma algebraMap_eq_mk_comp_C (c : Fin r → B) :
    algebraMap B (J c) = (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {rel c})).comp C
proof:
:= by
  ext b
  rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply B (MvPolynomial (Fin r) B), MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq,
    Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq]
  rfl

name: BezoutCounterexample.Jou.sum_σ_mul
statement: lemma sum_σ_mul (c : Fin r → B) : ∑ i, σ c i * algebraMap B (J c) (c i) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ∑ i, σ c i * algebraMap B (J c) (c i) = mk c (∑ i, X i * C (c i)) := by
    rw [map_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by rw [map_mul, mk_C]; rfl
  have h2 : (∑ i, X i * C (c i) : MvPolynomial (Fin r) B) = rel c + 1 := by
    rw [rel, sub_add_cancel]
  rw [h1, h2, map_add, mk_rel, map_one, zero_add]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Jou.map_rel
statement:
lemma map_rel {D : Type*} [CommRing D] (f : B →+* D) (c : Fin r → B) :
    MvPolynomial.map f (rel c) = rel (f ∘ c)
proof:
:= by
  simp [rel]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Jou.rel_nzd
statement:
lemma rel_nzd {D : Type*} [CommRing D] (c : Fin r → D) {p : MvPolynomial (Fin r) D}
    (h : p * rel c = 0) : p = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hu : IsUnit ((rel c : MvPolynomial (Fin r) D) : MvPowerSeries (Fin r) D) := by
    rw [MvPowerSeries.isUnit_iff_constantCoeff, ← MvPowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply,
      MvPolynomial.coeff_coe, ← MvPolynomial.constantCoeff_eq]
    have : MvPolynomial.constantCoeff (rel c) = -1 := by
      rw [rel]; simp
    rw [this]; exact isUnit_one.neg
  have h2 : ((p : MvPolynomial (Fin r) D) : MvPowerSeries (Fin r) D) *
      ((rel c : MvPolynomial (Fin r) D) : MvPowerSeries (Fin r) D) = 0 := by
    rw [← MvPolynomial.coe_mul, h, MvPolynomial.coe_zero]
  have h3 := hu.mul_left_eq_zero.1 h2
  exact MvPolynomial.coe_injective (Fin r) D (h3.trans MvPolynomial.coe_zero.symm)

name: BezoutCounterexample.Jou.C_mul_mem
statement:
lemma C_mul_mem [IsDomain B] (c : Fin r → B) {b : B} (hb : b ≠ 0) {p : MvPolynomial (Fin r) B}
    (h : C b * p ∈ Ideal.span {rel c}) : p ∈ Ideal.span {rel c}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.1 h
  set π := Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {b})
  have h1 : MvPolynomial.map π a * rel (π ∘ c) = 0 := by
    have := congrArg (MvPolynomial.map π) ha
    rw [map_mul, map_mul, map_C, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.2 (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self b),
      C_0, zero_mul, map_rel] at this
    exact this
  have h2 := rel_nzd _ h1
  have h3 : a ∈ Ideal.map (C : B →+* MvPolynomial (Fin r) B) (RingHom.ker π) := by
    rw [← MvPolynomial.ker_map]; exact h2
  rw [Ideal.mk_ker, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton] at h3
  obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.1 h3
  have hCb : (C b : MvPolynomial (Fin r) B) ≠ 0 := by simpa using hb
  have : C b * p = C b * (a' * rel c) := by rw [← ha, ← ha']; ring
  rw [mul_left_cancel₀ hCb this]
  exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)

name: BezoutCounterexample.Jou.algebraMap_mul_eq_zero
statement:
lemma algebraMap_mul_eq_zero [IsDomain B] (c : Fin r → B) {b : B} (hb : b ≠ 0) {u : J c}
    (h : algebraMap B (J c) b * u = 0) : u = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective u
  rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply B (MvPolynomial (Fin r) B), MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq,
    Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq, ← map_mul, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem] at h
  exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.2 (C_mul_mem c hb h)

name: BezoutCounterexample.Jou.map_mk
statement:
lemma map_mk (p : MvPolynomial (Fin r) B) :
    map f c (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ p) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPolynomial.map f p)
proof: := rfl

name: BezoutCounterexample.Jou.map_algebraMap
statement: lemma map_algebraMap (b : B) : map f c (algebraMap B (J c) b) = algebraMap B' (J (f ∘ c)) (f b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply B (MvPolynomial (Fin r) B), MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq,
    Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq, map_mk, map_C, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply B' (MvPolynomial (Fin r) B'),
    MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq, Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Jou.map_σ
statement: lemma map_σ (i : Fin r) : map f c (σ c i) = σ (f ∘ c) i
proof:
:= by
  simp [σ, map_mk]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Jou.map_surjective
statement: lemma map_surjective (hf : Function.Surjective f) : Function.Surjective (map f c)
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective z
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := MvPolynomial.map_surjective _ hf p
  exact ⟨Ideal.Quotient.mk _ q, rfl⟩

name: BezoutCounterexample.Jou.mapAlgHom_σ
statement: lemma mapAlgHom_σ (i : Fin r) : mapAlgHom B' c (σ c i) = σ (algebraMap B B' ∘ c) i
proof:
:=
  map_σ _ _ i

name: BezoutCounterexample.Jou.tensorEquiv_tmul
statement:
@[simp] lemma tensorEquiv_tmul (b' : B') (z : J c) :
    tensorEquiv B' c (b' ⊗ₜ z) = b' • map (algebraMap B B') c z
proof: := rfl

name: BezoutCounterexample.Jou.ker_map_quotient
statement:
lemma ker_map_quotient (c : Fin r → B) (𝔞 : Ideal B) :
    RingHom.ker (map (Ideal.Quotient.mk 𝔞) c) = 𝔞.map (algebraMap B (J c))
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro z hz
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective z
    rw [RingHom.mem_ker, map_mk, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem] at hz
    obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.1 hz
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := MvPolynomial.map_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective a'
    rw [← map_rel, ← map_mul, ← sub_eq_zero, ← map_sub] at ha'
    have hk : p - a * rel c ∈ Ideal.map (C : B →+* MvPolynomial (Fin r) B)
        (RingHom.ker (Ideal.Quotient.mk 𝔞)) := by
      rw [← MvPolynomial.ker_map, RingHom.mem_ker, ← neg_sub, map_neg, ha', neg_zero]
    rw [Ideal.mk_ker] at hk
    have h1 : Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {rel c}) p =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {rel c}) (p - a * rel c) := by
      rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq, show p - (p - a * rel c) = a * rel c by ring]
      exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)
    rw [h1, algebraMap_eq_mk_comp_C, ← Ideal.map_map]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hk
  · rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    intro b hb
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap, RingHom.mem_ker, map_algebraMap, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.2 hb,
      map_zero]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Jou.redHom_surjective
statement: lemma redHom_surjective : Function.Surjective (redHom c b)
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective z
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := MvPolynomial.map_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective p
  exact ⟨Ideal.Quotient.mk _ q, rfl⟩

name: BezoutCounterexample.Jou.ker_redHom
statement: lemma ker_redHom : RingHom.ker (redHom c b) = Ideal.span {algebraMap B (J c) b}
proof:
:= by
  have h := ker_map_quotient c (Ideal.span {b})
  rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton] at h
  exact h

name: BezoutCounterexample.Jou.exists_clear
statement:
lemma exists_clear (M : Submonoid B) [Algebra B B'] [IsLocalization M B'] (p : MvPolynomial (Fin r) B') :
    ∃ (q : MvPolynomial (Fin r) B) (m : M),
      MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap B B') q = C (algebraMap B B' m) * p
proof:
:= by
  let := MvPolynomial.algebraMvPolynomial (σ := Fin r) (R := B) (S := B')
  obtain ⟨⟨q, ⟨_, m, hm, rfl⟩⟩, hq⟩ := IsLocalization.surj (M.map (C (σ := Fin r))) p
  refine ⟨q, ⟨m, hm⟩, ?_⟩
  simp only [MvPolynomial.algebraMap_def, map_C] at hq
  rw [← hq, mul_comm]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Jou.exists_kill
statement:
lemma exists_kill (M : Submonoid B) [Algebra B B'] [IsLocalization M B'] {g : MvPolynomial (Fin r) B}
    (hg : MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap B B') g = 0) : ∃ m : M, C (m : B) * g = 0
proof:
:= by
  let := MvPolynomial.algebraMvPolynomial (σ := Fin r) (R := B) (S := B')
  have : algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r) B) (MvPolynomial (Fin r) B') g = 0 := by
    rw [MvPolynomial.algebraMap_def]; exact hg
  obtain ⟨⟨_, m, hm, rfl⟩, h⟩ := (IsLocalization.map_eq_zero_iff (M.map (C (σ := Fin r))) _ g).1 this
  exact ⟨⟨m, hm⟩, h⟩

name: BezoutCounterexample.Jou.isLocalization_map
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra (J c) (J (algebraMap B B' ∘ c)) := (map (algebraMap B B') c).toAlgebra
  have hmap : ∀ z : J c, algebraMap (J c) (J (algebraMap B B' ∘ c)) z = map (algebraMap B B') c z :=
    fun _ => rfl
  have hJC : ∀ b : B, algebraMap B (J c) b = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (C b) := fun b => by
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply B (MvPolynomial (Fin r) B), MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq,
      Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩⟩
    rw [hmap, map_algebraMap]
    exact (IsLocalization.map_units B' ⟨m, hm⟩).map _
  · intro z
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective z
    obtain ⟨q, m, hq⟩ := exists_clear M p
    refine ⟨⟨Ideal.Quotient.mk _ q, ⟨algebraMap B (J c) m, ⟨m, m.2, rfl⟩⟩⟩, ?_⟩
    simp only
    rw [hmap, hmap, map_mk, map_algebraMap, hq, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply B' (MvPolynomial (Fin r) B'),
      MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq, Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq, map_mul, mul_comm]
  · intro z z' h
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective z
    obtain ⟨p', rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective z'
    rw [hmap, hmap, map_mk, map_mk, Ideal.Quotient.eq, ← map_sub] at h
    obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.1 h
    obtain ⟨a, m, ha⟩ := exists_clear M a'
    have hk : MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap B B') (C (m : B) * (p - p') - a * rel c) = 0 := by
      rw [map_sub, map_mul, map_mul, map_C, ha, map_rel, ← ha']
      ring
    obtain ⟨m', hm'⟩ := exists_kill M hk
    refine ⟨⟨algebraMap B (J c) (m' * m), ⟨m' * m, (m' * m).2, rfl⟩⟩, ?_⟩
    simp only
    rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← mul_sub, hJC, ← map_sub, ← map_mul, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
    have : C ((m' : B) * m) * (p - p') = (C (m' : B) * a) * rel c := by
      rw [C_mul]
      linear_combination hm'
    rw [this]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)

name: BezoutCounterexample.Jou.elimHom_rel
statement:
lemma elimHom_rel {L : Type*} [CommRing L] (φ : B →+* L) (u : Lˣ) (hu : φ (c l) = u) :
    elimHom c l φ u (rel c) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [elimHom, rel, map_sub, map_sum, map_mul, eval₂Hom_X', eval₂Hom_C, RingHom.comp_apply,
    map_one]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_succAbove _ l]
  simp only [solveVals, Fin.insertNth_apply_same, Fin.insertNth_apply_succAbove, hu]
  have : (C (↑u⁻¹ : L) * (1 - ∑ j, X j * C (φ (c (l.succAbove j))))) * C (u : L) =
      (1 - ∑ j, X j * C (φ (c (l.succAbove j))) : MvPolynomial (Fin r) L) := by
    rw [mul_comm, ← mul_assoc, ← C_mul, Units.mul_inv, C_1, one_mul]
  rw [this]; ring

name: BezoutCounterexample.Jou.elimHom_rename
statement:
lemma elimHom_rename {L : Type*} [CommRing L] (φ : B →+* L) (u : Lˣ) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin r) B) :
    elimHom c l φ u (rename l.succAbove p) = MvPolynomial.map φ p
proof:
:= by
  have : (elimHom c l φ u).comp (rename l.succAbove).toRingHom = MvPolynomial.map φ := by
    refine MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext (fun a => ?_) (fun j => ?_)
    · simp [elimHom]
    · simp [elimHom, solveVals, Fin.insertNth_apply_succAbove]
  exact congrArg (fun f : MvPolynomial (Fin r) B →+* MvPolynomial (Fin r) L => f p) this

name: BezoutCounterexample.Jou.exists_pseudo
statement:
lemma exists_pseudo (p : MvPolynomial (Fin (r + 1)) B) :
    ∃ (N : ℕ) (q : MvPolynomial (Fin (r + 1)) B) (p₀ : MvPolynomial (Fin r) B),
      C (c l) ^ N * p = q * rel c + rename l.succAbove p₀
proof:
:= by
  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C a => exact ⟨0, 0, C a, by simp⟩
  | add p p' ih ih' =>
    obtain ⟨N, q, p₀, h⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨N', q', p₀', h'⟩ := ih'
    refine ⟨N + N', C (c l) ^ N' * q + C (c l) ^ N * q',
      C (c l) ^ N' * p₀ + C (c l) ^ N * p₀', ?_⟩
    rw [map_add, map_mul, map_mul, map_pow, map_pow, rename_C, pow_add, mul_add]
    calc C (c l) ^ N * C (c l) ^ N' * p + C (c l) ^ N * C (c l) ^ N' * p'
        = C (c l) ^ N' * (C (c l) ^ N * p) + C (c l) ^ N * (C (c l) ^ N' * p') := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [h, h']; ring
  | mul_X p i ih =>
    obtain ⟨N, q, p₀, h⟩ := ih
    by_cases hi : i = l
    · subst hi
      set g₀ : MvPolynomial (Fin r) B := 1 - ∑ j, X j * C (c (i.succAbove j))
      have hg : X i * C (c i) = rel c + rename i.succAbove g₀ := by
        simp only [g₀, rel, map_sub, map_one, map_sum, map_mul, rename_X, rename_C]
        rw [Fin.sum_univ_succAbove _ i]; ring
      refine ⟨N + 1, q * (rel c + rename i.succAbove g₀) + rename i.succAbove p₀,
        p₀ * g₀, ?_⟩
      calc C (c i) ^ (N + 1) * (p * X i) = (C (c i) ^ N * p) * (X i * C (c i)) := by ring
        _ = _ := by rw [h, hg, map_mul]; ring
    · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := Fin.exists_succAbove_eq hi
      refine ⟨N, q * X (l.succAbove j), p₀ * X j, ?_⟩
      calc C (c l) ^ N * (p * X (l.succAbove j)) = (C (c l) ^ N * p) * X (l.succAbove j) := by ring
        _ = _ := by rw [h, map_mul, rename_X]; ring

name: BezoutCounterexample.Jou.elim_mk
statement:
lemma elim_mk {L : Type*} [CommRing L] (φ : B →+* L) (u : Lˣ) (hu : φ (c l) = u)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin (r + 1)) B) : elim φ u hu (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ p) = elimHom c l φ u p
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: BezoutCounterexample.Jou.elim_algebraMap
statement:
lemma elim_algebraMap {L : Type*} [CommRing L] (φ : B →+* L) (u : Lˣ) (hu : φ (c l) = u) (b : B) :
    elim φ u hu (algebraMap B (J c) b) = C (φ b)
proof:
:= by
  have : algebraMap B (J c) b = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (C b) := by
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply B (MvPolynomial (Fin (r + 1)) B), MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq,
      Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq]
  rw [this, elim_mk]; simp [elimHom]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Jou.elim_σ
statement:
lemma elim_σ {L : Type*} [CommRing L] (φ : B →+* L) (u : Lˣ) (hu : φ (c l) = u) (j : Fin r) :
    elim φ u hu (σ c (l.succAbove j)) = X j
proof:
:= by
  show elim φ u hu (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (X (l.succAbove j))) = _
  rw [elim_mk]
  simp [elimHom, solveVals, Fin.insertNth_apply_succAbove]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Jou.elimLoc_algebraMap
statement:
lemma elimLoc_algebraMap (b : B) :
    elimLoc c l (algebraMap B (J c) b) = C (algebraMap B (Localization.Away (c l)) b)
proof:
:=
  elim_algebraMap _ _ _ b

name: BezoutCounterexample.Jou.elimLoc_σ
statement: lemma elimLoc_σ (j : Fin r) : elimLoc c l (σ c (l.succAbove j)) = X j
proof: := elim_σ _ _ _ j

name: BezoutCounterexample.Jou.exists_pow_mul_eq_zero_of_elimLoc
statement:
lemma exists_pow_mul_eq_zero_of_elimLoc {z : J c} (hz : elimLoc c l z = 0) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, algebraMap B (J c) (c l) ^ n * z = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective z
  obtain ⟨N, q, p₀, h⟩ := exists_pseudo (c := c) (l := l) p
  set L := Localization.Away (c l)
  set u := (IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit (c l) : IsUnit (algebraMap B L (c l))).unit
  have h1 : elimHom c l (algebraMap B L) u (C (c l) ^ N * p) = 0 := by
    rw [map_mul]
    have : elimHom c l (algebraMap B L) u p = 0 := hz
    rw [this, mul_zero]
  rw [h, map_add, map_mul, elimHom_rel _ u rfl, mul_zero, zero_add, elimHom_rename] at h1
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_kill (B' := L) (Submonoid.powers (c l)) h1
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := m.2
  refine ⟨N + k, ?_⟩
  rw [← map_pow, algebraMap_eq_mk_comp_C, RingHom.comp_apply, ← map_mul,
    Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
  have h2 : C (c l ^ (N + k)) * p = (C (c l) ^ k * q) * rel c := by
    have hk' : c l ^ k = m := hk
    have hm' : C (c l ^ k) * p₀ = 0 := by rw [hk']; exact hm
    have h3 : C (c l ^ k) * rename l.succAbove p₀ = 0 := by
      rw [← rename_C l.succAbove, ← map_mul, hm', map_zero]
    simp only [map_pow] at h3 ⊢
    linear_combination (C (c l) ^ k) * h + h3
  rw [h2]
  exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)

name: BezoutCounterexample.Jou.isLocalization_elim
statement:
theorem isLocalization_elim (c : Fin (r + 1) → B) (l : Fin (r + 1)) :
    @IsLocalization.Away _ _ (algebraMap B (J c) (c l)) (LocP c l) _ (elimLoc c l).toAlgebra
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra (J c) (LocP c l) := (elimLoc c l).toAlgebra
  set L := Localization.Away (c l)
  have hu : IsUnit (algebraMap B L (c l)) := IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit _
  have halg : ∀ b : B, algebraMap (J c) (LocP c l) (algebraMap B (J c) b) =
      C (algebraMap B L b) := fun b => elimLoc_algebraMap b
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨_, n, rfl⟩
    simp only [map_pow]
    rw [halg]
    exact (hu.map C).pow n
  · intro z
    induction z using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
    | C a =>
      obtain ⟨⟨b, ⟨_, n, rfl⟩⟩, hb⟩ := IsLocalization.mk'_surjective (Submonoid.powers (c l)) a
      refine ⟨⟨algebraMap B (J c) b, ⟨_, n, rfl⟩⟩, ?_⟩
      simp only [map_pow]
      rw [halg, halg, ← map_pow, ← map_mul, ← hb]
      congr 1
      rw [← map_pow]
      exact IsLocalization.mk'_spec _ _ _
    | add z z' hz hz' =>
      obtain ⟨⟨a, s⟩, ha⟩ := hz
      obtain ⟨⟨a', s'⟩, ha'⟩ := hz'
      refine ⟨⟨a * s' + a' * s, s * s'⟩, ?_⟩
      simp only [Submonoid.coe_mul, map_mul, map_add] at ha ha' ⊢
      rw [← ha, ← ha']; ring
    | mul_X z j hz =>
      obtain ⟨⟨a, s⟩, ha⟩ := hz
      refine ⟨⟨a * σ c (l.succAbove j), s⟩, ?_⟩
      simp only [map_mul] at ha ⊢
      have hX : algebraMap (J c) (LocP c l) (σ c (l.succAbove j)) = X j := elimLoc_σ j
      rw [hX, ← ha]; ring
  · intro x y hxy
    have h0 : elimLoc c l (x - y) = 0 := by
      rw [map_sub]; exact sub_eq_zero.2 hxy
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_pow_mul_eq_zero_of_elimLoc h0
    exact ⟨⟨_, n, rfl⟩, by rw [mul_sub] at hn; exact sub_eq_zero.1 hn⟩

name: BezoutCounterexample.Jou.isDomain
statement: theorem isDomain [IsDomain B] (hl : c l ≠ 0) : IsDomain (J c)
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra (J c) (LocP c l) := (elimLoc c l).toAlgebra
  have := isLocalization_elim c l
  have : IsDomain (Localization.Away (c l)) := IsLocalization.isDomain_localization
    (powers_le_nonZeroDivisors_of_noZeroDivisors hl)
  have hnzd : Submonoid.powers (algebraMap B (J c) (c l)) ≤ nonZeroDivisors (J c) := by
    rintro _ ⟨n, rfl⟩
    show algebraMap B (J c) (c l) ^ n ∈ _
    rw [← map_pow, mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_right]
    intro u hu
    exact algebraMap_mul_eq_zero c (pow_ne_zero n hl) (by rwa [mul_comm] at hu)
  have hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap (J c) (LocP c l)) :=
    IsLocalization.injective (LocP c l) hnzd
  exact hinj.isDomain _

name: BezoutCounterexample.Jou.algebraMap_injective
statement:
lemma algebraMap_injective [IsDomain B] (hl : c l ≠ 0) :
    Function.Injective (algebraMap B (J c))
proof:
:= by
  set L := Localization.Away (c l)
  have hinjB : Function.Injective (algebraMap B L) := IsLocalization.injective L
    (powers_le_nonZeroDivisors_of_noZeroDivisors hl)
  intro a a' h
  have h2 := congrArg (elimLoc c l) h
  rw [elimLoc_algebraMap, elimLoc_algebraMap] at h2
  exact hinjB (C_injective _ _ h2)

name: BezoutCounterexample.Jou.isPrime_map
statement:
lemma isPrime_map (𝔞 : Ideal B) [𝔞.IsPrime] (hl : c l ∉ 𝔞) :
    (𝔞.map (algebraMap B (J c))).IsPrime
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ker_map_quotient]
  have : IsDomain (J (Ideal.Quotient.mk 𝔞 ∘ c)) := isDomain (l := l) (by
    simpa [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem] using hl)
  exact RingHom.ker_isPrime _

name: BezoutCounterexample.Jou.unitInv_elim
statement:
lemma unitInv_elim (u : Bˣ) (hu : c l = u) (z : J c) :
    unitInv (l := l) (elim (RingHom.id B) u hu z) = z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective z
  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C a => simp [elim_mk, elimHom, unitInv, algebraMap_eq_mk_comp_C]
  | add p q hp hq => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, hp, hq]
  | mul_X p i hp =>
    have hX : unitInv (l := l) (elim (RingHom.id B) u hu (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (X i))) =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {rel c}) (X i) := by
      by_cases hi : i = l
      · subst hi
        simp only [elim_mk, elimHom, coe_eval₂Hom, eval₂_X, solveVals, Fin.insertNth_apply_same]
        simp only [unitInv, map_mul, map_sub, map_one, map_sum, coe_eval₂Hom, eval₂_C, eval₂_X,
          RingHom.id_apply]
        
        have hsum := sum_σ_mul c
        rw [Fin.sum_univ_succAbove _ i] at hsum
        have hmk : (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {rel c}) (X i)) = σ c i := rfl
        rw [hmk]
        have hunit : algebraMap B (J c) (↑u⁻¹ : B) * algebraMap B (J c) (c i) = 1 := by
          rw [← map_mul, hu, Units.inv_mul, map_one]
        linear_combination (-(algebraMap B (J c) (↑u⁻¹ : B))) * hsum + σ c i * hunit
      · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := Fin.exists_succAbove_eq hi
        simp [elim_mk, elimHom, solveVals, Fin.insertNth_apply_succAbove, unitInv, σ]
    rw [map_mul, map_mul, map_mul, hp, hX]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Jou.equivPoly_apply
statement:
lemma equivPoly_apply (u : Bˣ) (hu : c l = u) (z : J c) :
    equivPoly u hu z = elim (RingHom.id B) u hu z
proof: := rfl

name: BezoutCounterexample.Jou.equivPoly_algebraMap
statement:
lemma equivPoly_algebraMap (u : Bˣ) (hu : c l = u) (b : B) :
    equivPoly u hu (algebraMap B (J c) b) = C b
proof:
:= by
  rw [equivPoly_apply, elim_algebraMap]; rfl

name: BezoutCounterexample.Jou.equivPoly_σ
statement:
lemma equivPoly_σ (u : Bˣ) (hu : c l = u) (j : Fin r) :
    equivPoly u hu (σ c (l.succAbove j)) = X j
proof:
:= by
  rw [equivPoly_apply, elim_σ]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Jou.formallySmooth
statement: theorem formallySmooth (c : Fin r → B) : Algebra.FormallySmooth B (J c)
proof:
:= by
  set P := MvPolynomial (Fin r) B
  have hrange : Ideal.span (Set.range fun _ : Fin 1 => rel c) = Ideal.span {rel c} := by
    rw [Set.range_const]
  set E : Derivation B P P := MvPolynomial.mkDerivation B (fun i => (X i : P)) with hE
  have hErel : E (rel c) = rel c + 1 := by
    rw [rel, map_sub, map_sum, Derivation.map_one_eq_zero, sub_zero, sub_add_cancel]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [Derivation.leibniz, hE, MvPolynomial.mkDerivation_X, MvPolynomial.derivation_C,
      smul_zero, zero_add, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
  let D : Fin 1 → Derivation B P (P ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range fun _ : Fin 1 => rel c)) := fun _ =>
    ((Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ P (Ideal.span (Set.range fun _ : Fin 1 => rel c))).toLinearMap).compDer E
  have hD : ∀ i j, D i ((fun _ : Fin 1 => rel c) j) = if i = j then 1 else 0 := by
    intro i j
    have hij : i = j := Subsingleton.elim i j
    rw [ite_eq_left hij]
    show Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (E (rel c)) = 1
    rw [hErel, map_add, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.2
      (Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self (0 : Fin 1))), zero_add, map_one]
  have := formallySmooth_quotient_of_dual (R := B) (fun _ : Fin 1 => rel c) D hD
  exact Algebra.FormallySmooth.of_equiv (Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq B hrange)

name: BezoutCounterexample.Jou.smooth
statement: theorem smooth [Algebra ℚ B] [Algebra.Smooth ℚ B] (c : Fin r → B) : Algebra.Smooth ℚ (J c)
proof:
:=
  haveI := formallySmooth c
  haveI : Algebra.Smooth B (J c) := ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩
  Algebra.Smooth.comp ℚ B (J c)

name: BezoutCounterexample.Jou.ufd
statement:
theorem ufd [IsDomain B] [IsNoetherianRing B] [UniqueFactorizationMonoid B] (hl : Prime (c l))
    {m : Fin (r + 1)} (hm : ¬ c l ∣ c m) : UniqueFactorizationMonoid (J c)
proof:
:= by
  have hl0 := hl.ne_zero
  have := isDomain hl0
  set L := Localization.Away (c l)
  have : IsDomain L := IsLocalization.isDomain_localization
    (powers_le_nonZeroDivisors_of_noZeroDivisors hl0)
  have : UniqueFactorizationMonoid L :=
    BezoutCounterexample.UniqueFactorizationMonoid.of_isLocalization (Submonoid.powers (c l))
      (fun h => hl0 (by obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := h; exact pow_eq_zero_iff'.1 hn |>.1)) L
  let : Algebra (J c) (LocP c l) := (elimLoc c l).toAlgebra
  have : IsLocalization.Away (algebraMap B (J c) (c l)) (LocP c l) := isLocalization_elim c l
  
  have hprime : Prime (algebraMap B (J c) (c l)) := by
    have hne : algebraMap B (J c) (c l) ≠ 0 := fun h =>
      hl0 (algebraMap_injective hl0 (by rw [h, map_zero]))
    rw [← Ideal.span_singleton_prime hne]
    have : IsDomain (B ⧸ Ideal.span {c l}) :=
      (Ideal.Quotient.isDomain_iff_prime _).2 ((Ideal.span_singleton_prime hl0).2 hl)
    have hm' : (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {c l}) ∘ c) m ≠ 0 := by
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, ne_eq, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem,
        Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
      exact hm
    have := isDomain hm'
    rw [← Ideal.Quotient.isDomain_iff_prime]
    exact (quotEquiv c (c l)).toMulEquiv.isDomain_iff.2 inferInstance
  exact BezoutCounterexample.UniqueFactorizationMonoid.of_isLocalization_away hprime (LocP c l)

name: BezoutCounterexample.derivOfTsze_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma derivOfTsze_apply (θ : S →+* TrivSqZeroExt S S) (hfst : ∀ s, (θ s).fst = s) (s : S) :
    derivOfTsze θ hfst s = (θ s).snd
proof: := rfl

name: BezoutCounterexample.Jou.fst_polyTsze
statement:
lemma fst_polyTsze (δ : Derivation ℚ B B) (v : Fin r → J c) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin r) B) :
    (polyTsze c δ v p).fst = mk c p
proof:
:= by
  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C a => simp [polyTsze, coefTsze]
  | add p q hp hq => rw [map_add, fst_add, hp, hq, map_add]
  | mul_X p i hp => rw [map_mul, fst_mul, hp, map_mul]; simp [polyTsze, σ]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Jou.liftDer_algebraMap
statement:
lemma liftDer_algebraMap (δ : Derivation ℚ B B) (v : Fin r → J c) (hv) (b : B) :
    liftDer δ v hv (algebraMap B (J c) b) = algebraMap B (J c) (δ b)
proof:
:= by
  have : algebraMap B (J c) b = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (C b) := by
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply B (MvPolynomial (Fin r) B), MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq,
      Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq]
  rw [liftDer, derivOfTsze_apply, this, Ideal.Quotient.lift_mk]
  simp [polyTsze, coefTsze, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Jou.liftDer_σ
statement:
lemma liftDer_σ (δ : Derivation ℚ B B) (v : Fin r → J c) (hv) (i : Fin r) :
    liftDer δ v hv (σ c i) = v i
proof:
:= by
  rw [liftDer, derivOfTsze_apply, σ, mk, Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_eq_mk, Ideal.Quotient.lift_mk]
  simp [polyTsze]

name: BezoutCounterexample.eq_of_forall_isMaximal
statement:
theorem eq_of_forall_isMaximal {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsJacobsonRing R]
    {F G : Set (Ideal R)} (hF : F.Finite) (hG : G.Finite) (hFp : ∀ P ∈ F, P.IsPrime)
    (hGp : ∀ P ∈ G, P.IsPrime) (hFc : ∀ P ∈ F, ∀ Q ∈ F, P ≠ Q → P ⊔ Q = ⊤)
    (hGc : ∀ P ∈ G, ∀ Q ∈ G, P ≠ Q → P ⊔ Q = ⊤)
    (h : ∀ 𝔪 : Ideal R, 𝔪.IsMaximal → ((∃ P ∈ F, P ≤ 𝔪) ↔ (∃ Q ∈ G, Q ≤ 𝔪))) : F = G
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have below : ∀ {F G : Set (Ideal R)}, G.Finite → (∀ P ∈ F, P.IsPrime) →
      (∀ 𝔪 : Ideal R, 𝔪.IsMaximal → ((∃ P ∈ F, P ≤ 𝔪) → (∃ Q ∈ G, Q ≤ 𝔪))) →
      ∀ P ∈ F, ∃ Q ∈ G, Q ≤ P := by
    intro F G hG hFp h P hP
    have := hFp P hP
    have hprod : hG.toFinset.prod id ≤ P := by
      rw [← (IsJacobsonRing.out' P (hFp P hP).isRadical)]
      refine le_sInf fun 𝔪 ⟨hP𝔪, h𝔪⟩ => ?_
      obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hQ𝔪⟩ := h 𝔪 h𝔪 ⟨P, hP, hP𝔪⟩
      exact (Ideal.prod_le_inf.trans (Finset.inf_le (hG.mem_toFinset.2 hQ))).trans hQ𝔪
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hQP⟩ := (Ideal.IsPrime.prod_le (hFp P hP)).1 hprod
    exact ⟨Q, hG.mem_toFinset.1 hQ, hQP⟩
  have sub : ∀ {F G : Set (Ideal R)}, F.Finite → G.Finite → (∀ P ∈ F, P.IsPrime) →
      (∀ P ∈ G, P.IsPrime) → (∀ P ∈ F, ∀ Q ∈ F, P ≠ Q → P ⊔ Q = ⊤) →
      (∀ 𝔪 : Ideal R, 𝔪.IsMaximal → ((∃ P ∈ F, P ≤ 𝔪) ↔ (∃ Q ∈ G, Q ≤ 𝔪))) → F ⊆ G := by
    intro F G hF hG hFp hGp hFc h P hP
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hQP⟩ := below hG hFp (fun 𝔪 h𝔪 => (h 𝔪 h𝔪).1) P hP
    obtain ⟨P', hP', hP'Q⟩ := below hF hGp (fun 𝔪 h𝔪 => (h 𝔪 h𝔪).2) Q hQ
    have hPP' : P' = P := by
      by_contra hne
      have := hFc P' hP' P hP hne
      rw [sup_eq_right.2 (hP'Q.trans hQP)] at this
      exact (hFp P hP).ne_top this
    rw [hPP'] at hP'Q
    rwa [le_antisymm hQP hP'Q] at hQ
  exact le_antisymm (sub hF hG hFp hGp hFc h) (sub hG hF hGp hFp hGc fun 𝔪 h𝔪 => (h 𝔪 h𝔪).symm)

name: BezoutCounterexample.components_eq_of
statement:
theorem components_eq_of {I : Ideal A} (hI : I ≠ ⊥) (hItop : I ≠ ⊤) {F : Set (Ideal A)}
    (hF : F.Finite) (hFp : ∀ P ∈ F, P.IsPrime ∧ I ≤ P)
    (hFc : ∀ P ∈ F, ∀ Q ∈ F, P ≠ Q → P ⊔ Q = ⊤)
    (hloc : ∀ (𝔪 : Ideal A) [𝔪.IsMaximal], I ≤ 𝔪 →
      (inv I 𝔪 = maxinv I ↔ ∃ P ∈ F, P ≤ 𝔪)) :
    components I = F
proof:
:= by
  have : IsJacobsonRing A := isJacobsonRing_of_finiteType (A := ℚ)
  obtain ⟨hfin, hprime, hcomax, hiff, -⟩ := theorem_3_3_3 hI hItop
  refine eq_of_forall_isMaximal hfin hF (fun P hP => (hprime P hP).1) (fun P hP => (hFp P hP).1)
    hcomax hFc fun 𝔪 h𝔪 => ?_
  by_cases hI𝔪 : I ≤ 𝔪
  · exact (hiff 𝔪 hI𝔪).symm.trans (hloc 𝔪 hI𝔪)
  · constructor
    · rintro ⟨P, hP, hP𝔪⟩; exact absurd ((hprime P hP).2.trans hP𝔪) hI𝔪
    · rintro ⟨P, hP, hP𝔪⟩; exact absurd ((hFp P hP).2.trans hP𝔪) hI𝔪

name: BezoutCounterexample.exists_maxinv_zero_eq
statement:
theorem exists_maxinv_zero_eq {I : Ideal A} (hI : I ≠ ⊥) (hItop : I ≠ ⊤) :
    ∃ a : ℕ, 0 < a ∧ maxinv I 0 = 1 / a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨𝔪, h𝔪, hI𝔪, hinv⟩, -⟩ := maxinv_spec hI hItop
  rw [← hinv]; exact exists_inv_zero_eq hI hI𝔪

name: BezoutCounterexample.ReesData.e_ne_zero_iff
statement: theorem ReesData.e_ne_zero_iff (S : ReesData A) (i : ℕ) : S.e i ≠ 0 ↔ i < S.k
proof:
:=
  ne_zero_iff_lt_numNonzero (maxinv_mem_Γ S.ne_bot S.ne_top)
    (finite_support_maxinv S.ne_bot S.ne_top) i

name: BezoutCounterexample.ReesData.one_le_k
statement: theorem ReesData.one_le_k (S : ReesData A) : 1 ≤ S.k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, he⟩ := exists_maxinv_zero_eq S.ne_bot S.ne_top
  have h0 : S.e 0 ≠ 0 := by
    show maxinv S.I 0 ≠ 0
    rw [he]; positivity
  exact (S.e_ne_zero_iff 0).1 h0

name: BezoutCounterexample.ReesData.exists_prime_mem
statement: theorem ReesData.exists_prime_mem (S : ReesData A) : ∃ π : A, Prime π ∧ π ∈ S.𝔭
proof:
:= by
  have h𝔭 := (theorem_3_3_3 S.ne_bot S.ne_top).2.1 S.𝔭 S.mem_components
  have hne : S.𝔭 ≠ ⊥ := fun h => S.ne_bot (eq_bot_iff.2 (h ▸ h𝔭.2))
  obtain ⟨π, hπ𝔭, hπ⟩ := Ideal.IsPrime.exists_mem_prime_of_ne_bot h𝔭.1 hne
  exact ⟨π, hπ, hπ𝔭⟩

name: BezoutCounterexample.PrincipalizationData.divisorial_e
statement: theorem divisorial_e : ∃ a : ℕ, 0 < a ∧ S.e = fun i => if i = 0 then 1 / (a : ℚ) else 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, he⟩ := exists_maxinv_zero_eq S.ne_bot S.ne_top
  refine ⟨a, ha, funext fun i => ?_⟩
  split_ifs with hi
  · subst hi; exact he
  · by_contra h
    have := (S.e_ne_zero_iff i).1 h
    have hk' : S.toReesData.k = 1 := hk
    omega

name: BezoutCounterexample.PrincipalizationData.e_zero_ne
statement: theorem e_zero_ne : S.e 0 ≠ 0
proof: := (S.e_ne_zero_iff 0).2 (by have : S.toReesData.k = 1 := hk; omega)

name: BezoutCounterexample.PrincipalizationData.e_one_eq
statement: theorem e_one_eq : S.e 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  have := (S.e_ne_zero_iff 1).1 h
  have hk' : S.toReesData.k = 1 := hk
  omega

name: BezoutCounterexample.PrincipalizationData.divisorial_𝔭_eq
statement: theorem divisorial_𝔭_eq : S.𝔭 = Ideal.span {S.π}
proof:
:=
  div_eq_span S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 (S.e_zero_ne hk) (S.e_one_eq hk) S.prime_π S.π_mem

name: BezoutCounterexample.PrincipalizationData.divisorial_le
statement: theorem divisorial_le : S.I ≤ Ideal.span {S.π ^ a}
proof:
:=
  div_le_span_pow S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.d_pos (S.e_zero_ne hk) (S.e_one_eq hk) S.prime_π
    S.π_mem ha

name: BezoutCounterexample.PrincipalizationData.a_pos
statement: theorem a_pos : 0 < a
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos a with h | h
  · exfalso; apply S.e_zero_ne hk; rw [ha, h]; simp
  · exact h

name: BezoutCounterexample.PrincipalizationData.divisorial_I_eq
statement: theorem divisorial_I_eq : S.I = Ideal.span {S.π ^ a} * S.divI₁ a
proof:
:=
  div_eq_mul (S.divisorial_le hk ha)

name: BezoutCounterexample.PrincipalizationData.divisorial_sup
statement: theorem divisorial_sup : S.divI₁ a ⊔ Ideal.span {S.π} = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  obtain ⟨𝔪, h𝔪, hle⟩ := Ideal.exists_le_maximal _ h
  exact div_not_mem S.ne_bot S.hmax (S.a_pos hk ha) ha (S.divisorial_le hk ha) 𝔪
    (le_sup_left.trans hle) (hle (Ideal.mem_sup_right (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self S.π)))

name: BezoutCounterexample.PrincipalizationData.π_not_mem
statement: theorem π_not_mem (𝔪 : Ideal A) [𝔪.IsMaximal] (h𝔪 : S.divI₁ a ≤ 𝔪) : S.π ∉ 𝔪
proof:
:=
  div_not_mem S.ne_bot S.hmax (S.a_pos hk ha) ha (S.divisorial_le hk ha) 𝔪 h𝔪

name: BezoutCounterexample.PrincipalizationData.divisorial_inv_eq
statement:
theorem divisorial_inv_eq (𝔪 : Ideal A) [𝔪.IsMaximal] (h𝔪 : S.divI₁ a ≤ 𝔪) :
    inv (S.divI₁ a) 𝔪 = inv S.I 𝔪
proof:
:= by
  have hI𝔪 : S.I ≤ 𝔪 := (le_divI S.I S.π a).trans h𝔪
  exact inv_eq_of_invAt (divI_ne_bot S.ne_bot) h𝔪
    ((div_invAt_iff S.ne_bot S.hmax (S.a_pos hk ha) ha (S.divisorial_le hk ha) 𝔪 h𝔪).2
      (invAt_inv S.ne_bot hI𝔪))

name: BezoutCounterexample.PrincipalizationData.divisorial_decrease
statement:
theorem divisorial_decrease :
    maxinv (S.divI₁ a) ≺ maxinv S.I ∨ S.divI₁ a = ⊤ ∨
      (maxinv (S.divI₁ a) = maxinv S.I ∧ components (S.divI₁ a) = components S.I \ {S.𝔭} ∧
        numComponents (S.divI₁ a) < numComponents S.I)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases htop : S.divI₁ a = ⊤
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl htop)
  have hI₁ : S.divI₁ a ≠ ⊥ := divI_ne_bot S.ne_bot
  have hII₁ : S.I ≤ S.divI₁ a := le_divI S.I S.π a
  
  obtain ⟨⟨𝔪₁, h𝔪₁, hI₁𝔪₁, hinv₁⟩, -⟩ := maxinv_spec hI₁ htop
  have hle : maxinv (S.divI₁ a) ⪯ maxinv S.I := by
    rw [← hinv₁, S.divisorial_inv_eq hk ha 𝔪₁ hI₁𝔪₁]
    exact (maxinv_spec S.ne_bot S.ne_top).2 𝔪₁ (hII₁.trans hI₁𝔪₁)
  by_cases heq : maxinv (S.divI₁ a) = maxinv S.I
  swap
  · exact Or.inl ⟨hle, heq⟩
  obtain ⟨hfin, hprime, hcomax, hiff, -⟩ := theorem_3_3_3 S.ne_bot S.ne_top
  have h𝔭π := S.divisorial_𝔭_eq hk
  
  have hπP : ∀ P ∈ components S.I, P ≠ S.𝔭 → S.π ∉ P := by
    intro P hP hne hπ
    have := hcomax P hP S.𝔭 S.mem_components hne
    rw [sup_eq_left.2 (by rw [h𝔭π, Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]; exact hπ)] at this
    exact (hprime P hP).1.ne_top this
  have hcomp : components (S.divI₁ a) = components S.I \ {S.𝔭} := by
    refine components_eq_of hI₁ htop (hfin.sdiff) (fun P hP => ⟨(hprime P hP.1).1, ?_⟩)
      (fun P hP Q hQ hne => hcomax P hP.1 Q hQ.1 hne) (fun 𝔪 _ h𝔪 => ?_)
    · 
      intro f hf
      have hπ := hπP P hP.1 hP.2
      have h1 : S.π ^ a * f ∈ P := (hprime P hP.1).2 (mem_divI.1 hf)
      rcases (hprime P hP.1).1.mem_or_mem h1 with h | h
      · exact absurd ((hprime P hP.1).1.mem_of_pow_mem a h) hπ
      · exact h
    · rw [S.divisorial_inv_eq hk ha 𝔪 h𝔪, heq, hiff 𝔪 (hII₁.trans h𝔪)]
      have hπ𝔪 := S.π_not_mem hk ha 𝔪 h𝔪
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨P, hP, hP𝔪⟩
        refine ⟨P, ⟨hP, fun h => hπ𝔪 ?_⟩, hP𝔪⟩
        rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at h
        exact hP𝔪 (h ▸ S.π_mem)
      · rintro ⟨P, hP, hP𝔪⟩
        exact ⟨P, hP.1, hP𝔪⟩
  refine Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨heq, hcomp, ?_⟩)
  unfold numComponents
  rw [hcomp]
  exact Set.ncard_sdiff_singleton_lt_of_mem S.mem_components hfin

name: BezoutCounterexample.formallySmooth_quotient_of_dual
statement:
theorem formallySmooth_quotient_of_dual [Algebra.FormallySmooth R P] (r : Fin m → P)
    (D : Fin m → Derivation R P (P ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range r)))
    (hD : ∀ i j, D i (r j) = if i = j then 1 else 0) :
    Algebra.FormallySmooth R (P ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range r))
proof:
:= by
  let Q := P ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range r)
  have hsmul : ∀ (p : P) (u : Q), p • u = algebraMap P Q p * u := fun p u => Algebra.smul_def p u
  rw [Algebra.FormallySmooth.iff_split_injection (P := P) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective]
  set K' := RingHom.ker (algebraMap P Q)
  have hK : K' = Ideal.span (Set.range r) := Ideal.mk_ker
  let eK : Q ≃+* P ⧸ K' := Ideal.quotEquivOfEq hK.symm
  have heK : ∀ p : P, eK (algebraMap P Q p) = Ideal.Quotient.mk K' p :=
    fun p => Ideal.quotEquivOfEq_mk hK.symm p
  have hrK : ∀ j, r j ∈ K' := fun j => by rw [hK]; exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨j, rfl⟩
  let rC : Fin m → K'.Cotangent := fun j => K'.toCotangent ⟨r j, hrK j⟩
  let l₀ : Ω[P⁄R] →ₗ[P] K'.Cotangent :=
    { toFun := fun ω => ∑ i, eK ((D i).liftKaehlerDifferential ω) • rC i
      map_add' := fun ω ω' => by
        simp only [map_add, add_smul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      map_smul' := fun p ω => by
        simp only [map_smul, RingHom.id_apply, Finset.smul_sum, hsmul, map_mul, heK, mul_smul]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
        rw [← Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq, algebraMap_smul] }
  let lB : Q →ₗ[P] Ω[P⁄R] →ₗ[P] K'.Cotangent :=
    LinearMap.mk₂ P (fun u ω => eK u • l₀ ω)
      (fun u u' ω => by simp only [map_add, add_smul])
      (fun p u ω => by
        rw [hsmul, map_mul, heK, mul_smul, ← Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq, algebraMap_smul])
      (fun u ω ω' => by simp only [map_add, smul_add])
      (fun p u ω => by rw [map_smul, smul_comm])
  refine ⟨TensorProduct.lift lB, ?_⟩
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro t
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := K'.toCotangent_surjective t
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, KaehlerDifferential.kerCotangentToTensor_toCotangent,
    TensorProduct.lift.tmul, LinearMap.id_apply]
  show eK 1 • l₀ (KaehlerDifferential.D R P y) = _
  rw [map_one, one_smul]
  show ∑ i, eK ((D i).liftKaehlerDifferential (KaehlerDifferential.D R P y)) • rC i = _
  simp only [Derivation.liftKaehlerDifferential_comp_D]
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := y
  have hy' : y ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range r) := by rw [← hK]; exact hy
  
  obtain ⟨cf, hcf⟩ := (Ideal.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun).1 hy'
  have hr0 : ∀ j, algebraMap P Q (r j) = 0 := fun j =>
    (Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem).2 (Ideal.subset_span ⟨j, rfl⟩)
  have hDy : ∀ i, D i y = algebraMap P Q (cf i) := by
    intro i
    rw [← hcf, map_sum]
    simp only [Derivation.leibniz, hsmul, hr0, hD]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
    · simp
    · intro b _ hb; rw [ite_eq_right (Ne.symm hb)]; simp
    · simp
  simp only [hDy, heK]
  have : (⟨y, hy⟩ : K') = ∑ i, cf i • (⟨r i, hrK i⟩ : K') := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp only [Submodule.coe_sum, Submodule.coe_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    exact hcf.symm
  rw [this, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [map_smul]
  rfl

statement:
theorem isBezout_iff_span_pair_isPrincipal (R : Type*) [CommRing R] :

name: BezoutCounterexample.isSmithNormalForm_iff_chain
statement:
theorem isSmithNormalForm_iff_chain {m n : ℕ} (D : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) R) :
    IsSmithNormalForm D ↔ ∃ d : ℕ → R, (∀ i j, D i j = if (i : ℕ) = j then d i else 0) ∧
      ∀ k, k + 1 < min m n → d k ∣ d (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨d, r, hr, hD, hnz, hdiv⟩
    refine ⟨d, hD, fun k hk => ?_⟩
    by_cases hkr : k + 1 < r
    · exact hdiv k hkr
    · have : d (k + 1) = 0 := by
        by_contra h
        exact hkr ((hnz (k + 1) hk).1 h)
      rw [this]
      exact dvd_zero _
  · classical
    rintro ⟨d, hD, hdiv⟩
    
    let P : ℕ → Prop := fun k => k < min m n → d k = 0
    have hP : ∃ k, P k := ⟨min m n, fun h => absurd h (lt_irrefl _)⟩
    let r := Nat.find hP
    have hr : r ≤ min m n := Nat.find_min' hP (fun h => absurd h (lt_irrefl _))
    have hlt : ∀ k < r, d k ≠ 0 := by
      intro k hk h0
      exact Nat.find_min hP hk (fun _ => h0)
    have hzero : ∀ k, r ≤ k → k < min m n → d k = 0 := by
      intro k hrk hk
      induction k, hrk using Nat.le_induction with
      | base => exact Nat.find_spec hP hk
      | succ k hrk ih =>
        have h0 : d k = 0 := ih (by omega)
        have := hdiv k hk
        rw [h0, zero_dvd_iff] at this
        exact this
    refine ⟨d, r, hr, hD, fun k hk => ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => hlt k h⟩, fun k hk => hdiv k ?_⟩
    · by_contra hkr
      exact h (hzero k (not_lt.1 hkr) hk)
    · omega

  exact Ideal.sum_mem _ fun l _ => Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _
    (Ideal.sum_mem _ fun k _ => Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (hG k l))

name: BezoutCounterexample.IsElementaryDivisorDomain.isBezout
statement: theorem IsElementaryDivisorDomain.isBezout (h : IsElementaryDivisorDomain R) : IsBezout R
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsBezout.iff_span_pair_isPrincipal]
  intro a b
  obtain ⟨G, hFG, hG⟩ := h.2 1 2 !![a, b]
  obtain ⟨d, hD, -⟩ := (isSmithNormalForm_iff_chain G).1 hG
  have hGd : ∀ i j, G i j ∈ (Ideal.span {d 0} : Ideal R) := by
    intro i j
    fin_cases i; fin_cases j
    · rw [hD]; exact Ideal.subset_span rfl
    · rw [hD]; simp
  refine ⟨⟨d 0, le_antisymm ?_ ?_⟩⟩
  · rw [Ideal.span_le]
    intro r hr
    rcases hr with rfl | rfl
    · simpa using hFG.entry_mem _ hGd 0 0
    · simpa using hFG.entry_mem _ hGd 0 1
  · rw [Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
    obtain ⟨P, Q, hPQ⟩ := hFG
    have h00 : d 0 = G 0 0 := by rw [hD 0 0]; simp
    rw [h00, ← hPQ]
    refine entry_mem_of_mul _ _ _ _ (fun i j => ?_) 0 0
    fin_cases i; fin_cases j
    · exact Ideal.subset_span (by simp)
    · exact Ideal.subset_span (by simp)

name: BezoutCounterexample.finite_support_inv
statement:
theorem finite_support_inv {I : Ideal A} (hI : I ≠ ⊥) {𝔪 : Ideal A} [𝔪.IsMaximal]

name: BezoutCounterexample.ne_zero_iff_lt_numNonzero
statement:
theorem ne_zero_iff_lt_numNonzero {e : ℕ → ℚ} (he : e ∈ Γ) (hfin : {i | e i ≠ 0}.Finite)
    (i : ℕ) : e i ≠ 0 ↔ i < numNonzero e
proof:
:= by
  
  have hdown : ∀ j l, j ≤ l → e l ≠ 0 → e j ≠ 0 := by
    intro j l hjl hl hj
    apply hl
    induction l, hjl using Nat.le_induction with
    | base => exact hj
    | succ l _ ih => exact he.2 l (ih (fun h => hl (he.2 l h)))
  
  have hseg : {i | e i ≠ 0} = ↑(Finset.range (numNonzero e)) := by
    by_cases hne : {i | e i ≠ 0}.Nonempty
    · obtain ⟨M, hM, hmax⟩ := Set.exists_max_image _ id hfin hne
      have hS : {i | e i ≠ 0} = ↑(Finset.range (M + 1)) := by
        ext j
        simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Finset.coe_range, Set.mem_Iio]
        constructor
        · intro hj
          have := hmax j hj
          simp only [id] at this
          omega
        · intro hj
          exact hdown j M (by omega) hM
      have hcard : numNonzero e = M + 1 := by
        unfold numNonzero; rw [hS, Set.ncard_coe_finset, Finset.card_range]
      rw [hcard, hS]
    · have h0 : {i | e i ≠ 0} = ∅ := Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.1 hne
      have hcard : numNonzero e = 0 := by unfold numNonzero; rw [h0, Set.ncard_empty]
      rw [hcard, h0]; simp
  have := congrArg (i ∈ ·) hseg
  simpa using this

name: BezoutCounterexample.maxLocusIdeal_eq_locusIdeal
statement:
theorem maxLocusIdeal_eq_locusIdeal {I : Ideal A} (hI : I ≠ ⊥) :

  · rintro ⟨h𝔪, hI𝔪, hv⟩
    exact ⟨h𝔪, hI𝔪, inv_eq_of_invAt hI hI𝔪 hv⟩

name: BezoutCounterexample.ReesData.map_I_eq
statement: theorem map_I_eq : S.I.map (algebraMap A S.𝓡) = Ideal.span {S.s ^ S.d} * S.Iw
proof:
:=
  map_eq_weakT S.fil _ S.I S.d S.I_le_fil

name: BezoutCounterexample.ReesData.map_𝔭_le
statement: theorem map_𝔭_le : S.𝔭.map (algebraMap A S.𝓡) ≤ Ideal.span {S.s}
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
  intro g hg
  have hg1 : g ∈ S.𝓕 1 := by rw [S.𝓕_one]; exact hg
  rw [Ideal.mem_comap, Ideal.mem_span_singleton']
  refine ⟨S.mono 1 g hg1, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
  show C g * T 1 * T (-1) = algebraMap A A[T;T⁻¹] g
  rw [mul_assoc, ← T_add, add_neg_cancel, T_zero, mul_one, LaurentPolynomial.C_eq_algebraMap]

name: BezoutCounterexample.ReesData.𝓕_eq_sum
statement:
theorem 𝓕_eq_sum {j : ℤ} (hj : (S.d : ℤ) < j) :
    S.𝓕 j = ⨆ q ∈ Finset.Icc (1 : ℤ) S.d, S.𝓕 q * S.𝓕 (j - q)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← S.fil_F]
  refine le_antisymm (compFil_le_iSup S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.d_pos S.hw hj)
    (iSup₂_le fun q _ => ?_)
  have := S.fil.mul_le q (j - q)
  rwa [add_sub_cancel] at this

name: BezoutCounterexample.ReesData.𝓡_eq_adjoin
statement: theorem 𝓡_eq_adjoin : S.𝓡 = Algebra.adjoin A S.gens
proof:
:=
  reesAlg_eq_adjoin S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.d S.d_pos S.hw

name: BezoutCounterexample.ReesData.𝓡plus_eq_span
statement:
theorem 𝓡plus_eq_span : S.𝓡plus = Ideal.span {r : S.𝓡 | ∃ j ∈ Finset.Icc (1 : ℤ) S.d, ∃ g ∈ S.G j,
    (r : A[T;T⁻¹]) = C g * T j}
proof:
:= by
  set J := Ideal.span {r : S.𝓡 | ∃ j ∈ Finset.Icc (1 : ℤ) S.d, ∃ g ∈ S.G j,
    (r : A[T;T⁻¹]) = C g * T j}
  
  have hadd : ∀ {j : ℤ} {f₁ f₂ : A} (h₁ : f₁ ∈ S.𝓕 j) (h₂ : f₂ ∈ S.𝓕 j),
      S.mono j f₁ h₁ ∈ J → S.mono j f₂ h₂ ∈ J → S.mono j (f₁ + f₂) (add_mem h₁ h₂) ∈ J := by
    intro j f₁ f₂ h₁ h₂ hJ₁ hJ₂
    have : S.mono j (f₁ + f₂) (add_mem h₁ h₂) = S.mono j f₁ h₁ + S.mono j f₂ h₂ :=
      Subtype.ext (by simp [mono, add_mul])
    rw [this]; exact add_mem hJ₁ hJ₂
  have hzero : ∀ j : ℤ, S.mono j 0 (zero_mem _) ∈ J := fun j => by
    have : S.mono j 0 (zero_mem _) = 0 := Subtype.ext (by simp [mono])
    rw [this]; exact zero_mem _
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [𝓡plus, Ideal.span_le]
    rintro r ⟨j, f, hj1, hf, hr⟩
    have hr' : r = S.mono j f hf := Subtype.ext hr
    rw [hr']
    
    suffices H : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ j : ℤ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ n → ∀ f (hf : f ∈ S.𝓕 j), S.mono j f hf ∈ J from
      H j.toNat j hj1 (Int.self_le_toNat j) f hf
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => intro j hj1 hjn; omega
    | succ n ih =>
      intro j hj1 hjn f hf
      by_cases hjd : j ≤ S.d
      · 
        have hfG : f ∈ Ideal.span (S.G j : Set A) := by rw [S.span_G]; exact hf
        induction hfG using Submodule.span_induction with
        | mem g hg =>
          exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨j, Finset.mem_Icc.2 ⟨hj1, hjd⟩, g, hg, rfl⟩
        | zero => exact hzero j
        | add f₁ f₂ h₁ h₂ ih₁ ih₂ =>
          have h₁' : f₁ ∈ S.𝓕 j := by rw [← S.span_G]; exact h₁
          have h₂' : f₂ ∈ S.𝓕 j := by rw [← S.span_G]; exact h₂
          exact hadd h₁' h₂' (ih₁ h₁') (ih₂ h₂')
        | smul a f₁ h₁ ih₁ =>
          replace h₁ : f₁ ∈ S.𝓕 j := by rw [← S.span_G]; exact h₁
          have : S.mono j (a • f₁) hf = algebraMap A S.𝓡 a * S.mono j f₁ h₁ :=
            Subtype.ext (by
              simp only [mono, smul_eq_mul, map_mul, Subalgebra.coe_mul, Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap,
                LaurentPolynomial.C_eq_algebraMap]
              ring)
          rw [this]; exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (ih₁ h₁)
      · 
        push Not at hjd
        have hmemj : ∀ {q : ℤ} {a b : A}, a ∈ S.𝓕 q → b ∈ S.𝓕 (j - q) → a * b ∈ S.𝓕 j := by
          intro q a b ha hb
          have := S.fil.mul_le q (j - q) (Ideal.mul_mem_mul (by rw [S.fil_F]; exact ha)
            (by rw [S.fil_F]; exact hb))
          rwa [add_sub_cancel, S.fil_F] at this
        have key : ∀ g, g ∈ ⨆ q ∈ Finset.Icc (1 : ℤ) S.d, S.𝓕 q * S.𝓕 (j - q) →
            g ∈ S.𝓕 j ∧ ∀ hg : g ∈ S.𝓕 j, S.mono j g hg ∈ J := by
          intro g hg
          refine Submodule.iSup_induction _ (motive := fun g => g ∈ S.𝓕 j ∧
            ∀ hg : g ∈ S.𝓕 j, S.mono j g hg ∈ J) hg (fun q g hgq => ?_) ⟨zero_mem _, fun _ => hzero j⟩
            (fun g₁ g₂ ih₁ ih₂ => ⟨add_mem ih₁.1 ih₂.1, fun _ => hadd ih₁.1 ih₂.1 (ih₁.2 _)
              (ih₂.2 _)⟩)
          refine Submodule.iSup_induction _ (motive := fun g => g ∈ S.𝓕 j ∧
            ∀ hg : g ∈ S.𝓕 j, S.mono j g hg ∈ J) hgq (fun hq g hgq' => ?_) ⟨zero_mem _, fun _ => hzero j⟩
            (fun g₁ g₂ ih₁ ih₂ => ⟨add_mem ih₁.1 ih₂.1, fun _ => hadd ih₁.1 ih₂.1 (ih₁.2 _)
              (ih₂.2 _)⟩)
          have hq' := Finset.mem_Icc.1 hq
          refine Submodule.mul_induction_on (C := fun g => g ∈ S.𝓕 j ∧
            ∀ hg : g ∈ S.𝓕 j, S.mono j g hg ∈ J) hgq' (fun a ha b hb => ⟨hmemj ha hb, fun hab => ?_⟩)
            (fun g₁ g₂ ih₁ ih₂ => ⟨add_mem ih₁.1 ih₂.1, fun _ => hadd ih₁.1 ih₂.1 (ih₁.2 _)
              (ih₂.2 _)⟩)
          have hmul : S.mono j (a * b) hab = S.mono q a ha * S.mono (j - q) b hb :=
            Subtype.ext (by
              simp only [mono, Subalgebra.coe_mul]
              conv_lhs => rw [show j = q + (j - q) by ring]
              rw [map_mul, T_add]; ring)
          rw [hmul]
          exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (ih q hq'.1 (by omega) a ha)
        exact (key f (by rw [← S.𝓕_eq_sum hjd]; exact hf)).2 hf
  · rw [Ideal.span_le]
    rintro r ⟨j, hj, g, hg, hr⟩
    exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨j, g, (Finset.mem_Icc.1 hj).1,
      by rw [← S.span_G]; exact Ideal.subset_span hg, hr⟩

name: BezoutCounterexample.ReesData.isLocalization_away_s

theorem isLocalization_rees (𝔪 : Ideal A) [𝔪.IsMaximal] :

name: BezoutCounterexample.ReesData.fil_loc_F
statement:
theorem fil_loc_F (𝔪 : Ideal A) [𝔪.IsMaximal] (h𝔭𝔪 : S.𝔭 ≤ 𝔪) (j : ℤ) :
    (S.fil.loc (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪)).F j = maxCenter S.I 𝔪 ((j : ℚ) / S.d)
proof:
:= by
  rw [maxCenter_eq_cRF S.ne_bot
    ((le_of_mem_components S.ne_bot S.ne_top S.mem_components).trans h𝔭𝔪)]
  exact compFil_loc_F S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.d 𝔪 h𝔭𝔪 j

name: BezoutCounterexample.ReesData.w_spec
statement: theorem w_spec (i : ℕ) : (S.w i : ℚ) = S.d * S.e i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := S.d_mul i
  have h0 : (0 : ℚ) ≤ z :=
    hz ▸ mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (Γ_nonneg (maxinv_mem_Γ S.ne_bot S.ne_top) i)
  have h0' : (0 : ℤ) ≤ z := by exact_mod_cast h0
  have : S.w i = z.toNat := by simp only [w, e, hz, Rat.num_intCast]
  rw [this, e, hz]
  exact_mod_cast Int.toNat_of_nonneg h0'

name: BezoutCounterexample.ReesData.k_le_n
statement:
theorem k_le_n {𝔪 : Ideal A} [𝔪.IsMaximal] (J : MarkedCenter 𝔪)
    (hJw : J.weights = maxinv S.I) : S.k ≤ J.n
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  have hn : J.n < S.k := lt_of_not_ge h
  have he : S.e J.n ≠ 0 :=
    (ne_zero_iff_lt_numNonzero (maxinv_mem_Γ S.ne_bot S.ne_top)
      (finite_support_maxinv S.ne_bot S.ne_top) J.n).2 hn
  apply he
  rw [e, ← hJw]
  simp [MarkedCenter.weights]

name: BezoutCounterexample.ReesData.rees_presentation
statement:
theorem rees_presentation (𝔪 : Ideal A) [𝔪.IsMaximal] (h𝔭𝔪 : S.𝔭 ≤ 𝔪) (J : MarkedCenter 𝔪)
    (hJw : J.weights = maxinv S.I) (hJ : J.IsAdmissible S.I)
    (_hJ𝔭 : S.𝔭.map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪)) =
      Ideal.span (J.x '' {i | (i : ℕ) < S.k})) :
    let hkn : S.k ≤ J.n := S.k_le_n J hJw
    ∃ φ : (MvPolynomial (Option (Fin S.k)) (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪) ⧸
        Ideal.span (Set.range fun i : Fin S.k =>
          MvPolynomial.C (J.x (Fin.castLE hkn i)) -
            MvPolynomial.X none ^ S.w i * MvPolynomial.X (some i))) ≃ₐ[Localization.AtPrime 𝔪]
        ReesAlg (S.fil.loc (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪)),
      ((φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPolynomial.X none)) : (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪)[T;T⁻¹]) =
        T (-1)) ∧
      ∀ i : Fin S.k, ((φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPolynomial.X (some i))) :
        (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪)[T;T⁻¹]) = C (J.x (Fin.castLE hkn i)) * T (S.w i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let hkn : S.k ≤ J.n := S.k_le_n J hJw
  
  obtain ⟨c, hcx, hc⟩ := J.isRegular.exists_chart
  have hI𝔪 : S.I ≤ 𝔪 := (le_of_mem_components S.ne_bot S.ne_top S.mem_components).trans h𝔭𝔪
  have hinv : inv S.I 𝔪 = maxinv S.I :=
    ((theorem_3_3_3 S.ne_bot S.ne_top).2.2.2.1 𝔪 hI𝔪).2 ⟨S.𝔭, S.mem_components, h𝔭𝔪⟩
  have hJe : ∀ i : Fin J.n, J.e i = S.e i := fun i => by
    have := congrFun hJw i
    simpa [MarkedCenter.weights, ReesData.e] using this
  
  have hF : ∀ j, (S.fil.loc (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪)).F j = chartFil c J.e S.d j := by
    intro j
    rw [S.fil_loc_F 𝔪 h𝔭𝔪 j, ← J.F_eq_maxCenter S.ne_bot hI𝔪 hJ (hJw.trans hinv.symm),
      J.F_eq_RF c hcx]
    rfl
  set wn : Fin J.n → ℕ := fun i => S.w i
  have hw : ∀ i, (wn i : ℚ) = S.d * J.e i := fun i => by
    simp only [wn]; rw [S.w_spec, hJe]
  have hsupp : ∀ i : Fin J.n, J.e i ≠ 0 ↔ (i : ℕ) < S.k := fun i => by
    rw [hJe]
    exact ne_zero_iff_lt_numNonzero (maxinv_mem_Γ S.ne_bot S.ne_top)
      (finite_support_maxinv S.ne_bot S.ne_top) i
  have hsurj := reesPsi_surjective c hF J.nonneg S.d_pos hw hkn hsupp
  have hrel : Ideal.span (Set.range fun i : Fin S.k =>
      MvPolynomial.C (J.x (Fin.castLE hkn i)) -
        MvPolynomial.X none ^ S.w i * MvPolynomial.X (some i)) =
      RingHom.ker (reesPsi c hF J.nonneg S.d_pos hw hkn) := by
    rw [reesPsi_ker c hc hF J.nonneg S.d_pos hw hkn hsupp]
    congr 2
    funext i
    simp only [reesRel, hcx]
    rfl
  refine ⟨(Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪) hrel).trans
    (Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective hsurj), ?_, fun i => ?_⟩
  · rw [AlgEquiv.trans_apply, Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq_mk,
      Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective_mk]
    simp only [reesPsi, MvPolynomial.aeval_X, reesGen, Option.elim]
    exact reesX_last c hF J.nonneg S.d_pos hw
  · rw [AlgEquiv.trans_apply, Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq_mk,
      Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective_mk]
    simp only [reesPsi, MvPolynomial.aeval_X, reesGen, Option.elim]
    rw [reesX_castSucc c hF J.nonneg S.d_pos hw, hcx]
    rfl

name: BezoutCounterexample.ReesData.rees_loc_eq_top
statement:
theorem rees_loc_eq_top (𝔪 : Ideal A) [𝔪.IsMaximal] (h𝔭𝔪 : ¬ S.𝔭 ≤ 𝔪) :
    ReesAlg (S.fil.loc (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  intro p _ j
  have : (S.fil.loc (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪)).F j = ⊤ :=
    compF_map_of_not_le S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.d_pos S.hw 𝔪 h𝔭𝔪 _
  rw [this]; trivial

name: BezoutCounterexample.ReesData.rees_smooth_domain

name: BezoutCounterexample.ReesData.mono_mem_span_s_iff
statement:
theorem mono_mem_span_s_iff {j : ℤ} {f : A} (hf : f ∈ S.𝓕 j) :
    S.mono j f hf ∈ Ideal.span {S.s} ↔ f ∈ S.𝓕 (j + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [s]
  refine (mem_span_s_iff S.fil _ _).trans ?_
  constructor
  · intro h
    have := h j
    simp only [mono, coeff_C_mul_T, ite_true] at this
    rwa [S.fil_F] at this
  · intro h i
    simp only [mono, coeff_C_mul_T]
    split_ifs with hij
    · subst hij; rw [S.fil_F]; exact h
    · exact zero_mem _

name: BezoutCounterexample.ReesData.monoLin_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma monoLin_apply (j : ℤ) (f : ↥(S.𝓕 j)) : S.monoLin j f = S.mono j f f.2
proof: := rfl

name: BezoutCounterexample.ReesData.grToQuot_mk
statement:
lemma grToQuot_mk (j : ℕ) (f : ↥(S.𝓕 j)) :
    S.grToQuot j (Submodule.Quotient.mk f) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (S.mono j f f.2)
proof: := rfl

name: BezoutCounterexample.ReesData.mem_span_mono
statement:
lemma mem_span_mono (r : S.𝓡) :
    r ∈ Submodule.span A {x : S.𝓡 | ∃ (j : ℤ) (f : A) (hf : f ∈ S.𝓕 j), x = S.mono j f hf}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hr : (r : A[T;T⁻¹]) = ∑ j ∈ (r : A[T;T⁻¹]).coeff.support,
      C ((r : A[T;T⁻¹]).coeff j) * T j := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← AddMonoidAlgebra.sum_coeff_single (r : A[T;T⁻¹])]
    rw [Finsupp.sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    rw [single_eq_C_mul_T]
  have hr' : r = ∑ j ∈ (r : A[T;T⁻¹]).coeff.support,
      S.mono j ((r : A[T;T⁻¹]).coeff j) ((S.mem_𝓡 _).1 r.2 j) := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [AddSubmonoidClass.coe_finsetSum]
    exact hr
  rw [hr']
  exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun j _ => Submodule.subset_span ⟨j, _, _, rfl⟩

name: BezoutCounterexample.ReesData.gradedToQuot_surjective
statement: theorem gradedToQuot_surjective : Function.Surjective S.gradedToQuot
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.range_eq_top, eq_top_iff]
  rintro q -
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective q
  have hr := S.mem_span_mono r
  induction hr using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨j, f, hf, rfl⟩ := hx
    by_cases hj : 0 ≤ j
    · obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Int.eq_ofNat_of_zero_le hj
      refine ⟨DirectSum.of S.grPiece n (Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨f, hf⟩), ?_⟩
      rw [gradedToQuot, ← DirectSum.lof_eq_of A, DirectSum.toModule_lof, grToQuot_mk]
    · 
      refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
      rw [map_zero, eq_comm, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
      refine (S.mono_mem_span_s_iff hf).2 ?_
      rw [S.𝓕_of_nonpos (by omega)]; trivial
  | zero => exact ⟨0, by rw [map_zero, map_zero]⟩
  | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hy
    exact ⟨a + b, by rw [map_add, ha, hb, map_add]⟩
  | smul a x _ hx =>
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hx
    refine ⟨a • b, ?_⟩
    rw [map_smul, hb]
    rfl

name: BezoutCounterexample.ReesData.gradedToQuot_injective
statement: theorem gradedToQuot_injective : Function.Injective S.gradedToQuot
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro x hx
  
  choose f hf using fun j => Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ (x j)
  have hxsum : x = ∑ j ∈ x.support, DirectSum.of S.grPiece j (Submodule.Quotient.mk (f j)) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← DirectSum.sum_support_of x]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by rw [hf j]
  have hx' : Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {S.s})
      (∑ j ∈ x.support, S.mono j (f j : A) (f j).2) = 0 := by
    rw [← hx]
    conv_rhs => rw [hxsum]
    rw [map_sum, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    rw [gradedToQuot, ← DirectSum.lof_eq_of A, DirectSum.toModule_lof, grToQuot_mk]
  rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, s] at hx'
  
  have hcoef := (mem_span_s_iff S.fil _ _).1 hx'
  have hall : ∀ j ∈ x.support, ((f j : ↥(S.𝓕 j)) : A) ∈ S.𝓕 (j + 1) := by
    intro j hj
    have := hcoef j
    rw [AddSubmonoidClass.coe_finsetSum, laurent_coeff_sum] at this
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem j hj] at this
    · simpa [mono, coeff_C_mul_T, S.fil_F] using this
    · intro i _ hij
      simp [mono, coeff_C_mul_T, Nat.cast_inj, Ne.symm hij]
  ext j
  by_cases hj : j ∈ x.support
  · rw [← hf j, DirectSum.zero_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
    simp only [Submodule.mem_comap, Submodule.coe_subtype]
    exact_mod_cast hall j hj
  · rw [DFinsupp.notMem_support_iff.1 hj, DirectSum.zero_apply]

name: BezoutCounterexample.ReesData.mul_not_mem_𝓕
statement:
theorem mul_not_mem_𝓕 {a b : ℕ} {f g : A} (hf : f ∈ S.𝓕 a) (hf1 : f ∉ S.𝓕 (a + 1))
    (hg : g ∈ S.𝓕 b) (hg1 : g ∉ S.𝓕 (b + 1)) : f * g ∉ S.𝓕 (a + b + 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← S.fil_F] at hf hf1 hg hg1 ⊢
  exact compFil_mul_not_mem S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.d_pos S.hw hf hf1 hg hg1

name: BezoutCounterexample.ReesData.isDomain_quotient_s
statement: theorem isDomain_quotient_s : IsDomain (S.𝓡 ⧸ Ideal.span {S.s})
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.Quotient.isDomain_iff_prime]
  exact rees_s_prime S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.d_pos S.hw

name: BezoutCounterexample.ReesData.prime_s
statement: theorem prime_s : Prime S.s
proof:
:= by
  have hs0 : S.s ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have := congrArg (fun r : S.𝓡 => (r : A[T;T⁻¹])) h
    simp only [s_coe, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero] at this
    exact (isUnit_T (-1 : ℤ)).ne_zero this
  exact (Ideal.span_singleton_prime hs0).1 (rees_s_prime S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.d_pos S.hw)

name: BezoutCounterexample.ReesData.drop
statement:
theorem drop (P : Ideal S.𝓡) [P.IsMaximal] (hIw : S.Iw ≤ P) (hs : S.s ∈ P)
    (hP : ¬ S.𝓡plus ≤ P) : inv S.Iw P ≺ maxinv S.I
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨r, ⟨j, f, hj1, hf, hr⟩, hrP⟩ : ∃ r ∈ {r : S.𝓡 | ∃ (j : ℤ) (f : A), 1 ≤ j ∧
      f ∈ S.𝓕 j ∧ (r : A[T;T⁻¹]) = C f * T j}, r ∉ P := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    exact hP (Ideal.span_le.2 fun r hr => h r hr)
  have hIw0 : S.Iw ≠ ⊥ := weakT_ne_bot S.fil S.ne_bot S.d S.I_le_fil
  have hv := invAt_inv hIw0 hIw
  rw [weightLT_iff]
  have hf' : f ∈ S.fil.F j := by rw [S.fil_F]; exact hf
  have hrP' : (⟨C f * T j, C_mul_T_mem_ReesAlg hf'⟩ : S.𝓡) ∉ P := by
    have : r = ⟨C f * T j, C_mul_T_mem_ReesAlg hf'⟩ := Subtype.ext hr
    rwa [this] at hrP
  exact Principalization.drop S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.d_pos S.hw P hIw hs hj1 hf' hrP' hv

name: BezoutCounterexample.deriv_mem_maxCenter
statement:
theorem deriv_mem_maxCenter {I : Ideal A} (hI : I ≠ ⊥) {𝔪 : Ideal A} [𝔪.IsMaximal]
    (hI𝔪 : I ≤ 𝔪) (δ : Derivation ℚ A A) (hδ : ∀ f ∈ I, δ f ∈ I) (t : ℚ)
    {f : Localization.AtPrime 𝔪} (hf : f ∈ maxCenter I 𝔪 t) :
    derivLoc δ 𝔪 f ∈ maxCenter I 𝔪 t
proof:
:= by
  rw [maxCenter_eq_cRF hI hI𝔪] at hf ⊢
  obtain ⟨n, e, he, -⟩ := invAt_inv hI hI𝔪
  obtain ⟨J, -, -⟩ := he.1
  obtain ⟨k, ck, hrun, hadm, hck, hsupp⟩ :=
    he.exists_run (Iloc_ne_bot hI 𝔪) (Iloc_le hI𝔪) J.c J.centred
  have hδ𝔪 : ∀ g ∈ Iloc I 𝔪, derivLoc δ 𝔪 g ∈ Iloc I 𝔪 := fun g hg =>
    deriv_mem_map (algebraMap A _) (derivLoc δ 𝔪) δ (fun r => extLoc_algebraMap _ δ r) hδ hg
  have hx : ∀ i, e i ≠ 0 → derivLoc δ 𝔪 (ck.x i) ∈ ck.RF e (e i) := fun i hi =>
    deriv_mem_RF hrun hadm hck he.nonneg he.anti hsupp _ hδ𝔪 i ((hsupp i).1 hi)
  have hcRF : cRF I 𝔪 t = ck.RF e t :=
    cRF_eq hI hI𝔪 (J := ⟨ck, e, hck, he.nonneg, he.anti⟩) hadm he t
  rw [hcRF] at hf ⊢
  exact deriv_mem_RF_of_x ck (derivLoc δ 𝔪) hx t hf

name: BezoutCounterexample.ReesData.deriv_mem_𝓕
statement:
theorem ReesData.deriv_mem_𝓕 (S : ReesData A) (δ : Derivation ℚ A A)
    (hδ : ∀ f ∈ S.I, δ f ∈ S.I) (j : ℤ) {f : A} (hf : f ∈ S.𝓕 j) : δ f ∈ S.𝓕 j
proof:
:= by
  rw [← S.fil_F] at hf ⊢
  exact deriv_mem_compF S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 δ hδ _ hf

name: BezoutCounterexample.numNonzero_inv_add_le
statement:
theorem numNonzero_inv_add_le {I : Ideal A} (hI : I ≠ ⊥) {𝔪 : Ideal A} [𝔪.IsMaximal]
    (hI𝔪 : I ≤ 𝔪) {m : ℕ} (δ : Fin m → Derivation ℚ A A) (hδ : ∀ j, ∀ f ∈ I, δ j f ∈ I)
    (z : Fin m → A) (hz : (Matrix.of fun j q => δ j (z q)).det ∉ 𝔪) :
    ((numNonzero (inv I 𝔪) + m : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim A
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, e, he, hext⟩ := invAt_inv hI hI𝔪
  obtain ⟨J, -, -⟩ := he.1
  obtain ⟨k, ck, hrun, hadm, hck, hsupp⟩ :=
    he.exists_run (Iloc_ne_bot hI 𝔪) (Iloc_le hI𝔪) J.c J.centred
  have hunit : IsUnit (Matrix.of fun j l => derivLoc (δ j) 𝔪
      (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪) (z l))).det := by
    rw [det_extLoc]
    exact IsLocalization.map_units (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪) (⟨_, hz⟩ : 𝔪.primeCompl)
  have hkm := length_le_of_derivations hrun hadm hck he.nonneg he.anti hsupp
    (fun j => derivLoc (δ j) 𝔪)
    (fun j g hg => deriv_mem_map (algebraMap A _) (derivLoc (δ j) 𝔪) (δ j)
      (fun r => extLoc_algebraMap _ (δ j) r) (hδ j) hg) _ hunit
  have hk : numNonzero (inv I 𝔪) = k := by
    rw [← hext]
    unfold numNonzero
    have : {i | ext0 e i ≠ 0} = ↑(Finset.range k) := by
      ext i
      simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Finset.coe_range, Set.mem_Iio]
      by_cases hin : i < n
      · rw [show ext0 e i = e ⟨i, hin⟩ by simp [ext0, hin]]
        exact hsupp ⟨i, hin⟩
      · rw [show ext0 e i = 0 by simp [ext0, hin]]
        simp only [ne_eq, not_true_eq_false, false_iff, not_lt]
        omega
    rw [this, Set.ncard_coe_finset, Finset.card_range]
  rw [chart_size_eq_ringKrullDim J.c, hk]
  exact_mod_cast hkm

name: Matrix.entryIdeal_le_iff
statement:
lemma entryIdeal_le_iff {R m n : Type*} [CommRing R] {F : Matrix m n R} {I : Ideal R} :
    entryIdeal F ≤ I ↔ ∀ i j, F i j ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  simp [entryIdeal, Ideal.span_le, Set.range_subset_iff]

name: Matrix.isSmithNormalForm_iff_chain
statement:
theorem isSmithNormalForm_iff_chain {m n : ℕ} (D : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) R) :
    BezoutCounterexample.IsSmithNormalForm D ↔
      ∃ d : ℕ → R, (∀ i j, D i j = if (i : ℕ) = j then d i else 0) ∧
        ∀ k, k + 1 < min m n → d k ∣ d (k + 1)
proof:
:=
  BezoutCounterexample.isSmithNormalForm_iff_chain D

name: Matrix.MatrixEquivalent.entry_mem
proof: := BezoutCounterexample.MatrixEquivalent.entry_mem h I hG i j

name: Matrix.MatrixEquivalent.entryIdeal_eq
statement:
theorem MatrixEquivalent.entryIdeal_eq {m n : ℕ} {F G : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) R}
    (h : MatrixEquivalent F G) : entryIdeal F = entryIdeal G
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [entryIdeal_le_iff]
    exact h.entry_mem _ (fun i j => Ideal.subset_span ⟨(i, j), rfl⟩)
  · obtain ⟨P, Q, hPQ⟩ := h
    rw [entryIdeal_le_iff]
    intro i j
    rw [← hPQ]
    exact BezoutCounterexample.entry_mem_of_mul _ F _ (entryIdeal F)
      (fun i j => Ideal.subset_span ⟨(i, j), rfl⟩) i j

name: Matrix.IsElementaryDivisorDomain.isBezout
statement: theorem IsElementaryDivisorDomain.isBezout (h : IsElementaryDivisorDomain R) : IsBezout R
proof:
:=
  BezoutCounterexample.IsElementaryDivisorDomain.isBezout h

name: IsBezout.exists_eq_mul_isCoprime
statement:
theorem exists_eq_mul_isCoprime (a b : R) :
    ∃ d r s : R, a = d * r ∧ b = d * s ∧ IsCoprime r s
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hzero : a = 0 ∧ b = 0
  · exact ⟨0, 1, 0, by simp [hzero.1], by simp [hzero.2], isCoprime_one_left⟩
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := gcd_dvd_left a b
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := gcd_dvd_right a b
  obtain ⟨u, v, huv⟩ := gcd_eq_sum a b
  generalize gcd a b = d at hr hs huv
  have hd : d ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    exact hzero ⟨by simp [hr, h], by simp [hs, h]⟩
  refine ⟨d, r, s, hr, hs, u, v, ?_⟩
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ hd
  calc
    d * (u * r + v * s) = u * a + v * b := by rw [hr, hs]; ring
    _ = d := huv
    _ = d * 1 := (mul_one _).symm

name: Matrix.exists_det_one_mul_eq_upperTriangular
statement:
theorem exists_det_one_mul_eq_upperTriangular (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) :
    ∃ (H : GL (Fin 2) R) (a b c : R),
      det (H : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) = 1 ∧
      (H : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) * M = !![a, b; 0, c]
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, r, s, hr, hs, u, v, huv⟩ :=
    IsBezout.exists_eq_mul_isCoprime (M 0 0) (M 1 0)
  let A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R := !![u, v; -s, r]
  have hdet : det A = 1 := by
    simp only [A, det_fin_two_of, mul_neg, sub_neg_eq_add]
    linear_combination huv
  let H : GL (Fin 2) R := GeneralLinearGroup.mk'' A (hdet.symm ▸ isUnit_one)
  refine ⟨H, d, u * M 0 1 + v * M 1 1, -s * M 0 1 + r * M 1 1, hdet, ?_⟩
  change A * M = _
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
  · change u * M 0 0 + v * M 1 0 = d
    rw [hr, hs]
    linear_combination d * huv
  · rfl
  · change -s * M 0 0 + r * M 1 0 = 0
    rw [hr, hs]
    ring
  · rfl

name: Ideal.span_triple_eq_top_iff
statement:
theorem span_triple_eq_top_iff (a b c : R) :
    (span {a, b, c} : Ideal R) = ⊤ ↔ ∃ u v w : R, u * a + v * b + w * c = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff_one, mem_span_insert]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨u, z, hz, he⟩
    obtain ⟨v, w, rfl⟩ := mem_span_pair.mp hz
    exact ⟨u, v, w, by simpa only [add_assoc] using he.symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨u, v, w, h⟩
    exact ⟨u, v * b + w * c, mem_span_pair.mpr ⟨v, w, rfl⟩,
      by simpa only [add_assoc] using h.symm⟩

name: kaplanskyCondition_iff_exists
statement:
theorem kaplanskyCondition_iff_exists :
    KaplanskyCondition R ↔
      ∀ a b c : R, (∃ u v w : R, u * a + v * b + w * c = 1) →
        ∃ p q s t : R, s * (p * a) + t * (p * b + q * c) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [KaplanskyCondition, Ideal.span_triple_eq_top_iff, IsCoprime]

name: KaplanskyCondition.gcd_eq_one_iff_isUnit
statement:
theorem gcd_eq_one_iff_isUnit [NormalizedGCDMonoid R] (a b : R) :
    gcd a b = 1 ↔ IsUnit (gcd a b)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [normalize_gcd] using (normalize_eq_one (x := gcd a b))

name: KaplanskyCondition.isBezout_iff_gcd_eq_sum
statement:
theorem isBezout_iff_gcd_eq_sum [IsDomain R] [GCDMonoid R] :
    IsBezout R ↔ ∀ a b : R, ∃ x y : R, x * a + y * b = gcd a b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    let := h
    intro a b
    obtain ⟨x, y, hxy⟩ := exists_gcd_eq_mul_add_mul a b
    exact ⟨x, y, by simpa only [mul_comm] using hxy.symm⟩
  · intro h
    rw [IsBezout.iff_span_pair_isPrincipal]
    intro a b
    refine ⟨⟨gcd a b, le_antisymm ?_ ?_⟩⟩
    · rw [Ideal.span_insert, sup_le_iff]
      exact ⟨Ideal.span_singleton_le_span_singleton.mpr (gcd_dvd_left a b),
        Ideal.span_singleton_le_span_singleton.mpr (gcd_dvd_right a b)⟩
    · rw [Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
      obtain ⟨x, y, hxy⟩ := h a b
      exact Ideal.mem_span_pair.mpr ⟨x, y, hxy⟩

name: KaplanskyCondition.span_triple_eq_span_gcd
statement:
theorem span_triple_eq_span_gcd [GCDMonoid R] (a b c : R) :
    (Ideal.span {a, b, c} : Ideal R) = Ideal.span {gcd a (gcd b c)}
proof:
:= by
  rw [span_gcd a (gcd b c)]
  conv_rhs => rw [Ideal.span_insert, span_gcd b c]
  rw [Ideal.span_insert]

name: KaplanskyCondition.span_triple_eq_top_iff_gcd_eq_one
statement:
theorem span_triple_eq_top_iff_gcd_eq_one [NormalizedGCDMonoid R] (a b c : R) :
    (Ideal.span {a, b, c} : Ideal R) = ⊤ ↔ gcd a (gcd b c) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [span_triple_eq_span_gcd, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top, gcd_eq_one_iff_isUnit]

name: KaplanskyCondition.span_triple_eq_top_iff_associated_gcd_one
statement:
theorem span_triple_eq_top_iff_associated_gcd_one [GCDMonoid R] (a b c : R) :
    (Ideal.span {a, b, c} : Ideal R) = ⊤ ↔ Associated (gcd a (gcd b c)) 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [span_triple_eq_span_gcd, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top, associated_one_iff_isUnit]

name: kaplanskyCondition_iff_gcd
statement:
theorem kaplanskyCondition_iff_gcd [IsDomain R] [IsBezout R] [NormalizedGCDMonoid R] :
    KaplanskyCondition R ↔ KaplanskyConditionGCD R
proof:
:= by
  simp only [KaplanskyCondition, KaplanskyConditionGCD,
    KaplanskyCondition.span_triple_eq_top_iff_gcd_eq_one,
    ← gcd_isUnit_iff, ← KaplanskyCondition.gcd_eq_one_iff_isUnit]

name: kaplanskyCondition_iff_gcdUpToUnits
statement:
theorem kaplanskyCondition_iff_gcdUpToUnits [IsDomain R] [IsBezout R] [GCDMonoid R] :
    KaplanskyCondition R ↔ KaplanskyConditionGCDUpToUnits R
proof:
:= by
  simp only [KaplanskyCondition, KaplanskyConditionGCDUpToUnits,
    KaplanskyCondition.span_triple_eq_top_iff_associated_gcd_one,
    associated_one_iff_isUnit, gcd_isUnit_iff]

name: kaplanskyConditionGCD_iff_upToUnits
statement:
theorem kaplanskyConditionGCD_iff_upToUnits
    [IsDomain R] [IsBezout R] [NormalizedGCDMonoid R] :
    KaplanskyConditionGCD R ↔ KaplanskyConditionGCDUpToUnits R
proof:
:=
  kaplanskyCondition_iff_gcd.symm.trans kaplanskyCondition_iff_gcdUpToUnits

name: not_kaplanskyConditionGCD_iff
statement:
theorem not_kaplanskyConditionGCD_iff [NormalizedGCDMonoid R] :
    ¬ KaplanskyConditionGCD R ↔
      ∃ a b c : R, gcd a (gcd b c) = 1 ∧
        ∀ p q : R, gcd (p * a) (p * b + q * c) ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [KaplanskyConditionGCD, not_forall, not_exists, exists_prop]

name: Matrix.entryIdeal_upperTriangular
statement:
theorem entryIdeal_upperTriangular (a b c : R) :
    entryIdeal !![a, b; 0, c] = (Ideal.span {a, b, c} : Ideal R)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [entryIdeal_le_iff]
    intro i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
    · exact Ideal.subset_span (by simp)
    · exact Ideal.subset_span (by simp)
    · exact Ideal.zero_mem _
    · exact Ideal.subset_span (by simp)
  · rw [Ideal.span_le]
    rintro x (rfl | rfl | rfl)
    · exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨(0, 0), rfl⟩
    · exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨(0, 1), rfl⟩
    · exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨(1, 1), rfl⟩

name: Matrix.vecMul_upperTriangular_dotProduct
statement:
theorem vecMul_upperTriangular_dotProduct (a b c p q s t : R) :
    ![p, q] ᵥ* !![a, b; 0, c] ⬝ᵥ ![s, t] =
      s * (p * a) + t * (p * b + q * c)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [vecMul, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  change (p * a + q * 0) * s + (p * b + q * c) * t = _
  ring

name: Matrix.HasSmithNormalForm.exists_vecMul_dotProduct_eq_one
statement:
theorem HasSmithNormalForm.exists_vecMul_dotProduct_eq_one
    {M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R} (hSNF : HasSmithNormalForm M)
    (hM : entryIdeal M = ⊤) :
    ∃ p q s t : R, ![p, q] ᵥ* M ⬝ᵥ ![s, t] = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨G, hMG, hG⟩ := hSNF
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hdiv⟩ := (isSmithNormalForm_iff_chain G).1 hG
  have hd12 : d 0 ∣ d 1 := hdiv 0 (by norm_num)
  have htop : (Ideal.span {d 0, d 1} : Ideal R) = ⊤ := by
    apply top_unique
    rw [← hM, entryIdeal_le_iff]
    apply hMG.entry_mem
    intro i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
    · rw [hd]; exact Ideal.subset_span (by simp)
    · rw [hd]; simp
    · rw [hd]; simp
    · rw [hd]; exact Ideal.subset_span (by simp)
  have hunit : IsUnit (d 0) := by
    have hspan : (Ideal.span {d 0, d 1} : Ideal R) = Ideal.span {d 0} := by
      rw [Ideal.span_insert, sup_eq_left.2 (Ideal.span_singleton_le_span_singleton.2 hd12)]
    rwa [hspan, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top] at htop
  obtain ⟨P, Q, hPQ⟩ := hMG
  have h00 : ![(P : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) 0 0, (P : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) 0 1] ᵥ*
      M ⬝ᵥ ![(Q : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) 0 0, (Q : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) 1 0] =
      d 0 := by
    have h : ((P : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) * M * Q) 0 0 = d 0 := by
      rw [hPQ, hd]; simp
    rw [← h]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, vecMul, dotProduct]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ⟩ := hunit.exists_left_inv
  refine ⟨μ * (P : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) 0 0,
    μ * (P : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) 0 1,
    (Q : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) 0 0, (Q : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) 1 0, ?_⟩
  simp only [vecMul, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_two] at h00 ⊢
  change ((P : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) 0 0 * M 0 0 +
      (P : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) 0 1 * M 1 0) *
        (Q : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) 0 0 +
    ((P : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) 0 0 * M 0 1 +
      (P : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) 0 1 * M 1 1) *
        (Q : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) 1 0 = d 0 at h00
  change (μ * (P : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) 0 0 * M 0 0 +
      μ * (P : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) 0 1 * M 1 0) *
        (Q : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) 0 0 +
    (μ * (P : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) 0 0 * M 0 1 +
      μ * (P : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) 0 1 * M 1 1) *
        (Q : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) 1 0 = 1
  linear_combination μ * h00 + hμ

name: KaplanskyCondition.exists_vecMul_dotProduct_eq_one
statement:
theorem exists_vecMul_dotProduct_eq_one (h : KaplanskyCondition R)
    (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) (hM : Matrix.entryIdeal M = ⊤) :
    ∃ p q s t : R, ![p, q] ᵥ* M ⬝ᵥ ![s, t] = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨H, a, b, c, -, hH⟩ := Matrix.exists_det_one_mul_eq_upperTriangular M
  have he : Matrix.MatrixEquivalent M !![a, b; 0, c] := ⟨H, 1, by simpa using hH⟩
  have htop : (Ideal.span {a, b, c} : Ideal R) = ⊤ := by
    rw [← Matrix.entryIdeal_upperTriangular, ← he.entryIdeal_eq]
    exact hM
  obtain ⟨p, q, s, t, hpq⟩ := h a b c htop
  let row := ![p, q] ᵥ* (H : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R)
  have hrow : row ᵥ* M ⬝ᵥ ![s, t] = 1 := by
    rw [Matrix.vecMul_vecMul, hH, Matrix.vecMul_upperTriangular_dotProduct]
    exact hpq
  have heq : ![row 0, row 1] = row := by
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  exact ⟨row 0, row 1, s, t, heq.symm ▸ hrow⟩

name: kaplanskyCondition_iff_primitive_matrix
statement:
theorem kaplanskyCondition_iff_primitive_matrix [IsBezout R] [IsCancelMulZero R] :
    KaplanskyCondition R ↔
      ∀ M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R, Matrix.entryIdeal M = ⊤ →
        ∃ p q s t : R, ![p, q] ᵥ* M ⬝ᵥ ![s, t] = 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact fun h => h.exists_vecMul_dotProduct_eq_one
  · intro h a b c habc
    obtain ⟨p, q, s, t, hpq⟩ := h !![a, b; 0, c]
      ((Matrix.entryIdeal_upperTriangular a b c).trans habc)
    exact ⟨p, q, s, t, by rwa [Matrix.vecMul_upperTriangular_dotProduct] at hpq⟩

name: BezoutCounterexample.RealPt.isClosed_range_coe
statement: lemma isClosed_range_coe : IsClosed (range fun w : RealPt A => (w : A → ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have : range (fun w : RealPt A => (w : A → ℝ)) =
      {f : A → ℝ | f 1 = 1} ∩ (⋂ x : A, ⋂ y : A, {f | f (x + y) = f x + f y}) ∩
        (⋂ x : A, ⋂ y : A, {f | f (x * y) = f x * f y}) := by
    ext f
    simp only [mem_range, mem_inter_iff, mem_ofPred_eq, mem_iInter]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨w, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨⟨map_one w, fun x y => map_add w x y⟩, fun x y => map_mul w x y⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨h1, hadd⟩, hmul⟩
      refine ⟨RealPt.ofHom
        { toFun := f, map_one' := h1, map_mul' := hmul,
          map_zero' := by have := hadd 0 0; simp at this; linarith,
          map_add' := hadd }, rfl⟩
  rw [this]
  refine ((isClosed_eq (continuous_apply 1) continuous_const).inter ?_).inter ?_
  · exact isClosed_iInter fun x => isClosed_iInter fun y =>
      isClosed_eq (continuous_apply _) ((continuous_apply x).add (continuous_apply y))
  · exact isClosed_iInter fun x => isClosed_iInter fun y =>
      isClosed_eq (continuous_apply _) ((continuous_apply x).mul (continuous_apply y))

name: BezoutCounterexample.RealPt.isClosedEmbedding_coe
