name: BezoutCounterexample.RealPt.isCompact_of_forall_bounded
statement:
theorem isCompact_of_forall_bounded {K' : Set (RealPt A)} (hK' : IsClosed K')
    (hb : ∀ x : A, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ K', |w x| ≤ C) : IsCompact K'
proof:
:= by
  choose C hC using hb
  have hbox : IsCompact (Set.pi univ fun x : A => Icc (-C x) (C x)) :=
    isCompact_univ_pi fun x => isCompact_Icc
  have hsub : (fun w : RealPt A => (w : A → ℝ)) '' K' ⊆
      Set.pi univ fun x : A => Icc (-C x) (C x) := by
    rintro _ ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ x -
    exact abs_le.1 (hC x w hw)
  have himg : IsCompact ((fun w : RealPt A => (w : A → ℝ)) '' K') :=
    hbox.of_isClosed_subset (isClosedEmbedding_coe.isClosedMap K' hK') hsub
  have := isClosedEmbedding_coe.isCompact_preimage himg
  rwa [Set.preimage_image_eq _ isClosedEmbedding_coe.injective] at this

name: BezoutCounterexample.RealPt.forall_bounded_of_gen
statement:
theorem forall_bounded_of_gen {U : Type*} [CommRing U] [Algebra A U] {K : Set (RealPt A)}
    (hK : IsCompact K) {K' : Set (RealPt U)} (hmaps : ∀ w ∈ K', comap (algebraMap A U) w ∈ K)
    {s : Set U} (hgen : Algebra.adjoin A s = ⊤) (hs : ∀ y ∈ s, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ K', |w y| ≤ C)
    (x : U) : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ K', |w x| ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  have hx : x ∈ Algebra.adjoin A s := by rw [hgen]; trivial
  induction hx using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
  | mem y hy => exact hs y hy
  | algebraMap a =>
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := (hK.image (continuous_eval a)).isBounded.exists_norm_le
    refine ⟨C, fun w hw => ?_⟩
    have := hC _ ⟨_, hmaps w hw, rfl⟩
    simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using this
  | add y z _ _ hy hz =>
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hy
    obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := hz
    exact ⟨C + D, fun w hw => by
      rw [map_add]; exact (abs_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (hC w hw) (hD w hw))⟩
  | mul y z _ _ hy hz =>
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hy
    obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := hz
    refine ⟨|C| * |D|, fun w hw => ?_⟩
    rw [map_mul, abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul ((hC w hw).trans (le_abs_self C)) ((hD w hw).trans (le_abs_self D))
      (abs_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _)

lemma continuous_aeval_rat (P : MvPolynomial (Fin m) ℚ) :

proof:
:= by

      fun p => MvPolynomial.eval p (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap ℚ ℝ) P) := by

statement:
lemma evalGens_injective (hgen : Algebra.adjoin ℚ (Set.range a) = ⊤) :
    Function.Injective (evalGens a)
proof:
:= by
  intro z w h
  have : toAlgHom z = toAlgHom w :=
    AlgHom.ext_of_adjoin_eq_top hgen (by
      rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
      exact congrFun h i)

name: BezoutCounterexample.RealPt.isEmbedding_evalGens
statement:
theorem isEmbedding_evalGens (hgen : Algebra.adjoin ℚ (Set.range a) = ⊤) :
    IsEmbedding (evalGens a)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨le_antisymm (continuous_iff_le_induced.1 (continuous_evalGens a)) ?_⟩,
    evalGens_injective hgen⟩
  
  let tI : TopologicalSpace (RealPt A) := TopologicalSpace.induced (evalGens a) inferInstance
  have hcont : Continuous (fun z : RealPt A => (z : A → ℝ)) := by
    refine continuous_pi fun b => ?_
    obtain ⟨P, rfl⟩ : ∃ P, MvPolynomial.aeval a P = b := by
      have hb : b ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℚ (Set.range a) := by rw [hgen]; trivial
      rw [← MvPolynomial.aeval_range] at hb
      exact hb
    have : (fun z : RealPt A => (z : A → ℝ) (MvPolynomial.aeval a P)) =
        (fun p => MvPolynomial.aeval p P) ∘ evalGens a := by
      funext z; exact apply_aeval a z P
    rw [this]
    exact (continuous_aeval_rat P).comp continuous_induced_dom
  exact continuous_iff_le_induced.1 hcont

name: BezoutCounterexample.RealPt.range_evalGens
statement:
theorem range_evalGens (hgen : Algebra.adjoin ℚ (Set.range a) = ⊤) :
    Set.range (evalGens a) = relZeroSet a
proof:
:= by
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective (MvPolynomial.aeval (R := ℚ) a) := by
    intro b
    have hb : b ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℚ (Set.range a) := by rw [hgen]; trivial
    rw [← MvPolynomial.aeval_range] at hb
    exact hb
  ext p
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, rfl⟩ P hP
    rw [← apply_aeval, RingHom.mem_ker.1 hP, map_zero]
  · intro hp
    let e := Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective hsurj
    let φ : MvPolynomial (Fin m) ℚ ⧸ RingHom.ker (MvPolynomial.aeval (R := ℚ) a) →ₐ[ℚ] ℝ :=
      Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ _ (MvPolynomial.aeval p) (fun P hP => hp P hP)
    refine ⟨ofHom (φ.comp e.symm.toAlgHom).toRingHom, funext fun i => ?_⟩
    have : e.symm (a i) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPolynomial.X i) := by
      rw [AlgEquiv.symm_apply_eq]
      simp [e]
    show φ (e.symm (a i)) = p i
    rw [this]
    exact MvPolynomial.aeval_X (R := ℚ) p i

name: BezoutCounterexample.RealPt.isCompact_iff
statement:
theorem isCompact_iff (hgen : Algebra.adjoin ℚ (Set.range a) = ⊤) (K : Set (RealPt A)) :
    IsCompact K ↔ IsClosed K ∧ ∀ i, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ K, |z (a i)| ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hK
    refine ⟨hK.isClosed, fun i => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := (hK.image (continuous_eval (a i))).isBounded.exists_norm_le
    exact ⟨C, fun z hz => by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hC _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨hcl, hb⟩
    refine isCompact_of_forall_bounded hcl fun b => ?_
    have hb' : b ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℚ (Set.range a) := by rw [hgen]; trivial
    induction hb' using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
    | mem y hy =>
      obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hy
      exact hb i
    | algebraMap q =>
      refine ⟨|(q : ℝ)|, fun w _ => le_of_eq ?_⟩
      rw [← eq_ratCast (toHom w |>.comp (algebraMap ℚ A)) q]
      rfl
    | add y z _ _ hy hz =>
      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hy
      obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := hz
      exact ⟨C + D, fun w hw => by
        rw [map_add]; exact (abs_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (hC w hw) (hD w hw))⟩
    | mul y z _ _ hy hz =>
      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hy
      obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := hz
      refine ⟨|C| * |D|, fun w hw => ?_⟩
      rw [map_mul, abs_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul ((hC w hw).trans (le_abs_self C)) ((hD w hw).trans (le_abs_self D))
        (abs_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _)

name: BezoutCounterexample.IsMonotoneSurjOn.id
statement:
lemma IsMonotoneSurjOn.id {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (K : Set X) :
    IsMonotoneSurjOn (fun z : X => z) K K
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨mapsTo_id K, ⟨continuous_id.subtype_map _, fun w => ⟨w, rfl⟩, fun z => ?_⟩⟩
  have : (Set.MapsTo.restrict (fun z : X => z) K K (mapsTo_id K)) ⁻¹' {z} = {z} := by
    ext w
    simp only [mem_preimage, mem_singleton_iff]
    constructor
    · intro h; exact Subtype.ext (congrArg Subtype.val h)
    · intro h; subst h; rfl
  rw [this]
  exact isConnected_singleton

name: BezoutCounterexample.PrincipalizationData.ν_pos_iff
statement: theorem ν_pos_iff (z : RealPt A) : 0 < S.ν z ↔ ¬ S.𝔭 ≤ RingHom.ker z
proof:
:= by
  have hnn : 0 ≤ S.ν z := gNorm_nonneg S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 z
  constructor
  · intro hpos hle
    apply hpos.ne'
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => ?_
    have hg : z (S.g i) = 0 :=
      hle (genCoeff_mem_p S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.d_pos S.hw S.π_mem_fil i)
    rw [hg]
    exact zero_pow (Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.1 (sphE_pos S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.d_pos i))
  · intro hle
    rcases hnn.lt_or_eq with h | h
    · exact h
    · exact absurd (fun g hg => kills_of_gNorm_zero S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.d_pos S.hw
        h.symm g hg) hle

name: BezoutCounterexample.PrincipalizationData.sphere_bundle
statement:
theorem sphere_bundle (hk : 2 ≤ S.k) {K : Set (RealPt A)} (hK : IsCompact K) :
    IsCompact (S.sphereBundle K) ∧
    IsMonotoneSurjOn (RealPt.comap (algebraMap A S.U)) (S.sphereBundle K) K ∧
    (∀ z ∈ K, ¬ S.𝔭 ≤ RingHom.ker z →
      ∃! z' : RealPt S.U, z' ∈ S.sphereBundle K ∧ RealPt.comap (algebraMap A S.U) z' = z) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ K, S.𝔭 ≤ RingHom.ker z →
      ∃ Γ : {a : Fin S.k → ℝ // a ≠ 0} → RealPt S.U, Continuous Γ ∧
        Set.range Γ = {z' | z' ∈ S.sphereBundle K ∧ RealPt.comap (algebraMap A S.U) z' = z})
proof:
:= by
  have hk2 : maxinv S.I 1 ≠ 0 := (S.e_ne_zero_iff 1).2 (by omega)
  refine ⟨torsorK_isCompact S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.d_pos S.hw S.π_mem_fil hK, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (RealPt.comap (algebraMap A S.U)) (S.sphereBundle K) K :=
      fun w hw => hw.1
    refine ⟨hmaps, ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · exact ((RealPt.continuous_comap _).comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk _
    · rintro ⟨z, hzK⟩
      rcases (gNorm_nonneg S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 (d := S.d) (π := S.π) z).lt_or_eq with hpos | h0
      · exact ⟨⟨ptA S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.d_pos S.π_mem_fil z hpos,
          ptA_mem S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.d_pos S.π_mem_fil K hzK hpos⟩,
          Subtype.ext (ptA_comap S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.d_pos S.π_mem_fil z hpos)⟩
      · have hz := kills_of_gNorm_zero S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.d_pos S.hw h0.symm
        obtain ⟨P⟩ := LocPres.nonempty S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.hw z hz
        have hk : 0 < P.k := by have := P.hk2 hk2; omega
        set u : ({0}ᶜ : Set (Fin P.k → ℝ)) := ⟨fun _ => 1, fun h => by
          have := congrFun h ⟨0, hk⟩; simp at this⟩
        exact ⟨⟨P.Gamma S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.d_pos hz S.π_mem_fil u,
          P.Gamma_mem S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.d_pos hz S.π_mem_fil hzK u⟩,
          Subtype.ext (P.Gamma_comap S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.d_pos hz S.π_mem_fil u)⟩
    · rintro ⟨z, hzK⟩
      apply isConnected_restrict_fiber
      show IsConnected (torsorFib S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.π_mem_fil K z)
      rcases (gNorm_nonneg S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 (d := S.d) (π := S.π) z).lt_or_eq with hpos | h0
      · have : torsorFib S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.π_mem_fil K z =
            {ptA S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.d_pos S.π_mem_fil z hpos} := by
          ext w
          constructor
          · rintro ⟨hwK, hwz⟩
            exact eq_ptA S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.d_pos S.π_mem_fil K hwK hwz hpos
          · rintro rfl
            exact ⟨ptA_mem S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.d_pos S.π_mem_fil K hzK hpos,
              ptA_comap S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.d_pos S.π_mem_fil z hpos⟩
        rw [this]
        exact isConnected_singleton
      · exact fib_connected S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.d_pos S.hw S.π_mem_fil
          (kills_of_gNorm_zero S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.d_pos S.hw h0.symm) hk2 hzK
  · 
    intro z hzK hz
    have hpos : 0 < S.ν z := (S.ν_pos_iff z).2 hz
    refine ⟨ptA S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.d_pos S.π_mem_fil z hpos,
      ⟨ptA_mem S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.d_pos S.π_mem_fil K hzK hpos,
        ptA_comap S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.d_pos S.π_mem_fil z hpos⟩, ?_⟩
    rintro w ⟨hwK, hwz⟩
    exact eq_ptA S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.d_pos S.π_mem_fil K hwK hwz hpos
  · 
    intro z hzK hle
    have hz : ∀ g ∈ S.𝔭, z g = 0 := fun g hg => hle hg
    obtain ⟨P⟩ := LocPres.nonempty S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.hw z hz
    
    have hPk : P.k = S.k := by
      have hsupp : ∀ i : Fin P.n, S.e i ≠ 0 ↔ (i : ℕ) < P.k := fun i => by
        rw [show S.e i = P.e i from (P.hev i).symm]; exact P.hsupp i
      
      have hvan : ∀ i, P.n ≤ i → S.e i = 0 := by
        obtain ⟨⟨𝔪, h𝔪, hI𝔪, hinv⟩, -⟩ := maxinv_spec S.ne_bot S.ne_top
        obtain ⟨n', e', he', hext⟩ := invAt_inv S.ne_bot hI𝔪
        obtain ⟨J, -, -⟩ := he'.1
        have hn' : n' = P.n := by
          have h1 := chart_size_eq_ringKrullDim J.c
          have h2 := chart_size_eq_ringKrullDim P.c
          rw [h1] at h2; exact_mod_cast h2
        intro i hi
        show maxinv S.I i = 0
        rw [← hinv, ← hext]
        simp [ext0, show ¬ i < n' by omega]
      have hkn := P.hkn
      by_contra hne
      rcases Nat.lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with h | h
      · 
        have h1 := (S.e_ne_zero_iff P.k).2 h
        by_cases hPn : P.k < P.n
        · exact absurd ((hsupp ⟨P.k, hPn⟩).1 h1) (lt_irrefl _)
        · exact h1 (hvan P.k (by omega))
      · 
        have h1 := (hsupp ⟨S.k, by omega⟩).2 h
        exact absurd ((S.e_ne_zero_iff S.k).1 h1) (lt_irrefl _)
    
    let φ : {a : Fin S.k → ℝ // a ≠ 0} → ({0}ᶜ : Set (Fin P.k → ℝ)) := fun a =>
      ⟨a.1 ∘ Fin.cast hPk, fun h => a.2 (funext fun i => by
        have := congrFun h (Fin.cast hPk.symm i)
        simpa using this)⟩
    have hφ : Function.Surjective φ := fun u =>
      ⟨⟨u.1 ∘ Fin.cast hPk.symm, fun h => u.2 (funext fun i => by
        have := congrFun h (Fin.cast hPk i)
        simpa using this)⟩, Subtype.ext (funext fun i => by simp [φ])⟩
    have hφc : Continuous φ := by
      apply Continuous.subtype_mk
      exact continuous_pi fun i => (continuous_apply (Fin.cast hPk i)).comp continuous_subtype_val
    refine ⟨P.Gamma S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.d_pos hz S.π_mem_fil ∘ φ,
      (P.continuous_Gamma S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.d_pos hz S.π_mem_fil).comp hφc, ?_⟩
    rw [hφ.range_comp]
    exact (P.fib_eq S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.d_pos S.hw S.π_mem_fil hz hzK).symm

name: BezoutCounterexample.ReesData.gradedAddEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem gradedAddEquiv_apply (a : DirectSum ℕ S.grPiece) :
    S.gradedAddEquiv a = a
proof: := S.quotientSEquiv.symm_apply_apply a

name: BezoutCounterexample.ReesData.quotientSRingEquiv_initialForm
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientSRingEquiv_initialForm (j : ℕ) (f : A) (hf : f ∈ S.𝓕 j) :
    S.quotientSRingEquiv (S.initialForm j f hf) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (S.mono j f hf)
proof:
:= by
  change S.gradedToQuot (DirectSum.of S.grPiece j (Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨f, hf⟩)) = _
  rw [gradedToQuot, ← DirectSum.lof_eq_of A, DirectSum.toModule_lof, grToQuot_mk]

name: BezoutCounterexample.ReesData.mul_mem_filtration
statement:
theorem mul_mem_filtration {a b : ℕ} {f g : A}
    (hf : f ∈ S.𝓕 a) (hg : g ∈ S.𝓕 b) : f * g ∈ S.𝓕 (a + b)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Nat.cast_add, S.fil_F] using
    S.fil.mul_le a b (Ideal.mul_mem_mul
      (by simpa only [S.fil_F] using hf) (by simpa only [S.fil_F] using hg))

name: BezoutCounterexample.ReesData.initialForm_mul
statement:
theorem initialForm_mul {a b : ℕ} {f g : A}
    (hf : f ∈ S.𝓕 a) (hg : g ∈ S.𝓕 b) :
    S.initialForm a f hf * S.initialForm b g hg =
      S.initialForm (a + b) (f * g) (S.mul_mem_filtration hf hg)
proof:
:= by
  apply S.quotientSRingEquiv.injective
  rw [map_mul, quotientSRingEquiv_initialForm, quotientSRingEquiv_initialForm,
    quotientSRingEquiv_initialForm, ← map_mul]
  congr 1
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (C f * T (a : ℤ)) * (C g * T (b : ℤ)) = C (f * g) * T ((a + b : ℕ) : ℤ)
  rw [map_mul, Nat.cast_add, T_add]
  ring

name: BezoutCounterexample.ReesData.initialForm_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem initialForm_one (h1 : (1 : A) ∈ S.𝓕 0) :
    S.initialForm 0 1 h1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply S.quotientSRingEquiv.injective
  rw [quotientSRingEquiv_initialForm, map_one]
  have hm : S.mono 0 1 h1 = 1 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [mono]
  simp only [Nat.cast_zero, hm, map_one]

name: BezoutCounterexample.ReesData.associatedGraded_isDomain
statement: theorem associatedGraded_isDomain : IsDomain S.AssociatedGraded
proof:
:= by
  let : IsDomain (S.𝓡 ⧸ Ideal.span {S.s}) := S.isDomain_quotient_s
  exact S.quotientSRingEquiv.injective.isDomain S.quotientSRingEquiv.toRingHom

name: BezoutCounterexample.complexityLT_wf
statement: theorem complexityLT_wf (N : ℕ) : WellFounded (ComplexityLT N)
proof:
:= by
  have hΓ : WellFounded (fun a b : ΓN N => a.1 ≺ b.1) := Γ_wellFoundedOn N
  have hwf : WellFounded (Prod.Lex (fun a b : ΓN N => a.1 ≺ b.1) (· < · : ℕ → ℕ → Prop)) :=
    WellFounded.prod_lex hΓ wellFounded_lt
  refine ⟨fun p => ?_⟩
  by_cases hp : p.1 ∈ ΓN N
  · suffices H : ∀ q : ΓN N × ℕ, Acc (ComplexityLT N) (q.1.1, q.2) from H (⟨p.1, hp⟩, p.2)
    intro q
    induction q using hwf.induction with
    | h q ih =>
      refine ⟨_, fun r hr => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨hr1, -, hlt⟩ := hr
      have := ih (⟨r.1, hr1⟩, r.2) (by
        rcases hlt with h | ⟨h, h'⟩
        · exact Prod.Lex.left _ _ h
        · have hq : (⟨r.1, hr1⟩ : ΓN N) = q.1 := Subtype.ext h
          rw [hq]
          exact Prod.Lex.right _ h')
      exact this
  · exact ⟨_, fun r hr => absurd hr.2.1 hp⟩

name: BezoutCounterexample.eq_zero_of_mem_ΓN
statement: theorem eq_zero_of_mem_ΓN {N : ℕ} {e : ℕ → ℚ} (he : e ∈ ΓN N) {i : ℕ} (hi : N ≤ i) : e i = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  have hprop : ∀ j, e j = 0 → ∀ l, j ≤ l → e l = 0 := by
    intro j hj l hl
    induction l, hl using Nat.le_induction with
    | base => exact hj
    | succ l _ ih => exact he.1.2 l ih
  have hall : ∀ j ≤ i, e j ≠ 0 := fun j hj h0 => h (hprop j h0 i hj)
  have hsub : (Finset.range (i + 1) : Set ℕ) ⊆ {j | e j ≠ 0} := fun j hj =>
    hall j (Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (Finset.mem_range.1 hj))
  have h1 := Set.encard_le_encard hsub
  rw [Set.encard_coe_eq_coe_finsetCard, Finset.card_range] at h1
  have h2 := h1.trans he.2
  norm_cast at h2
  omega

name: BezoutCounterexample.exists_common_denominator
statement:
theorem exists_common_denominator {e : ℕ → ℚ} {N : ℕ} (he : ∀ i, N ≤ i → e i = 0) :
    ∃ d : ℕ, 1 ≤ d ∧ ∀ i, ∃ w : ℤ, (d : ℚ) * e i = w
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨∏ i ∈ Finset.range N, (e i).den, Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2
    (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.2 fun i _ => (e i).den_ne_zero), fun i => ?_⟩
  by_cases hi : i < N
  · exact dvd_den_mul_int (Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_range.2 hi))
  · exact ⟨0, by rw [he i (not_lt.1 hi), mul_zero, Int.cast_zero]⟩

name: BezoutCounterexample.conclusion_top
statement:
theorem conclusion_top (B : SmoothFactorialDomain) (K : Set (RealPt B)) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    PrincipalizationConclusion B ⊤ K
proof:
:=
  ⟨B, AlgHom.id ℚ B, K, Function.injective_id, ⟨⟨1, by simp⟩⟩, hK, IsMonotoneSurjOn.id K⟩

name: BezoutCounterexample.conclusion_of_step
statement:
theorem conclusion_of_step {B B₁ : SmoothFactorialDomain} {𝔟 : Ideal B} {K : Set (RealPt B)}
    (f : B →ₐ[ℚ] B₁) (K₁ : Set (RealPt B₁)) (𝔟₁ : Ideal B₁) (α : B₁)
    (hinj : Function.Injective f) (hmap : 𝔟.map f = Ideal.span {α} * 𝔟₁)
    (hmono : IsMonotoneSurjOn (RealPt.comap (f : B →+* B₁)) K₁ K)
    (h : PrincipalizationConclusion B₁ 𝔟₁ K₁) : PrincipalizationConclusion B 𝔟 K
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨B', g, K', hginj, ⟨⟨t, ht⟩⟩, hK', hgmono⟩ := h
  refine ⟨B', g.comp f, K', hginj.comp hinj, ⟨⟨g α * t, ?_⟩⟩, hK', ?_⟩
  · have : (𝔟.map (g.comp f) : Ideal B') = (𝔟.map f).map g :=
      (Ideal.map_map (f : B →+* B₁) (g : B₁ →+* B')).symm
    rw [this, hmap, Ideal.map_mul, ht, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton,
      Ideal.span_singleton_mul_span_singleton]
  · exact IsMonotoneSurjOn.trans hK' hmono hgmono

name: BezoutCounterexample.maxinv_mem_ΓN
statement:
theorem maxinv_mem_ΓN {N m : ℕ} {B : Type} [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [Algebra ℚ B]
    [Algebra.Smooth ℚ B] {𝔟 : Ideal B} (h𝔟 : 𝔟 ≠ ⊥) (htop : 𝔟 ≠ ⊤) (hstar : Star N 𝔟 m) :
    maxinv 𝔟 ∈ ΓN N
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨𝔪, h𝔪, h𝔟𝔪, hinv⟩, -⟩ := maxinv_spec h𝔟 htop
  rw [← hinv]
  refine ⟨inv_mem_Γ h𝔟 h𝔟𝔪, ?_⟩
  have h1 := hstar.numNonzero_inv_le h𝔟 𝔪 h𝔟𝔪
  rw [← (finite_support_inv h𝔟 h𝔟𝔪).cast_ncard_eq]
  exact_mod_cast h1

name: BezoutCounterexample.principalization_star
statement:
theorem principalization_star (N : ℕ) (B : SmoothFactorialDomain) (𝔟 : Ideal B) (m : ℕ)
    (h𝔟 : 𝔟 ≠ ⊥) (hstar : Star N 𝔟 m) (K : Set (RealPt B)) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    PrincipalizationConclusion B 𝔟 K
proof:
:= by
  suffices H : ∀ μ : (ℕ → ℚ) × ℕ, ∀ (B : SmoothFactorialDomain) (𝔟 : Ideal B) (m : ℕ),
      𝔟 ≠ ⊥ → Star N 𝔟 m → (maxinv 𝔟, numComponents 𝔟) = μ → ∀ K : Set (RealPt B),
      IsCompact K → PrincipalizationConclusion B 𝔟 K from
    H _ B 𝔟 m h𝔟 hstar rfl K hK
  intro μ
  induction μ using (complexityLT_wf N).induction with
  | h μ ih =>
    intro B 𝔟 m h𝔟 hstar hμ K hK
    
    by_cases htop : 𝔟 = ⊤
    · subst htop; exact conclusion_top B K hK
    have hΓ := maxinv_mem_ΓN h𝔟 htop hstar
    
    have hrec : ∀ (B₁ : SmoothFactorialDomain) (𝔟₁ : Ideal B₁) (m₁ : ℕ), 𝔟₁ ≠ ⊥ →
        Star N 𝔟₁ m₁ → (maxinv 𝔟₁ ≺ maxinv 𝔟 ∨ 𝔟₁ = ⊤ ∨
          (maxinv 𝔟₁ = maxinv 𝔟 ∧ numComponents 𝔟₁ < numComponents 𝔟)) →
        ∀ K₁ : Set (RealPt B₁), IsCompact K₁ → PrincipalizationConclusion B₁ 𝔟₁ K₁ := by
      intro B₁ 𝔟₁ m₁ h𝔟₁ hstar₁ hdec K₁ hK₁
      by_cases htop₁ : 𝔟₁ = ⊤
      · subst htop₁; exact conclusion_top B₁ K₁ hK₁
      refine ih _ ?_ B₁ 𝔟₁ m₁ h𝔟₁ hstar₁ rfl K₁ hK₁
      refine ⟨maxinv_mem_ΓN h𝔟₁ htop₁ hstar₁, hμ ▸ hΓ, ?_⟩
      rw [← hμ]
      rcases hdec with h | h | h
      · exact Or.inl h
      · exact absurd h htop₁
      · exact Or.inr h
    
    obtain ⟨⟨𝔪, h𝔪, h𝔟𝔪, hinv⟩, -⟩ := maxinv_spec h𝔟 htop
    obtain ⟨𝔭, h𝔭, -⟩ := ((theorem_3_3_3 h𝔟 htop).2.2.2.1 𝔪 h𝔟𝔪).1 hinv
    obtain ⟨d, hd1, hd⟩ := exists_common_denominator (fun i hi => eq_zero_of_mem_ΓN hΓ hi)
    let R : ReesData B := ⟨𝔟, h𝔟, htop, 𝔭, h𝔭, d, hd1, hd⟩
    obtain ⟨π, hπ, hπ𝔭⟩ := R.exists_prime_mem
    let S : PrincipalizationData B := ⟨R, π, hπ, hπ𝔭⟩
    by_cases hk : S.k = 1
    · 
      obtain ⟨a, ha0, he⟩ := S.divisorial_e hk
      have ha : S.e 0 = 1 / (a : ℚ) := by rw [he]; simp
      refine conclusion_of_step (AlgHom.id ℚ B) K (S.divI₁ a) (S.π ^ a) Function.injective_id
        ?_ (IsMonotoneSurjOn.id K) ?_
      · change Ideal.map (RingHom.id B) 𝔟 = _
        rw [Ideal.map_id]; exact S.divisorial_I_eq hk ha
      · have h𝔟₁ : S.divI₁ a ≠ ⊥ := fun h => h𝔟 (eq_bot_iff.2 (by
          have := S.divisorial_I_eq hk ha
          rw [h, Ideal.mul_bot] at this
          exact this.le))
        exact hrec B (S.divI₁ a) m h𝔟₁ (S.length_control_divisorial hstar hk ha)
          ((S.divisorial_decrease hk ha).imp_right (Or.imp id fun h => ⟨h.1, h.2.2⟩)) K hK
    · 
      have hk2 : 2 ≤ S.k := by have := R.one_le_k; change 1 ≤ S.k at this; omega
      obtain ⟨-, -, -, hinj, -, hmap⟩ := S.torsor_spec hk2
      obtain ⟨hI₁, -, -, hdec⟩ := S.torsor_invariant hk2
      obtain ⟨hK₁, hmono, -, -⟩ := S.sphere_bundle hk2 hK
      exact conclusion_of_step (B₁ := S.torsorSFD hk2) (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom ℚ B S.U)
        (S.sphereBundle K) S.I₁ (S.sU ^ S.d) hinj hmap hmono
        (hrec (S.torsorSFD hk2) S.I₁ (m + S.ℓ + 1) hI₁ (S.length_control_torsor hstar hk2)
          (hdec.imp_right (Or.imp id fun h => ⟨h.1, h.2.2⟩)) _ hK₁)

name: BezoutCounterexample.Star.numNonzero_inv_le
statement:
theorem Star.numNonzero_inv_le {N m : ℕ} {𝔟 : Ideal B} (h : Star N 𝔟 m) (h𝔟 : 𝔟 ≠ ⊥)
    (𝔪 : Ideal B) [𝔪.IsMaximal] (h𝔟𝔪 : 𝔟 ≤ 𝔪) : numNonzero (inv 𝔟 𝔪) ≤ N
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨δ, z, hδ, hdet⟩ := h.derivations 𝔪 inferInstance h𝔟𝔪
  have h1 := (numNonzero_inv_add_le h𝔟 h𝔟𝔪 δ hδ z hdet).trans h.dim_le
  have h2 : numNonzero (inv 𝔟 𝔪) + m ≤ N + m := by exact_mod_cast h1
  omega

name: BezoutCounterexample.star_initial
statement: theorem star_initial {N : ℕ} (hN : ringKrullDim B = N) (𝔟 : Ideal B) : Star N 𝔟 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨by rw [hN]; simp, fun 𝔪 h𝔪 _ => ⟨Fin.elim0, Fin.elim0, fun j => Fin.elim0 j, ?_⟩⟩
  rw [Matrix.det_isEmpty]
  exact (Ideal.ne_top_iff_one _).1 h𝔪.ne_top

name: BezoutCounterexample.PrincipalizationData.length_control_divisorial
statement:
theorem length_control_divisorial {N m : ℕ} (hS : Star N S.I m) (hk : S.k = 1) {a : ℕ}
    (ha : S.e 0 = 1 / (a : ℚ)) : Star N (S.divI₁ a) m
proof:
:=
  ⟨hS.dim_le, div_vertOK S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.d_pos S.hw (S.divisorial_𝔭_eq hk)
    (S.a_pos hk ha) hS.derivations⟩

name: BezoutCounterexample.PrincipalizationData.ringKrullDim_U
statement: theorem ringKrullDim_U : ringKrullDim S.U = ringKrullDim A + ((1 + S.ℓ : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := Ideal.exists_maximal S.U
  obtain ⟨nA, ⟨cA⟩⟩ := exists_chart_atPrime (Q.comap (algebraMap A S.U))
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := exists_torsorY_not_mem S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.π_mem_fil Q
  obtain ⟨nP, ⟨cP⟩⟩ := exists_chart_atPrime (Q.comap (algebraMap S.𝓡 S.U))
  have hnP : nP = nA + 1 :=
    rees_chart_card _ (fun j hj => compFil_F_nonpos S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.d hj) _ cA _ cP
  obtain ⟨cU⟩ := chart_of_mvLoc (S := Localization.AtPrime (Q.comap (algebraMap S.𝓡 S.U)))
    (S' := Localization.AtPrime Q) (theta2 S.h Q hl) (theta2_injective _ Q hl)
    (theta2_surj _ Q hl) cP
  rw [chart_size_eq_ringKrullDim cU, chart_size_eq_ringKrullDim cA, hnP]
  norm_cast
  omega

name: BezoutCounterexample.PrincipalizationData.length_control_torsor
statement:
theorem length_control_torsor {N m : ℕ} (hS : Star N S.I m) (_hk : 2 ≤ S.k) :
    Star N S.I₁ (m + S.ℓ + 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    rw [S.ringKrullDim_U]
    have h := hS.dim_le
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_ringKrullDim_eq_natCast A
    rw [hn] at h ⊢
    have h' : n ≤ N + m := by exact_mod_cast h
    norm_cast
    omega
  · 
    have := torsor_vertOK S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.d_pos S.hw S.π_mem_fil hS.derivations
    exact this

name: BezoutCounterexample.vecMul_M_dotProduct
statement:
lemma vecMul_M_dotProduct {S : Type*} [CommRing S] (φ : A₀ →+* S) (p q u v : S) :
    ![p, q] ᵥ* (M.map φ) ⬝ᵥ ![u, v] =
      (p * (1 + φ x) + q * φ y) * u + (p * φ y + q * (1 - φ x)) * v
proof:
:= by
  simp [Matrix.vecMul, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_two, M]

name: BezoutCounterexample.key_obstruction
statement:
theorem key_obstruction :
    ¬ ∃ p q u v μ : R, μ * (![p, q] ᵥ* (M.map R.ι) ⬝ᵥ ![u, v]) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨p, q, u, v, μ, hrel⟩
  
  obtain ⟨N, w, hw⟩ := R.exists_of_fin 5 ![p, q, u, v, μ]
  
  have hrelN : w 4 * (![w 0, w 1] ᵥ* (M.map (ι N)) ⬝ᵥ ![w 2, w 3]) = 1 := by
    apply R.of_injective N
    have e : ∀ t, R.of N (w t) = ![p, q, u, v, μ] t := hw
    simp only [vecMul_M_dotProduct, map_mul, map_add, map_sub, map_one, R.of_ι, e] at hrel ⊢
    simpa using hrel
  rw [vecMul_M_dotProduct] at hrelN
  
  apply nonorientable N
  have hc : ∀ a : A N, Continuous fun z : K N => z.1 a :=
    fun a => (RealPt.continuous_eval a).comp continuous_subtype_val
  refine ⟨fun z => (Mreal (z.1 (ι N x)) (z.1 (ι N y))).mulVec ![z.1 (w 2), z.1 (w 3)], ?_,
    fun z => ⟨?_, mem_lineBundle_iff.2 ⟨_, rfl⟩⟩⟩
  · 
    refine continuous_pi fun i => ?_
    fin_cases i <;> simp only [Mreal_mulVec] <;> simp <;> fun_prop
  · 
    intro h0
    have h := congrArg z.1 hrelN
    simp only [map_mul, map_add, map_sub, map_one] at h
    have h1 := congrFun h0 0
    have h2 := congrFun h0 1
    simp only [Mreal_mulVec, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Pi.zero_apply] at h1 h2
    have : z.1 (w 4) * (z.1 (w 0) * ((1 + z.1 (ι N x)) * z.1 (w 2) + z.1 (ι N y) * z.1 (w 3)) +
        z.1 (w 1) * (z.1 (ι N y) * z.1 (w 2) + (1 - z.1 (ι N x)) * z.1 (w 3))) = 1 := by
      linear_combination h
    rw [h1, h2, mul_zero, mul_zero, add_zero, mul_zero] at this
    exact zero_ne_one this

name: BezoutCounterexample.span_entries_M_map
statement: theorem span_entries_M_map : (Ideal.span {R.ι (1 + x), R.ι y, R.ι (1 - x)} : Ideal R) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (Ideal.map R.ι) span_entries_M
  rwa [Ideal.map_span, Ideal.map_top, Set.image_insert_eq, Set.image_pair] at h

name: BezoutCounterexample.not_hasSmithNormalForm
statement: theorem not_hasSmithNormalForm : ¬ HasSmithNormalForm (M.map R.ι)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨G, hMG, hG⟩
  
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hdiv⟩ := (isSmithNormalForm_iff_chain G).1 hG
  have hd12 : d 0 ∣ d 1 := hdiv 0 (by norm_num)
  
  have htop : (Ideal.span {d 0, d 1} : Ideal R) = ⊤ := by
    have hGmem : ∀ i j, G i j ∈ (Ideal.span {d 0, d 1} : Ideal R) := by
      intro i j
      fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
      · rw [hd]; exact Ideal.subset_span (by simp)
      · rw [hd]; simp
      · rw [hd]; simp
      · rw [hd]; exact Ideal.subset_span (by simp)
    have hM := hMG.entry_mem _ hGmem
    rw [eq_top_iff, ← span_entries_M_map, Ideal.span_le]
    rintro r (rfl | rfl | rfl)
    · simpa [M] using hM 0 0
    · simpa [M] using hM 0 1
    · simpa [M] using hM 1 1
  
  have hunit : IsUnit (d 0) := by
    have h : (Ideal.span {d 0, d 1} : Ideal R) = Ideal.span {d 0} := by
      rw [Ideal.span_insert, sup_eq_left.2 (Ideal.span_singleton_le_span_singleton.2 hd12)]
    rwa [h, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top] at htop
  
  obtain ⟨P, Q, hPQ⟩ := hMG
  have h00 : ![(P : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) 0 0, (P : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) 0 1] ᵥ*
      (M.map R.ι) ⬝ᵥ ![(Q : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) 0 0, (Q : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) 1 0] =
      d 0 := by
    have h : ((P : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) * M.map R.ι * Q) 0 0 = d 0 := by
      rw [hPQ, hd]; simp
    rw [← h]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.vecMul, dotProduct]
    simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one]
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ⟩ := hunit.exists_left_inv
  exact key_obstruction ⟨_, _, _, _, μ, by rw [h00, hμ]⟩

name: BezoutCounterexample.PrincipalizationData.h_spec
statement:
theorem h_spec (i : Fin (S.ℓ + 1)) :
    (S.h i : A[T;T⁻¹]) = C (S.g i) * T (S.jdeg i) ∧ 1 ≤ S.jdeg i ∧ S.jdeg i ≤ S.d ∧
      S.g i ∈ S.𝓕 (S.jdeg i)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := genDeg_pos S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.d i
  have h2 := genDeg_le S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.d S.one_le_d i
  have hj : ((S.jdeg i : ℕ) : ℤ) = genDeg S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.d i := by
    simp only [jdeg]; omega
  refine ⟨?_, by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
  · rw [hj]; rfl
  · rw [hj, ← S.fil_F]; exact genCoeff_mem S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.d S.π_mem_fil i

proof:

    (List.get_mem (genPairs S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.d) i)
  have hj : ((S.jdeg i.succ : ℕ) : ℤ) = ((genPairs S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.d).get i).1 := by
    simp only [jdeg, genDeg, Fin.cons_succ]; omega

name: BezoutCounterexample.PrincipalizationData.exists_h_eq

theorem exists_h_eq {j : ℤ} (hj1 : 1 ≤ j) (hjd : j ≤ S.d) {g : A} (hg : g ∈ S.G j) :
    ∃ i : Fin S.ℓ, (S.jdeg i.succ : ℤ) = j ∧ S.g i.succ = g
proof:
:= by

  refine ⟨i, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [jdeg, genDeg, Fin.cons_succ, hi]; omega
  · simp only [PrincipalizationData.g, genCoeff, Fin.cons_succ, hi]

name: BezoutCounterexample.PrincipalizationData.span_h
statement: theorem span_h : Ideal.span (Set.range S.h) = S.𝓡plus
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [Ideal.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨hh, h1, -, hg⟩ := S.h_spec i
    exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨S.jdeg i, S.g i, by exact_mod_cast h1, hg, hh⟩
  · rw [S.𝓡plus_eq_span, Ideal.span_le]
    rintro r ⟨j, hj, g, hg, hr⟩
    obtain ⟨i, hij, hig⟩ := S.exists_h_eq (Finset.mem_Icc.1 hj).1 (Finset.mem_Icc.1 hj).2 hg
    have : r = S.h i.succ := Subtype.ext (by rw [hr, (S.h_spec i.succ).1, hij, hig])
    rw [this]
    exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨i.succ, rfl⟩

name: BezoutCounterexample.PrincipalizationData.torsor_spec
statement:
theorem torsor_spec (hk : 2 ≤ S.k) :
    IsDomain S.U ∧ Algebra.Smooth ℚ S.U ∧ UniqueFactorizationMonoid S.U ∧
      Function.Injective (algebraMap A S.U) ∧ Prime S.sU ∧
      S.I.map (algebraMap A S.U) = Ideal.span {S.sU ^ S.d} * S.I₁
proof:
:= by
  have hk2 : maxinv S.I 1 ≠ 0 := (S.e_ne_zero_iff 1).2 (by omega)
  exact ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance,
    torsor_ufd S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.d_pos S.hw S.π_mem_fil hk2 S.prime_π S.π_mem,
    torsor_injective S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.π_mem_fil S.π_ne_zero,
    torsor_s_prime S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.d_pos S.hw S.π_mem_fil S.π_ne_zero,
    torsor_map_eq S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.d_pos S.π_mem_fil⟩

name: BezoutCounterexample.PrincipalizationData.torsor_invariant
statement:
theorem torsor_invariant (hk : 2 ≤ S.k) :
    S.I₁ ≠ ⊥ ∧
    (∀ (Q : Ideal S.U) [Q.IsMaximal], S.I₁ ≤ Q → S.sU ∈ Q →
      (Q.comap (algebraMap S.𝓡 S.U)).IsMaximal ∧
      inv S.I₁ Q = inv S.Iw (Q.comap (algebraMap S.𝓡 S.U)) ∧
      inv S.Iw (Q.comap (algebraMap S.𝓡 S.U)) ≺ maxinv S.I) ∧
    (∀ (Q : Ideal S.U) [Q.IsMaximal], S.I₁ ≤ Q → S.sU ∉ Q →
      (Q.comap (algebraMap A S.U)).IsMaximal ∧ S.I ≤ Q.comap (algebraMap A S.U) ∧
      ¬ S.𝔭 ≤ Q.comap (algebraMap A S.U) ∧
      inv S.I₁ Q = inv S.I (Q.comap (algebraMap A S.U))) ∧
    (maxinv S.I₁ ≺ maxinv S.I ∨ S.I₁ = ⊤ ∨
      (maxinv S.I₁ = maxinv S.I ∧
        components S.I₁ = (fun 𝔭' => 𝔭'.map (algebraMap A S.U)) '' (components S.I \ {S.𝔭}) ∧
        numComponents S.I₁ < numComponents S.I))
proof:
:= by
  have hI₁ : S.I₁ ≠ ⊥ := torsorI_ne_bot S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.d_pos S.π_mem_fil S.π_ne_zero
  have hIw0 : S.Iw ≠ ⊥ := weakT_ne_bot S.fil S.ne_bot S.d S.I_le_fil
  
  have part1 : ∀ (Q : Ideal S.U) [Q.IsMaximal], S.I₁ ≤ Q → S.sU ∈ Q →
      (Q.comap (algebraMap S.𝓡 S.U)).IsMaximal ∧
      inv S.I₁ Q = inv S.Iw (Q.comap (algebraMap S.𝓡 S.U)) ∧
      inv S.Iw (Q.comap (algebraMap S.𝓡 S.U)) ≺ maxinv S.I := by
    intro Q _ hIQ hsQ
    have hPmax : (Q.comap (algebraMap S.𝓡 S.U)).IsMaximal := comap_isMaximal_of_finiteType Q
    have hIwP : S.Iw ≤ Q.comap (algebraMap S.𝓡 S.U) := Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.1 hIQ
    
    obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := exists_torsorY_not_mem S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.π_mem_fil Q
    have hinvQ := invAt_torsor_of_rees S.h Q hl hIw0 hIwP (invAt_inv hIw0 hIwP)
    refine ⟨hPmax, inv_eq_of_invAt hI₁ hIQ hinvQ, ?_⟩
    refine S.drop _ hIwP hsQ fun hle => hl (hle ?_)
    rw [← S.span_h]
    exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨l, rfl⟩
  
  have part2 : ∀ (Q : Ideal S.U) [Q.IsMaximal], S.I₁ ≤ Q → S.sU ∉ Q →
      (Q.comap (algebraMap A S.U)).IsMaximal ∧ S.I ≤ Q.comap (algebraMap A S.U) ∧
      ¬ S.𝔭 ≤ Q.comap (algebraMap A S.U) ∧
      inv S.I₁ Q = inv S.I (Q.comap (algebraMap A S.U)) := by
    intro Q _ hIQ hsQ
    rcases torsor_invAt S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.d_pos S.hw S.π_mem_fil S.π_ne_zero Q hIQ
      (invAt_inv hI₁ hIQ) with ⟨hs, -⟩ | ⟨-, hI𝔮, h𝔭𝔮, hv⟩
    · exact absurd hs hsQ
    · have h𝔮 : (Q.comap (algebraMap A S.U)).IsMaximal := comap_isMaximal_of_finiteType Q
      exact ⟨h𝔮, hI𝔮, h𝔭𝔮, (inv_eq_of_invAt S.ne_bot hI𝔮 hv).symm⟩
  refine ⟨hI₁, part1, part2, ?_⟩
  
  by_cases htop : S.I₁ = ⊤
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl htop)
  obtain ⟨⟨Q₁, hQ₁, hIQ₁, hinv₁⟩, -⟩ := maxinv_spec hI₁ htop
  have hle : maxinv S.I₁ ⪯ maxinv S.I := by
    rw [← hinv₁]
    exact torsor_inv_ge S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.d_pos S.hw S.π_mem_fil S.π_ne_zero Q₁ hIQ₁
      (invAt_inv hI₁ hIQ₁)
  by_cases heq : maxinv S.I₁ = maxinv S.I
  swap
  · exact Or.inl ⟨hle, heq⟩
  obtain ⟨hfin, hprime, hcomax, hiff, -⟩ := theorem_3_3_3 S.ne_bot S.ne_top
  have : IsJacobsonRing S.U := isJacobsonRing_of_finiteType (A := ℚ)
  
  have hsnot : ∀ 𝔭' ∈ components S.I, 𝔭' ≠ S.𝔭 → ∀ Q : Ideal S.U, Q.IsMaximal →
      𝔭'.map (algebraMap A S.U) ≤ Q → S.sU ∉ Q := by
    intro 𝔭' h𝔭' hne Q hQ hle' hsQ
    have h1 : S.𝔭.map (algebraMap A S.U) ≤ Q := by
      rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq A S.𝓡 S.U, ← Ideal.map_map]
      refine (Ideal.map_mono S.map_𝔭_le).trans ?_
      rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton, Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
      exact hsQ
    have h2 : (S.𝔭 ⊔ 𝔭').map (algebraMap A S.U) ≤ Q := by
      rw [Ideal.map_sup]; exact sup_le h1 hle'
    rw [hcomax S.𝔭 S.mem_components 𝔭' h𝔭' (Ne.symm hne), Ideal.map_top] at h2
    exact hQ.ne_top (top_le_iff.1 h2)
  have hmapI := (S.torsor_spec hk).2.2.2.2.2
  
  have hI₁Q : ∀ 𝔭' ∈ components S.I, 𝔭' ≠ S.𝔭 → ∀ Q : Ideal S.U, Q.IsMaximal →
      𝔭'.map (algebraMap A S.U) ≤ Q → S.I₁ ≤ Q := by
    intro 𝔭' h𝔭' hne Q hQ hle'
    have hsQ := hsnot 𝔭' h𝔭' hne Q hQ hle'
    have h1 : Ideal.span {S.sU ^ S.d} * S.I₁ ≤ Q := by
      rw [← hmapI]
      exact (Ideal.map_mono ((hprime 𝔭' h𝔭').2)).trans hle'
    rcases hQ.isPrime.mul_le.1 h1 with h | h
    · rw [Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff] at h
      exact absurd (hQ.isPrime.mem_of_pow_mem _ h) hsQ
    · exact h
  have hcomp : components S.I₁ =
      (fun 𝔭' => 𝔭'.map (algebraMap A S.U)) '' (components S.I \ {S.𝔭}) := by
    refine components_eq_of hI₁ htop (hfin.sdiff.image _) ?_ ?_ ?_
    · rintro _ ⟨𝔭', ⟨h𝔭', hne⟩, rfl⟩
      have hne' : 𝔭' ≠ S.𝔭 := hne
      have h𝔭'min : 𝔭' ∈ (locusIdeal S.I (maxinv S.I)).minimalPrimes := by
        rw [← maxLocusIdeal_eq_locusIdeal S.ne_bot]; exact h𝔭'
      have hP := torsor_comp_isPrime S.ne_bot S.hmax S.h𝔭 S.d_pos S.hw S.π_mem_fil
        h𝔭'min (Ne.symm hne')
      have hP' : (𝔭'.map (algebraMap A S.U)).IsPrime := hP
      refine ⟨hP', ?_⟩
      show S.I₁ ≤ 𝔭'.map (algebraMap A S.U)
      rw [← IsJacobsonRing.out' _ hP'.isRadical, Ideal.jacobson]
      exact le_sInf fun Q ⟨hle', hQ⟩ => hI₁Q 𝔭' h𝔭' hne' Q hQ hle'
    · rintro _ ⟨𝔭', ⟨h𝔭', hne⟩, rfl⟩ _ ⟨𝔭'', ⟨h𝔭'', hne'⟩, rfl⟩ hPQ
      have h' : 𝔭' ≠ 𝔭'' := fun h => hPQ (by rw [h])
      rw [← Ideal.map_sup, hcomax 𝔭' h𝔭' 𝔭'' h𝔭'' h', Ideal.map_top]
    · intro Q _ hIQ
      rw [heq]
      constructor
      · intro hinvQ
        by_cases hsQ : S.sU ∈ Q
        · exfalso
          obtain ⟨-, h1, h2⟩ := part1 Q hIQ hsQ
          rw [← h1, hinvQ] at h2
          exact h2.2 rfl
        · obtain ⟨h𝔮, hI𝔮, h𝔭𝔮, hinv⟩ := part2 Q hIQ hsQ
          rw [hinv] at hinvQ
          obtain ⟨𝔭', h𝔭', h𝔭'𝔮⟩ := (hiff _ hI𝔮).1 hinvQ
          refine ⟨𝔭'.map (algebraMap A S.U), ⟨𝔭', ⟨h𝔭', fun h => h𝔭𝔮 ?_⟩, rfl⟩,
            Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.2 h𝔭'𝔮⟩
          rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at h
          rwa [← h]
      · rintro ⟨_, ⟨𝔭', ⟨h𝔭', hne⟩, rfl⟩, hle'⟩
        have hsQ := hsnot 𝔭' h𝔭' hne Q inferInstance hle'
        obtain ⟨h𝔮, hI𝔮, -, hinv⟩ := part2 Q hIQ hsQ
        rw [hinv]
        exact (hiff _ hI𝔮).2 ⟨𝔭', h𝔭', Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.1 hle'⟩
  refine Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨heq, hcomp, ?_⟩)
  unfold numComponents
  rw [hcomp]
  exact (Set.ncard_image_le hfin.sdiff).trans_lt
    (Set.ncard_sdiff_singleton_lt_of_mem S.mem_components hfin)

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.prod_pow_add_single
statement:
lemma prod_pow_add_single (x : Fin n → R) (α : Fin n →₀ ℕ) (j : Fin n) :
    ∏ i, x i ^ (α + Finsupp.single j 1 : Fin n →₀ ℕ) i = (∏ i, x i ^ α i) * x j
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Finsupp.add_apply, pow_add, Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  congr 1
  rw [Finset.prod_eq_single j]
  · simp
  · intro i _ hi; simp [Ne.symm hi]
  · simp

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.Chart.IsCentred.pow_eq_span
statement:
lemma IsCentred.pow_eq_span (hc : c.IsCentred) (N : ℕ) :
    maximalIdeal R ^ N = Ideal.span (c.monos N)
proof:
:= by
  induction N with
  | zero =>
    rw [pow_zero, Ideal.one_eq_top, eq_comm, Ideal.eq_top_iff_one]
    exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨0, by simp, by simp⟩
  | succ N ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, ih, hc, Ideal.span_mul_span]
    congr 1
    ext f
    simp only [Set.mem_mul, monos, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_range]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨a, ⟨α, hα, rfl⟩, b, ⟨j, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨α + Finsupp.single j 1, by simp [hα], (prod_pow_add_single _ _ _).symm⟩
    · rintro ⟨α, hα, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j, α j ≠ 0 := by
        by_contra h; push Not at h
        have : α = 0 := Finsupp.ext h
        subst this; simp at hα
      set α' := α - Finsupp.single j 1 with hα'
      have hsum : α' + Finsupp.single j 1 = α := by
        ext l
        simp only [hα', Finsupp.coe_add, Finsupp.coe_tsub, Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply,
          Finsupp.single_apply]
        split_ifs with h
        · subst h; omega
        · omega
      refine ⟨_, ⟨α', ?_, rfl⟩, _, ⟨j, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      · have := congrArg Finsupp.degree hsum
        rw [map_add, hα, Finsupp.degree_single] at this
        omega
      · rw [← prod_pow_add_single, hsum]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.Chart.coeff_eq_zero_of_mem_span_X
statement:
lemma coeff_eq_zero_of_mem_span_X {K : Type*} [CommRing K] (S : Set (Fin n))
    {Φ : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K} (hΦ : Φ ∈ Ideal.span (X '' S)) (δ : Fin n →₀ ℕ)
    (hδ : ∀ i ∈ S, δ i = 0) : coeff δ Φ = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  revert δ
  induction hΦ using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem Ψ hΨ =>
    intro δ hδ
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := hΨ
    rw [coeff_X]; split_ifs with h
    · subst h; simpa using hδ i hi
    · rfl
  | zero => intros; simp
  | add _ _ _ _ h1 h2 => intro δ hδ; rw [map_add, h1 δ hδ, h2 δ hδ, add_zero]
  | smul a Ψ _ h =>
    intro δ hδ
    rw [smul_eq_mul, coeff_mul, Finset.sum_eq_zero]
    intro p hp
    rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
    have : ∀ i ∈ S, p.2 i = 0 := fun i hi => by
      have := congrArg (fun q => q i) hp
      simp only [Finsupp.coe_add, Pi.add_apply, hδ i hi] at this
      omega
    rw [h p.2 this, mul_zero]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.Finsupp.eq_of_le_of_degree_eq
statement:
lemma _root_.BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.Finsupp.eq_of_le_of_degree_eq
    {α α' : Fin n →₀ ℕ} (hle : α' ≤ α) (hdeg : α'.degree = α.degree) : α' = α
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : α' + (α - α') = α := add_tsub_cancel_of_le hle
  have h2 := congrArg Finsupp.degree h1
  rw [map_add, hdeg] at h2
  have h3 : (α - α').degree = 0 := by omega
  rw [Finsupp.degree_eq_zero_iff] at h3
  rw [h3, add_zero] at h1
  exact h1

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.Chart.constantCoeff_tau
statement: lemma constantCoeff_tau (f : R) : constantCoeff (c.tau f) = residue R f
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, coeff_tau, Dv_zero]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.Chart.IsCentred.map_tau_span
statement:
lemma IsCentred.map_tau_span (hc : c.IsCentred) (S : Set (Fin n)) :
    Ideal.map c.tau (Ideal.span (c.x '' S)) = Ideal.span (X '' S)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.map_span, ← Set.image_comp]
  congr 1
  exact Set.image_congr fun i _ => hc.tau_x i

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.Chart.IsCentred.coeff_tau_eq_zero_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  refine coeff_eq_zero_of_mem_span_X S ?_ δ hδ
  rw [← hc.map_tau_span]
  exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hg

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.Chart.IsCentred.mem_sup_pow_succ
statement:
lemma IsCentred.mem_sup_pow_succ (hc : c.IsCentred) (S : Set (Fin n)) {g : R} (N : ℕ)
    (hg : g ∈ Ideal.span (c.x '' S) ⊔ maximalIdeal R ^ N)
    (h0 : ∀ δ : Fin n →₀ ℕ, (∀ i ∈ S, δ i = 0) → coeff δ (c.tau g) = 0) :
    g ∈ Ideal.span (c.x '' S) ⊔ maximalIdeal R ^ (N + 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set J := Ideal.span (c.x '' S)
  obtain ⟨j, hj, h, hh, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hg
  rw [hc.pow_eq_span] at hh
  obtain ⟨T, hT, hhT⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_finite_of_mem_span hh
  obtain ⟨r, -, hr⟩ := (Submodule.mem_span_finset).1 hhT
  choose α hαdeg hα using fun t : T => hT t.2
  
  have key : ∀ t : T, (∀ i ∈ S, α t i = 0) → r t ∈ maximalIdeal R := by
    intro t ht
    have h1 := h0 (α t) ht
    rw [← hr, map_add, map_add, hc.coeff_tau_eq_zero_of_mem hj _ ht, zero_add, map_sum,
      map_sum] at h1
    rw [← Finset.sum_coe_sort T] at h1
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single t] at h1
    · have ht : c.tau (t : R) = monomial (α t) 1 := by rw [hα t]; exact hc.tau_monomial _
      rw [smul_eq_mul, map_mul, ht, coeff_mul_monomial, ite_eq_left le_rfl,
        tsub_self, mul_one, coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, constantCoeff_tau] at h1
      exact (residue_eq_zero_iff _).1 h1
    · intro t' _ hne
      have ht' : c.tau (t' : R) = monomial (α t') 1 := by rw [hα t']; exact hc.tau_monomial _
      rw [smul_eq_mul, map_mul, ht', coeff_mul_monomial]
      split_ifs with hle
      · exfalso
        have heq : α t' = α t :=
          Finsupp.eq_of_le_of_degree_eq hle (by rw [hαdeg, hαdeg])
        apply hne
        exact Subtype.ext (by rw [hα t', hα t, heq])
      · rfl
    · simp
  have hmem : ∀ t : T, r t • (t : R) ∈ J ⊔ maximalIdeal R ^ (N + 1) := by
    intro t
    by_cases hS : ∀ i ∈ S, α t i = 0
    · refine Ideal.mem_sup_right ?_
      rw [smul_eq_mul, pow_succ']
      refine Ideal.mul_mem_mul (key t hS) ?_
      rw [hc.pow_eq_span]
      exact Ideal.subset_span (hT t.2)
    · push Not at hS
      obtain ⟨i, hiS, hi⟩ := hS
      refine Ideal.mem_sup_left (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ ?_)
      rw [hα t, ← Finset.mul_prod_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i)]
      exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.pow_mem_of_mem _
        (Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_image_of_mem c.x hiS)) _ (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hi))
  rw [← hr, ← Finset.sum_coe_sort T]
  exact add_mem (Ideal.mem_sup_left hj) (Ideal.sum_mem _ fun t _ => hmem t)

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.Chart.IsCentred.mem_span_iff
statement:
theorem IsCentred.mem_span_iff [IsNoetherianRing R] (hc : c.IsCentred) (S : Set (Fin n))
    (g : R) : g ∈ Ideal.span (c.x '' S) ↔
      ∀ δ : Fin n →₀ ℕ, (∀ i ∈ S, δ i = 0) → coeff δ (c.tau g) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hg δ hδ => hc.coeff_tau_eq_zero_of_mem hg δ hδ, fun h0 => ?_⟩
  set J := Ideal.span (c.x '' S)
  have hN : ∀ N, g ∈ J ⊔ maximalIdeal R ^ N := by
    intro N
    induction N with
    | zero => simp
    | succ N ih => exact hc.mem_sup_pow_succ S N ih h0
  by_cases hJ : J = ⊤
  · rw [hJ]; trivial
  have : Nontrivial (R ⧸ J) := Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.2 hJ
  have : IsLocalRing (R ⧸ J) := .of_surjective' _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hmax : maximalIdeal (R ⧸ J) ≠ ⊤ := (maximalIdeal.isMaximal _).ne_top
  have hbot := Ideal.iInf_pow_eq_bot_of_isLocalRing (maximalIdeal (R ⧸ J)) hmax
  rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, ← Ideal.mem_bot, ← hbot, Ideal.mem_iInf]
  intro N
  have hle : Ideal.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk J) (maximalIdeal R) ≤ maximalIdeal (R ⧸ J) :=
    Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.2 fun r hr => by
      rw [Ideal.mem_comap, mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff]
      rintro ⟨u, hu⟩
      obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (↑u⁻¹ : R ⧸ J)
      have h1 : Ideal.Quotient.mk J (r * s) = 1 := by rw [map_mul, hs, ← hu, Units.mul_inv]
      have h2 : r * s - 1 ∈ J := by
        rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, map_sub, h1, map_one, sub_self]
      have h3 : r * s - 1 ∈ maximalIdeal R := le_maximalIdeal hJ h2
      have h4 : r * s ∈ maximalIdeal R := Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ hr
      exact (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).ne_top ((Ideal.eq_top_iff_one _).2
        (by simpa using sub_mem h4 h3))
  have := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (Ideal.Quotient.mk J) (hN N)
  rw [Ideal.map_sup, Ideal.map_quotient_self, bot_sup_eq, Ideal.map_pow] at this
  exact Ideal.pow_right_mono hle N this

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.Chart.F_zero
statement: lemma F_zero (w : Fin n → ℕ) : c.F w 0 = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.eq_top_iff_one]
  exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨0, fun _ _ => rfl, zero_le, by simp⟩

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.weight_le_of_le
statement:
lemma weight_le_of_le (w : Fin n → ℕ) {β β' : Fin n →₀ ℕ} (h : β' ≤ β) :
    Finsupp.weight w β' ≤ Finsupp.weight w β
proof:
:= by
  have : β' + (β - β') = β := add_tsub_cancel_of_le h
  rw [← this, map_add]; exact Nat.le_add_right _ _

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.eq_zero_of_weight_eq_zero
statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_weight_eq_zero (w : Fin n → ℕ) {γ : Fin n →₀ ℕ}
    (hs : ∀ i, w i = 0 → γ i = 0) (hw : Finsupp.weight w γ = 0) : γ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finsupp.weight_eq_sum, Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff] at hw
  ext i
  by_cases hi : w i = 0
  · exact hs i hi
  · have := hw i (Finset.mem_univ _)
    rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_eq_zero] at this
    exact this.resolve_right hi

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.Chart.IsCentred.map_tau_F
statement:
lemma IsCentred.map_tau_F (hc : c.IsCentred) (w : Fin n → ℕ) (j : ℕ) :
    Ideal.map c.tau (c.F w j) =
      Ideal.span ((fun α => monomial α 1) ''
        {α : Fin n →₀ ℕ | (∀ i, w i = 0 → α i = 0) ∧ j ≤ Finsupp.weight w α})
proof:
:= by
  rw [F, Ideal.map_span]
  congr 1
  ext Φ; constructor
  · rintro ⟨f, ⟨α, h0, hj, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨α, ⟨h0, hj⟩, (hc.tau_monomial α).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨α, ⟨h0, hj⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_, ⟨α, h0, hj, rfl⟩, hc.tau_monomial α⟩

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.Chart.coeff_eq_zero_of_mem_span_monomial
statement:
lemma coeff_eq_zero_of_mem_span_monomial {K : Type*} [CommRing K] (w : Fin n → ℕ) (j : ℕ)
    {Φ : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K}
    (hΦ : Φ ∈ Ideal.span ((fun α => monomial α (1 : K)) ''
        {α : Fin n →₀ ℕ | (∀ i, w i = 0 → α i = 0) ∧ j ≤ Finsupp.weight w α}))
    (β : Fin n →₀ ℕ) (hβ : Finsupp.weight w β < j) : coeff β Φ = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  revert β
  induction hΦ using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem Ψ hΨ =>
    intro β hβ
    obtain ⟨α, ⟨_, hj⟩, rfl⟩ := hΨ
    rw [coeff_monomial, ite_eq_right]
    rintro rfl; omega
  | zero => intros; simp
  | add _ _ _ _ h1 h2 => intro β hβ; rw [map_add, h1 β hβ, h2 β hβ, add_zero]
  | smul a Ψ _ h =>
    intro β hβ
    rw [smul_eq_mul, coeff_mul, Finset.sum_eq_zero]
    intro p hp
    rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
    have hle : p.2 ≤ β := hp ▸ le_add_self
    rw [h p.2 (lt_of_le_of_lt (weight_le_of_le w hle) hβ), mul_zero]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.Chart.IsCentred.mem_F_iff
statement:
theorem IsCentred.mem_F_iff [IsNoetherianRing R] (hc : c.IsCentred) (w : Fin n → ℕ) :
    ∀ (j : ℕ) (g : R), g ∈ c.F w j ↔
      ∀ β : Fin n →₀ ℕ, Finsupp.weight w β < j → coeff β (c.tau g) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro j
  induction j with
  | zero => intro g; simp [F_zero]
  | succ j ih =>
    intro g
    constructor
    · intro hg β hβ
      refine coeff_eq_zero_of_mem_span_monomial w (j + 1) ?_ β hβ
      rw [← hc.map_tau_F]
      exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hg
    · intro h0
      have hg : g ∈ c.F w j := (ih g).2 fun β hβ => h0 β (by omega)
      obtain ⟨T, hT, hgT⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_finite_of_mem_span hg
      obtain ⟨r, -, hr⟩ := (Submodule.mem_span_finset).1 hgT
      choose α hα0 hαj hα using fun t : T => hT t.2
      have hmem : ∀ t : T, r t • (t : R) ∈ c.F w (j + 1) := by
        intro t
        by_cases hlt : j + 1 ≤ Finsupp.weight w (α t)
        · exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.subset_span ⟨α t, hα0 t, hlt, hα t⟩)
        · have heq : Finsupp.weight w (α t) = j := by have := hαj t; omega
          
          have hrt : r t ∈ Ideal.span (c.x '' {i | w i ≠ 0}) := by
            rw [hc.mem_span_iff]
            intro δ hδ
            have hδw : Finsupp.weight w δ = 0 := by
              rw [Finsupp.weight_eq_sum, Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff]
              intro i _
              by_cases hi : w i = 0
              · rw [hi, smul_zero]
              · rw [hδ i hi, zero_smul]
            have h1 := h0 (α t + δ) (by rw [map_add, heq, hδw]; omega)
            rw [← hr, map_sum, map_sum, ← Finset.sum_coe_sort T, Finset.sum_eq_single t] at h1
            · have ht : c.tau (t : R) = monomial (α t) 1 := by
                rw [hα t]; exact hc.tau_monomial _
              rwa [smul_eq_mul, map_mul, ht, coeff_mul_monomial, ite_eq_left le_self_add,
                add_tsub_cancel_left, mul_one] at h1
            · intro t' _ hne
              have ht' : c.tau (t' : R) = monomial (α t') 1 := by
                rw [hα t']; exact hc.tau_monomial _
              rw [smul_eq_mul, map_mul, ht', coeff_mul_monomial]
              split_ifs with hle
              · exfalso
                have hle' : α t' ≤ α t := by
                  intro i
                  have := hle i
                  simp only [Finsupp.coe_add, Pi.add_apply] at this
                  by_cases hi : w i = 0
                  · rw [hα0 t' i hi]; exact Nat.zero_le _
                  · rw [hδ i hi, add_zero] at this; exact this
                have hsub := add_tsub_cancel_of_le hle'
                have hw := congrArg (Finsupp.weight w) hsub
                rw [map_add, heq] at hw
                have hw0 : Finsupp.weight w (α t - α t') = 0 := by have := hαj t'; omega
                have hz := eq_zero_of_weight_eq_zero w (fun i hi => by
                  simp only [Finsupp.coe_tsub, Pi.sub_apply, hα0 t i hi, Nat.zero_sub]) hw0
                rw [hz, add_zero] at hsub
                exact hne (Subtype.ext (by rw [hα t', hα t, hsub]))
              · rfl
            · simp
          
          rw [smul_eq_mul]
          have aux : ∀ y ∈ Ideal.span (c.x '' {i | w i ≠ 0}), y * (t : R) ∈ c.F w (j + 1) := by
            intro y hy
            induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
            | mem y hy =>
              obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := hy
              refine Ideal.subset_span ⟨α t + Finsupp.single i 1, fun l hl => ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
              · rw [Finsupp.add_apply, hα0 t l hl, Finsupp.single_apply,
                  ite_eq_right (by rintro rfl; exact hi hl), add_zero]
              · rw [map_add, heq, Finsupp.weight_single, one_smul]
                have : w i ≠ 0 := hi
                omega
              · rw [prod_pow_add_single, hα t, mul_comm]
            | zero => rw [zero_mul]; exact zero_mem _
            | add _ _ _ _ h1 h2 => rw [add_mul]; exact add_mem h1 h2
            | smul a y _ h => rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc]; exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ h
          exact aux _ hrt
      rw [← hr, ← Finset.sum_coe_sort T]
      exact Ideal.sum_mem _ fun t _ => hmem t

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.jPt_mk
statement:
lemma jPt_mk (z : R →+* ℝ) (sv : Fin r → ℝ) (h) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin r) R) :
    jPt y z sv h (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ p) = eval₂ z sv p
proof: := rfl

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.jPt_algebraMap
statement:
lemma jPt_algebraMap (z : R →+* ℝ) (sv : Fin r → ℝ) (h) (a : R) :
    jPt y z sv h (algebraMap R (J y) a) = z a
proof:
:= by
  rw [Jou.algebraMap_eq_mk_comp_C, RingHom.comp_apply, jPt_mk, eval₂_C]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.jPt_σ
statement: lemma jPt_σ (z : R →+* ℝ) (sv : Fin r → ℝ) (h) (i : Fin r) : jPt y z sv h (σ y i) = sv i
proof:
:= by
  show jPt y z sv h (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (X i)) = _
  rw [jPt_mk, eval₂_X]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.realPt_J_ext
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective f
  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C a => have := h1 a; rwa [Jou.algebraMap_eq_mk_comp_C] at this
  | add p q hp hq => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, hp, hq]
  | mul_X p i hp =>
    rw [map_mul, map_mul, map_mul, hp]
    congr 1
    exact h2 i

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.continuous_jPt
statement:
lemma continuous_jPt {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (z : X → (R →+* ℝ))
    (hz : ∀ a, Continuous fun t => z t a) (sv : X → Fin r → ℝ) (hsv : ∀ i, Continuous fun t => sv t i)
    (h : ∀ t, ∑ i, sv t i * z t (y i) = 1) :
    Continuous fun t => jPt y (z t) (sv t) (h t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [RealPt.continuous_iff]
  intro f
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective f
  simp only [jPt_mk]
  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C a => simp only [eval₂_C]; exact hz a
  | add p q hp hq => simp only [eval₂_add]; exact hp.add hq
  | mul_X p i hp => simp only [eval₂_mul, eval₂_X]; exact hp.mul (hsv i)

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.reesPt_apply
statement:
lemma reesPt_apply (z : B →+* ℝ) (t : ℝˣ) (p : ReesAlg Φ) :
    reesPt Φ z t p = LaurentPolynomial.eval₂ z t (p : B[T;T⁻¹])
proof: := rfl

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.reesPt_algebraMap
statement:
lemma reesPt_algebraMap (z : B →+* ℝ) (t : ℝˣ) (b : B) :
    reesPt Φ z t (algebraMap B (ReesAlg Φ) b) = z b
proof:
:= by
  rw [reesPt_apply]
  show LaurentPolynomial.eval₂ z t (algebraMap B B[T;T⁻¹] b) = z b
  rw [← LaurentPolynomial.C_eq_algebraMap, eval₂_C]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.reesPt_C_mul_T
statement:
lemma reesPt_C_mul_T (z : B →+* ℝ) (t : ℝˣ) {j : ℤ} {g : B} (hg : g ∈ Φ.F j) :
    reesPt Φ z t ⟨LaurentPolynomial.C g * T j, C_mul_T_mem_ReesAlg hg⟩ = z g * ((t ^ j : ℝˣ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [reesPt_apply]
  exact eval₂_C_mul_T _ _ g j

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.reesPt_s
statement: lemma reesPt_s (z : B →+* ℝ) (t : ℝˣ) : reesPt Φ z t (reesS Φ hneg) = ((t⁻¹ : ℝˣ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [reesPt_apply, reesS_coe, eval₂_T]
  simp

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.reesPt_eq
statement:
theorem reesPt_eq (w : RealPt (ReesAlg Φ)) (hw : w (reesS Φ hneg) ≠ 0) :
    w = reesPt Φ ((RealPt.toHom w).comp (algebraMap B (ReesAlg Φ)))
      (Units.mk0 (w (reesS Φ hneg)) hw)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have := isLocalization_away_s Φ hneg
  have hu : IsUnit ((RealPt.toHom w) (reesS Φ hneg)) := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.2 hw
  set L : B[T;T⁻¹] →+* ℝ := IsLocalization.Away.lift (reesS Φ hneg) hu
  have hL : ∀ p : ReesAlg Φ, L (p : B[T;T⁻¹]) = w p := fun p =>
    IsLocalization.lift_eq (M := Submonoid.powers (reesS Φ hneg)) _ p
  have hLeq : L = LaurentPolynomial.eval₂ ((RealPt.toHom w).comp (algebraMap B (ReesAlg Φ)))
      (Units.mk0 (w (reesS Φ hneg)) hw)⁻¹ := by
    refine IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers (Polynomial.X : Polynomial B)) ?_
    refine Polynomial.ringHom_ext (fun b => ?_) ?_
    · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, LaurentPolynomial.algebraMap_eq_toLaurent,
        Polynomial.toLaurent_C, eval₂_C]
      rw [LaurentPolynomial.C_eq_algebraMap]
      exact hL (algebraMap B (ReesAlg Φ) b)
    · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, LaurentPolynomial.algebraMap_eq_toLaurent,
        Polynomial.toLaurent_X, eval₂_T]
      have h1 : L (T 1) * L (T (-1)) = 1 := by rw [← map_mul, ← T_add]; simp
      have h2 : L (T (-1)) = w (reesS Φ hneg) := hL (reesS Φ hneg)
      rw [h2] at h1
      simp only [zpow_one, Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val, Units.val_mk0]
      exact eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left h1
  ext p
  rw [reesPt_apply, ← hLeq, hL]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.gdeg_pos
statement: lemma gdeg_pos (l) : 0 < gdeg hI hmax h𝔭 (d := d) l
proof:
:= by
  have := genDeg_pos hI hmax h𝔭 d l; simp only [gdeg]; omega

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.gdeg_cast
statement: lemma gdeg_cast (l) : ((gdeg hI hmax h𝔭 (d := d) l : ℕ) : ℤ) = genDeg hI hmax h𝔭 d l
proof:
:= by
  have := genDeg_pos hI hmax h𝔭 d l; simp only [gdeg]; omega

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.gdeg_mul_sphE
statement: lemma gdeg_mul_sphE (l) : gdeg hI hmax h𝔭 (d := d) l * sphE hI hmax h𝔭 l = 2 * d.factorial
proof:
:= by
  have hle : gdeg hI hmax h𝔭 (d := d) l ≤ d := by
    have := genDeg_le hI hmax h𝔭 d (by omega) l; simp only [gdeg]; omega
  have hdvd : gdeg hI hmax h𝔭 (d := d) l ∣ d.factorial :=
    Nat.dvd_factorial (gdeg_pos hI hmax h𝔭 l) hle
  simp only [sphE]
  rw [mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_div_cancel' hdvd]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.sphE_pos
statement: lemma sphE_pos (l) : 0 < sphE hI hmax h𝔭 (d := d) l
proof:
:= by
  have h := gdeg_mul_sphE hI hmax h𝔭 hd l
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (sphE hI hmax h𝔭 (d := d) l) with h0 | h0
  · rw [h0, mul_zero] at h; have := Nat.factorial_pos d; omega
  · exact h0

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.sphE_even
statement: lemma sphE_even (l) : Even (sphE hI hmax h𝔭 (d := d) l)
proof: := even_two_mul _

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.torsorY_mul_s_pow
statement:
lemma torsorY_mul_s_pow (l : Fin (nGen hI hmax h𝔭 d + 1)) :
    torsorY hI hmax h𝔭 d hπ l *
      reesS (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d) (fun _j hj => compFil_F_nonpos hI hmax h𝔭 d hj) ^
        gdeg hI hmax h𝔭 l =
      algebraMap A (ReesAlg (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d)) (genCoeff hI hmax h𝔭 d π l)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  show (LaurentPolynomial.C (genCoeff hI hmax h𝔭 d π l) * T (genDeg hI hmax h𝔭 d l)) *
    ((reesS (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d) (fun j hj => compFil_F_nonpos hI hmax h𝔭 d hj) ^
      gdeg hI hmax h𝔭 l : ReesAlg (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d)) : A[T;T⁻¹]) = algebraMap A A[T;T⁻¹] _
  rw [reesS_pow_coe, gdeg_cast hI hmax h𝔭, mul_assoc, ← T_add, add_neg_cancel, T_zero,
    mul_one, LaurentPolynomial.C_eq_algebraMap]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.s_pow_eq
statement:
lemma s_pow_eq (w : RealPt (Torsor hI hmax h𝔭 d hπ))
    (hsph : ∑ l, w (yU hI hmax h𝔭 hπ l) ^ sphE hI hmax h𝔭 l = 1) :
    w (torsorS hI hmax h𝔭 hπ) ^ (2 * d.factorial) =
      ∑ l, w (algebraMap A _ (genCoeff hI hmax h𝔭 d π l)) ^ sphE hI hmax h𝔭 l
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ∀ l, w (algebraMap A (Torsor hI hmax h𝔭 d hπ) (genCoeff hI hmax h𝔭 d π l)) =
      w (yU hI hmax h𝔭 hπ l) * w (torsorS hI hmax h𝔭 hπ) ^ gdeg hI hmax h𝔭 l := by
    intro l
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A (ReesAlg (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d)),
      ← torsorY_mul_s_pow hI hmax h𝔭 hπ l, map_mul, map_pow, map_mul, map_pow]
  rw [← mul_one (w (torsorS hI hmax h𝔭 hπ) ^ (2 * d.factorial)), ← hsph, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => ?_
  rw [h1, mul_pow, ← pow_mul, gdeg_mul_sphE hI hmax h𝔭 hd, mul_comm]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.torsor_adjoin
statement: theorem torsor_adjoin : Algebra.adjoin A (torsorGens hI hmax h𝔭 hπ) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  set S := Algebra.adjoin A (torsorGens hI hmax h𝔭 hπ)
  
  have hR : ∀ r : ReesAlg (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d),
      algebraMap (ReesAlg (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d)) (Torsor hI hmax h𝔭 d hπ) r ∈ S := by
    intro r
    have hr : (r : A[T;T⁻¹]) ∈ Algebra.adjoin A (reesGenSet hI hmax h𝔭 d) := by
      rw [← reesAlg_eq_adjoin hI hmax h𝔭 d hd hw]; exact r.2
    suffices H : ∀ p (hp : p ∈ Algebra.adjoin A (reesGenSet hI hmax h𝔭 d)),
        algebraMap (ReesAlg (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d)) (Torsor hI hmax h𝔭 d hπ)
          ⟨p, (reesAlg_eq_adjoin hI hmax h𝔭 d hd hw).symm ▸ hp⟩ ∈ S from H _ hr
    intro p hp
    induction hp using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      rcases hx with hx | hx
      · rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
        subst hx
        exact Algebra.subset_adjoin (Or.inl (Or.inl rfl))
      · simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_image, Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_Icc] at hx
        obtain ⟨j, ⟨hj1, hjd⟩, g, hg, rfl⟩ := hx
        obtain ⟨l, hl1, hl2⟩ := exists_index hI hmax h𝔭 (π := π) hj1 hjd hg
        have : (⟨LaurentPolynomial.C g * T j, (reesAlg_eq_adjoin hI hmax h𝔭 d hd hw).symm ▸
            Algebra.subset_adjoin (Or.inr (Set.mem_biUnion (Finset.mem_coe.2 (Finset.mem_Icc.2
              ⟨hj1, hjd⟩)) ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩))⟩ : ReesAlg (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d)) =
            torsorY hI hmax h𝔭 d hπ l := by
          apply Subtype.ext
          simp only [torsorY, hl1, hl2]
        rw [this]
        exact Algebra.subset_adjoin (Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨l, rfl⟩))
    | algebraMap a =>
      have : (⟨algebraMap A A[T;T⁻¹] a, _⟩ : ReesAlg (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d)) =
          algebraMap A (ReesAlg (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d)) a := rfl
      rw [this, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply]
      exact Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ a
    | add x y hx hy ihx ihy =>
      have : (⟨x + y, _⟩ : ReesAlg (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d)) =
          ⟨x, (reesAlg_eq_adjoin hI hmax h𝔭 d hd hw).symm ▸ hx⟩ +
            ⟨y, (reesAlg_eq_adjoin hI hmax h𝔭 d hd hw).symm ▸ hy⟩ := rfl
      rw [this, map_add]; exact add_mem ihx ihy
    | mul x y hx hy ihx ihy =>
      have : (⟨x * y, _⟩ : ReesAlg (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d)) =
          ⟨x, (reesAlg_eq_adjoin hI hmax h𝔭 d hd hw).symm ▸ hx⟩ *
            ⟨y, (reesAlg_eq_adjoin hI hmax h𝔭 d hd hw).symm ▸ hy⟩ := rfl
      rw [this, map_mul]; exact mul_mem ihx ihy
  
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  rintro f -
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective f
  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C a =>
    have := hR a
    rwa [Jou.algebraMap_eq_mk_comp_C] at this
  | add p q hp hq => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hp hq
  | mul_X p i hp =>
    rw [map_mul]
    exact mul_mem hp (Algebra.subset_adjoin (Or.inr ⟨i, rfl⟩))

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.abs_le_one_add_pow
statement: lemma abs_le_one_add_pow (x : ℝ) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) : |x| ≤ 1 + x ^ (2 * n)
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : x ^ (2 * n) = |x| ^ (2 * n) := by rw [pow_mul, pow_mul, sq_abs]
  rw [h2]
  rcases le_or_gt |x| 1 with h | h
  · have : 0 ≤ |x| ^ (2 * n) := by positivity
    linarith
  · have : |x| ≤ |x| ^ (2 * n) := le_self_pow₀ h.le (by omega)
    linarith

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.abs_le_one_of_pow_le
statement: lemma abs_le_one_of_pow_le {x : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) (he : Even n) (h : x ^ n ≤ 1) : |x| ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← he.pow_abs] at h
  exact (pow_le_one_iff_of_nonneg (abs_nonneg x) hn).1 h

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.torsorK_y_le
statement:
lemma torsorK_y_le {K : Set (RealPt A)} {w : RealPt (Torsor hI hmax h𝔭 d hπ)}
    (hwK : w ∈ torsorK hI hmax h𝔭 hπ K) (l) : |w (yU hI hmax h𝔭 hπ l)| ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨-, -, hsph, -⟩ := hwK
  refine abs_le_one_of_pow_le (sphE_pos hI hmax h𝔭 hd l).ne' (sphE_even hI hmax h𝔭 l) ?_
  rw [← hsph]
  exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun l' => w (yU hI hmax h𝔭 hπ l') ^ sphE hI hmax h𝔭 l')
    (fun l' _ => (sphE_even hI hmax h𝔭 l').pow_nonneg (w (yU hI hmax h𝔭 hπ l')))
    (Finset.mem_univ l)

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.torsorK_isCompact
statement:
theorem torsorK_isCompact {K : Set (RealPt A)} (hK : IsCompact K) :
    IsCompact (torsorK hI hmax h𝔭 hπ K)
proof:
:= by
  have hclosed : IsClosed (torsorK hI hmax h𝔭 hπ K) := by
    have h1 : IsClosed {w : RealPt (Torsor hI hmax h𝔭 d hπ) |
        RealPt.comap (algebraMap A (Torsor hI hmax h𝔭 d hπ)) w ∈ K} :=
      hK.isClosed.preimage (RealPt.continuous_comap _)
    have h2 : IsClosed {w : RealPt (Torsor hI hmax h𝔭 d hπ) | 0 ≤ w (torsorS hI hmax h𝔭 hπ)} :=
      isClosed_le continuous_const (RealPt.continuous_eval _)
    have h3 : IsClosed {w : RealPt (Torsor hI hmax h𝔭 d hπ) |
        ∑ l, w (yU hI hmax h𝔭 hπ l) ^ sphE hI hmax h𝔭 l = 1} :=
      isClosed_eq (continuous_finsetSum _ fun l _ => (RealPt.continuous_eval _).pow _)
        continuous_const
    have h4 : IsClosed {w : RealPt (Torsor hI hmax h𝔭 d hπ) | ∀ l,
        w (σ (torsorY hI hmax h𝔭 d hπ) l) = w (yU hI hmax h𝔭 hπ l) ^ (sphE hI hmax h𝔭 l - 1)} := by
      simp only [Set.ofPred_forall]
      exact isClosed_iInter fun l =>
        isClosed_eq (RealPt.continuous_eval _) ((RealPt.continuous_eval _).pow _)
    exact h1.inter (h2.inter (h3.inter h4))
  refine RealPt.isCompact_of_forall_bounded hclosed fun x => ?_
  refine RealPt.forall_bounded_of_gen hK (fun w hw => hw.1) (torsor_adjoin hI hmax h𝔭 hd hw hπ)
    ?_ x
  rintro _ ((h | ⟨l, rfl⟩) | ⟨l, rfl⟩)
  · rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at h
    subst h
    
    have hC : ∀ l, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ K, |z (genCoeff hI hmax h𝔭 d π l)| ≤ C := fun l => by
      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := (hK.image (RealPt.continuous_eval (genCoeff hI hmax h𝔭 d π l))).isBounded.exists_norm_le
      exact ⟨C, fun z hz => by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hC _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩⟩
    choose C hC using hC
    refine ⟨1 + ∑ l, C l ^ sphE hI hmax h𝔭 l, fun w hwK => ?_⟩
    have hs := s_pow_eq hI hmax h𝔭 hd hπ w hwK.2.2.1
    refine (abs_le_one_add_pow _ (Nat.factorial_pos d)).trans ?_
    rw [hs]
    have hsum : ∑ l, w (algebraMap A (Torsor hI hmax h𝔭 d hπ) (genCoeff hI hmax h𝔭 d π l)) ^
        sphE hI hmax h𝔭 l ≤ ∑ l, C l ^ sphE hI hmax h𝔭 l := Finset.sum_le_sum fun l _ => ?_
    · linarith
    have hz := hC l _ hwK.1
    rw [RealPt.comap_apply] at hz
    rw [← (sphE_even hI hmax h𝔭 l).pow_abs]
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) hz _
  · exact ⟨1, fun w hwK => torsorK_y_le hI hmax h𝔭 hd hπ hwK l⟩
  · refine ⟨1, fun w hwK => ?_⟩
    rw [hwK.2.2.2 l, abs_pow]
    exact pow_le_one₀ (abs_nonneg _) (torsorK_y_le hI hmax h𝔭 hd hπ hwK l)

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.gNorm_nonneg
statement: lemma gNorm_nonneg (z : RealPt A) : 0 ≤ gNorm hI hmax h𝔭 d π z
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_nonneg fun l _ => (sphE_even hI hmax h𝔭 l).pow_nonneg _

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.gRoot_pos
statement: lemma gRoot_pos {z : RealPt A} (hz : 0 < gNorm hI hmax h𝔭 d π z) : 0 < gRoot hI hmax h𝔭 d π z
proof:
:=
  Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hz _

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.gRoot_pow
statement:
lemma gRoot_pow (z : RealPt A) :
    gRoot hI hmax h𝔭 d π z ^ (2 * d.factorial) = gNorm hI hmax h𝔭 d π z
proof:
:=
  Real.rpow_inv_natCast_pow (gNorm_nonneg hI hmax h𝔭 z) (by positivity)

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.ptA_R_y
statement:
lemma ptA_R_y (z : RealPt A) (hz : 0 < gNorm hI hmax h𝔭 d π z) (l) :
    ptA_R hI hmax h𝔭 z hz (torsorY hI hmax h𝔭 d hπ l) =
      z (genCoeff hI hmax h𝔭 d π l) * (gRoot hI hmax h𝔭 d π z ^ gdeg hI hmax h𝔭 l)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [ptA_R, torsorY, reesPt_C_mul_T _ _ _ (genCoeff_mem hI hmax h𝔭 d hπ l),
    ← gdeg_cast hI hmax h𝔭 l, zpow_natCast,
    Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val, Units.val_mk0, inv_pow]
  rfl

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.ptA_R_sph
statement:
lemma ptA_R_sph (z : RealPt A) (hz : 0 < gNorm hI hmax h𝔭 d π z) :
    ∑ l, ptA_R hI hmax h𝔭 z hz (torsorY hI hmax h𝔭 d hπ l) ^ sphE hI hmax h𝔭 l = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hcpow := gRoot_pow hI hmax h𝔭 (d := d) (π := π) z
  simp_rw [ptA_R_y hI hmax h𝔭 hπ z hz, mul_pow, inv_pow, ← pow_mul,
    gdeg_mul_sphE hI hmax h𝔭 hd, ← Finset.sum_mul, hcpow]
  exact mul_inv_cancel₀ hz.ne'

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.ptA_rel
statement:
lemma ptA_rel (z : RealPt A) (hz : 0 < gNorm hI hmax h𝔭 d π z) :
    ∑ l, ptA_R hI hmax h𝔭 z hz (torsorY hI hmax h𝔭 d hπ l) ^ (sphE hI hmax h𝔭 l - 1) *
      ptA_R hI hmax h𝔭 z hz (torsorY hI hmax h𝔭 d hπ l) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ptA_R_sph hI hmax h𝔭 hd hπ z hz]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => ?_
  rw [← pow_succ, Nat.sub_add_cancel (sphE_pos hI hmax h𝔭 hd l)]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.ptA_algebraMap
statement:
lemma ptA_algebraMap (z : RealPt A) (hz : 0 < gNorm hI hmax h𝔭 d π z)
    (r : ReesAlg (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d)) :
    ptA hI hmax h𝔭 hd hπ z hz (algebraMap _ (Torsor hI hmax h𝔭 d hπ) r) = ptA_R hI hmax h𝔭 z hz r
proof:
:=
  jPt_algebraMap _ _ _ _ r

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.ptA_σ
statement:
lemma ptA_σ (z : RealPt A) (hz : 0 < gNorm hI hmax h𝔭 d π z) (l) :
    ptA hI hmax h𝔭 hd hπ z hz (σ (torsorY hI hmax h𝔭 d hπ) l) =
      ptA_R hI hmax h𝔭 z hz (torsorY hI hmax h𝔭 d hπ l) ^ (sphE hI hmax h𝔭 l - 1)
proof:
:=
  jPt_σ _ _ _ _ l

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.ptA_comap
statement:
lemma ptA_comap (z : RealPt A) (hz : 0 < gNorm hI hmax h𝔭 d π z) :
    RealPt.comap (algebraMap A (Torsor hI hmax h𝔭 d hπ)) (ptA hI hmax h𝔭 hd hπ z hz) = z
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  rw [RealPt.comap_apply, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A (ReesAlg (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d)),
    ptA_algebraMap, ptA_R, reesPt_algebraMap]
  rfl

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.ptA_s
statement:
lemma ptA_s (z : RealPt A) (hz : 0 < gNorm hI hmax h𝔭 d π z) :
    ptA hI hmax h𝔭 hd hπ z hz (torsorS hI hmax h𝔭 hπ) = gRoot hI hmax h𝔭 d π z
proof:
:= by
  rw [torsorS, ptA_algebraMap, ptA_R, reesPt_s]
  simp

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.ptA_mem
statement:
lemma ptA_mem (K : Set (RealPt A)) {z : RealPt A} (hzK : z ∈ K)
    (hz : 0 < gNorm hI hmax h𝔭 d π z) : ptA hI hmax h𝔭 hd hπ z hz ∈ torsorK hI hmax h𝔭 hπ K
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨by rw [ptA_comap]; exact hzK, ?_, ?_, fun l => ?_⟩
  · rw [ptA_s]; exact (gRoot_pos hI hmax h𝔭 hz).le
  · simp only [yU, ptA_algebraMap]
    exact ptA_R_sph hI hmax h𝔭 hd hπ z hz
  · simp only [yU, ptA_algebraMap, ptA_σ]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.eq_ptA
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨-, hs0, hsph, hσ⟩ := hwK
  have hpow := s_pow_eq hI hmax h𝔭 hd hπ w hsph
  have hgz : ∑ l, w (algebraMap A _ (genCoeff hI hmax h𝔭 d π l)) ^ sphE hI hmax h𝔭 l =
      gNorm hI hmax h𝔭 d π z := by
    rw [gNorm, ← hwz]; rfl
  rw [hgz, ← gRoot_pow hI hmax h𝔭 z] at hpow
  have hsw : w (torsorS hI hmax h𝔭 hπ) = gRoot hI hmax h𝔭 d π z :=
    (pow_left_inj₀ hs0 (gRoot_pos hI hmax h𝔭 hz).le (by positivity)).1 hpow
  
  set wR := RealPt.comap (algebraMap (ReesAlg (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d)) (Torsor hI hmax h𝔭 d hπ)) w
  have hwRs : wR (reesS _ (fun j hj => compFil_F_nonpos hI hmax h𝔭 d hj)) =
      gRoot hI hmax h𝔭 d π z := hsw
  have hwR := reesPt_eq _ (fun j hj => compFil_F_nonpos hI hmax h𝔭 d hj) wR
    (by rw [hwRs]; exact (gRoot_pos hI hmax h𝔭 hz).ne')
  have hcomp : (RealPt.toHom wR).comp (algebraMap A (ReesAlg (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d))) =
      RealPt.toHom z := by
    ext a
    rw [← hwz]
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, RealPt.toHom_apply, RealPt.comap_apply, wR]
    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply]
  have hwR' : wR = ptA_R hI hmax h𝔭 z hz := by
    rw [hwR, ptA_R, hcomp]
    congr 2
    exact Units.ext hwRs
  apply realPt_J_ext
  · intro r
    show wR r = _
    rw [hwR', ptA_algebraMap]
  · intro l
    rw [hσ l, ptA_σ]
    show wR _ ^ _ = _
    rw [hwR']

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.LocPres.nonempty
statement:
theorem LocPres.nonempty (z : RealPt A) (hz : ∀ g ∈ 𝔭, z g = 0) :
    Nonempty (LocPres hI hmax h𝔭 (d := d) z)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set 𝔮 := RingHom.ker (RealPt.toHom z)
  have h𝔮 : 𝔮 ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro h
    have : (1 : A) ∈ 𝔮 := h ▸ Submodule.mem_top
    rw [RingHom.mem_ker, map_one] at this
    exact one_ne_zero this
  obtain ⟨𝔪, h𝔪, h𝔮𝔪⟩ := Ideal.exists_le_maximal 𝔮 h𝔮
  have := h𝔪
  have h𝔭𝔪 : 𝔭 ≤ 𝔪 := fun g hg => h𝔮𝔪 (by rw [RingHom.mem_ker]; exact hz g hg)
  obtain ⟨hI𝔪, hv⟩ := mem_maxLocus_of_minimal hI hmax h𝔭 𝔪 h𝔭𝔪
  obtain ⟨D⟩ := LocData.nonempty hI 𝔪 hI𝔪 hv
  
  have hunit : ∀ m : 𝔪.primeCompl, IsUnit ((RealPt.toHom z) (m : A)) := fun m => by
    rw [isUnit_iff_ne_zero]
    intro h0
    exact m.2 (h𝔮𝔪 (by rw [RingHom.mem_ker]; exact h0))
  set z𝔪 : Localization.AtPrime 𝔪 →+* ℝ := IsLocalization.lift hunit
  have hz𝔪 : ∀ a, z𝔪 (algebraMap A _ a) = z a := fun a => IsLocalization.lift_eq hunit a
  have hev : ∀ i : Fin D.n, D.ek i = v₀ i := fun i => by
    have := congrFun D.hv (i : ℕ); rw [ext0_apply] at this; exact this
  choose w hw' using fun i : Fin D.n => hw i
  set k' := min D.k D.n
  have hsupp' : ∀ i : Fin D.n, D.ek i ≠ 0 ↔ (i : ℕ) < k' := fun i => by
    rw [D.supp i]; have := i.2; omega
  refine ⟨⟨𝔪, D.n, k', min_le_right _ _, Loc.transport (D.ctrl 𝔪 D.hg) D.ck, D.cent, D.ek,
    D.inv.nonneg, fun i => D.inv.le_one (Iloc_le hI𝔪) i, hsupp', hev, fun h1 => ?_, w, fun i => by rw [hw' i, hev i], fun j => ?_, z𝔪, hz𝔪, ?_⟩⟩
  · have hv1 := congrFun D.hv 1
    by_cases hn : 1 < D.n
    · simp only [ext0, dite_eq_left hn] at hv1
      have hne : D.ek ⟨1, hn⟩ ≠ 0 := by rw [hv1]; exact h1
      have h2 : (1 : ℕ) < D.k := (D.supp ⟨1, hn⟩).1 hne
      simp only [k']; omega
    · simp only [ext0, dite_eq_right hn] at hv1
      exact absurd hv1.symm h1
  · rw [compFil_loc_F hI hmax h𝔭 d 𝔪 h𝔭𝔪, D.cRF_eq_transport hI]; rfl
  · have h1 := D.map_p
    rw [← D.eq_p_of_minimal h𝔭 h𝔭𝔪] at h1
    rw [h1, LocData.P]
    congr 2
    ext i
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    have := i.2; omega

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.LocPres.psi_surj
statement: lemma LocPres.psi_surj : Function.Surjective (P.psi hI hmax h𝔭 hd)
proof:
:=
  reesPsi_surjective P.c P.hF P.he hd P.hw P.hkn P.hsupp

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.LocPres.z𝔪_x
statement: lemma LocPres.z𝔪_x (i : Fin P.k) : P.z𝔪 (P.c.x (ιk P.hkn i)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : P.c.x (ιk P.hkn i) ∈ 𝔭.map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime P.𝔪)) := by
    rw [P.hP]
    exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨ιk P.hkn i, by simp [ιk], rfl⟩
  have hle : 𝔭.map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime P.𝔪)) ≤ RingHom.ker P.z𝔪 := by
    rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    intro g hg
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap, RingHom.mem_ker, P.hz𝔪]
    exact hz g hg
  exact hle hmem

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.LocPres.ev_kills
statement:
lemma LocPres.ev_kills (u : Fin P.k → ℝ) :
    RingHom.ker (P.psi hI hmax h𝔭 hd).toRingHom ≤ RingHom.ker (P.ev hI hmax h𝔭 u)
proof:
:= by
  have hker := reesPsi_ker P.c P.hc P.hF P.he hd P.hw P.hkn P.hsupp
  rw [show RingHom.ker (P.psi hI hmax h𝔭 hd).toRingHom =
    RingHom.ker (reesPsi P.c P.hF P.he hd P.hw P.hkn) from rfl, hker, Ideal.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, RingHom.mem_ker, reesRel, LocPres.ev, map_sub, map_mul, map_pow,
    eval₂Hom_C, eval₂Hom_X', eval₂Hom_X', P.z𝔪_x hI hmax h𝔭 hz i]
  have hw0 : P.w (ιk P.hkn i) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have hne : P.e (ιk P.hkn i) ≠ 0 := (P.hsupp _).2 (by simp [ιk])
    have := P.hw (ιk P.hkn i)
    rw [h0, Nat.cast_zero] at this
    have hdq : (d : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hd.ne'
    exact hne ((mul_eq_zero.1 this.symm).resolve_left hdq)
  simp [zero_pow hw0]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.LocPres.psiPt_psi
statement:
lemma LocPres.psiPt_psi (u : Fin P.k → ℝ) (p) :
    P.psiPt hI hmax h𝔭 hd hz u (P.psi hI hmax h𝔭 hd p) = P.ev hI hmax h𝔭 u p
proof:
:= by
  rw [LocPres.psiPt, RingHom.comp_apply]
  have : (RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective (P.psi_surj hI hmax h𝔭 hd)).symm
      (P.psi hI hmax h𝔭 hd p) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ p := by
    rw [RingEquiv.symm_apply_eq]; rfl
  rw [RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingEquiv.coe_toRingHom, this, Ideal.Quotient.lift_mk]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.LocPres.Psi_apply
statement:
lemma LocPres.Psi_apply (u : Fin P.k → ℝ) (p : ReesAlg (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d)) :
    P.Psi hI hmax h𝔭 hd hz u p =
      P.psiPt hI hmax h𝔭 hd hz u (reesMap _ (Localization.AtPrime P.𝔪) p)
proof: := rfl

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.LocPres.reesMap_algebraMap
statement:
lemma LocPres.reesMap_algebraMap (a : A) :
    reesMap (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d) (Localization.AtPrime P.𝔪)
        (algebraMap A (ReesAlg (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d)) a) =
      P.psi hI hmax h𝔭 hd (C (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime P.𝔪) a))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq, AlgHom.commutes]
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [reesMap_coe]
  show lmap _ (algebraMap A A[T;T⁻¹] a) = algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime P.𝔪) _ _
  rw [← LaurentPolynomial.C_eq_algebraMap, ← LaurentPolynomial.C_eq_algebraMap]
  have := lmap_C_mul_T (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime P.𝔪)) a 0
  simp only [T_zero, mul_one] at this
  exact this

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.LocPres.Psi_algebraMap
statement:
lemma LocPres.Psi_algebraMap (u : Fin P.k → ℝ) (a : A) :
    P.Psi hI hmax h𝔭 hd hz u (algebraMap A (ReesAlg (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d)) a) = z a
proof:
:= by
  rw [LocPres.Psi_apply, LocPres.reesMap_algebraMap hI hmax h𝔭 hd P a, LocPres.psiPt_psi,
    LocPres.ev, eval₂Hom_C, P.hz𝔪]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.LocPres.reesMap_s
statement:
lemma LocPres.reesMap_s :
    reesMap (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d) (Localization.AtPrime P.𝔪)
        (reesS _ (fun _j hj => compFil_F_nonpos hI hmax h𝔭 d hj)) =
      P.psi hI hmax h𝔭 hd (X none)
proof:
:= by
  rw [LocPres.psi, reesPsi, aeval_X]
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [reesMap_coe, reesS_coe]
  simp only [reesGen, Option.elim, reesX_last]
  have := lmap_C_mul_T (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime P.𝔪)) 1 (-1)
  simp only [map_one, one_mul] at this
  exact this

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.LocPres.Psi_s
statement:
lemma LocPres.Psi_s (u : Fin P.k → ℝ) :
    P.Psi hI hmax h𝔭 hd hz u (reesS _ (fun _j hj => compFil_F_nonpos hI hmax h𝔭 d hj)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [LocPres.Psi_apply, LocPres.reesMap_s hI hmax h𝔭 hd P, LocPres.psiPt_psi, LocPres.ev,
    eval₂Hom_X']
  rfl

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.LocPres.psiPt_u
statement:
lemma LocPres.psiPt_u (u : Fin P.k → ℝ) (i : Fin P.k) :
    P.psiPt hI hmax h𝔭 hd hz u (reesX P.c P.hF P.he hd P.hw (Fin.castSucc (ιk P.hkn i))) = u i
proof:
:= by
  have : reesX P.c P.hF P.he hd P.hw (Fin.castSucc (ιk P.hkn i)) = P.psi hI hmax h𝔭 hd (X (some i)) := by
    rw [LocPres.psi, reesPsi, aeval_X]; rfl
  rw [this, LocPres.psiPt_psi, LocPres.ev, eval₂Hom_X']
  rfl

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.LocPres.continuous_Psi
statement: lemma LocPres.continuous_Psi : Continuous fun u => P.Psi hI hmax h𝔭 hd hz u
proof:
:= by
  rw [RealPt.continuous_iff]
  intro p
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := P.psi_surj hI hmax h𝔭 hd (reesMap _ (Localization.AtPrime P.𝔪) p)
  simp only [LocPres.Psi_apply, ← hQ, LocPres.psiPt_psi, LocPres.ev, coe_eval₂Hom]
  clear hQ
  induction Q using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C a => simp only [MvPolynomial.eval₂_C]; exact continuous_const
  | add p q hp hq => simp only [MvPolynomial.eval₂_add]; exact hp.add hq
  | mul_X p o hp =>
    simp only [MvPolynomial.eval₂_mul, MvPolynomial.eval₂_X]
    refine hp.mul ?_
    cases o with
    | none => exact continuous_const
    | some i => exact continuous_apply i

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.LocPres.eq_Psi
statement:
theorem LocPres.eq_Psi (wR : RealPt (ReesAlg (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d)))
    (hA : ∀ a, wR (algebraMap A _ a) = z a)
    (hs : wR (reesS _ (fun _j hj => compFil_F_nonpos hI hmax h𝔭 d hj)) = 0) :
    ∃ u, wR = P.Psi hI hmax h𝔭 hd hz u
proof:
:= by
  let := (reesMap (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d) (Localization.AtPrime P.𝔪)).toAlgebra
  have hloc := reesMap_isLocalization (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d) (Localization.AtPrime P.𝔪)
    P.𝔪.primeCompl (Ideal.primeCompl_le_nonZeroDivisors P.𝔪)
  have hunit : ∀ m : P.𝔪.primeCompl.map (algebraMap A (ReesAlg (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d))),
      IsUnit ((RealPt.toHom wR) (m : ReesAlg (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d))) := by
    rintro ⟨_, m, hm, rfl⟩
    rw [RealPt.toHom_apply, hA, isUnit_iff_ne_zero, ← P.hz𝔪]
    exact (IsLocalization.map_units (Localization.AtPrime P.𝔪) (⟨m, hm⟩ : P.𝔪.primeCompl)).map
      P.z𝔪 |>.ne_zero
  set w' : ReesAlg ((compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d).loc (Localization.AtPrime P.𝔪)) →+* ℝ :=
    IsLocalization.lift hunit
  have hw' : ∀ p, w' (reesMap _ (Localization.AtPrime P.𝔪) p) = wR p := fun p =>
    IsLocalization.lift_eq hunit p
  refine ⟨fun i => w' (reesX P.c P.hF P.he hd P.hw (Fin.castSucc (ιk P.hkn i))), ?_⟩
  
  have hbase : w'.comp (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime P.𝔪) _) = P.z𝔪 := by
    refine IsLocalization.ringHom_ext P.𝔪.primeCompl (RingHom.ext fun a => ?_)
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply]
    rw [P.hz𝔪, ← hA, ← hw']
    congr 1
    rw [LocPres.reesMap_algebraMap hI hmax h𝔭 hd P a, ← MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq,
      AlgHom.commutes]
  have hcomp : w'.comp (P.psi hI hmax h𝔭 hd).toRingHom =
      P.ev hI hmax h𝔭 (fun i => w' (reesX P.c P.hF P.he hd P.hw (Fin.castSucc (ιk P.hkn i)))) := by
    refine MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext (fun b => ?_) (fun o => ?_)
