  obtain ⟨⟨j, ⟨_, s, hs, rfl⟩⟩, hj⟩ := hx
  simp only at hj
  have hinj : Function.Injective (Loc.map h) :=
    Loc.map_injective h (Ideal.primeCompl_le_nonZeroDivisors Q)
  rw [← halg, ← halg, ← map_mul] at hj
  refine ⟨s, hs, ?_⟩
  rw [map_mul, mul_comm, hinj hj]
  exact j.2

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.drop
statement:
theorem drop (P : Ideal (ReesAlg (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d))) [hPm : P.IsMaximal]
    (hIwP : weakT (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d) I d (I_le_compFil hI hmax h𝔭 hd) ≤ P)
    (hsP : reesS (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d) (fun _j hj => compFil_F_nonpos hI hmax h𝔭 d hj) ∈ P)
    {j : ℤ} (hj : 1 ≤ j) {f : A} (hf : f ∈ (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d).F j)
    (hyP : (⟨LaurentPolynomial.C f * T j, C_mul_T_mem_ReesAlg hf⟩ :
      ReesAlg (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d)) ∉ P)
    {v : ℕ → ℚ} (hv : InvAt (weakT (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d) I d (I_le_compFil hI hmax h𝔭 hd)) P v) :
    toLex v₀ < toLex v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hneg : ∀ j : ℤ, j ≤ 0 → (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d).F j = ⊤ := fun j hj => compFil_F_nonpos hI hmax h𝔭 d hj
  have hId := I_le_compFil hI hmax h𝔭 hd
  have : Algebra.FiniteType A (ReesAlg (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d)) := reesAlg_finiteType hI hmax h𝔭 d hd hw
  have : Algebra.FiniteType ℚ (ReesAlg (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d)) := Algebra.FiniteType.trans (S := A) inferInstance inferInstance
  have : IsNoetherianRing (ReesAlg (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d)) := Algebra.FiniteType.isNoetherianRing A (ReesAlg (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d))
  have : Algebra.Smooth ℚ (ReesAlg (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d)) := rees_smooth hI hmax h𝔭 hd hw
  
  set 𝔪 := P.comap (algebraMap A (ReesAlg (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d)))
  have : 𝔪.IsMaximal := comap_isMaximal_of_finiteType P
  have h𝔭𝔪 : 𝔭 ≤ 𝔪 := by
    intro g hg
    have hg1 : g ∈ (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d).F 1 := by
      rw [compFil_F, show ((1 : ℤ) : ℚ) / d = 1 / d by push_cast; ring, compF_one_div hI hmax h𝔭 hd hw]
      exact hg
    show algebraMap A (ReesAlg (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d)) g ∈ P
    have : algebraMap A (ReesAlg (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d)) g = reesS (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d) hneg * ⟨LaurentPolynomial.C g * T 1, C_mul_T_mem_ReesAlg hg1⟩ := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      show algebraMap A A[T;T⁻¹] g = T (-1) * (LaurentPolynomial.C g * T 1)
      rw [mul_left_comm, ← T_add, neg_add_cancel, T_zero, mul_one, LaurentPolynomial.C_eq_algebraMap]
    rw [this]; exact P.mul_mem_right _ hsP
  obtain ⟨D⟩ := VertexData.nonempty hI hmax h𝔭 hw 𝔪 h𝔭𝔪
  set hpos := D.hpos hd
  set P₀ := vertexG (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d) 𝔪 hpos
  obtain ⟨J₀, hJ₀adm, hJ₀e, hJ₀inv, hJ₀homog⟩ := D.vertexG_data hd
  
  have hIw0 : (weakT (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d) I d hId) ≠ ⊥ := weakT_ne_bot (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d) hI d hId
  have hIwP₀ : (weakT (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d) I d hId) ≤ P₀ := by
    apply weakT_le
    intro g hg
    rw [mem_vertexG, coeff_C_mul_T, ite_eq_right (by omega)]
    exact zero_mem _
  obtain ⟨n', M', g, hg, hctrl, k', ck, ek, hsupp', hadm', hinv', hcent', hbound'⟩ :=
    local_inv (weakT (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d) I d hId) hIw0 P₀ hIwP₀
  obtain rfl := hinv'.card_eq J₀.c
  have hek : ek = pad (D.n + 1) D.J.e := by
    rw [← hJ₀e]; exact hinv'.unique hJ₀inv
  
  set y : (ReesAlg (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d)) := ⟨LaurentPolynomial.C f * T j, C_mul_T_mem_ReesAlg hf⟩
  have hy₀ : algebraMap (ReesAlg (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d)) (Localization.AtPrime P₀) y ∈
      (ck.RF ek (1 / d)).map (Loc.map (hctrl P₀ hg)) := by
    rw [Loc.map_RF, ← (hbound' P₀ hg J₀ hJ₀adm).2 (by rw [hJ₀e, hek]) (1 / d)]
    exact hJ₀homog j hj f hf
  obtain ⟨h, hh, hhy⟩ := Loc.exists_of_mem_map (hctrl P₀ hg) _ hy₀
  
  set G := g * h
  have hG : hcomp (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d) G 0 ∉ P := by
    intro hGP
    have hGP₀ : G ∉ P₀ := fun h' => (Ideal.IsPrime.mem_or_mem inferInstance h').elim hg hh
    apply hGP₀
    rw [mem_vertexG]
    have : hcomp (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d) G 0 = algebraMap A (ReesAlg (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d)) ((G : A[T;T⁻¹]).coeff 0) := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      show LaurentPolynomial.C ((G : A[T;T⁻¹]).coeff 0) * T 0 = _
      rw [T_zero, mul_one, LaurentPolynomial.C_eq_algebraMap]; rfl
    rw [this] at hGP
    exact hGP
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ, hμG⟩ := exists_reesScale_not_mem (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d) hneg P hsP G hG
  set σ := reesScale (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d) (qUnit (B := A) μ hμ)
  set P' := P.comap σ
  have : P'.IsMaximal := Ideal.comap_isMaximal_of_surjective σ σ.surjective
  have hgP' : g ∉ P' := fun h' => hμG (by rw [Ideal.mem_comap] at h'; exact
    (show σ G ∈ P by rw [map_mul]; exact P.mul_mem_right _ h'))
  have hhP' : h ∉ P' := fun h' => hμG (by rw [Ideal.mem_comap] at h'; exact
    (show σ G ∈ P by rw [map_mul]; exact P.mul_mem_left _ h'))
  have hIwP' : (weakT (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d) I d hId) ≤ P' := by
    intro x hx
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap]
    exact hIwP ((reesScale_weakT_le (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d) _ d hId) (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hx))
  
  obtain ⟨v', hv'⟩ := exists_invAt hIw0 P' hIwP'
  have hvv : v = v' := by
    refine hv.unique ?_
    exact InvAt.of_ringEquiv σ (reesScale_weakT (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d) _ d hId) P hv'
  subst hvv
  obtain ⟨n'', e', he', rfl⟩ := hv'
  obtain rfl := he'.card_eq (Loc.transport (hctrl P' hgP') ck)
  obtain ⟨⟨J', hJ', hJ'e⟩, hmin'⟩ := he'
  have hle := (hbound' P' hgP' J' hJ').1
  rw [hJ'e, hek] at hle
  rcases hle.lt_or_eq with hlt | heq
  · have := ext0_lt hlt
    rwa [ext0_pad (by omega), D.hev] at this
  · exfalso
    
    have hRF := (hbound' P' hgP' J' hJ').2 (by rw [hJ'e, hek]; exact (toLex.injective heq).symm)
    have hmem : algebraMap (ReesAlg (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d)) (Localization.AtPrime P') (h * y) ∈ J'.RF (1 / d) := by
      rw [hRF (1 / d), ← Loc.map_RF, ← Loc.map_algebraMap (hctrl P' hgP')]
      exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hhy
    have hmax' := J'.centred.RF_le_maximalIdeal (show (0 : ℚ) < 1 / d by positivity) hmem
    rw [IsLocalization.AtPrime.to_map_mem_maximal_iff _ P'] at hmax'
    have hyP' : y ∈ P' := ((Ideal.IsPrime.mem_or_mem inferInstance hmax').resolve_left hhP')
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap] at hyP'
    apply hyP
    have : σ y = algebraMap A (ReesAlg (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d)) ↑((qUnit (B := A) μ hμ) ^ j) * y := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [reesScale_coe]
      show lscale _ (LaurentPolynomial.C f * T j) =
        algebraMap A A[T;T⁻¹] ↑((qUnit (B := A) μ hμ) ^ j) * (LaurentPolynomial.C f * T j)
      rw [lscale_C_mul_T, ← LaurentPolynomial.C_eq_algebraMap, ← mul_assoc, ← map_mul, mul_comm f]
    rw [this] at hyP'
    refine ((Ideal.IsPrime.mem_or_mem inferInstance hyP').resolve_left fun hu => ?_)
    have hunit : IsUnit (algebraMap A (ReesAlg (compFil hI hmax h𝔭 d)) ↑((qUnit (B := A) μ hμ) ^ j)) :=
      (Units.isUnit _).map _
    exact hPm.ne_top (Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem _ hu hunit)

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.torsorK_monotone
statement:
theorem torsorK_monotone (hk2 : v₀ 1 ≠ 0) (K : Set (RealPt A)) :
    IsMonotoneSurjOn (RealPt.comap (algebraMap A (Torsor hI hmax h𝔭 d hπ)))
      (torsorK hI hmax h𝔭 hπ K) K
proof:
:= by
  have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (RealPt.comap (algebraMap A (Torsor hI hmax h𝔭 d hπ)))
      (torsorK hI hmax h𝔭 hπ K) K := fun w hw => hw.1
  refine ⟨hmaps, ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · exact ((RealPt.continuous_comap _).comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk _
  · rintro ⟨z, hzK⟩
    rcases (gNorm_nonneg hI hmax h𝔭 (d := d) (π := π) z).lt_or_eq with hpos | h0
    · exact ⟨⟨ptA hI hmax h𝔭 hd hπ z hpos, ptA_mem hI hmax h𝔭 hd hπ K hzK hpos⟩,
        Subtype.ext (ptA_comap hI hmax h𝔭 hd hπ z hpos)⟩
    · have hz := kills_of_gNorm_zero hI hmax h𝔭 hd hw h0.symm
      obtain ⟨P⟩ := LocPres.nonempty hI hmax h𝔭 hw z hz
      have hk : 0 < P.k := by have := P.hk2 hk2; omega
      set u : ({0}ᶜ : Set (Fin P.k → ℝ)) := ⟨fun _ => 1, fun h => by
        have := congrFun h ⟨0, hk⟩; simp at this⟩
      exact ⟨⟨P.Gamma hI hmax h𝔭 hd hz hπ u, P.Gamma_mem hI hmax h𝔭 hd hz hπ hzK u⟩,
        Subtype.ext (P.Gamma_comap hI hmax h𝔭 hd hz hπ u)⟩
  · rintro ⟨z, hzK⟩
    apply isConnected_restrict_fiber
    show IsConnected (torsorFib hI hmax h𝔭 hπ K z)
    rcases (gNorm_nonneg hI hmax h𝔭 (d := d) (π := π) z).lt_or_eq with hpos | h0
    · have : torsorFib hI hmax h𝔭 hπ K z = {ptA hI hmax h𝔭 hd hπ z hpos} := by
        ext w
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨hwK, hwz⟩
          exact eq_ptA hI hmax h𝔭 hd hπ K hwK hwz hpos
        · rintro rfl
          exact ⟨ptA_mem hI hmax h𝔭 hd hπ K hzK hpos, ptA_comap hI hmax h𝔭 hd hπ z hpos⟩
      rw [this]
      exact isConnected_singleton
    · exact fib_connected hI hmax h𝔭 hd hw hπ (kills_of_gNorm_zero hI hmax h𝔭 hd hw h0.symm)
        hk2 hzK

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.pow_max_le_RF_const
statement:
lemma pow_max_le_RF_const {c : Chart S n} (hc : c.IsCentred) {w : ℚ} (hw : 0 < w) (j : ℕ) :
    maximalIdeal S ^ j ≤ c.RF (fun _ => w) (j * w)
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero =>
    rw [pow_zero, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, c.RF_of_nonpos (fun _ => hw.le) le_rfl]
    exact le_top
  | succ j ih =>
    rw [pow_succ]
    have hmax : maximalIdeal S ≤ c.RF (fun _ => w) w := by
      rw [hc, Ideal.span_le]
      rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
      exact c.x_mem_RF (fun _ => w) i hw.ne'
    refine (Ideal.mul_mono ih hmax).trans ?_
    have := c.RF_mul_le (fun _ => w) (j * w) w
    rwa [show (j : ℚ) * w + w = ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) * w by push_cast; ring] at this

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.IsInv.zero_le_of_le_pow
statement:
lemma IsInv.zero_le_of_le_pow {I : Ideal S} {e : Fin n → ℚ} (he : IsInv I n e)
    (c : Chart S n) (hc : c.IsCentred) {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hIb : I ≤ maximalIdeal S ^ b)
    (h0 : 0 < n) : e ⟨0, h0⟩ ≤ 1 / b
proof:
:= by
  have hw : (0 : ℚ) < 1 / b := by positivity
  set J' : MC S n := ⟨c, fun _ => 1 / b, hc, fun _ => hw.le, fun _ _ _ => le_rfl⟩
  have hadm : J'.Adm I := by
    show I ≤ c.RF (fun _ => 1 / b) 1
    have := pow_max_le_RF_const hc hw b
    rw [show (b : ℚ) * (1 / b) = 1 by field_simp] at this
    exact hIb.trans this
  have := he.2 J' hadm
  exact lex_le_at this h0 (fun i hi => absurd hi (Nat.not_lt_zero _))

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.invAt_zero_le_of_le_pow
statement:
lemma invAt_zero_le_of_le_pow {I : Ideal A} {𝔪 : Ideal A} [𝔪.IsMaximal] {v : ℕ → ℚ}
    (hv : InvAt I 𝔪 v) {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hIb : I ≤ 𝔪 ^ b) : v 0 ≤ 1 / b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, e, he, rfl⟩ := hv
  by_cases h0 : 0 < n
  · simp only [ext0, dite_eq_left h0]
    obtain ⟨J, -, -⟩ := he.1
    refine he.zero_le_of_le_pow J.c J.centred hb ?_ h0
    rw [Iloc, ← IsLocalization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal 𝔪 (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪),
      ← Ideal.map_pow]
    exact Ideal.map_mono hIb
  · simp only [ext0, dite_eq_right h0]; positivity

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.eq_span_of_loc_principal
proof:
:= by
  have hπ𝔪 : π ∈ 𝔪 := h𝔭𝔪 hπ𝔭
  have hπp : (Ideal.span {π}).IsPrime := (Ideal.span_singleton_prime hπ.ne_zero).2 hπ
  have hdisj : Disjoint (𝔪.primeCompl : Set A) (Ideal.span {π} : Set A) := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro a ha ha'
    exact ha ((Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _).2 hπ𝔪 ha')
  have hQ : ((Ideal.span {π}).map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪))).IsPrime :=
    IsLocalization.isPrime_of_isPrime_disjoint 𝔪.primeCompl _ _ hπp hdisj
  
  have hπx : algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪) π ∈ Ideal.span {x} := by
    rw [← hloc]; exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hπ𝔭
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.1 hπx
  have hxQ : x ∈ (Ideal.span {π}).map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪)) := by
    have hmem : u * x ∈ (Ideal.span {π}).map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪)) := by
      rw [hu]; exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self π)
    rcases hQ.mem_or_mem hmem with h | h
    · exfalso
      rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton] at h
      obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.1 h
      have hπ0 : algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪) π ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        exact hπ.ne_zero (IsLocalization.injective (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪)
          (Ideal.primeCompl_le_nonZeroDivisors 𝔪) (h0.trans (map_zero _).symm))
      have h3 : algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪) π * (v * x) = u * x := by
        rw [← hv]; ring
      have h1 : algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪) π * (1 - v * x) = 0 := by
        rw [mul_sub, mul_one, h3, hu, sub_self]
      have h2 : 1 - v * x = 0 := (mul_eq_zero.1 h1).resolve_left hπ0
      have hxv : x * v = 1 := by rw [mul_comm]; exact (sub_eq_zero.1 h2).symm
      have : IsUnit x := ⟨⟨x, v, hxv, by rw [mul_comm]; exact hxv⟩, rfl⟩
      exact (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal x).1 hx this
    · exact h
  apply le_antisymm
  · have h1 : 𝔭.map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪)) ≤
        (Ideal.span {π}).map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪)) := by
      rw [hloc, Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]; exact hxQ
    have h2 := Ideal.comap_mono (f := algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪)) h1
    have e1 := IsLocalization.under_map_of_isPrime_disjoint 𝔪.primeCompl
      (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪) ‹𝔭.IsPrime›
      (by rw [Set.disjoint_left]; intro a ha ha'; exact ha (h𝔭𝔪 ha'))
    have e2 := IsLocalization.under_map_of_isPrime_disjoint 𝔪.primeCompl
      (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪) hπp hdisj
    exact e1.symm.le.trans (h2.trans e2.le)
  · rw [Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]; exact hπ𝔭

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.LocData.supp_zero
statement:
lemma LocData.supp_zero {𝔪 : Ideal A} [𝔪.IsMaximal] (D : LocData I v₀ 𝔪) (h0 : v₀ 0 ≠ 0)
    (hk1 : v₀ 1 = 0) (i : Fin D.n) : D.ek i ≠ 0 ↔ (i : ℕ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hv : ∀ j : Fin D.n, D.ek j = v₀ j := fun j => by
    have := congrFun D.hv (j : ℕ); rw [ext0_apply] at this; exact this
  constructor
  · intro hne
    by_contra hi
    have h1 : (1 : ℕ) < D.n := by have := i.2; omega
    have hle : D.ek i ≤ D.ek ⟨1, h1⟩ := D.inv.anti (Fin.le_def.2 (by simp; omega))
    rw [hv ⟨1, h1⟩, hk1] at hle
    exact hne (le_antisymm hle (D.inv.nonneg i))
  · intro hi
    rw [hv i, show (i : ℕ) = 0 from hi]
    exact h0

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.LocData.n_pos
statement:
lemma LocData.n_pos {𝔪 : Ideal A} [𝔪.IsMaximal] (D : LocData I v₀ 𝔪) (h0 : v₀ 0 ≠ 0) :
    0 < D.n
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  apply h0
  have := congrFun D.hv 0
  simp only [ext0, dite_eq_right h] at this
  exact this.symm

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.LocData.P_eq_span
proof:
:= by
  have hset : {i : Fin D.n | (i : ℕ) < D.k} = {⟨0, D.n_pos h0⟩} := by
    ext i
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    rw [← D.supp i, D.supp_zero h0 hk1 i, Fin.ext_iff]
  rw [LocData.P, hset, Set.image_singleton]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.RF_le_pow_of_single
proof:
:= by
  rw [Chart.RF, Ideal.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨α, hα0, hα1, rfl⟩
  have hαi : ∀ i : Fin n, i ≠ ⟨0, h0⟩ → α i = 0 := fun i hi => by
    apply hα0 i
    by_contra hne
    exact hi (Fin.ext ((hsupp i).1 hne))
  have hprod : ∏ i, c.x i ^ α i = c.x ⟨0, h0⟩ ^ α ⟨0, h0⟩ := by
    rw [Finset.prod_eq_single ⟨0, h0⟩]
    · intro i _ hi; rw [hαi i hi, pow_zero]
    · simp
  have hlam : lam e α = α ⟨0, h0⟩ * (1 / a) := by
    rw [lam, Finset.sum_eq_single ⟨0, h0⟩, ha]
    · intro i _ hi; rw [hαi i hi]; simp
    · simp
  have ha' : a ≤ α ⟨0, h0⟩ := by
    rw [hlam] at hα1
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos a with h | h
    · omega
    · have : (a : ℚ) ≤ α ⟨0, h0⟩ := by
        have hapos : (0 : ℚ) < a := by exact_mod_cast h
        rw [mul_one_div, le_div_iff₀ hapos, one_mul] at hα1
        exact hα1
      exact_mod_cast this
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, hprod, ← Nat.sub_add_cancel ha', pow_add]
  exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.pow_mem_pow (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _) _)

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.div_eq_span
statement:
theorem div_eq_span (h0 : v₀ 0 ≠ 0) (hk1 : v₀ 1 = 0) {π : A} (hπ : Prime π) (hπ𝔭 : π ∈ 𝔭) :
    𝔭 = Ideal.span {π}
proof:
:= by
  have := h𝔭.1.1
  obtain ⟨𝔪, h𝔪, hle⟩ := Ideal.exists_le_maximal 𝔭 (Ideal.IsPrime.ne_top ‹_›)
  have := h𝔪
  obtain ⟨hI𝔪, hv⟩ := mem_maxLocus_of_minimal hI hmax h𝔭 𝔪 hle
  obtain ⟨D⟩ := LocData.nonempty hI 𝔪 hI𝔪 hv
  have hp : 𝔭 = D.p := D.eq_p_of_minimal h𝔭 hle
  have hloc : 𝔭.map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪)) =
      Ideal.span {(Loc.transport (D.ctrl 𝔪 D.hg) D.ck).x ⟨0, D.n_pos h0⟩} := by
    rw [hp, D.map_p, D.P_eq_span h0 hk1]
  exact eq_span_of_loc_principal hle hπ hπ𝔭 (D.cent.x_mem _) hloc

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.div_le_span_pow
statement:
theorem div_le_span_pow (h0 : v₀ 0 ≠ 0) (hk1 : v₀ 1 = 0) {π : A} (hπ : Prime π) (hπ𝔭 : π ∈ 𝔭)
    {a : ℕ} (ha : v₀ 0 = 1 / a) : I ≤ Ideal.span {π ^ a}
proof:
:= by
  have h𝔭π := div_eq_span hI hmax h𝔭 h0 hk1 hπ hπ𝔭
  refine (I_le_compFil hI hmax h𝔭 hd).trans ?_
  rw [compFil_F, show ((d : ℤ) : ℚ) / d = 1 by
    have : (d : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hd.ne'
    push_cast; field_simp]
  apply Ideal.le_of_forall_map
  intro 𝔪 _
  by_cases h𝔭𝔪 : 𝔭 ≤ 𝔪
  · rw [compF_map hI hmax h𝔭 𝔪 h𝔭𝔪 1]
    obtain ⟨hI𝔪, hv⟩ := mem_maxLocus_of_minimal hI hmax h𝔭 𝔪 h𝔭𝔪
    obtain ⟨D⟩ := LocData.nonempty hI 𝔪 hI𝔪 hv
    rw [D.cRF_eq_transport hI 1]
    have h0' := D.n_pos h0
    have hek : D.ek ⟨0, h0'⟩ = 1 / a := by
      have := congrFun D.hv 0
      rw [ext0, dite_eq_left h0'] at this
      rw [this, ha]
    refine (RF_le_pow_of_single _ h0' (D.supp_zero h0 hk1) hek).trans ?_
    have hx : Ideal.span {(Loc.transport (D.ctrl 𝔪 D.hg) D.ck).x ⟨0, h0'⟩} =
        (Ideal.span {π}).map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪)) := by
      rw [← D.P_eq_span h0 hk1, ← D.map_p, ← D.eq_p_of_minimal h𝔭 h𝔭𝔪, h𝔭π]
    rw [hx, ← Ideal.map_pow, Ideal.span_singleton_pow]
  · have hπ𝔪 : π ∉ 𝔪 := fun h => h𝔭𝔪 (h𝔭π ▸ (Ideal.span_le.2 (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 h)))
    have hu : IsUnit (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪) (π ^ a)) :=
      IsLocalization.map_units _ (⟨π ^ a, 𝔪.primeCompl.pow_mem hπ𝔪 a⟩ : 𝔪.primeCompl)
    rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top.2 hu]
    exact le_top

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.mem_divI
statement: lemma mem_divI {I : Ideal A} {π : A} {a : ℕ} {f : A} : f ∈ divI I π a ↔ π ^ a * f ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  rw [divI, Submodule.mem_colon_singleton, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.le_divI
statement: lemma le_divI (I : Ideal A) (π : A) (a : ℕ) : I ≤ divI I π a
proof:
:=
  fun _f hf => mem_divI.2 (I.mul_mem_left _ hf)

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.div_eq_mul
statement:
lemma div_eq_mul {I : Ideal A} {π : A} {a : ℕ} (hle : I ≤ Ideal.span {π ^ a}) :
    I = Ideal.span {π ^ a} * divI I π a
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro f hf
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.1 (hle hf)
    have hgI : g ∈ divI I π a := mem_divI.2 (by rw [mul_comm, hg]; exact hf)
    rw [← hg, mul_comm g]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _) hgI
  · rw [Ideal.mul_le]
    intro x hx y hy
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.1 hx
    rw [mul_assoc]
    exact I.mul_mem_left _ (mem_divI.1 hy)

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.div_not_mem
statement: theorem div_not_mem (𝔪 : Ideal A) [𝔪.IsMaximal] (h𝔪 : divI I π a ≤ 𝔪) : π ∉ 𝔪
proof:
:= by
  intro hπ𝔪
  have hI𝔪 : I ≤ 𝔪 ^ (a + 1) := by
    rw [div_eq_mul hle, pow_succ]
    refine Ideal.mul_mono ?_ h𝔪
    rw [Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
    exact Ideal.pow_mem_pow hπ𝔪 a
  have hI𝔪' : I ≤ 𝔪 := hI𝔪.trans (Ideal.pow_le_self (by omega))
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := exists_invAt hI 𝔪 hI𝔪'
  have h1 := invAt_zero_le_of_le_pow hv (by omega) hI𝔪
  have h2 := hmax 𝔪 hI𝔪' v hv
  have hlt : v 0 < v₀ 0 := by
    rw [ha]
    refine lt_of_le_of_lt h1 ?_
    have : (0 : ℚ) < a := by exact_mod_cast ha0
    push_cast
    exact one_div_lt_one_div_of_lt this (by linarith)
  exact absurd h2 (not_le.2 ⟨0, fun j hj => absurd hj (Nat.not_lt_zero _), hlt⟩)

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.div_Iloc
statement:
lemma div_Iloc (𝔪 : Ideal A) [𝔪.IsMaximal] (h𝔪 : divI I π a ≤ 𝔪) :
    Iloc I 𝔪 = Iloc (divI I π a) 𝔪
proof:
:= by
  have := Iloc_span_unit_mul (J := divI I π a) (𝔪 := 𝔪)
    (div_not_mem hI hmax ha0 ha hle 𝔪 h𝔪) a
  rwa [← div_eq_mul hle] at this

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.div_invAt_iff
statement:
lemma div_invAt_iff (𝔪 : Ideal A) [𝔪.IsMaximal] (h𝔪 : divI I π a ≤ 𝔪) {v : ℕ → ℚ} :
    InvAt (divI I π a) 𝔪 v ↔ InvAt I 𝔪 v
proof:
:=
  ⟨InvAt.of_Iloc_eq (div_Iloc hI hmax ha0 ha hle 𝔪 h𝔪).symm,
    InvAt.of_Iloc_eq (div_Iloc hI hmax ha0 ha hle 𝔪 h𝔪)⟩

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.div_inv_ge
statement:
theorem div_inv_ge (𝔪 : Ideal A) [𝔪.IsMaximal] (h𝔪 : divI I π a ≤ 𝔪) {v : ℕ → ℚ}
    (hv : InvAt (divI I π a) 𝔪 v) : toLex v₀ ≤ toLex v
proof:
:=
  hmax 𝔪 ((le_divI I π a).trans h𝔪) v ((div_invAt_iff hI hmax ha0 ha hle 𝔪 h𝔪).1 hv)

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.divI_ne_bot
statement: lemma divI_ne_bot (hI : I ≠ ⊥) : divI I π a ≠ ⊥
proof: := fun h => hI (eq_bot_iff.2 (h ▸ le_divI I π a))

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.div_count
statement:
theorem div_count :
    (locusIdeal (divI I π a) v₀).minimalPrimes.ncard < (locusIdeal I v₀).minimalPrimes.ncard
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : Algebra.FiniteType ℚ A := inferInstance
  have : IsJacobsonRing A := isJacobsonRing_of_finiteType (A := ℚ)
  have hfin : (locusIdeal I v₀).minimalPrimes.Finite :=
    Ideal.finite_minimalPrimes_of_isNoetherianRing A _
  have hπ𝔭 : ∀ Q : Ideal A, π ∉ Q → ¬ 𝔭 ≤ Q := fun Q hπ h =>
    hπ (h (h𝔭π ▸ Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self π))
  have hle' := ncard_minimalPrimes_sInf_le (S := maxLocus (divI I π a) v₀)
    (hfin.toFinset.erase 𝔭) (fun 𝔭' => 𝔭') ?_ ?_ ?_
  · have hcard : (hfin.toFinset.erase 𝔭).card < (locusIdeal I v₀).minimalPrimes.ncard := by
      rw [Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card _ hfin]
      exact Finset.card_erase_lt_of_mem (hfin.mem_toFinset.2 h𝔭)
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt hle' hcard
  · intro 𝔭' h𝔭'
    rw [Finset.mem_erase, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] at h𝔭'
    exact h𝔭'.2.1.1
  · intro Q hQ
    obtain ⟨hQm, hIQ, hv⟩ := hQ
    have hπQ := div_not_mem hI hmax ha0 ha hle Q hIQ
    have hv' := (div_invAt_iff hI hmax ha0 ha hle Q hIQ).1 hv
    have hL : locusIdeal I v₀ ≤ Q := sInf_le ⟨hQm, (le_divI I π a).trans hIQ, hv'⟩
    obtain ⟨𝔭', h𝔭', h𝔭'le⟩ := Ideal.exists_minimalPrimes_le hL
    refine ⟨𝔭', ?_, h𝔭'le⟩
    rw [Finset.mem_erase, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset]
    exact ⟨fun h => hπ𝔭 Q hπQ (h ▸ h𝔭'le), h𝔭'⟩
  · intro 𝔭' h𝔭' Q hQ h𝔭'Q
    rw [Finset.mem_erase, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] at h𝔭'
    have := hQ
    obtain ⟨hIQ, hinv⟩ := mem_maxLocus_of_minimal hI hmax h𝔭'.2 Q h𝔭'Q
    have hπQ : π ∉ Q := fun h => by
      have := minimalPrimes_sup_eq_top hI hmax h𝔭 h𝔭'.2 (Ne.symm h𝔭'.1)
      apply hQ.ne_top
      rw [eq_top_iff, ← this]
      exact sup_le (h𝔭π ▸ Ideal.span_le.2 (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 h)) h𝔭'Q
    have hdivQ : divI I π a ≤ Q := by
      have h1 := hIQ
      rw [div_eq_mul hle] at h1
      rcases hQ.isPrime.mul_le.1 h1 with h | h
      · exact absurd (hQ.isPrime.mem_of_pow_mem a (h (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _))) hπQ
      · exact h
    exact ⟨hQ, hdivQ, (div_invAt_iff hI hmax ha0 ha hle Q hdivQ).2 hinv⟩

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.deriv_mem_divI
statement:
theorem deriv_mem_divI (δ : Derivation ℚ A A) (hδ : ∀ f ∈ I, δ f ∈ I) {f : A}
    (hf : f ∈ divI I π a) : δ f ∈ divI I π a
proof:
:= by
  have hπF : π ∈ compF I 𝔭 (1 / d) := by
    rw [compF_one_div hI hmax h𝔭 hd hw, h𝔭π]; exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self π
  have hδπ : δ π ∈ Ideal.span {π} := by
    rw [← h𝔭π, ← compF_one_div hI hmax h𝔭 hd hw]
    exact deriv_mem_compF hI hmax h𝔭 δ hδ _ hπF
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.1 hδπ
  rw [mem_divI] at hf ⊢
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ : ∃ b, a = b + 1 := ⟨a - 1, by omega⟩
  have h2 : δ (π ^ (b + 1) * f) = π ^ (b + 1) * δ f + ((b + 1 : ℕ) * c) * (π ^ (b + 1) * f) := by
    rw [Derivation.leibniz, Derivation.leibniz_pow, ← hc, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, nsmul_eq_mul,
      smul_eq_mul, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    push_cast; ring
  have : π ^ (b + 1) * δ f = δ (π ^ (b + 1) * f) - ((b + 1 : ℕ) * c) * (π ^ (b + 1) * f) := by
    rw [h2]; ring
  rw [this]
  exact I.sub_mem (hδ _ hf) (I.mul_mem_left _ hf)

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.div_vertOK
statement: theorem div_vertOK {m : ℕ} (hV : VertOK I m) : VertOK (divI I π a) m
proof:
:= by
  intro 𝔪 h𝔪 hle
  obtain ⟨δ, y, hδ, hdet⟩ := hV 𝔪 h𝔪 ((le_divI I π a).trans hle)
  exact ⟨δ, y, fun j f hf => deriv_mem_divI hI hmax h𝔭 hd hw h𝔭π ha0 (δ j) (hδ j) hf, hdet⟩

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.div_dimOK
statement: theorem div_dimOK {m N : ℕ} (hD : DimOK I m N) : DimOK (divI I π a) m N
proof:
:=
  fun 𝔪 _ hle n hc => hD 𝔪 ((le_divI I π a).trans hle) n hc

name: BezoutCounterexample.coeff_mapCoeffsLin
statement:
@[simp] lemma coeff_mapCoeffsLin (δ : Derivation R A A) (p : MvPolynomial σ A) (m : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    (mapCoeffsLin δ p).coeff m = δ (p.coeff m)
proof:
:= by
  simp [mapCoeffsLin]

name: BezoutCounterexample.mapCoeffsLin_monomial
statement:
lemma mapCoeffsLin_monomial (δ : Derivation R A A) (m : σ →₀ ℕ) (a : A) :
    mapCoeffsLin δ (monomial m a) = monomial m (δ a)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext n
  rw [coeff_mapCoeffsLin, coeff_monomial, coeff_monomial]
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: BezoutCounterexample.mapCoeffsLin_mul
statement:
lemma mapCoeffsLin_mul (δ : Derivation R A A) (p q : MvPolynomial σ A) :
    mapCoeffsLin δ (p * q) = p * mapCoeffsLin δ q + q * mapCoeffsLin δ p
proof:
:= by
  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on' with
  | monomial m a =>
    induction q using MvPolynomial.induction_on' with
    | monomial n b =>
      rw [monomial_mul_monomial, mapCoeffsLin_monomial, mapCoeffsLin_monomial, mapCoeffsLin_monomial,
        monomial_mul_monomial, monomial_mul_monomial, Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, map_add,
        add_comm m n]
    | add q₁ q₂ h₁ h₂ => rw [mul_add, map_add, h₁, h₂, map_add]; ring
  | add p₁ p₂ h₁ h₂ => rw [add_mul, map_add, h₁, h₂, map_add]; ring

name: BezoutCounterexample.mapCoeffs_C
statement:
@[simp] lemma mapCoeffs_C (δ : Derivation R A A) (a : A) :
    mapCoeffs (σ := σ) δ (C a) = C (δ a)
proof:
:=
  mapCoeffsLin_monomial δ 0 a

name: BezoutCounterexample.mapCoeffs_X
statement: @[simp] lemma mapCoeffs_X (δ : Derivation R A A) (i : σ) : mapCoeffs δ (X i : MvPolynomial σ A) = 0
proof:
:= by
  show mapCoeffsLin δ (monomial (Finsupp.single i 1) 1) = 0
  rw [mapCoeffsLin_monomial, Derivation.map_one_eq_zero, monomial_zero]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.Chart.basis_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma basis_apply (i : Fin n) : c.basis i = KaehlerDifferential.D ℚ R (c.x i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [basis]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.conormal_injective
statement:
lemma conormal_injective [Algebra.FormallySmooth ℚ R]
    [Algebra.FormallySmooth ℚ (ResidueField R)] :
    Function.Injective (KaehlerDifferential.kerCotangentToTensor ℚ R (ResidueField R))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := (Algebra.FormallySmooth.iff_split_injection (R := ℚ) (P := R)
    (A := ResidueField R) (residue_surjective)).1 inferInstance
  exact Function.LeftInverse.injective (g := l) fun x => by
    rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, hl, LinearMap.id_apply]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.mem_sq_of_tmul_eq_zero
statement:
lemma mem_sq_of_tmul_eq_zero [Algebra.FormallySmooth ℚ R]
    [Algebra.FormallySmooth ℚ (ResidueField R)] {r : R} (hr : r ∈ maximalIdeal R)
    (h : (1 : ResidueField R) ⊗ₜ[R] KaehlerDifferential.D ℚ R r = 0) :
    r ∈ maximalIdeal R ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hrk : r ∈ RingHom.ker (algebraMap R (ResidueField R)) := by
    rw [show algebraMap R (ResidueField R) = residue R from rfl, ker_residue]; exact hr
  have h0 : (RingHom.ker (algebraMap R (ResidueField R))).toCotangent ⟨r, hrk⟩ = 0 := by
    apply conormal_injective
    rw [KaehlerDifferential.kerCotangentToTensor_toCotangent, map_zero]
    exact h
  rw [Ideal.toCotangent_eq_zero] at h0
  have h1 : r ∈ (RingHom.ker (algebraMap R (ResidueField R))) ^ 2 := h0
  rwa [show algebraMap R (ResidueField R) = residue R from rfl, ker_residue] at h1

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.Chart.isCentred_of_mem
statement:
theorem isCentred_of_mem [IsNoetherianRing R] [Algebra.FormallySmooth ℚ R]
    [Algebra.FormallySmooth ℚ (ResidueField R)] (hx : ∀ i, c.x i ∈ maximalIdeal R) :
    c.IsCentred
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ((Ideal.span_le).2 (by rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact hx i))
  refine Submodule.le_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson_bot (IsNoetherian.noetherian _)
    (maximalIdeal_le_jacobson _) ?_
  intro r hr
  set r' := r - ∑ i, c.d i r * c.x i with hr'
  have hr'm : r' ∈ maximalIdeal R :=
    sub_mem hr (Ideal.sum_mem _ fun i _ => Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (hx i))
  have hd : ∀ l, c.d l r' ∈ maximalIdeal R := by
    intro l
    have : ∀ i, c.d l (c.d i r * c.x i) =
        (if l = i then c.d i r else 0) + c.x i * c.d l (c.d i r) := by
      intro i
      rw [Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, c.d_x, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero]
    rw [hr', map_sub, map_sum]
    simp only [this, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, ite_true]
    rw [sub_add_cancel_left]
    exact neg_mem (Ideal.sum_mem _ fun i _ => Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (hx i))
  have h2 : r' ∈ maximalIdeal R ^ 2 := by
    refine mem_sq_of_tmul_eq_zero hr'm ?_
    rw [c.kD_eq_sum r', tmul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun l _ => ?_
    rw [← TensorProduct.smul_tmul]
    rw [show (c.d l r' • (1 : ResidueField R)) = 0 from by
      rw [Algebra.smul_def, mul_one]; exact (residue_eq_zero_iff _).2 (hd l)]
    rw [zero_tmul]
  have : r = r' + ∑ i, c.d i r * c.x i := by rw [hr']; ring
  rw [this]
  refine add_mem (Submodule.mem_sup_right ?_) (Submodule.mem_sup_left (Ideal.sum_mem _ fun i _ =>
    Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩)))
  rw [smul_eq_mul, ← pow_two]; exact h2

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.Chart.exists_centred
statement:
theorem exists_centred [IsNoetherianRing R] [Algebra.FormallySmooth ℚ R]
    [Algebra.FormallySmooth ℚ (ResidueField R)] [Algebra.IsIntegral ℚ (ResidueField R)]
    (c : Chart R n) :
    ∃ c' : Chart R n, c'.IsCentred ∧ ∀ i, c.x i ∈ maximalIdeal R → c'.x i = c.x i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set P : Fin n → ℚ[X] := fun i => minpoly ℚ (residue R (c.x i)) with hP
  set y : Fin n → R := fun i => aeval (c.x i) (P i) with hy
  have hsep : ∀ i, (P i).Separable := fun i =>
    Algebra.IsSeparable.isSeparable ℚ (residue R (c.x i))
  have hmap : ∀ (a : R) (p : ℚ[X]), residue R (aeval a p) = aeval (residue R a) p := fun a p =>
    (Polynomial.aeval_algebraMap_apply (B := ResidueField R) a p).symm
  have hres : ∀ i, residue R (aeval (c.x i) (derivative (P i))) ≠ 0 := by
    intro i
    rw [hmap]
    exact (hsep i).aeval_derivative_ne_zero (minpoly.aeval ℚ _)
  have hjac : c.jac y = Matrix.diagonal fun j => aeval (c.x j) (derivative (P j)) := by
    ext i j
    simp only [jac, Matrix.of_apply, hy, Derivation.map_aeval, c.d_x, smul_eq_mul, mul_ite,
      mul_one, mul_zero, Matrix.diagonal_apply]
    split_ifs <;> simp_all
  have hdet : IsUnit (c.jac y).det := by
    rw [hjac, Matrix.det_diagonal, IsUnit.prod_univ_iff]
    intro j
    rw [← notMem_maximalIdeal, ← residue_eq_zero_iff]; exact hres j
  refine ⟨c.change y hdet, isCentred_of_mem fun i => ?_, fun i hi => ?_⟩
  · rw [change_x, ← residue_eq_zero_iff, hy]
    simp only
    rw [hmap]
    exact minpoly.aeval ℚ _
  · rw [change_x, hy]
    simp only [hP, (residue_eq_zero_iff _).2 hi, minpoly.zero, aeval_X]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.MC.SA.step_run_of
statement:
theorem SA.step_run_of (hSA : SA I j J) (hna : ¬ J.Adm I) (βs : Fin n →₀ ℕ) (f : R) (hf : f ∈ I)
    (hfne : coeff βs (J.c.tau f) ≠ 0) (hlt : lam J.e βs < 1) (hN : 0 < tailSum j βs)
    (hmin : ∀ β : Fin n →₀ ℕ, (∃ g ∈ I, coeff β (J.c.tau g) ≠ 0) → lam J.e β < 1 →
      Xi J.e j βs ≤ Xi J.e j β) (l : Fin n) (hl : j ≤ (l : ℕ)) (hβl : βs l ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (hj : j < n) (_ : IsUnit (J.c.D βs f))
      (_ : ∀ i : Fin n, (i : ℕ) < j → nextW J.e j βs ≤ J.e i)
      (u : Rˣ) (hu : J.c.d l (J.c.Dv (βs - Finsupp.single l 1) f) = u)
      (hc : (nextChart J.c ⟨j, hj⟩ l (J.c.Dv (βs - Finsupp.single l 1) f) u hu).IsCentred)
      (hnn : ∀ i, 0 ≤ nextE J.e j (nextW J.e j βs) i)
      (ha : Antitone (nextE J.e j (nextW J.e j βs))),
      SA I (j + 1) ⟨nextChart J.c ⟨j, hj⟩ l (J.c.Dv (βs - Finsupp.single l 1) f) u hu,
        nextE J.e j (nextW J.e j βs), hc, hnn, ha⟩
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨hj, β₀, f₀, hf₀, hf₀ne, hlt₀, hN₀, hmin₀, hnext₀, hbJ₀⟩ := hSA.step_data hna
  have hXi : Xi J.e j βs = Xi J.e j β₀ :=
    le_antisymm (hmin β₀ ⟨f₀, hf₀, hf₀ne⟩ hlt₀) (hmin₀ βs ⟨f, hf, hfne⟩ hlt)
  have hW : (1 - lam J.e βs) / tailSum j βs = (1 - lam J.e β₀) / tailSum j β₀ := by
    have h1 : (1 - lam J.e βs) / tailSum j βs = (Xi J.e j βs)⁻¹ := by rw [Xi, inv_div]
    have h2 : (1 - lam J.e β₀) / tailSum j β₀ = (Xi J.e j β₀)⁻¹ := by rw [Xi, inv_div]
    rw [h1, h2, hXi]
  have hnext : ∀ J' : MC R n, J'.Adm I → (∀ i : Fin n, (i : ℕ) < j → J'.e i = J.e i) →
      0 < J'.e ⟨j, hj⟩ ∧ (1 - lam J.e βs) / tailSum j βs ≤ J'.e ⟨j, hj⟩ := by
    intro J' hJ' hag; rw [hW]; exact hnext₀ J' hJ' hag
  have hbJ : ∀ i : Fin n, (i : ℕ) < j → (1 - lam J.e βs) / tailSum j βs ≤ J.e i := by
    intro i hi; rw [hW]; exact hbJ₀ i hi
  set jj : Fin n := ⟨j, hj⟩ with hjj
  set bp : ℚ := (1 - lam J.e βs) / tailSum j βs with hbpdef
  have hNq : (0 : ℚ) < tailSum j βs := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hbp : 0 < bp := div_pos (by linarith) hNq
  have hzero : ∀ i : Fin n, j ≤ (i : ℕ) → J.e i = 0 := fun i hi => hSA.e_eq_zero hi
  have hkey : lam J.e βs + bp * tailSum j βs = 1 := by
    rw [hbpdef]; field_simp; ring
  have hS_bound : ∀ β : Fin n →₀ ℕ, (∃ g ∈ I, coeff β (J.c.tau g) ≠ 0) → lam J.e β < 1 →
      1 ≤ lam J.e β + bp * tailSum j β := by
    intro β hβ hβlt
    have hX := hmin β hβ hβlt
    simp only [Xi] at hX
    have h1 : 0 < 1 - lam J.e β := by linarith
    have h2 : 0 < 1 - lam J.e βs := by linarith
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ h2 h1] at hX
    have : 1 - lam J.e β ≤ bp * tailSum j β := by
      rw [hbpdef, div_mul_eq_mul_div, le_div_iff₀ hNq]; linarith
    linarith
  
  have hc_nonneg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ compl J.e j bp i := fun i => by
    simp only [compl]; split_ifs
    · exact J.nonneg i
    · exact hbp.le
  have hc_anti : Antitone (compl J.e j bp) := by
    intro i i' hii'
    simp only [compl]
    by_cases h1 : (i' : ℕ) < j
    · have h2 : (i : ℕ) < j := lt_of_le_of_lt (Fin.le_def.1 hii') h1
      rw [ite_eq_left h1, ite_eq_left h2]; exact J.anti hii'
    · rw [ite_eq_right h1]
      by_cases h2 : (i : ℕ) < j
      · rw [ite_eq_left h2]; exact hbJ i h2
      · rw [ite_eq_right h2]
  have hc_adm : I ≤ J.c.RF (compl J.e j bp) 1 := by
    intro g hg
    rw [J.centred.mem_RF_iff hc_nonneg]
    intro β hβ
    by_contra hne
    rw [lam_compl hzero] at hβ
    by_cases hβ1 : lam J.e β < 1
    · have := hS_bound β ⟨g, hg, hne⟩ hβ1; linarith
    · have : 0 ≤ bp * tailSum j β := mul_nonneg hbp.le (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
      linarith
  
  set γ := βs - Finsupp.single l 1 with hγdef
  have hγ : γ + Finsupp.single l 1 = βs := add_single_sub hβl
  have hlamγ : lam J.e γ = lam J.e βs := by
    rw [← hγ, lam_add, lam_single, hzero l hl, mul_zero, add_zero]
  have htailγ : tailSum j γ + 1 = tailSum j βs := tailSum_sub_single hl hβl
  set xb := J.c.Dv γ f with hxb
  have hdl : J.c.d l xb = ((γ l + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) • J.c.Dv βs f := by rw [hxb, Chart.d_Dv, hγ]
  have hdl_nm : J.c.d l xb ∉ maximalIdeal R := by
    intro hmem
    rw [hdl, ← residue_eq_zero_iff, map_rat_smul] at hmem
    rw [← Chart.coeff_tau] at hmem
    exact hfne ((smul_eq_zero.1 hmem).resolve_left (by positivity))
  have hxb_mem : xb ∈ maximalIdeal R := by
    rw [hxb, ← residue_eq_zero_iff, ← Chart.coeff_tau]
    by_contra hne
    have hX := hmin γ ⟨f, hf, hne⟩ (by rw [hlamγ]; exact hlt)
    simp only [Xi, hlamγ] at hX
    have h2 : 0 < 1 - lam J.e βs := by linarith
    rw [div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right h2] at hX
    have : ((tailSum j γ : ℕ) : ℚ) + 1 = tailSum j βs := by exact_mod_cast htailγ
    linarith
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := notMem_maximalIdeal.1 hdl_nm
  
  set cp := (J.c.replace l xb u hu.symm).reindex (Equiv.swap jj l) with hcp
  have hcp_centred : cp.IsCentred := (J.centred.replace l xb u hu.symm hxb_mem).reindex _
  set ep : Fin n → ℚ := fun i => if (i : ℕ) < j then J.e i else if (i : ℕ) = j then bp else 0
    with hep
  have hep_nonneg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ ep i := fun i => by
    simp only [hep]; split_ifs
    · exact J.nonneg i
    · exact hbp.le
    · exact le_rfl
  have hep_anti : Antitone ep := by
    intro i i' hii'
    have hle := Fin.le_def.1 hii'
    simp only [hep]
    by_cases h1 : (i' : ℕ) < j
    · rw [ite_eq_left h1, ite_eq_left (lt_of_le_of_lt hle h1)]; exact J.anti hii'
    · rw [ite_eq_right h1]
      by_cases h2 : (i' : ℕ) = j
      · rw [ite_eq_left h2]
        by_cases h3 : (i : ℕ) < j
        · rw [ite_eq_left h3]; exact hbJ i h3
        · rw [ite_eq_right h3, ite_eq_left (by omega)]
      · rw [ite_eq_right h2]
        split_ifs
        · exact J.nonneg i
        · exact hbp.le
        · exact le_rfl
  have hcp_x_lt : ∀ i : Fin n, (i : ℕ) < j → cp.x i = J.c.x i := by
    intro i hi
    have h1 : i ≠ jj := fun h => by rw [h] at hi; simp [hjj] at hi
    have h2 : i ≠ l := fun h => by rw [h] at hi; omega
    rw [hcp, Chart.reindex_x, Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne h1 h2, J.c.replace_x_ne _ _ _ _ h2]
  have hcp_x_j : cp.x jj = xb := by
    rw [hcp, Chart.reindex_x, Equiv.swap_apply_left, J.c.replace_x_self]
  have hunitD : IsUnit (J.c.D βs f) := by
    rw [← notMem_maximalIdeal]
    intro hmem
    apply hfne
    rw [Chart.coeff_tau, residue_eq_zero_iff, Chart.Dv, Algebra.smul_def]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hmem
  refine ⟨hj, hunitD, hbJ, u, hu.symm, hcp_centred, hep_nonneg,
    hep_anti, ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · 
    intro i
    show ep i ≠ 0 ↔ (i : ℕ) < j + 1
    simp only [hep]
    by_cases h1 : (i : ℕ) < j
    · rw [ite_eq_left h1]; exact ⟨fun _ => by omega, fun _ => (hSA.supp i).2 h1⟩
    · rw [ite_eq_right h1]
      by_cases h2 : (i : ℕ) = j
      · rw [ite_eq_left h2]; exact ⟨fun _ => by omega, fun _ => hbp.ne'⟩
      · rw [ite_eq_right h2]; exact ⟨fun h => absurd rfl h, fun h => by omega⟩
  · 
    refine ⟨⟨J.c, compl J.e j bp, J.centred, hc_nonneg, hc_anti⟩, hc_adm, fun i hi => ?_⟩
    show compl J.e j bp i = ep i
    simp only [compl, hep]
    by_cases h1 : (i : ℕ) < j
    · rw [ite_eq_left h1, ite_eq_left h1]
    · rw [ite_eq_right h1, ite_eq_right h1, ite_eq_left (by omega)]
  · 
    intro J' hJ' i hi hbelow
    by_cases h1 : (i : ℕ) < j
    · have : ep i = J.e i := by simp only [hep, ite_eq_left h1]
      show ep i ≤ J'.e i
      rw [this]
      refine hSA.max J' hJ' i h1 fun i' hi' => ?_
      rw [hbelow i' hi']
      show ep i' = J.e i'
      simp only [hep, ite_eq_left (lt_trans (Fin.lt_def.1 hi') h1)]
    · have hij : (i : ℕ) = j := by omega
      have hieq : i = jj := Fin.ext hij
      subst hieq
      have hag : ∀ i' : Fin n, (i' : ℕ) < j → J'.e i' = J.e i' := fun i' hi' => by
        rw [hbelow i' (Fin.lt_def.2 hi')]
        show ep i' = J.e i'
        simp only [hep, ite_eq_left hi']
      have := (hnext J' hJ' hag).2
      show ep jj ≤ J'.e jj
      simp only [hep, ite_eq_right h1, ite_eq_left hij]
      exact this
  · 
    intro J' hJ' hag
    have hag_j : ∀ i : Fin n, (i : ℕ) < j → J'.e i = J.e i := fun i hi => by
      rw [hag i (by omega)]; show ep i = J.e i; simp only [hep, ite_eq_left hi]
    have hJ'j : J'.e jj = bp := by
      rw [hag jj (by simp [hjj])]; show ep jj = bp; simp [hep, hjj]
    obtain ⟨c'', hc'', hRF, hx⟩ := hSA.dom J' hJ' hag_j
    have hf' : f ∈ c''.RF J'.e 1 := by rw [hRF]; exact hJ' hf
    
    have hlow : ∀ i, c''.LowersBy J'.e (J.c.d i) (compl J.e j bp i) := by
      intro i
      by_cases hi : (i : ℕ) < j
      · have := hc''.lowersBy_lt (c := J.c) J'.nonneg J'.anti (fun i' hi' => (hx i' hi').symm) i hi
        simp only [compl, ite_eq_left hi]
        rwa [hag_j i hi] at this
      · simp only [compl, ite_eq_right hi]
        refine hc''.lowersBy_ge (c := J.c) J'.nonneg (fun i' hi' => (hx i' hi').symm) i (by omega)
          fun m hm => ?_
        rw [← hJ'j]; exact J'.anti (Fin.le_def.2 (by simp only [hjj, Fin.val_mk]; omega))
    have hxb_RF : xb ∈ c''.RF J'.e bp := by
      have hm1 := Chart.Dv_mem_RF_of_lowersBy c'' J.c J'.e (compl J.e j bp) hlow γ hf'
      rw [lam_compl hzero, hlamγ] at hm1
      have htq : ((tailSum j γ : ℕ) : ℚ) + 1 = tailSum j βs := by exact_mod_cast htailγ
      have hm2 : 1 - (lam J.e βs + bp * (tailSum j γ : ℚ)) = bp := by
        have := hkey; rw [← htq] at this; linarith
      rw [hm2] at hm1
      exact hm1
    
    obtain ⟨m, hm, hmnm⟩ : ∃ m : Fin n, j ≤ (m : ℕ) ∧ c''.d m xb ∉ maximalIdeal R := by
      by_contra hcon
      push Not at hcon
      apply hdl_nm
      rw [c''.eq_sum (J.c.d l), Derivation.sum_apply']
      refine Ideal.sum_mem _ fun m _ => ?_
      rw [Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      by_cases hmj : (m : ℕ) < j
      · rw [hx m hmj, J.c.d_x, ite_eq_right (fun h => by rw [h] at hl; omega), zero_mul]
        exact zero_mem _
      · exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (hcon m (by omega))
    have hJ'm : J'.e m = bp := by
      refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
      · rw [← hJ'j]; exact J'.anti (Fin.le_def.2 (by simp only [hjj, Fin.val_mk]; omega))
      · by_contra hlt'
        push Not at hlt'
        have := (hc''.mem_RF_iff J'.nonneg bp xb).1 hxb_RF (Finsupp.single m 1) (by
          rw [lam_single]; simpa using hlt')
        rw [Chart.coeff_tau_eq_zero_iff, Chart.Dv_single_one] at this
        exact hmnm this
    obtain ⟨u', hu'⟩ := notMem_maximalIdeal.1 hmnm
    refine ⟨(c''.replace m xb u' hu'.symm).reindex (Equiv.swap jj m),
      (hc''.replace m xb u' hu'.symm hxb_mem).reindex _, fun t => ?_, fun i hi => ?_⟩
    · rw [Chart.RF_reindex _ _ (fun i => by
          rcases eq_or_ne i jj with h | h
          · rw [h, Equiv.swap_apply_left, hJ'm, hJ'j]
          · rcases eq_or_ne i m with h' | h'
            · rw [h', Equiv.swap_apply_right, hJ'm, hJ'j]
            · rw [Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne h h'])]
      rw [hc''.RF_replace J'.nonneg m xb u' hu'.symm hxb_mem (by rw [hJ'm]; exact hxb_RF), hRF]
    · show ((c''.replace m xb u' hu'.symm).reindex (Equiv.swap jj m)).x i = cp.x i
      by_cases hij : (i : ℕ) < j
      · have h1 : i ≠ jj := fun h => by rw [h] at hij; simp [hjj] at hij
        have h2 : i ≠ m := fun h => by rw [h] at hij; omega
        rw [Chart.reindex_x, Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne h1 h2, c''.replace_x_ne _ _ _ _ h2,
          hx i hij, hcp_x_lt i hij]
      · have hieq : i = jj := Fin.ext (by simp [hjj]; omega)
        subst hieq
        rw [Chart.reindex_x, Equiv.swap_apply_left, c''.replace_x_self, hcp_x_j]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.Chart.laurent_x_last
statement: lemma Chart.laurent_x_last (c : Chart B n) : c.laurent.x (Fin.last n) = T 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [Chart.laurent]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.Chart.laurent_d_C
statement:
lemma Chart.laurent_d_C (c : Chart B n) (i : Fin n) (b : B) :
    c.laurent.d (Fin.castSucc i) (LaurentPolynomial.C b) = LaurentPolynomial.C (c.d i b)
proof:
:= by
  have h := Chart.localization_d (S := B[T;T⁻¹]) (Submonoid.powers (X : B[X])) c.polynomial
    (Fin.castSucc i) (Polynomial.C b)
  simp only [algebraMap_eq_toLaurent, Polynomial.toLaurent_C, Chart.polynomial_d_castSucc,
    polyExt_C] at h
  exact h

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.derivation_T_of
statement:
lemma derivation_T_of {D : Derivation ℚ B[T;T⁻¹] B[T;T⁻¹]} (h : D (T 1) = 0) (m : ℤ) :
    D (T m) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hnat : ∀ k : ℕ, D (T k) = 0 := by
    intro k
    have : (T k : B[T;T⁻¹]) = T 1 ^ k := by rw [T_pow, mul_one]
    rw [this, Derivation.leibniz_pow, h]; simp
  rcases Int.eq_nat_or_neg m with ⟨k, rfl | rfl⟩
  · exact hnat k
  · have h1 : (T (-(k : ℤ)) : B[T;T⁻¹]) * T k = 1 := by rw [← T_add, neg_add_cancel, T_zero]
    have h2 := congrArg D h1
    rw [Derivation.leibniz, hnat k, smul_zero, zero_add, Derivation.map_one_eq_zero,
      smul_eq_mul] at h2
    have hu : IsUnit (T k : B[T;T⁻¹]) := isUnit_T _
    exact hu.mul_right_eq_zero.1 h2

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.derivation_T_of_one
statement:
lemma derivation_T_of_one {D : Derivation ℚ B[T;T⁻¹] B[T;T⁻¹]} (h : D (T 1) = 1) (m : ℤ) :
    D (T m) = (m : B[T;T⁻¹]) * T (m - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hnat : ∀ k : ℕ, D (T k) = (k : B[T;T⁻¹]) * T (k - 1) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => simp [T_zero]
    | succ k ih =>
      have : (T ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) : B[T;T⁻¹]) = T k * T 1 := by rw [← T_add]; push_cast; rfl
      rw [this, Derivation.leibniz, ih, h, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
      have e1 : (T 1 : B[T;T⁻¹]) * ((k : B[T;T⁻¹]) * T (k - 1)) = (k : B[T;T⁻¹]) * T k := by
        rw [mul_left_comm, ← T_add]; congr 2; ring
      rw [e1]; push_cast
      rw [show ((k : ℤ) + 1 - 1) = k by ring]; ring
  rcases Int.eq_nat_or_neg m with ⟨k, rfl | rfl⟩
  · rw [Int.cast_natCast]; exact hnat k
  · have h1 : (T (-(k : ℤ)) : B[T;T⁻¹]) * T k = 1 := by rw [← T_add, neg_add_cancel, T_zero]
    have h2 := congrArg D h1
    rw [Derivation.leibniz, hnat k, Derivation.map_one_eq_zero, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul] at h2
    have hu : IsUnit (T k : B[T;T⁻¹]) := isUnit_T _
    have e1 : (T (-(k : ℤ)) : B[T;T⁻¹]) * ((k : B[T;T⁻¹]) * T (k - 1)) =
        (k : B[T;T⁻¹]) * T (-1) := by
      rw [mul_left_comm, ← T_add]; congr 2; ring
    have e2 : (T k : B[T;T⁻¹]) * ((((-(k : ℤ)) : ℤ) : B[T;T⁻¹]) * T (-(k : ℤ) - 1)) =
        -((k : B[T;T⁻¹]) * T (-1)) := by
      rw [mul_left_comm, ← T_add, show (k : ℤ) + (-(k : ℤ) - 1) = -1 by ring]
      push_cast; ring
    have h3 : (T k : B[T;T⁻¹]) * D (T (-(k : ℤ))) =
        T k * ((((-(k : ℤ)) : ℤ) : B[T;T⁻¹]) * T (-(k : ℤ) - 1)) := by
      rw [e2]; linear_combination h2 - e1
    exact hu.mul_left_cancel h3

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.Chart.laurent_d_castSucc_T
statement:
lemma Chart.laurent_d_castSucc_T (c : Chart B n) (i : Fin n) (m : ℤ) :
    c.laurent.d (Fin.castSucc i) (T m) = 0
proof:
:=
  derivation_T_of (by rw [← c.laurent_x_last, c.laurent.d_x, ite_eq_right (Fin.castSucc_lt_last i).ne]) m

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.Chart.laurent_d_last_T
statement:
lemma Chart.laurent_d_last_T (c : Chart B n) (m : ℤ) :
    c.laurent.d (Fin.last n) (T m) = (m : B[T;T⁻¹]) * T (m - 1)
proof:
:=
  derivation_T_of_one (by rw [← c.laurent_x_last, c.laurent.d_x, ite_eq_left rfl]) m

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.Chart.laurent_d_last_C
statement:
lemma Chart.laurent_d_last_C (c : Chart B n) (b : B) :
    c.laurent.d (Fin.last n) (LaurentPolynomial.C b) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := Chart.localization_d (S := B[T;T⁻¹]) (Submonoid.powers (X : B[X])) c.polynomial
    (Fin.last n) (Polynomial.C b)
  simp only [algebraMap_eq_toLaurent, Polynomial.toLaurent_C, Chart.polynomial_d_last,
    polyExt_C, Derivation.zero_apply, map_zero] at h
  exact h

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.coeff_C_mul_T
statement:
lemma coeff_C_mul_T (a : B) (m j : ℤ) :
    (LaurentPolynomial.C a * T m : B[T;T⁻¹]).coeff j = if j = m then a else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← single_eq_C_mul_T, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_apply]
  by_cases h : j = m
  · subst h; simp
  · rw [ite_eq_right (Ne.symm h), ite_eq_right h]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.coeff_T_mul
statement: lemma coeff_T_mul (p : B[T;T⁻¹]) (m j : ℤ) : (T m * p).coeff j = p.coeff (j - m)
proof:
:= by
  induction p using LaurentPolynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq => rw [mul_add, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_add, Finsupp.add_apply, hp, hq,
      AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_add, Finsupp.add_apply]
  | C_mul_T l a =>
    rw [mul_left_comm, ← T_add, coeff_C_mul_T, coeff_C_mul_T]
    congr 1; apply propext; omega

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.Chart.laurent_d_castSucc_coeff
statement:
lemma Chart.laurent_d_castSucc_coeff (c : Chart B n) (i : Fin n) (p : B[T;T⁻¹]) (j : ℤ) :
    (c.laurent.d (Fin.castSucc i) p).coeff j = c.d i (p.coeff j)
proof:
:= by
  induction p using LaurentPolynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq => rw [map_add, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_add, Finsupp.add_apply, hp, hq,
      AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_add, Finsupp.add_apply, map_add]
  | C_mul_T m a =>
    rw [Derivation.leibniz, c.laurent_d_castSucc_T, smul_zero, zero_add, c.laurent_d_C,
      smul_eq_mul, mul_comm, coeff_C_mul_T, coeff_C_mul_T]
    split_ifs <;> simp

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.Chart.laurent_d_last_coeff
statement:
lemma Chart.laurent_d_last_coeff (c : Chart B n) (p : B[T;T⁻¹]) (j : ℤ) :
    (c.laurent.d (Fin.last n) p).coeff j = ((j + 1 : ℤ) : B) * p.coeff (j + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction p using LaurentPolynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq => rw [map_add, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_add, Finsupp.add_apply, hp, hq,
      AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_add, Finsupp.add_apply, mul_add]
  | C_mul_T m a =>
    rw [Derivation.leibniz, c.laurent_d_last_T, c.laurent_d_last_C, smul_zero, add_zero,
      smul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc, mul_comm (LaurentPolynomial.C a), ← map_intCast
      (LaurentPolynomial.C : B →+* B[T;T⁻¹]), ← map_mul, coeff_C_mul_T, coeff_C_mul_T]
    by_cases h : j = m - 1
    · rw [ite_eq_left h, ite_eq_left (by omega), h]; ring_nf
    · rw [ite_eq_right h, ite_eq_right (by omega), mul_zero]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.Chart.d_mono_mem_RF
statement:
lemma Chart.d_mono_mem_RF (c : Chart B n) (e : Fin n → ℚ) (i : Fin n) :
    ∀ α : Fin n →₀ ℕ, (∀ l, e l = 0 → α l = 0) →
      c.d i (∏ l, c.x l ^ α l) ∈ c.RF e (lam e α - e i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine Finsupp.induction_single ?_ fun β j ih => ?_
  · intro _; simp
  · intro hα
    have hβ : ∀ l, e l = 0 → β l = 0 := fun l hl => by
      have := hα l hl; simp only [Finsupp.add_apply] at this; omega
    have hej : e j ≠ 0 := fun h => by
      have := hα j h; simp at this
    rw [prod_pow_add_single, Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, c.d_x]
    refine add_mem ?_ ?_
    · by_cases hij : i = j
      · subst hij
        rw [ite_eq_left rfl, mul_one]
        refine Ideal.subset_span ⟨β, hβ, ?_, rfl⟩
        rw [lam_add, lam_single]; simp
      · rw [ite_eq_right hij, mul_zero]; exact zero_mem _
    · have h1 := ih hβ
      have h2 := c.x_mem_RF e j hej
      have := c.RF_mul_le e _ _ (Ideal.mul_mem_mul h2 h1)
      convert this using 2
      rw [lam_add, lam_single]; ring

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.Chart.lowersBy_self
statement:
lemma Chart.lowersBy_self (c : Chart B n) {e : Fin n → ℚ} (he : ∀ i, 0 ≤ e i) (i : Fin n) :
    c.LowersBy e (c.d i) (e i)
proof:
:= by
  intro t f hf
  induction hf using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem g hg =>
    obtain ⟨α, hα0, hαt, rfl⟩ := hg
    exact c.RF_antitone e (by linarith) (c.d_mono_mem_RF e i α hα0)
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul a x hxm hx =>
    rw [smul_eq_mul, Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    refine add_mem (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hx) ?_
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (c.RF_antitone e (by linarith [he i]) hxm)

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.coeff_C_mul'
statement:
lemma coeff_C_mul' (a : B) (p : B[T;T⁻¹]) (m : ℤ) :
    (LaurentPolynomial.C a * p).coeff m = a * p.coeff m
proof:
:= by
  induction p using LaurentPolynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq => rw [mul_add, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_add, Finsupp.add_apply, hp, hq,
      AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_add, Finsupp.add_apply, mul_add]
  | C_mul_T l b =>
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← map_mul, coeff_C_mul_T, coeff_C_mul_T]
    split_ifs <;> simp

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.C_mul_T_mem_ReesAlg
statement:
lemma C_mul_T_mem_ReesAlg {f : B} {j : ℤ} (hf : f ∈ Φ.F j) :
    LaurentPolynomial.C f * T j ∈ ReesAlg Φ
proof:
:= by
  intro m
  rw [coeff_C_mul_T]
  split_ifs with h
  · subst h; exact hf
  · exact zero_mem _

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.chartFil_mul
statement:
lemma chartFil_mul (c : Chart B n) (e : Fin n → ℚ) (d : ℕ) (a b : ℤ) :
    chartFil c e d a * chartFil c e d b ≤ chartFil c e d (a + b)
proof:
:= by
  refine (c.RF_mul_le e _ _).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
  unfold chartFil; congr 1; push_cast; ring

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.eulerD_apply
statement:
lemma eulerD_apply (c : Chart B n) (w : Fin n → ℕ) (f : B) :
    eulerD c w f = ∑ i, (w i : B) * c.x i * c.d i f
proof:
:= by
  rw [eulerD, Derivation.sum_apply']
  simp only [Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.eulerD_mono
statement:
lemma eulerD_mono (c : Chart B n) (w : Fin n → ℕ) :
    ∀ α : Fin n →₀ ℕ, eulerD c w (∏ l, c.x l ^ α l) =
      ((Finsupp.weight w α : ℕ) : B) * ∏ l, c.x l ^ α l
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine Finsupp.induction_single ?_ fun β j ih => ?_
  · simp
  · rw [prod_pow_add_single, Derivation.leibniz, ih, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    have hx : eulerD c w (c.x j) = (w j : B) * c.x j := by
      rw [eulerD_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single j]
      · rw [c.d_x, ite_eq_left rfl, mul_one]
      · intro b _ hb; rw [c.d_x, ite_eq_right hb, mul_zero]
      · simp
    rw [hx, map_add, Finsupp.weight_single]
    push_cast; ring_nf

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.eulerD_sub_mem
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hdq : (0 : ℚ) < d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have hlamw : ∀ α : Fin n →₀ ℕ, lam e α = (Finsupp.weight w α : ℚ) / d := by
    intro α
    rw [lam, Finsupp.weight_eq_sum, eq_div_iff hdq.ne']
    push_cast
    rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [smul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_mul, hw i]; ring
  
  have hE1 : ∀ r : B, eulerD c w r ∈ chartFil c e d 1 := by
    intro r
    rw [eulerD_apply]
    refine Ideal.sum_mem _ fun i _ => ?_
    by_cases hwi : w i = 0
    · rw [hwi, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, zero_mul]; exact zero_mem _
    · have hei : e i ≠ 0 := by
        intro h; apply hwi; have := hw i; rw [h, mul_zero] at this; exact_mod_cast this
      have hx := c.x_mem_RF e i hei
      have : c.x i ∈ chartFil c e d 1 := by
        refine c.RF_antitone e ?_ hx
        have := hw i
        have h1 : (1 : ℚ) ≤ w i := by exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 hwi
        rw [Int.cast_one, div_le_iff₀ hdq]; linarith
      exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ this)
  
  have key : ∀ g ∈ chartFil c e d m, eulerD c w g - (m : B) * g ∈ chartFil c e d (m + 1) := by
    intro g hg
    induction hg using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨α, hα0, hαt, rfl⟩ := hx
      rw [eulerD_mono, ← sub_mul]
      have hmono : ∏ l, c.x l ^ α l ∈ c.RF e (lam e α) :=
        Ideal.subset_span ⟨α, hα0, le_rfl, rfl⟩
      have hαt' : (m : ℚ) ≤ Finsupp.weight w α := by
        have h1 := hαt
        rw [hlamw, Int.cast_natCast, div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hdq] at h1
        exact h1
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge m (Finsupp.weight w α) with hlt | hge
      · refine Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (c.RF_antitone e ?_ hmono)
        rw [hlamw]; push_cast
        rw [div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hdq]; exact_mod_cast hlt
      · have : Finsupp.weight w α = m := le_antisymm hge (by exact_mod_cast hαt')
        rw [this, sub_self, zero_mul]; exact zero_mem _
    | zero => simp
    | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
      rw [map_add, mul_add, add_sub_add_comm]; exact add_mem hx hy
    | smul a x hxm hx =>
      rw [smul_eq_mul, Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
      have e1 : a * eulerD c w x + x * eulerD c w a - (m : B) * (a * x) =
          a * (eulerD c w x - (m : B) * x) + x * eulerD c w a := by ring
      rw [e1]
      refine add_mem (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hx) ?_
      have := chartFil_mul c e d m 1 (Ideal.mul_mem_mul hxm (hE1 a))
      exact this
  exact key f hf

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.derivRestrict_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma derivRestrict_apply {L : Type*} [CommRing L] [Algebra B L] [Algebra ℚ L]
    [IsScalarTower ℚ B L] (A : Subalgebra B L) (D : Derivation ℚ L L) (h : ∀ x ∈ A, D x ∈ A)
    (x : A) : (derivRestrict A D h x : L) = D (x : L)
proof: := rfl

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.reesDu_coeff
statement:
lemma reesDu_coeff (c : Chart B n) (w : Fin n → ℕ) (i : Fin n) (p : B[T;T⁻¹]) (j : ℤ) :
    (reesDu c w i p).coeff j = c.d i (p.coeff (j + w i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [reesDu, Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, coeff_T_mul, c.laurent_d_castSucc_coeff]
  congr 2; ring

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.reesEx_coeff
statement:
lemma reesEx_coeff (c : Chart B n) (w : Fin n → ℕ) (p : B[T;T⁻¹]) (j : ℤ) :
    (reesEx c w p).coeff j = eulerD c w (p.coeff j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [reesEx, Derivation.sum_apply', eulerD_apply]
  rw [show (∑ i, ((LaurentPolynomial.C ((w i : B) * c.x i)) • c.laurent.d (Fin.castSucc i)) p) =
      ∑ i, LaurentPolynomial.C ((w i : B) * c.x i) * c.laurent.d (Fin.castSucc i) p from
    Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by rw [Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]]
  rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_sum, Finset.sum_apply']
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [coeff_C_mul', c.laurent_d_castSucc_coeff]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.reesDs_coeff
statement:
lemma reesDs_coeff (c : Chart B n) (w : Fin n → ℕ) (p : B[T;T⁻¹]) (j : ℤ) :
    (reesDs c w p).coeff j =
      eulerD c w (p.coeff (j - 1)) - ((j - 1 : ℤ) : B) * p.coeff (j - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [reesDs, Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, coeff_T_mul, Derivation.sub_apply,
    AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_sub, Finsupp.sub_apply, reesEx_coeff, Derivation.smul_apply,
    smul_eq_mul, coeff_T_mul, c.laurent_d_last_coeff]
  congr 2
  · push_cast; ring
  · ring_nf

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.reesDu_mem
statement:
lemma reesDu_mem (c : Chart B n) (hF : ∀ j, Φ.F j = chartFil c e d j) (he : ∀ i, 0 ≤ e i)
    (hd : 0 < d) (hw : ∀ i, (w i : ℚ) = d * e i) (i : Fin n) :
    ∀ p ∈ ReesAlg Φ, reesDu c w i p ∈ ReesAlg Φ
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp j
  rw [reesDu_coeff, hF]
  have h := hp (j + w i)
  rw [hF] at h
  have h2 := c.lowersBy_self he i _ _ h
  have hdq : (0 : ℚ) < d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  convert h2 using 2
  rw [show e i = (w i : ℚ) / d by rw [hw i]; field_simp]
  push_cast; field_simp
  simp only [chartFil]; congr 1; ring

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.reesDs_mem
statement:
lemma reesDs_mem (c : Chart B n) (hF : ∀ j, Φ.F j = chartFil c e d j) (he : ∀ i, 0 ≤ e i)
    (hd : 0 < d) (hw : ∀ i, (w i : ℚ) = d * e i) :
    ∀ p ∈ ReesAlg Φ, reesDs c w p ∈ ReesAlg Φ
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp j
  rw [reesDs_coeff]
  by_cases hj : j ≤ 0
  · rw [hF, chartFil, c.RF_of_nonpos he (by
      have : (j : ℚ) ≤ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hj
      exact div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg this (Nat.cast_nonneg _))]
    trivial
  · obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m : ℕ, j - 1 = m := ⟨(j - 1).toNat, by omega⟩
    have h := hp (j - 1)
    rw [hF, hm] at h
    have := eulerD_sub_mem c hd hw m h
    rw [hF, hm, show j = ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) by omega]
    rw [Int.cast_natCast]
    exact this

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.reesU_mem
statement:
lemma reesU_mem (c : Chart B n) (hF : ∀ j, Φ.F j = chartFil c e d j) (he : ∀ i, 0 ≤ e i)
    (hd : 0 < d) (hw : ∀ i, (w i : ℚ) = d * e i) (i : Fin n) :
    LaurentPolynomial.C (c.x i) * T (w i) ∈ ReesAlg Φ
proof:
:= by
  apply C_mul_T_mem_ReesAlg
  rw [hF, chartFil]
  have hdq : (0 : ℚ) < d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  by_cases hei : e i = 0
  · rw [c.RF_of_nonpos he (by
      have : (w i : ℚ) = 0 := by rw [hw i, hei, mul_zero]
      rw [Int.cast_natCast, this, zero_div])]
    trivial
  · have h := c.x_mem_RF e i hei
    convert h using 2
    rw [Int.cast_natCast, hw i]; field_simp

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.reesS_mem
statement:
lemma reesS_mem (c : Chart B n) (hF : ∀ j, Φ.F j = chartFil c e d j) (he : ∀ i, 0 ≤ e i) :
    (T (-1) : B[T;T⁻¹]) ∈ ReesAlg Φ
proof:
:= by
  have : (T (-1) : B[T;T⁻¹]) = LaurentPolynomial.C 1 * T (-1) := by rw [map_one, one_mul]
  rw [this]
  apply C_mul_T_mem_ReesAlg
  rw [hF, chartFil, c.RF_of_nonpos he (by
    have : ((-1 : ℤ) : ℚ) = -1 := by norm_num
    rw [this]; exact div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (by norm_num) (Nat.cast_nonneg _))]
  trivial

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.eulerD_x
statement: lemma eulerD_x (w : Fin n → ℕ) (b : Fin n) : eulerD c w (c.x b) = (w b : B) * c.x b
proof:
:= by
  rw [eulerD_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single b]
  · rw [c.d_x, ite_eq_left rfl, mul_one]
  · intro a _ hab; rw [c.d_x, ite_eq_right hab, mul_zero]
  · simp

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.coeff_one_laurent
statement: lemma coeff_one_laurent (j : ℤ) : (1 : B[T;T⁻¹]).coeff j = if j = 0 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← T_zero, T_apply]; simp [eq_comm]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.reesX_last
statement: @[simp] lemma reesX_last : (reesX c hF he hd hw (Fin.last n) : B[T;T⁻¹]) = T (-1)
proof:
:= by
  simp [reesX]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.reesX_castSucc
statement:
@[simp] lemma reesX_castSucc (i : Fin n) :
    (reesX c hF he hd hw (Fin.castSucc i) : B[T;T⁻¹]) = LaurentPolynomial.C (c.x i) * T (w i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [reesX]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.reesDer_last
statement:
@[simp] lemma reesDer_last (p : ReesAlg Φ) :
    (reesDer c hF he hd hw (Fin.last n) p : B[T;T⁻¹]) = reesDs c w p
proof:
:= by
  simp [reesDer]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.reesDer_castSucc
statement:
@[simp] lemma reesDer_castSucc (i : Fin n) (p : ReesAlg Φ) :
    (reesDer c hF he hd hw (Fin.castSucc i) p : B[T;T⁻¹]) = reesDu c w i p
proof:
:= by
  simp [reesDer]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.reesDer_reesX
statement:
lemma reesDer_reesX (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    reesDer c hF he hd hw i (reesX c hF he hd hw j) = if i = j then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply LaurentPolynomial.ext
  intro m
  have h1 : ((1 : ReesAlg Φ) : B[T;T⁻¹]) = 1 := rfl
  have h0' : ((0 : ReesAlg Φ) : B[T;T⁻¹]) = 0 := rfl
  cases i using Fin.lastCases with
  | last =>
    cases j using Fin.lastCases with
    | last =>
      rw [reesDer_last, reesX_last, reesDs_coeff, ite_eq_left rfl, h1, coeff_one_laurent, T_apply]
      by_cases hm : m = 0
      · subst hm; simp
      · rw [ite_eq_right (by omega), ite_eq_right hm]; simp
    | cast b =>
      rw [reesDer_last, reesX_castSucc, reesDs_coeff, ite_eq_right (Fin.castSucc_lt_last b).ne', h0',
        coeff_C_mul_T]
      split_ifs with h
      · rw [eulerD_x, h]; push_cast; simp
      · simp
  | cast a =>
    cases j using Fin.lastCases with
    | last =>
      rw [reesDer_castSucc, reesX_last, reesDu_coeff, ite_eq_right (Fin.castSucc_lt_last a).ne, h0',
        T_apply]
      split_ifs <;> simp
    | cast b =>
      rw [reesDer_castSucc, reesX_castSucc, reesDu_coeff, coeff_C_mul_T]
      by_cases hab : a = b
      · subst hab
        rw [ite_eq_left rfl, h1, coeff_one_laurent]
        by_cases hm : m = 0
        · subst hm; simp [c.d_x_self]
        · rw [ite_eq_right (by omega), ite_eq_right hm, map_zero]
      · rw [ite_eq_right (fun h => hab (Fin.castSucc_injective _ h)), h0']
        split_ifs
        · rw [c.d_x_ne hab]; simp
        · simp

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.reesX_castSucc_mul_pow
statement:
lemma reesX_castSucc_mul_pow (i : Fin n) :
    algebraMap B RA (c.x i) =
      reesX c hF he hd hw (Fin.castSucc i) * reesX c hF he hd hw (Fin.last n) ^ w i
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [Subalgebra.coe_mul, SubmonoidClass.coe_pow, reesX_castSucc, reesX_last, T_pow, mul_assoc,
    ← T_add, show (w i : ℤ) + ((w i : ℕ) : ℤ) * (-1) = 0 by ring, T_zero, mul_one,
    Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap, ← LaurentPolynomial.C_eq_algebraMap]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.prod_T_eq
statement:
lemma prod_T_eq {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℤ) :
    ∏ i ∈ s, (T (f i) : B[T;T⁻¹]) = T (∑ i ∈ s, f i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp [T_zero]
  | insert a s ha ih => rw [Finset.prod_insert ha, Finset.sum_insert ha, ih, ← T_add]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.reesX_span
statement:
theorem reesX_span :
    Submodule.span (ReesAlg Φ) (Set.range fun i =>
      KaehlerDifferential.D ℚ (ReesAlg Φ) (reesX c hF he hd hw i)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set W := Submodule.span (ReesAlg Φ) (Set.range fun i =>
      KaehlerDifferential.D ℚ (ReesAlg Φ) (reesX c hF he hd hw i)) with hWdef
  have hX : ∀ i, KaehlerDifferential.D ℚ (ReesAlg Φ) (reesX c hF he hd hw i) ∈ W :=
    fun i => Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩
  have hmul : ∀ x y : ReesAlg Φ, KaehlerDifferential.D ℚ (ReesAlg Φ) x ∈ W →
      KaehlerDifferential.D ℚ (ReesAlg Φ) y ∈ W →
      KaehlerDifferential.D ℚ (ReesAlg Φ) (x * y) ∈ W := fun x y hx hy => by
    rw [Derivation.leibniz]; exact W.add_mem (W.smul_mem _ hy) (W.smul_mem _ hx)
  have hpow : ∀ (x : ReesAlg Φ) (k : ℕ), KaehlerDifferential.D ℚ (ReesAlg Φ) x ∈ W →
      KaehlerDifferential.D ℚ (ReesAlg Φ) (x ^ k) ∈ W := fun x k hx => by
    rw [Derivation.leibniz_pow]; exact nsmul_mem (W.smul_mem _ hx) _
  have hprod : ∀ (s : Finset (Fin n)) (g : Fin n → ReesAlg Φ),
      (∀ i ∈ s, KaehlerDifferential.D ℚ (ReesAlg Φ) (g i) ∈ W) →
      KaehlerDifferential.D ℚ (ReesAlg Φ) (∏ i ∈ s, g i) ∈ W := by
    intro s g hg
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => rw [Finset.prod_empty, Derivation.map_one_eq_zero]; exact W.zero_mem
    | insert a s ha ih =>
      rw [Finset.prod_insert ha]
      exact hmul _ _ (hg a (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _))
        (ih fun i hi => hg i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))
  
  have hB : ∀ b : B, KaehlerDifferential.D ℚ (ReesAlg Φ) (algebraMap B (ReesAlg Φ) b) ∈ W := by
    intro b
    have h1 : KaehlerDifferential.D ℚ (ReesAlg Φ) (algebraMap B (ReesAlg Φ) b) =
        KaehlerDifferential.map ℚ ℚ B (ReesAlg Φ) (KaehlerDifferential.D ℚ B b) :=
      (KaehlerDifferential.map_D ℚ ℚ B (ReesAlg Φ) b).symm
    rw [h1, c.kD_eq_sum b, map_sum]
    refine W.sum_mem fun i _ => ?_
    rw [map_smul, KaehlerDifferential.map_D, ← algebraMap_smul (ReesAlg Φ) (c.d i b)]
    refine W.smul_mem _ ?_
    rw [reesX_castSucc_mul_pow c hF he hd hw i]
    exact hmul _ _ (hX _) (hpow _ _ (hX _))
  
  have hdq : (0 : ℚ) < d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have hhom : ∀ (j : ℤ) (f : B) (hf : LaurentPolynomial.C f * T j ∈ ReesAlg Φ),
      f ∈ Φ.F j → KaehlerDifferential.D ℚ (ReesAlg Φ) ⟨_, hf⟩ ∈ W := by
    intro j f hf hfF
    by_cases hj : j ≤ 0
    · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k : ℕ, j = -(k : ℤ) := ⟨(-j).toNat, by omega⟩
      have : (⟨_, hf⟩ : ReesAlg Φ) = algebraMap B (ReesAlg Φ) f *
          reesX c hF he hd hw (Fin.last n) ^ k := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        show LaurentPolynomial.C f * T j = _
        rw [Subalgebra.coe_mul, SubmonoidClass.coe_pow, reesX_last, T_pow,
          Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap, ← LaurentPolynomial.C_eq_algebraMap, hk]
        congr 2; ring
      rw [this]; exact hmul _ _ (hB f) (hpow _ _ (hX _))
    · 
      have hmemF : ∀ x ∈ Submodule.span B {f | ∃ α : Fin n →₀ ℕ, (∀ i, e i = 0 → α i = 0) ∧
          ((j : ℚ) / d) ≤ lam e α ∧ f = ∏ i, c.x i ^ α i}, x ∈ Φ.F j := fun x hx => by
        rw [hF, chartFil, Chart.RF]; exact hx
      rw [hF, chartFil, Chart.RF] at hfF
      revert hf
      induction hfF using Submodule.span_induction with
      | mem g hg =>
        intro hf
        obtain ⟨α, hα0, hαt, rfl⟩ := hg
        have hwα : (j : ℤ) ≤ Finsupp.weight w α := by
          have hlamw : lam e α = (Finsupp.weight w α : ℚ) / d := by
            rw [lam, Finsupp.weight_eq_sum, eq_div_iff hdq.ne']
            push_cast
            rw [Finset.sum_mul]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
            rw [smul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_mul, hw i]; ring
          rw [hlamw, div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hdq] at hαt
          exact_mod_cast hαt
        obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m : ℕ, (Finsupp.weight w α : ℤ) - j = m := ⟨_, (Int.toNat_of_nonneg
          (by omega)).symm⟩
        have : (⟨_, hf⟩ : ReesAlg Φ) = (∏ i, reesX c hF he hd hw (Fin.castSucc i) ^ α i) *
            reesX c hF he hd hw (Fin.last n) ^ m := by
          apply Subtype.ext
          show LaurentPolynomial.C (∏ i, c.x i ^ α i) * T j = _
          rw [Subalgebra.coe_mul, SubmonoidClass.coe_pow, reesX_last, T_pow,
            SubmonoidClass.coe_finsetProd]
          simp only [SubmonoidClass.coe_pow, reesX_castSucc, mul_pow, T_pow, ← map_pow]
          rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib, ← map_prod, prod_T_eq, mul_assoc, ← T_add]
          congr 2
          have : ((Finsupp.weight w α : ℕ) : ℤ) = ∑ i, ((α i : ℕ) : ℤ) * ((w i : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
            rw [Finsupp.weight_eq_sum]; push_cast; rfl
          linarith
        rw [this]
        exact hmul _ _ (hprod _ _ fun i _ => hpow _ _ (hX _)) (hpow _ _ (hX _))
      | zero =>
        intro hf
        have : (⟨_, hf⟩ : ReesAlg Φ) = 0 := Subtype.ext (by simp)
        rw [this, map_zero]; exact W.zero_mem
      | add x y hx hy ihx ihy =>
        intro hf
        have hxR : LaurentPolynomial.C x * T j ∈ ReesAlg Φ := C_mul_T_mem_ReesAlg (hmemF x hx)
        have hyR : LaurentPolynomial.C y * T j ∈ ReesAlg Φ := C_mul_T_mem_ReesAlg (hmemF y hy)
        have : (⟨_, hf⟩ : ReesAlg Φ) = ⟨_, hxR⟩ + ⟨_, hyR⟩ :=
          Subtype.ext (by show LaurentPolynomial.C (x + y) * T j = _; rw [map_add, add_mul]; rfl)
        rw [this, map_add]; exact W.add_mem (ihx hxR) (ihy hyR)
      | smul a x hx ih =>
        intro hf
        have hxR : LaurentPolynomial.C x * T j ∈ ReesAlg Φ := C_mul_T_mem_ReesAlg (hmemF x hx)
        have : (⟨_, hf⟩ : ReesAlg Φ) = algebraMap B (ReesAlg Φ) a * ⟨_, hxR⟩ :=
          Subtype.ext (by
            show LaurentPolynomial.C (a • x) * T j = _
            rw [Subalgebra.coe_mul, Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap, ← LaurentPolynomial.C_eq_algebraMap,
              smul_eq_mul, map_mul, mul_assoc])
        rw [this]; exact hmul _ _ (hB a) (ih hxR)
  
  rw [eq_top_iff, ← KaehlerDifferential.span_range_derivation, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨p, rfl⟩
  have hdecomp : p = ∑ j ∈ (p : B[T;T⁻¹]).coeff.support,
      (⟨LaurentPolynomial.C ((p : B[T;T⁻¹]).coeff j) * T j,
        C_mul_T_mem_ReesAlg (p.2 j)⟩ : ReesAlg Φ) := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [AddSubmonoidClass.coe_finsetSum]
    conv_lhs => rw [← AddMonoidAlgebra.sum_coeff_single (p : B[T;T⁻¹])]
    rw [Finsupp.sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    rw [single_eq_C_mul_T]
  rw [hdecomp, map_sum]
  exact W.sum_mem fun j _ => hhom j _ _ (p.2 j)

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.reesChart_x
statement: @[simp] lemma reesChart_x : (reesChart c hF he hd hw).x = reesX c hF he hd hw
proof: := rfl

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.reesChart_d
statement: @[simp] lemma reesChart_d : (reesChart c hF he hd hw).d = reesDer c hF he hd hw
proof: := rfl

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.vtx_surjective
statement:
lemma vtx_surjective (hpos : ∀ j : ℤ, 0 < j → Φ.F j ≤ maximalIdeal B) :
    Function.Surjective (vtx hpos)
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := residue_surjective a
  refine ⟨algebraMap B (ReesAlg Φ) b, ?_⟩
  show residue B ((algebraMap B B[T;T⁻¹] b).coeff 0) = residue B b
  rw [← LaurentPolynomial.C_eq_algebraMap, C_apply, ite_eq_left rfl]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.mem_vertex
statement:
lemma mem_vertex (hpos : ∀ j : ℤ, 0 < j → Φ.F j ≤ maximalIdeal B) (p : ReesAlg Φ) :
    p ∈ vertex hpos ↔ (p : B[T;T⁻¹]).coeff 0 ∈ maximalIdeal B
proof:
:= by
  rw [vertex, RingHom.mem_ker]
  exact residue_eq_zero_iff _

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.rees_decomp
statement:
lemma rees_decomp (p : ReesAlg Φ) : p = ∑ j ∈ (p : B[T;T⁻¹]).coeff.support,
    (⟨LaurentPolynomial.C ((p : B[T;T⁻¹]).coeff j) * T j,
      C_mul_T_mem_ReesAlg (p.2 j)⟩ : ReesAlg Φ)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [AddSubmonoidClass.coe_finsetSum]
  conv_lhs => rw [← AddMonoidAlgebra.sum_coeff_single (p : B[T;T⁻¹])]
  rw [Finsupp.sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  rw [single_eq_C_mul_T]

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.weight_ge_of_mem
statement:
lemma weight_ge_of_mem {α : Fin n →₀ ℕ} {j : ℤ} (hαt : ((j : ℚ) / d) ≤ lam e α) :
    (j : ℤ) ≤ Finsupp.weight w α
proof:
:= by
  have hdq : (0 : ℚ) < d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have hlamw : lam e α = (Finsupp.weight w α : ℚ) / d := by
    rw [lam, Finsupp.weight_eq_sum, eq_div_iff hdq.ne']
    push_cast
    rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [smul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_mul, hw i]; ring
  rw [hlamw, div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hdq] at hαt
  exact_mod_cast hαt

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.rees_mono_eq
statement:
lemma rees_mono_eq (α : Fin n →₀ ℕ) (j : ℤ) (m : ℕ) (hm : (Finsupp.weight w α : ℤ) - j = m)
    (hf : LaurentPolynomial.C (∏ i, c.x i ^ α i) * T j ∈ ReesAlg Φ) :
    (⟨_, hf⟩ : ReesAlg Φ) = (∏ i, reesX c hF he hd hw (Fin.castSucc i) ^ α i) *
      reesX c hF he hd hw (Fin.last n) ^ m
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  show LaurentPolynomial.C (∏ i, c.x i ^ α i) * T j = _
  rw [Subalgebra.coe_mul, SubmonoidClass.coe_pow, reesX_last, T_pow,
    SubmonoidClass.coe_finsetProd]
  simp only [SubmonoidClass.coe_pow, reesX_castSucc, mul_pow, T_pow, ← map_pow]
  rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib, ← map_prod, prod_T_eq, mul_assoc, ← T_add]
  congr 2
  have : ((Finsupp.weight w α : ℕ) : ℤ) = ∑ i, ((α i : ℕ) : ℤ) * ((w i : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
    rw [Finsupp.weight_eq_sum]; push_cast; rfl
  linarith

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.rees_adjoin
statement: theorem rees_adjoin : Algebra.adjoin B (Set.range (reesX c hF he hd hw)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set G := Algebra.adjoin B (Set.range (reesX c hF he hd hw))
  have hX : ∀ i, reesX c hF he hd hw i ∈ G := fun i => Algebra.subset_adjoin ⟨i, rfl⟩
  have hhom : ∀ (j : ℤ) (f : B) (hf : LaurentPolynomial.C f * T j ∈ ReesAlg Φ),
      f ∈ Φ.F j → (⟨_, hf⟩ : ReesAlg Φ) ∈ G := by
    intro j f hf hfF
    by_cases hj : j ≤ 0
    · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k : ℕ, j = -(k : ℤ) := ⟨(-j).toNat, by omega⟩
      have : (⟨_, hf⟩ : ReesAlg Φ) = algebraMap B (ReesAlg Φ) f *
          reesX c hF he hd hw (Fin.last n) ^ k := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        show LaurentPolynomial.C f * T j = _
        rw [Subalgebra.coe_mul, SubmonoidClass.coe_pow, reesX_last, T_pow,
          Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap, ← LaurentPolynomial.C_eq_algebraMap, hk]
        congr 2; ring
      rw [this]; exact G.mul_mem (G.algebraMap_mem f) (G.pow_mem (hX _) _)
    · have hmemF : ∀ x ∈ Submodule.span B {f | ∃ α : Fin n →₀ ℕ, (∀ i, e i = 0 → α i = 0) ∧
          ((j : ℚ) / d) ≤ lam e α ∧ f = ∏ i, c.x i ^ α i}, x ∈ Φ.F j := fun x hx => by
        rw [hF, chartFil, Chart.RF]; exact hx
      rw [hF, chartFil, Chart.RF] at hfF
      revert hf
      induction hfF using Submodule.span_induction with
      | mem g hg =>
        intro hf
        obtain ⟨α, hα0, hαt, rfl⟩ := hg
        have hwα := weight_ge_of_mem hd hw hαt
        obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m : ℕ, (Finsupp.weight w α : ℤ) - j = m :=
          ⟨_, (Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)).symm⟩
        rw [rees_mono_eq c hF he hd hw α j m hm hf]
        exact G.mul_mem (G.prod_mem fun i _ => G.pow_mem (hX _) _) (G.pow_mem (hX _) _)
      | zero =>
        intro hf
        have : (⟨_, hf⟩ : ReesAlg Φ) = 0 := Subtype.ext (by simp)
        rw [this]; exact G.zero_mem
      | add x y hx hy ihx ihy =>
        intro hf
        have hxR : LaurentPolynomial.C x * T j ∈ ReesAlg Φ := C_mul_T_mem_ReesAlg (hmemF x hx)
        have hyR : LaurentPolynomial.C y * T j ∈ ReesAlg Φ := C_mul_T_mem_ReesAlg (hmemF y hy)
        have : (⟨_, hf⟩ : ReesAlg Φ) = ⟨_, hxR⟩ + ⟨_, hyR⟩ :=
          Subtype.ext (by show LaurentPolynomial.C (x + y) * T j = _; rw [map_add, add_mul]; rfl)
        rw [this]; exact G.add_mem (ihx hxR) (ihy hyR)
      | smul a x hx ih =>
        intro hf
        have hxR : LaurentPolynomial.C x * T j ∈ ReesAlg Φ := C_mul_T_mem_ReesAlg (hmemF x hx)
        have : (⟨_, hf⟩ : ReesAlg Φ) = algebraMap B (ReesAlg Φ) a * ⟨_, hxR⟩ :=
          Subtype.ext (by
            show LaurentPolynomial.C (a • x) * T j = _
            rw [Subalgebra.coe_mul, Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap, ← LaurentPolynomial.C_eq_algebraMap,
              smul_eq_mul, map_mul, mul_assoc])
        rw [this]; exact G.mul_mem (G.algebraMap_mem a) (ih hxR)
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  intro p _
  rw [rees_decomp p]
  exact G.sum_mem fun j _ => hhom j _ _ (p.2 j)

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.rees_finiteType
statement: theorem rees_finiteType : Algebra.FiniteType B (ReesAlg Φ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact ⟨⟨Finset.univ.image (reesX c hF he hd hw), by
    rw [Finset.coe_image, Finset.coe_univ, Set.image_univ, rees_adjoin]⟩⟩

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.fil_pos_le
statement: lemma fil_pos_le (hc : c.IsCentred) : ∀ j : ℤ, 0 < j → Φ.F j ≤ maximalIdeal B
proof:
:= by
  intro j hj
  rw [hF, chartFil]
  exact hc.RF_le_maximalIdeal (div_pos (by exact_mod_cast hj) (by exact_mod_cast hd))

name: BezoutCounterexample.Principalization.vertex_eq_span
statement:
theorem vertex_eq_span (hc : c.IsCentred) :
    vertex (fil_pos_le c hF hd hc) = Ideal.span (Set.range (reesX c hF he hd hw))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set V := Ideal.span (Set.range (reesX c hF he hd hw)) with hVdef
  have hX : ∀ i, reesX c hF he hd hw i ∈ V := fun i => Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro p hp
    rw [mem_vertex] at hp
    rw [rees_decomp p]
    refine Ideal.sum_mem _ fun j _ => ?_
    have hpj := p.2 j
    rcases lt_trichotomy j 0 with hj | hj | hj
    · 
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k : ℕ, j = -((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) := ⟨(-j).toNat - 1, by omega⟩
      have : (⟨_, C_mul_T_mem_ReesAlg hpj⟩ : ReesAlg Φ) =
          algebraMap B (ReesAlg Φ) ((p : B[T;T⁻¹]).coeff j) *
            reesX c hF he hd hw (Fin.last n) ^ k * reesX c hF he hd hw (Fin.last n) := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        show LaurentPolynomial.C ((p : B[T;T⁻¹]).coeff j) * T j = _
        rw [Subalgebra.coe_mul, Subalgebra.coe_mul, SubmonoidClass.coe_pow, reesX_last, T_pow,
          Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap, ← LaurentPolynomial.C_eq_algebraMap, mul_assoc, ← T_add, hk]
        congr 2; push_cast; ring
      rw [this]; exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (hX _)
    · 
      subst hj
      have h0 : (p : B[T;T⁻¹]).coeff 0 ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range c.x) := by rw [← hc]; exact hp
      have : (⟨_, C_mul_T_mem_ReesAlg hpj⟩ : ReesAlg Φ) =
          algebraMap B (ReesAlg Φ) ((p : B[T;T⁻¹]).coeff 0) := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        show LaurentPolynomial.C ((p : B[T;T⁻¹]).coeff 0) * T 0 = _
        rw [T_zero, mul_one, Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap, LaurentPolynomial.C_eq_algebraMap]
      rw [this]
      have hmap : Ideal.map (algebraMap B (ReesAlg Φ)) (Ideal.span (Set.range c.x)) ≤ V := by
        rw [Ideal.map_span, Ideal.span_le]
        rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨i, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
        rw [reesX_castSucc_mul_pow c hF he hd hw i]
        exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (hX _)
      exact hmap (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ h0)
    · 
      have hmemF : ∀ x ∈ Submodule.span B {f | ∃ α : Fin n →₀ ℕ, (∀ i, e i = 0 → α i = 0) ∧
          ((j : ℚ) / d) ≤ lam e α ∧ f = ∏ i, c.x i ^ α i}, x ∈ Φ.F j := fun x hx => by
        rw [hF, chartFil, Chart.RF]; exact hx
      have hmem : (p : B[T;T⁻¹]).coeff j ∈ Submodule.span B {f | ∃ α : Fin n →₀ ℕ,
          (∀ i, e i = 0 → α i = 0) ∧ ((j : ℚ) / d) ≤ lam e α ∧ f = ∏ i, c.x i ^ α i} := by
        have := hpj; rw [hF, chartFil, Chart.RF] at this; exact this
      generalize C_mul_T_mem_ReesAlg hpj = hf
      revert hf
      generalize (p : B[T;T⁻¹]).coeff j = q at hmem ⊢
      induction hmem using Submodule.span_induction with
      | mem g hg =>
        intro hf
        obtain ⟨α, hα0, hαt, rfl⟩ := hg
        have hwα := weight_ge_of_mem hd hw hαt
        obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m : ℕ, (Finsupp.weight w α : ℤ) - j = m :=
          ⟨_, (Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)).symm⟩
        rw [rees_mono_eq c hF he hd hw α j m hm hf]
        refine Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ ?_
        obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, α i ≠ 0 := by
          by_contra h; push Not at h
          have : Finsupp.weight w α = 0 := by
            rw [Finsupp.weight_eq_sum]; exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => by rw [h i, zero_smul]
          omega
        have hdvd : reesX c hF he hd hw (Fin.castSucc i) ∣
            ∏ l, reesX c hF he hd hw (Fin.castSucc l) ^ α l :=
          (dvd_pow_self _ hi).trans (Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ i))
        obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hdvd
        rw [hr]; exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (hX _)
      | zero =>
        intro hf
        have : (⟨_, hf⟩ : ReesAlg Φ) = 0 := Subtype.ext (by simp)
